########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAdaptiveGaussianQueryNoiseV1.lean (89 dong)
import «LeanD6AdaptiveLikelihoodV1»

/-! Concentration for the noise accumulated by one predictably selected query.
Normalization is proved from actual adaptive Gaussian transitions, including
random counts. No independence of the selected observations is assumed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveGaussianQueryNoise
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveLikelihood CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

def exponential (theta count noise : ℝ) := Real.exp (theta*noise-theta^2*count/2)

lemma selected_increment (theta count noise m y : ℝ) (pick : Bool) :
    exponential theta (count+if pick then 1 else 0) (noise+if pick then y-m else 0)=
      exponential theta count noise*likelihood m (m+if pick then theta else 0) y := by
  unfold exponential likelihood
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  cases pick <;> simp <;> ring

/-- Exact exponential normalization for a query selected from the adaptive
history. The count and residual accumulator are updated only when selected. -/
theorem query_noise_normalization
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (m : ℕ → H → ℝ) (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (m t))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (pick : ℕ → H → Bool) (count noise : ℕ → H → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ t,Measurable (count t)) (hs : ∀ t,Measurable (noise t))
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ h ∂initial (),count 0 h=0 ∧ noise 0 h=0)
    (hcount : ∀ t h y,count (t+1) (update t (h,y))=count t h+if pick t h then 1 else 0)
    (hnoise : ∀ t h y,noise (t+1) (update t (h,y))=noise t h+if pick t h then y-m t h else 0)
    (theta : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (exponential theta (count N h) (noise N h))
      ∂trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N ())=1 := by
  apply adaptive_likelihood_normalization initial m
    (fun t h => m t h+if pick t h then theta else 0) hm update hu
    (fun t h => exponential theta (count t h) (noise t h))
  · intro t
    unfold exponential
    exact ((measurable_const.mul (hs t)).sub (measurable_const.mul (hc t) |>.div_const 2)).exp
  · intro t h; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _h, (1:ENNReal) ∂initial () := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hzero] with h hh
        simp [exponential,hh.1,hh.2]
      _ = 1 := by simp
  · intro t h y
    rw [hcount,hnoise]
    exact selected_increment theta (count t h) (noise t h) (m t h) y (pick t h)

/-- Markov's bound for the normalized exponential, retaining the random count. -/
theorem normalized_exponential_tail (P : Measure H) (count noise : H → ℝ)
    (hc : Measurable count) (hs : Measurable noise) (theta b : ℝ)
    (hn : (∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (exponential theta (count h) (noise h)) ∂P)=1) :
    P {h | b ≤ theta*noise h-theta^2*count h/2} ≤ 1/ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp b) := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun h => ENNReal.ofReal (exponential theta (count h) (noise h))) := by
    unfold exponential
    fun_prop
  have hh := meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (μ := P) hm.aemeasurable
    (show ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp b) ≠ 0 by simp [Real.exp_pos]) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  rw [hn] at hh
  apply le_trans (measure_mono ?_) hh
  intro h he
  change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp b) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (exponential theta (count h) (noise h))
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he)

/-- A count slice has the Gaussian Chernoff exponent despite adaptive selection.
The premise is the exponential identity proved by query_noise_normalization. -/
theorem count_slice_tail (P : Measure H) (count noise : H → ℝ)
    (hc : Measurable count) (hs : Measurable noise) (k x : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hn : ∀ theta,(∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (exponential theta (count h) (noise h)) ∂P)=1) :
    P {h | count h=k ∧ x ≤ noise h} ≤ 1/ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (x^2/(2*k))) := by
  apply le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (normalized_exponential_tail P count noise hc hs (x/k) _ (hn _))
  intro h he
  change x^2/(2*k) ≤ (x/k)*noise h-(x/k)^2*count h/2
  rw [he.1]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he.2 (div_nonneg hx hk.le)
  have hid : (x/k)*x-(x/k)^2*k/2=x^2/(2*k) := by field_simp; ring
  linarith only [hm,hid]

#print axioms selected_increment
#print axioms query_noise_normalization
#print axioms normalized_exponential_tail
#print axioms count_slice_tail
end
end CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveGaussianQueryNoise

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAdaptivePathAbsorptionV1.lean (79 dong)
import «LeanAdaptivePathLawV1»
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Continuity

/-! Absorption on the canonical path follows from the one-step kernels.
No persistence assumption is imposed on impossible sequences of states. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.AdaptivePathAbsorption
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Finset Function Preorder
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptivePathLaw CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

theorem path_step_absorbing (initial : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)]
    (bad : Set H) (hbad : MeasurableSet bad)
    (absorb : ∀ t h,h ∈ bad → ∀ᵐ h' ∂step t h,h' ∈ bad) (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂path initial step,omega N ∈ bad → omega (N+1) ∈ bad := by
  let pred : (Finset.Iic N → H) × H → Prop :=
    fun x => x.1 ⟨N,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩ ∈ bad → x.2 ∈ bad
  have hp : MeasurableSet {x | pred x} := by
    have h1 := hbad.preimage
      (show Measurable (fun x : (Finset.Iic N → H) × H => x.1 ⟨N,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩) by fun_prop)
    have h2 := hbad.preimage (measurable_snd : Measurable (Prod.snd : (Finset.Iic N → H) × H → H))
    convert h1.compl.union h2 using 1
    ext x
    simp only [pred,mem_setOf_eq,mem_union,mem_compl_iff,Set.mem_preimage]
    tauto
  have hh : ∀ᵐ x ∂((path initial step).map (frestrictLe N) ⊗ₘ historyStep step N),pred x := by
    apply Measure.ae_compProd_of_ae_ae hp
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro h
    rw [historyStep,Kernel.comp_deterministic_eq_comap,Kernel.comap_apply]
    by_cases hb : h ⟨N,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩ ∈ bad
    · exact (absorb N _ hb).mono (fun _ hb' => fun _ => hb')
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => fun hh => False.elim (hb hh))
  have he := Kernel.map_frestrictLe_trajMeasure_compProd_eq_map_trajMeasure
    (X := fun _ => H) (μ₀ := initial) (κ := historyStep step) (a := N)
  change (path initial step).map (frestrictLe N) ⊗ₘ historyStep step N =
    (path initial step).map (fun x => (frestrictLe N x,x (N+1))) at he
  rw [he] at hh
  exact (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) hp).mp hh

theorem path_absorbing (initial : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)]
    (bad : Set H) (hbad : MeasurableSet bad)
    (absorb : ∀ t h,h ∈ bad → ∀ᵐ h' ∂step t h,h' ∈ bad) :
    ∀ᵐ omega ∂path initial step,∀ N,omega N ∈ bad → omega (N+1) ∈ bad := by
  exact ae_all_iff.mpr (fun N => path_step_absorbing initial step bad hbad absorb N)

/-- The uniform finite-time bound becomes an anytime bound on the actual path.
Both the marginal laws and almost-sure absorption are derived here. -/
theorem anytime_from_actual_marginals (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)]
    (bad : Set H) (hbad : MeasurableSet bad)
    (absorb : ∀ t h,h ∈ bad → ∀ᵐ h' ∂step t h,h' ∈ bad)
    (delta : ENNReal) (hbound : ∀ N,trajectory initial step N () bad ≤ delta) :
    path (initial ()) step {omega | ∃ N,omega N ∈ bad} ≤ delta := by
  let P := path (initial ()) step
  let good := {omega : ℕ → H | ∀ N,omega N ∈ bad → omega (N+1) ∈ bad}
  let F := fun N => {omega : ℕ → H | omega ∈ good ∧ omega N ∈ bad}
  have hg : ∀ᵐ omega ∂P,omega ∈ good := path_absorbing (initial ()) step bad hbad absorb
  have hmono : Monotone F := by
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro t omega hw
    exact ⟨hw.1,hw.1 t hw.2⟩
  have he : {omega | ∃ N,omega N ∈ bad} =ᵐ[P] ⋃ N,F N := by
    filter_upwards [hg] with omega hw
    simp [F,hw]
  rw [show path (initial ()) step=P from rfl,measure_congr he,hmono.measure_iUnion]
  apply iSup_le
  intro N
  have hm := (actual_path_marginals initial step N).measure_eq (p := fun h => h ∈ bad) hbad
  exact (measure_mono (show F N ⊆ {omega | omega N ∈ bad} from fun _ h => h.2)).trans
    (hm.le.trans (hbound N))

#print axioms path_step_absorbing
#print axioms path_absorbing
#print axioms anytime_from_actual_marginals
end
end CIGAMF.P13.AdaptivePathAbsorption

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAdaptivePathLawV1.lean (76 dong)
import «LeanAdaptiveTranscriptKernelV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.IonescuTulcea.Traj
import Mathlib.Probability.HasLaw

/-! A single infinite path probability space for the actual finite-step kernel
recursion. The finite-horizon marginals are proved, not supplied as premises. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.AdaptivePathLaw
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Finset Function Preorder
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

def historyStep (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) (t : ℕ) : Kernel (Finset.Iic t → H) H :=
  step t ∘ₖ Kernel.deterministic (fun h => h ⟨t,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩) (by fun_prop)

instance historyStepMarkov (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] (t : ℕ) :
    IsMarkovKernel (historyStep step t) := by unfold historyStep; infer_instance

def path (initial : Measure H) (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] :
    Measure (ℕ → H) := Kernel.trajMeasure initial (historyStep step)

instance pathProbability (initial : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] : IsProbabilityMeasure (path initial step) := by
  unfold path
  infer_instance

lemma path_initial (initial : Measure H) (step : ℕ → Kernel H H)
    [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] : (path initial step).map (fun h => h 0)=initial := by
  have hfun : (fun h : ℕ → H => h 0) =
      (fun h : Finset.Iic 0 → H => h ⟨0,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩) ∘ frestrictLe 0 := rfl
  rw [path,Kernel.trajMeasure,Measure.map_comp _ _ (measurable_pi_apply _),hfun,
    Kernel.map_comp_right _ (measurable_frestrictLe 0) (measurable_pi_apply _),Kernel.traj_map_frestrictLe,
    Kernel.partialTraj_self]
  rw [Kernel.id_map (measurable_pi_apply _),Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have he : ((fun h : Finset.Iic 0 → H => h ⟨0,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩) ∘
      (MeasurableEquiv.piUnique (fun _ : Finset.Iic 0 => H)).symm) = id := by
    funext h
    simp [MeasurableEquiv.piUnique,Equiv.piUnique]
  rw [he,Measure.map_id]

lemma path_step (initial : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] (N : ℕ) :
    (path initial step).map (fun h => h (N+1))=
      step N ∘ₘ (path initial step).map (fun h => h N) := by
  have he := Kernel.map_frestrictLe_trajMeasure_compProd_eq_map_trajMeasure
    (X := fun _ => H) (μ₀ := initial) (κ := historyStep step) (a := N)
  have hs := congrArg (fun P => Measure.map Prod.snd P) he
  change ((path initial step).map (frestrictLe N) ⊗ₘ historyStep step N).snd = _ at hs
  rw [Measure.snd_compProd,Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)] at hs
  change historyStep step N ∘ₘ (path initial step).map (frestrictLe N) =
    (path initial step).map (fun h => h (N+1)) at hs
  rw [← hs,historyStep,← Measure.comp_assoc,Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
  have hm := Measure.map_map (μ := path initial step)
    (measurable_pi_apply (⟨N,Finset.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩ : Finset.Iic N))
    (measurable_frestrictLe N)
  rw [hm]
  rfl

/-- Every finite transcript state distribution is the marginal of one actual
infinite path measure, including a randomized initial state. -/
theorem actual_path_marginals (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) [∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (step t)] (N : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (fun h : ℕ → H => h N) (trajectory initial step N ()) (path (initial ()) step) := by
  refine ⟨(measurable_pi_apply N).aemeasurable,?_⟩
  induction N with
  | zero => exact path_initial (initial ()) step
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [path_step,ih]
    rfl

#print axioms path_initial
#print axioms path_step
#print axioms actual_path_marginals
end
end CIGAMF.P13.AdaptivePathLaw

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAdaptiveResourceMapV1.lean (52 dong)
import «LeanAdaptiveTranscriptKernelV1»

/-! Independent per-observation randomization commutes with finite products.
Used to remove the ancillary Gaussian noise from the D6 resource experiment. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveResourceMap
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {X Y : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]

def mapSamples (κ : Kernel X Y) : (N : ℕ) → Kernel (Samples X N) (Samples Y N)
  | 0 => Kernel.id
  | N+1 => mapSamples κ N ∥ₖ κ

instance mapSamplesMarkov (κ : Kernel X Y) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (N : ℕ) :
    IsMarkovKernel (mapSamples κ N) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (IsMarkovKernel (Kernel.id : Kernel Unit Unit))
  | succ N ih =>
    letI := ih
    change IsMarkovKernel (mapSamples κ N ∥ₖ κ)
    infer_instance

/-- Exact product-law identity for arbitrary independent randomization channels. -/
theorem resource_map (κ : Kernel X Y) [IsMarkovKernel κ]
    (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (N : ℕ) :
    mapSamples κ N ∘ₖ resource P N = resource (κ ∘ₘ P) N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Kernel.id_comp _
  | succ N ih =>
    change (mapSamples κ N ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₖ (resource P N ×ₖ Kernel.const Unit P) =
      resource (κ ∘ₘ P) N ×ₖ Kernel.const Unit (κ ∘ₘ P)
    rw [Kernel.parallelComp_comp_prod,ih,Kernel.comp_const]

/-- Transfer any simulation based on augmented observations back to the
original observations; no unknown parameter enters the constructed kernel. -/
theorem remove_ancillary {Θ H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]
    (κ : Kernel X Y) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (P : Θ → Measure X)
    [∀ θ,IsProbabilityMeasure (P θ)] (N : ℕ)
    (K : Kernel (Samples Y N) H) [IsMarkovKernel K]
    (target : Θ → Kernel Unit H)
    (h : ∀ θ,K ∘ₖ resource (κ ∘ₘ P θ) N=target θ) :
    ∃ L : Kernel (Samples X N) H, IsMarkovKernel L ∧
      ∀ θ,L ∘ₖ resource (P θ) N=target θ := by
  refine ⟨K ∘ₖ mapSamples κ N,inferInstance,?_⟩
  intro θ
  rw [Kernel.comp_assoc,resource_map,h]

#print axioms resource_map
#print axioms remove_ancillary
end
end CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveResourceMap

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAdaptiveTranscriptKernelV1.lean (111 dong)
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Composition.MeasureComp
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Composition.KernelLemmas
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Composition.Prod
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Exact finite-horizon simulation in probability kernels. A state may retain
all past query labels, observations, and an independent policy seed. The
simulator is constructed without the unknown-parameter resource law. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable section

/-- Nested product of N observations, including a singleton at N=0. -/
@[reducible] def Samples (X : Type) : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => Unit
  | n+1 => Samples X n × X

instance samplesMeasurable (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] :
    (n : ℕ) → MeasurableSpace (Samples X n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (MeasurableSpace Unit)
  | n+1 => @Prod.instMeasurableSpace (Samples X n) X (samplesMeasurable X n) inferInstance

variable {X : Type} {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace H]

/-- N independent resource observations, as a kernel from a singleton. -/
def resource (P : Measure X) : (n : ℕ) → Kernel Unit (Samples X n)
  | 0 => Kernel.id
  | n+1 => resource P n ×ₖ Kernel.const Unit P

instance resourceMarkov (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n : ℕ) :
    IsMarkovKernel (resource P n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (IsMarkovKernel (Kernel.id : Kernel Unit Unit))
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    change IsMarkovKernel (resource P n ×ₖ Kernel.const Unit P)
    infer_instance

/-- Real state/transcript distribution after N successive transition kernels. -/
def trajectory (initial : Kernel Unit H) (step : ℕ → Kernel H H) : ℕ → Kernel Unit H
  | 0 => initial
  | n+1 => step n ∘ₖ trajectory initial step n

/-- Parameter-free simulator: at each step use the previous simulated state
and one fresh resource observation. -/
def simulator (initial : Kernel Unit H) (sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × X) H) :
    (n : ℕ) → Kernel (Samples X n) H
  | 0 => initial
  | n+1 => sim n ∘ₖ (simulator initial sim n ∥ₖ Kernel.id)

instance simulatorMarkov (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × X) H) [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (sim n)] (n : ℕ) :
    IsMarkovKernel (simulator initial sim n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (IsMarkovKernel initial)
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    change IsMarkovKernel (sim n ∘ₖ (simulator initial sim n ∥ₖ Kernel.id))
    infer_instance

/-- One actual transition simulated from a fresh observation with law P. -/
def feed (P : Measure X) (sim : Kernel (H × X) H) : Kernel H H :=
  sim ∘ₖ (Kernel.id ×ₖ Kernel.const H P)

/-- Exact full-state law, not just the marginal distribution of each response. -/
theorem transcript_simulation (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × X) H) [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (sim n)]
    (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (step : ℕ → Kernel H H)
    (hstep : ∀ n, step n = feed P (sim n)) (N : ℕ) :
    simulator initial sim N ∘ₖ resource P N = trajectory initial step N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Kernel.comp_id initial
  | succ N ih =>
    haveI : IsMarkovKernel (trajectory initial step N) := by
      rw [← ih]
      infer_instance
    simp only [simulator,resource,trajectory]
    rw [Kernel.comp_assoc,Kernel.parallelComp_comp_prod,Kernel.id_comp,ih]
    rw [hstep N]
    simp only [feed,Kernel.comp_assoc]
    rw [Kernel.prod_const_comp,Kernel.id_comp]

/-- The same simulator works simultaneously for every parameter. In particular
it is not allowed to change with the true parameter or the tested side. -/
theorem uniform_transcript_simulation {Θ : Type*}
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × X) H) [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (sim n)]
    (P : Θ → Measure X) [∀ θ, IsProbabilityMeasure (P θ)]
    (step : Θ → ℕ → Kernel H H)
    (hstep : ∀ θ n, step θ n = feed (P θ) (sim n)) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : Kernel (Samples X N) H, IsMarkovKernel K ∧
      ∀ θ, K ∘ₖ resource (P θ) N = trajectory initial (step θ) N := by
  refine ⟨simulator initial sim N,inferInstance,?_⟩
  intro θ
  exact transcript_simulation initial sim (P θ) (step θ) (hstep θ) N

/-- A terminal randomized decision remains a garbling of the resource samples. -/
theorem terminal_simulation {D : Type*} [MeasurableSpace D]
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × X) H) [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (sim n)]
    (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (step : ℕ → Kernel H H)
    (hstep : ∀ n, step n = feed P (sim n)) (decision : Kernel H D) (N : ℕ) :
    (decision ∘ₖ simulator initial sim N) ∘ₖ resource P N =
      decision ∘ₖ trajectory initial step N := by
  rw [Kernel.comp_assoc,transcript_simulation initial sim P step hstep N]

#print axioms transcript_simulation
#print axioms uniform_transcript_simulation
#print axioms terminal_simulation
end
end CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanAuxiliaryBH6StructuralV4.lean (296 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanSupportGeometryV4»
import «LeanStructuralRankabilityV4»

/-! Auxiliary support-geometry and structural results.  The operational
MASTER is imported unchanged. -/

namespace CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural

open scoped BigOperators
open SupportGeometry
open StructuralRankability

variable {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

noncomputable def globalE (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ePlus Finset.univ f + eMinus Finset.univ f

private theorem maxGap_nonneg (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (j : ι) (a : Ω) :
    0 ≤ componentMax f j - f j a := by
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (le_maxVal (f j) a)

private theorem minGap_nonneg (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (j : ι) (a : Ω) :
    0 ≤ f j a - componentMin f j := by
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (minVal_le (f j) a)

private theorem minVal_mono
    (u v : Ω → ℝ) (h : ∀ a, u a ≤ v a) : minVal u ≤ minVal v := by
  rcases exists_eq_minVal v with ⟨a, ha⟩
  calc
    minVal u ≤ u a := minVal_le u a
    _ ≤ v a := h a
    _ = minVal v := ha

theorem ePlus_subset_le_global (T : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    ePlus T f ≤ ePlus Finset.univ f := by
  unfold ePlus
  apply minVal_mono
  intro a
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ T)
    (fun j _ _ => maxGap_nonneg f j a)

theorem eMinus_subset_le_global (T : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    eMinus T f ≤ eMinus Finset.univ f := by
  unfold eMinus
  apply minVal_mono
  intro a
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ T)
    (fun j _ _ => minGap_nonneg f j a)

theorem BH6_deficit_le_globalE (T : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    deficit T f ≤ globalE f := by
  rw [(BH3_exact_support_deficit_identity T f).1]
  unfold globalE
  exact add_le_add (ePlus_subset_le_global T f) (eMinus_subset_le_global T f)

theorem BH6_cardinality_topC_global_E_half
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (trueTop optimum : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore (componentSpan f) trueTop k)
    (hOptCard : optimum.card = k) :
    selectedRadius f trueTop - selectedRadius f optimum ≤ globalE f / 2 := by
  exact BH5_cardinality_topC_support_deficit f trueTop optimum k (globalE f)
    hTop hOptCard (BH6_deficit_le_globalE optimumᶜ f)

theorem modularity_radius_formula
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hmod : AllSubsetsModular f) (S : Finset ι) :
    selectedRadius f S = Sᶜ.sum (componentSpan f) / 2 := by
  unfold selectedRadius
  rw [hmod Sᶜ]
  rfl

theorem S2_all_subsets_modular_implies_topC_exact_at_k
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hmod : AllSubsetsModular f)
    (top : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore (componentSpan f) top k) :
    ∀ S : Finset ι, S.card = k → selectedRadius f top ≤ selectedRadius f S := by
  intro S hcard
  rw [modularity_radius_formula f hmod top, modularity_radius_formula f hmod S]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (topK_implies_omitted_modular_min (componentSpan f) top S k hTop hcard)
    (by norm_num)

theorem S2_all_subsets_modular_implies_topC_exact_all_budgets
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hmod : AllSubsetsModular f)
    (topC : ℕ → Finset ι)
    (hTop : ∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card ι →
      IsTopKByScore (componentSpan f) (topC k) k) :
    TopCExactAllBudgets (selectedRadius f) topC := by
  intro k hk S hcard
  exact S2_all_subsets_modular_implies_topC_exact_at_k f hmod (topC k) k
    (hTop k hk) S hcard

private theorem ePlus_nonneg (T : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ePlus T f := by
  unfold ePlus
  apply le_minVal
  intro a
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j hj => maxGap_nonneg f j a)

private theorem eMinus_nonneg (T : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ eMinus T f := by
  unfold eMinus
  apply le_minVal
  intro a
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j hj => minGap_nonneg f j a)

theorem S3_all_subsets_modular_implies_global_coextremizable
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    AllSubsetsModular f → GloballyCoextremizable f := by
  intro hmod
  have hdef : deficit Finset.univ f = 0 := by
    unfold deficit
    rw [hmod Finset.univ]
    ring
  have hid := (BH3_exact_support_deficit_identity Finset.univ f).1
  have hp0 : ePlus Finset.univ f = 0 := by
    have hp := ePlus_nonneg Finset.univ f
    have hm := eMinus_nonneg Finset.univ f
    linarith
  have hm0 : eMinus Finset.univ f = 0 := by
    have hp := ePlus_nonneg Finset.univ f
    have hm := eMinus_nonneg Finset.univ f
    linarith
  let plusGap : Ω → ℝ := fun a =>
    Finset.univ.sum (fun j => componentMax f j - f j a)
  let minusGap : Ω → ℝ := fun a =>
    Finset.univ.sum (fun j => f j a - componentMin f j)
  rcases exists_eq_minVal plusGap with ⟨amax, hamax⟩
  rcases exists_eq_minVal minusGap with ⟨amin, hamin⟩
  have hsumMax : Finset.univ.sum (fun j => componentMax f j - f j amax) = 0 := by
    change plusGap amax = 0
    rw [hamax]
    exact hp0
  have hsumMin : Finset.univ.sum (fun j => f j amin - componentMin f j) = 0 := by
    change minusGap amin = 0
    rw [hamin]
    exact hm0
  refine ⟨amax, amin, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hj := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun l _ => maxGap_nonneg f l amax)).mp hsumMax j (Finset.mem_univ j)
    linarith
  · intro j
    have hj := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun l _ => minGap_nonneg f l amin)).mp hsumMin j (Finset.mem_univ j)
    linarith

theorem S3_global_coextremizable_iff_all_subsets_modular
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    GloballyCoextremizable f ↔ AllSubsetsModular f := by
  constructor
  · exact S1_global_coextremizable_implies_all_subsets_modular f
  · exact S3_all_subsets_modular_implies_global_coextremizable f

section StrictnessWitnesses

theorem prefixSet_card_of_full
    (ranking : List ι) (hfull : IsFullRanking ranking)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    (prefixSet ranking k).card = k := by
  have hlen : ranking.length = Fintype.card ι := by
    calc
      ranking.length = ranking.toFinset.card :=
        (List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hfull.1).symm
      _ = Finset.univ.card := congrArg Finset.card hfull.2
      _ = Fintype.card ι := Finset.card_univ
  unfold prefixSet
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hfull.1.take]
  simp [List.length_take, hlen, Nat.min_eq_left hk]

def scalarNotTopObjective (S : Finset (Fin 2)) : ℝ :=
  if S.card = 1 then if (1 : Fin 2) ∈ S then 0 else 1 else 0

def badTopC : ℕ → Finset (Fin 2) := fun k =>
  if k = 1 then {(0 : Fin 2)} else ([(1 : Fin 2), 0].take k).toFinset

theorem W1_scalar_prefix_rankable_not_topC_exact :
    ScalarPrefixRankable scalarNotTopObjective ∧
      ¬ TopCExactAllBudgets scalarNotTopObjective badTopC := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨[(1 : Fin 2), 0], ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · decide
      · ext x
        fin_cases x <;> simp
    intro k hk S hcard
    have hk2 : k ≤ 2 := by simpa using hk
    interval_cases k <;>
      simp_all [prefixSet, scalarNotTopObjective] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · intro h
    have hbad := h 1 (by decide) ({(1 : Fin 2)} : Finset (Fin 2)) (by simp)
    norm_num [badTopC, scalarNotTopObjective] at hbad

def antiF (j a : Bool) : ℝ := if j = a then 1 else 0

theorem antiF_componentMax (j : Bool) :
    componentMax antiF j = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply maxVal_le
    intro a
    simp only [antiF]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · unfold componentMax
    simpa [antiF] using le_maxVal (antiF j) j

theorem antiF_componentMin (j : Bool) :
    componentMin antiF j = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold componentMin
    simpa [antiF] using minVal_le (antiF j) (!j)
  · apply le_minVal
    intro a
    simp only [antiF]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem antiF_singleton_radius (j : Bool) :
    selectedRadius antiF ({j} : Finset Bool) = 1 / 2 := by
  have hcomp : ({j} : Finset Bool)ᶜ = {!j} := by
    ext x
    cases j <;> cases x <;> simp
  rw [selectedRadius, hcomp]
  have hexact := BH4_coextremizable_exactness ({!j} : Finset Bool) antiF (!j) j
    (fun l hl => by
      have : l = !j := by simpa using hl
      subst l
      simp [antiF, antiF_componentMax])
    (fun l hl => by
      have : l = !j := by simpa using hl
      subst l
      simp [antiF, antiF_componentMin])
  rw [hexact]
  simp [modularSpan, componentSpan, antiF_componentMax, antiF_componentMin]

def antiTopC : ℕ → Finset Bool := fun k =>
  if k = 0 then ∅ else if k = 1 then {false} else Finset.univ

theorem antiF_topC_exact_all_budgets :
    TopCExactAllBudgets (selectedRadius antiF) antiTopC := by
  intro k hk S hcard
  have hk2 : k ≤ 2 := by simpa using hk
  interval_cases k
  · have hS : S = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hcard
    subst S
    simp [antiTopC]
  · rcases Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    cases a <;> simp [antiTopC, antiF_singleton_radius]
  · have hS : S = Finset.univ := S.card_eq_iff_eq_univ.mp (by simpa using hcard)
    subst S
    simp [antiTopC]

theorem antiF_not_globally_coextremizable :
    ¬ GloballyCoextremizable antiF := by
  rintro ⟨amax, amin, hmax, hmin⟩
  have hfalse := hmax false
  have htrue := hmax true
  have hfmax := antiF_componentMax false
  have htmax := antiF_componentMax true
  cases amax <;> simp [antiF] at hfalse htrue <;> linarith

theorem W2_topC_exact_not_global_coextremizable :
    TopCExactAllBudgets (selectedRadius antiF) antiTopC ∧
      ¬ GloballyCoextremizable antiF :=
  ⟨antiF_topC_exact_all_budgets, antiF_not_globally_coextremizable⟩

def nonnestedObjective (S : Finset (Fin 3)) : ℝ :=
  if S.card = 1 then
    if S = {(0 : Fin 3)} then 0 else 1
  else if S.card = 2 then
    if S = {(1 : Fin 3), 2} then 0 else 1
  else 0

theorem W3_nonnested_unique_optima_not_scalar_prefix :
    ¬ ScalarPrefixRankable nonnestedObjective := by
  rintro ⟨ranking, hfull, hopt⟩
  have hc1 := prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull 1 (by decide)
  have hc2 := prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull 2 (by decide)
  have h1 := hopt 1 (by decide) ({(0 : Fin 3)} : Finset (Fin 3)) (by simp)
  have h2 := hopt 2 (by decide) ({(1 : Fin 3), 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) (by simp)
  have hp1 : prefixSet ranking 1 = {(0 : Fin 3)} := by
    by_contra hne
    simp [nonnestedObjective, hc1, hne] at h1
    norm_num at h1
  have hp2 : prefixSet ranking 2 = {(1 : Fin 3), 2} := by
    by_contra hne
    simp [nonnestedObjective, hc2, hne] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  have hnested := prefixSet_nested ranking 1
  rw [hp1, hp2] at hnested
  have := hnested (by simp : (0 : Fin 3) ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)))
  have hne : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
  exact hne (by simpa using this)

end StrictnessWitnesses

end CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanBalancedTranslateDesignV1.lean (50 dong)
import Mathlib

/-! Finite translates give a balanced query design with exactly |C| rows.
Rows may overlap: no unknown world or hidden label enters the construction. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.BalancedTranslateDesign
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
noncomputable section
variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] [AddCommGroup C]

def row (Q : Finset C) (t : C) : Finset C :=
  univ.filter (fun i => i - t ∈ Q)

@[simp] theorem mem_row (Q : Finset C) (t i : C) :
    i ∈ row Q t ↔ i - t ∈ Q := by simp [row]

theorem row_card (Q : Finset C) (t : C) : (row Q t).card = Q.card := by
  apply card_bij (fun i _ => i - t)
  · intro i hi; exact (mem_row Q t i).mp hi
  · intro i hi j hj hij; exact sub_left_injective hij
  · intro i hi
    refine ⟨i + t, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [hi]

theorem column_sum (Q : Finset C) (i : C) :
    (∑ t : C, if i ∈ row Q t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = Q.card := by
  simp only [mem_row]
  have hb : Function.Bijective (fun t : C => i - t) := by
    constructor
    · intro a b h; exact sub_right_injective h
    · intro a; exact ⟨i - a, by abel⟩
  rw [hb.sum_comp (fun x => if x ∈ Q then (1 : ℝ) else 0)]
  simp

theorem intersection_sum (Q B : Finset C) :
    (∑ t : C, ((row Q t ∩ B).card : ℝ)) = (Q.card : ℝ) * B.card := by
  have he (t : C) : ((row Q t ∩ B).card : ℝ) =
      ∑ i ∈ B, if i ∈ row Q t then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    have hf : B.filter (fun i => i ∈ row Q t) = row Q t ∩ B := by
      ext i; simp [and_comm]
    simp [← hf]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [sum_comm]
  simp_rw [column_sum]
  simp [mul_comm]

#print axioms row_card
#print axioms column_sum
#print axioms intersection_sum
end
end CIGAMF.P13.BalancedTranslateDesign

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanBinaryKLTwoPointV1.lean (99 dong)
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue

/-! # Binary KL and the two-point error bound

Mathlib has no Pinsker inequality and no total-variation/KL comparison, on the
current pin or on master (checked by tree listing, 2026-09-11).  The discovery
lower bound needs SOME step from "the two worlds have small KL" to "some test
error is large", so it has to be proved here.

Two are given, deliberately.

`two_point_error_weak` needs only `x*log x ≥ -1/e` and gives
`1 - a - exp (-1) ≤ p + (1-q)` from `binaryKL p q ≤ a`.  It is non-trivial
exactly when `a < 1 - 1/e ≈ 0.632`, which is the regime a sample-complexity
lower bound lives in, and its proof is four lines.  Use this one first; it
already fixes the SHAPE of the lower bound, and only the constant is lost.

`binary_pinsker` is the sharp statement `2*(p-q)^2 ≤ binaryKL p q`.  It is
proved from the second derivative identity
`1/p + 1/(1-p) - 4 = (1-2*p)^2/(p*(1-p)) ≥ 0`, so the gap function is convex
with a stationary zero at `p = q`.  Use it to recover the standard constants.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.BinaryKLTwoPoint
open Real

/-- Binary Kullback-Leibler divergence. -/
noncomputable def binaryKL (p q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p*Real.log (p/q)+(1-p)*Real.log ((1-p)/(1-q))

/-- `x*log x ≥ -exp (-1)` for `x > 0`, from `log y ≤ y - 1` at `y = 1/(e*x)`. -/
theorem mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : -Real.exp (-1) ≤ x*Real.log x := by
  have he : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hy : 0 < 1/(Real.exp 1*x) := by positivity
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hy
  rw [Real.log_div one_ne_zero (by positivity),Real.log_one,
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hx),Real.log_exp] at h
  have hstep : -Real.log x ≤ 1/(Real.exp 1*x) := by linarith
  have hmul : x*(-Real.log x) ≤ x*(1/(Real.exp 1*x)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hx.le
  have hx' : x*(1/(Real.exp 1*x))=Real.exp (-1) := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]; field_simp
  have hneg : x*(-Real.log x)=-(x*Real.log x) := by ring
  rw [hx',hneg] at hmul
  linarith

/-- `log t ≥ 1 - 1/t`, applied on the complement: `q - p ≤ (1-p)*log ((1-p)/(1-q))`.
This is the half that actually carries the two-point bound; bounding it below by
`-exp (-1)` as well would make the argument vacuous. -/
theorem complement_term_ge {p q : ℝ} (hp1 : p < 1) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    q-p ≤ (1-p)*Real.log ((1-p)/(1-q)) := by
  have h1p : (0:ℝ) < 1-p := by linarith
  have h1q : (0:ℝ) < 1-q := by linarith
  have hinv : (0:ℝ) < (1-q)/(1-p) := by positivity
  have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hinv
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt h1q) (ne_of_gt h1p)] at hl
  have hge : 1-(1-q)/(1-p) ≤ Real.log (1-p)-Real.log (1-q) := by linarith
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt h1p) (ne_of_gt h1q)]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge h1p.le
  have he : (1-p)*(1-(1-q)/(1-p))=q-p := by field_simp; ring
  rw [he] at hmul
  exact hmul

/-- **Weak two-point bound.**  Small binary KL forces a large error sum.
`p*log (p/q)` is bounded below by `-exp (-1)`; the complement term is bounded
below by `q - p`.  No convexity, no Pinsker. -/
theorem two_point_error_weak {p q a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (h : binaryKL p q ≤ a) :
    1-a-Real.exp (-1) ≤ p+(1-q) := by
  have hlogq : Real.log q ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hq.le hq1.le
  have h1 : -Real.exp (-1) ≤ p*Real.log (p/q) := by
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hp) (ne_of_gt hq),mul_sub]
    have hml := mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp hp
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp.le (neg_nonneg.mpr hlogq)]
  have h2 := complement_term_ge hp1 hq1
  unfold binaryKL at h
  linarith

/-- The second-derivative identity behind Pinsker. -/
theorem pinsker_curvature {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    1/p+1/(1-p)-4=(1-2*p)^2/(p*(1-p)) := by
  have h0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp
  have h1 : (1:ℝ)-p ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  field_simp
  ring

theorem pinsker_curvature_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    0 ≤ 1/p+1/(1-p)-4 := by
  rw [pinsker_curvature hp hp1]
  have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1-p := by linarith
  positivity

#print axioms mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp
#print axioms complement_term_ge
#print axioms two_point_error_weak
#print axioms pinsker_curvature
#print axioms pinsker_curvature_nonneg

end CIGAMF.BinaryKLTwoPoint

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanBinaryPinskerV1.lean (186 dong)
import «LeanBinaryKLTwoPointV1»
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv

/-! # Binary Pinsker: `2*(p-q)^2 ≤ binaryKL p q`

Mathlib carries no Pinsker inequality, on this pin or on master (checked by
tree listing, not recalled). This is the sharp replacement for
`two_point_error_weak`.

Route, every Mathlib name read from the pin:

* `g = fun x => binaryKL x q - 2*(x-q)^2` on the OPEN set `D = Ioo 0 1`, so
  `interior D = D`;
* `g' x = log (x/q) - log ((1-x)/(1-q)) - 4*(x-q)`, which vanishes at `x = q`;
* `g'' x = 1/x + 1/(1-x) - 4 = (1-2*x)^2/(x*(1-x)) ≥ 0`
  (`BinaryKLTwoPoint.pinsker_curvature_nonneg`);
* `convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg` takes `f'` and `f''` as DATA, so no
  symbolic `deriv` is computed;
* `ConvexOn.isMinOn_of_rightDeriv_eq_zero` turns the stationary point into a
  global minimum;
* `g q = 0` closes it.

`binaryKL` is defined by `log` of a quotient, so it is total but agrees with the
four-term expansion only on `Ioo 0 1`. Every derivative is therefore transported
with `HasDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq` across that open set rather than proved
for a globally equal function.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.BinaryPinsker
open Real Set Filter
open CIGAMF.BinaryKLTwoPoint

/-- On `Ioo 0 1` the divergence is four elementary terms. -/
theorem binaryKL_expand {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    binaryKL p q=p*Real.log p-p*Real.log q+((1-p)*Real.log (1-p)-(1-p)*Real.log (1-q)) := by
  unfold binaryKL
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hp) (ne_of_gt hq),Real.log_div (by linarith) (by linarith)]
  ring

/-- `x ↦ 1 - x`, via the dedicated `const_sub` lemma rather than `.sub` of two
derivatives, which produces the Pi-subtraction `(fun _ => 1) - id` in a
different module instance. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_one_sub (p : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 1-x) (-1) p := by
  simpa using (hasDerivAt_id p).const_sub (1:ℝ)

/-- `x ↦ log x`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_log_self {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x) (1/p) p := by
  simpa [one_div] using (hasDerivAt_id p).log hp

/-- `x ↦ log (1-x)`, via `HasDerivAt.log`, which already folds the composition. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_log_one_sub {p : ℝ} (hp : (1:ℝ)-p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1-x)) (-1/(1-p)) p := by
  simpa using (hasDerivAt_one_sub p).log (by simpa using hp)

/-- `x ↦ x*log x`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_mul_log {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x*Real.log x) (Real.log p+1) p := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id p).mul (hasDerivAt_log_self hp)
  have he : ((id : ℝ → ℝ)*fun x : ℝ => Real.log x)=(fun x : ℝ => x*Real.log x) := by
    funext x; rfl
  rw [he] at h
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [id_eq,one_mul,mul_one_div,div_self hp]

/-- `x ↦ (1-x)*log (1-x)`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_one_sub_mul_log {p : ℝ} (hp : (1:ℝ)-p ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (1-x)*Real.log (1-x)) (-(Real.log (1-p)+1)) p := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_one_sub p).mul (hasDerivAt_log_one_sub hp)
  have he : ((fun x : ℝ => 1-x)*fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1-x))=
      (fun x : ℝ => (1-x)*Real.log (1-x)) := by funext x; rfl
  rw [he] at h
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  field_simp
  ring

/-- `x ↦ (x-q)^2`, via `.mul` rather than `.pow`, which produces the Pi-power. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_sq_sub (p q : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x-q)^2) (2*(p-q)) p := by
  have hb := (hasDerivAt_id p).sub_const q
  simp only [id_eq] at hb
  have h := hb.mul hb
  have he : ((fun x : ℝ => x-q)*fun x : ℝ => x-q)=(fun x : ℝ => (x-q)^2) := by
    funext x
    show (x-q)*(x-q)=(x-q)^2
    ring
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)

/-- First derivative of the gap, transported across `Ioo 0 1`. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_gap {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => binaryKL x q-2*(x-q)^2)
      (Real.log (p/q)-Real.log ((1-p)/(1-q))-4*(p-q)) p := by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp
  have h1p : (1:ℝ)-p ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  have h1 := hasDerivAt_mul_log hp0
  have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id p).mul_const (Real.log q)
  simp only [id_eq,one_mul] at h2
  have h3 := hasDerivAt_one_sub_mul_log h1p
  have h4 := (hasDerivAt_one_sub p).mul_const (Real.log (1-q))
  have h5 := (hasDerivAt_sq_sub p q).const_mul (2:ℝ)
  have hsum := ((h1.sub h2).add (h3.sub h4)).sub h5
  have heq : (fun x : ℝ => binaryKL x q-2*(x-q)^2) =ᶠ[nhds p]
      (fun x : ℝ => x*Real.log x-x*Real.log q+((1-x)*Real.log (1-x)-
        (1-x)*Real.log (1-q))-2*(x-q)^2) :=
    eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hp hp1)
      (fun x hx => by rw [binaryKL_expand hx.1 hx.2 hq hq1])
  refine (hsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).congr_deriv ?_
  rw [Real.log_div hp0 (ne_of_gt hq),
    Real.log_div h1p (by intro h; linarith : (1:ℝ)-q ≠ 0)]
  ring

/-- Second derivative of the gap.  `log (x/q) = log x - log q` is FALSE at
`x = 0` (the left side is `0`), so the split is transported across `Ioo 0 1`
with `EventuallyEq` rather than rewritten globally. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_gap' {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (x/q)-Real.log ((1-x)/(1-q))-4*(x-q))
      (1/p+1/(1-p)-4) p := by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp
  have h1p : (1:ℝ)-p ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq
  have h1q : (1:ℝ)-q ≠ 0 := by intro h; linarith
  have d1 := (hasDerivAt_log_self hp0).sub_const (Real.log q)
  have d2 := (hasDerivAt_log_one_sub h1p).sub_const (Real.log (1-q))
  have d3 := (hasDerivAt_id p).sub_const q
  simp only [id_eq] at d3
  have d4 := d3.const_mul (4:ℝ)
  have hsum := (d1.sub d2).sub d4
  have heq : (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (x/q)-Real.log ((1-x)/(1-q))-4*(x-q)) =ᶠ[nhds p]
      (fun x : ℝ => (Real.log x-Real.log q)-(Real.log (1-x)-Real.log (1-q))-4*(x-q)) :=
    eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds hp hp1) (fun x hx => by
      rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hx.1) hq0,
        Real.log_div (by intro h; linarith [hx.2] : (1:ℝ)-x ≠ 0) h1q])
  refine (hsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).congr_deriv ?_
  ring

/-- **Binary Pinsker.** -/
theorem binary_pinsker {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    2*(p-q)^2 ≤ binaryKL p q := by
  set D : Set ℝ := Ioo 0 1 with hD
  have hopen : interior D = D := IsOpen.interior_eq isOpen_Ioo
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => binaryKL x q-2*(x-q)^2 with hg
  set g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.log (x/q)-Real.log ((1-x)/(1-q))-4*(x-q) with hg'
  set g'' : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 1/x+1/(1-x)-4 with hg''
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior D,HasDerivWithinAt g (g' x) (interior D) x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hopen] at hx ⊢
    exact (hasDerivAt_gap hx.1 hx.2 hq hq1).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hderiv2 : ∀ x ∈ interior D,HasDerivWithinAt g' (g'' x) (interior D) x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hopen] at hx ⊢
    exact (hasDerivAt_gap' hx.1 hx.2 hq hq1).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hnn : ∀ x ∈ interior D,0 ≤ g'' x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hopen] at hx
    exact pinsker_curvature_nonneg hx.1 hx.2
  have hcont : ContinuousOn g D := by
    intro x hx
    exact ((hasDerivAt_gap hx.1 hx.2 hq hq1).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ D g :=
    convexOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonneg (convex_Ioo 0 1) hcont hderiv hderiv2 hnn
  have hqD : q ∈ interior D := by rw [hopen]; exact ⟨hq,hq1⟩
  have hzero : derivWithin g (Ioi q) q=0 := by
    have hgq : HasDerivAt g (g' q) q := hasDerivAt_gap hq hq1 hq hq1
    have hg'q : g' q=0 := by
      simp only [hg']
      rw [div_self (ne_of_gt hq),div_self (by linarith : (1:ℝ)-q ≠ 0),Real.log_one]
      ring
    rw [hg'q] at hgq
    exact hgq.hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ioi q)
  have hmin := hconv.isMinOn_of_rightDeriv_eq_zero hqD hzero
  have hpD : p ∈ D := ⟨hp,hp1⟩
  have h := hmin hpD
  simp only [hg,Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h
  have hgq0 : binaryKL q q-2*(q-q)^2=0 := by
    unfold binaryKL
    rw [div_self (ne_of_gt hq),div_self (by linarith : (1:ℝ)-q ≠ 0),Real.log_one]
    ring
  linarith [h,hgq0.le,hgq0.ge]

#print axioms binaryKL_expand
#print axioms hasDerivAt_gap
#print axioms hasDerivAt_gap'
#print axioms binary_pinsker

end CIGAMF.BinaryPinsker

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AbelSurplusV1.lean (112 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6H3Exchange»

/-!
# Top-C surplus and Abel sign control

For a valid selected/rejected pairing Top-C gives the stronger pointwise
surplus inequality, hence every prefix sum is nonnegative in every ordering.
The Abel identity below turns those prefix inequalities into the sign needed
for a monotone weighted PAEC correction.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AbelSurplus

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange

noncomputable def prefixSum (z : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, z i

theorem prefixSum_succ (z : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    prefixSum z (r + 1) = prefixSum z r + z r := by
  simp [prefixSum, Finset.sum_range_succ]

/- Finite Abel summation in the indexing used by a `d`-pair PAEC. -/
theorem abel_sum_identity (z beta : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), z i * beta i) =
      prefixSum z (d + 1) * beta d +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d,
          prefixSum z (i + 1) * (beta i - beta (i + 1)) := by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      simp [prefixSum]
  | succ d ih =>
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1 + 1), z i * beta i) =
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), z i * beta i) +
              z (d + 1) * beta (d + 1) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        _ = (prefixSum z (d + 1) * beta d +
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d,
                prefixSum z (i + 1) * (beta i - beta (i + 1))) +
              z (d + 1) * beta (d + 1) := by rw [ih]
        _ = prefixSum z (d + 1 + 1) * beta (d + 1) +
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
                prefixSum z (i + 1) * (beta i - beta (i + 1)) := by
              have hp : prefixSum z (d + 1 + 1) =
                  prefixSum z (d + 1) + z (d + 1) := by
                simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using prefixSum_succ z (d + 1)
              conv_rhs =>
                rhs
                rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
              rw [hp]
              ring

theorem abel_weighted_sum_nonnegative
    (z beta : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hPrefix : ∀ r, r ≤ d + 1 → 0 ≤ prefixSum z r)
    (hBetaLast : 0 ≤ beta d)
    (hBetaMono : ∀ i, i < d → beta (i + 1) ≤ beta i) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), z i * beta i := by
  rw [abel_sum_identity]
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact mul_nonneg (hPrefix (d + 1) le_rfl) hBetaLast
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i hi
    have hil : i < d := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    exact mul_nonneg (hPrefix (i + 1) (by omega))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hBetaMono i hil))

theorem prefix_nonnegative_of_terms_nonnegative
    (z : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i, i < d → 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∀ r, r ≤ d → 0 ≤ prefixSum z r := by
  intro r hr
  unfold prefixSum
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi ↦ hz i (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hr)

/- For Top-C, every selected/rejected pair is score ordered.  Consequently
the cyclic-permutation lemma is not needed merely to obtain nonnegative
prefix sums: any valid ordering of the pairs works. -/
theorem topK_paired_prefix_nonnegative
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (C : ι → ℝ) (selected : Finset ι) (k d : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore C selected k)
    (s t : Fin d → ι)
    (hs : ∀ a, s a ∈ selected)
    (ht : ∀ a, t a ∉ selected) :
    ∀ r, r ≤ d →
      0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin d ↦ a.val < r),
        (C (s a) - C (t a)) := by
  intro r hr
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro a ha
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr
    (topK_pairwise_score_order C selected k hTop (hs a) (ht a))

noncomputable def abelCorrection (z beta : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), z i * beta i)

theorem abelCorrection_nonpositive
    (z beta : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hPrefix : ∀ r, r ≤ d + 1 → 0 ≤ prefixSum z r)
    (hBetaLast : 0 ≤ beta d)
    (hBetaMono : ∀ i, i < d → beta (i + 1) ≤ beta i) :
    abelCorrection z beta d ≤ 0 := by
  unfold abelCorrection
  exact neg_nonpos.mpr
    (abel_weighted_sum_nonnegative z beta d hPrefix hBetaLast hBetaMono)

end CIGAMF.P13.D6AbelSurplus

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AcquisitionBenchmarkV1.lean (97 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualMultiEpochRiskV1»

/-! # Both benchmark conventions for the acquisition half

`D6ActualMultiEpochRisk.acquisitionCost` counts every query the algorithm
issues: `4*d*r0*E` to discover `A`, and `d * ∑ s, L s` to run the cyclic design
while deployed.  Whether the second term is *regret* is not a fact about the
algorithm; it is a fact about what the comparator is assumed to pay.  The two
natural comparators are settled here, so no result downstream has to choose.

* `benchmarkMeasuring`: an oracle that already knows `A` and deploys the SAME
  cyclic design.  It pays `d * ∑ s, L s` as well, so that term cancels exactly
  and the regret is the discovery cost alone, `4*d*r0*E`, linear in the epoch
  count.
* `benchmarkFree`: an oracle that measures nothing.  Then the whole acquisition
  cost is regret, and under a doubling schedule it is at least `d*L0*(2^E - 1)`,
  which is the horizon itself.

Both are exact identities in `ℕ`; neither is an estimate.  The separation
theorem is the honest form of the `O(log T)` question: the same algorithm is
logarithmic against one comparator and linear in the horizon against the other.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AcquisitionBenchmark
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualMultiEpochRisk
noncomputable section

/-- Comparator that knows `A` and still deploys the cyclic design: it pays the
per-step measurement cost but no discovery cost. -/
def benchmarkMeasuring (d E : ℕ) (L : Fin E → ℕ) : ℕ := d*∑ s,L s

/-- Comparator that pays nothing to measure. -/
def benchmarkFree : ℕ := 0

/-- Against a comparator that also measures, the deployment term cancels
exactly and the acquisition regret is the discovery cost alone. -/
theorem acquisition_regret_measuring (d r0 E : ℕ) (L : Fin E → ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E L-benchmarkMeasuring d E L=4*d*r0*E := by
  unfold acquisitionCost benchmarkMeasuring
  exact Nat.add_sub_cancel _ _

/-- Against a comparator that measures nothing, the whole acquisition cost is
regret. -/
theorem acquisition_regret_free (d r0 E : ℕ) (L : Fin E → ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E L-benchmarkFree=4*d*r0*E+d*∑ s,L s := by
  unfold acquisitionCost benchmarkFree
  exact Nat.sub_zero _

/-- Doubling schedule, free comparator: the closed form. -/
theorem doubling_regret_free (d r0 L0 E : ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)-benchmarkFree=
      4*d*r0*E+d*L0*(2^E-1) := by
  rw [acquisition_regret_free d r0 E (fun s => L0*2^s.val),
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun s => L0*2^s) E]
  exact doubling_acquisition_cost d r0 L0 E

/-- Doubling schedule, measuring comparator: linear in the epoch count, with no
dependence on `L0` at all. -/
theorem doubling_regret_measuring (d r0 L0 E : ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)-
      benchmarkMeasuring d E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)=4*d*r0*E :=
  acquisition_regret_measuring d r0 E _

/-- The horizon served by a doubling schedule of `E` epochs. -/
def horizon (L0 E : ℕ) : ℕ := L0*(2^E-1)

/-- **The separation.**  One algorithm, two comparators: against the measuring
comparator the acquisition regret is `4*d*r0*E`, free of `L0` and hence of the
horizon; against the free comparator it is at least `d * horizon L0 E`.  Neither
number is more correct than the other, and a paper must say which it reports. -/
theorem benchmark_separation (d r0 L0 E : ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)-
        benchmarkMeasuring d E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)=4*d*r0*E ∧
    d*horizon L0 E ≤ acquisitionCost d r0 E (fun s => L0*2^s.val)-benchmarkFree := by
  refine ⟨doubling_regret_measuring d r0 L0 E,?_⟩
  rw [doubling_regret_free d r0 L0 E]
  unfold horizon
  rw [← mul_assoc]
  exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

/-- The measuring-comparator regret does not depend on the schedule at all: any
two schedules over the same epoch count give the same acquisition regret.  This
is what makes `O(E)` a statement about discovery rather than about deployment. -/
theorem measuring_regret_schedule_free (d r0 E : ℕ) (L L' : Fin E → ℕ) :
    acquisitionCost d r0 E L-benchmarkMeasuring d E L=
      acquisitionCost d r0 E L'-benchmarkMeasuring d E L' := by
  rw [acquisition_regret_measuring,acquisition_regret_measuring]

#print axioms acquisition_regret_measuring
#print axioms acquisition_regret_free
#print axioms doubling_regret_free
#print axioms doubling_regret_measuring
#print axioms benchmark_separation
#print axioms measuring_regret_schedule_free
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AcquisitionBenchmark

/-!
# Canonical active-cell completion interface

This file isolates the exact remaining scientific obligation.  A completion
is an actual restricted canonical certificate of the requested mass.  Its
soundness and the normalized global consequence are proved; universal
existence for every balanced cell is intentionally not assumed or claimed.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellCompletion

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CanonicalUniformDecisionCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DecisionInteractionComplexity
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NormalizedBalancedTarget
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CanonicalPolyhedralCells
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Fin6WeightedDualCertificate

universe u

variable {U : Type u} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

def HasCanonicalActiveCellCompletionAtMost {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) (bound : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (R J : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : Fintype J)
      (cert : CanonicalUniformDecisionCertificate cell R J),
    cert.mass ≤ bound

theorem decisionInteractionConstant_of_canonical_completion {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) (bound : ℝ)
    (hCompletion : HasCanonicalActiveCellCompletionAtMost cell bound) :
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell bound := by
  rcases hCompletion with ⟨R, J, instR, instJ, cert, hMass⟩
  letI : Fintype R := instR
  letI : Fintype J := instJ
  intro F hCell hUnit
  have h := canonicalUniformDecisionCertificate_sound cell cert F 1
    (by norm_num) hCell hUnit
  have hBound : cert.mass * 1 ≤ bound := by simpa using hMass
  exact h.trans hBound

/-- This theorem is the exact zero-sorry bridge needed after the still-open
construction: canonical completion of every normalized balanced cell implies
the normalized balanced law. -/
theorem normalized_balanced_law_of_canonical_completion
    (hComplete : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Type u) [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
      (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U),
      (∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c) →
      (∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) →
      cell.BalancedComplement →
      HasCanonicalActiveCellCompletionAtMost cell n) :
    NormalizedBalancedDecisionInteractionBound.{u} := by
  intro n U instF instN cell hWeight hNorm hBalanced
  exact decisionInteractionConstant_of_canonical_completion cell n
    (hComplete n U cell hWeight hNorm hBalanced)

theorem canonicalCell4_has_completion_atMost_three :
    HasCanonicalActiveCellCompletionAtMost canonicalCell4 3 := by
  exact ⟨Fin 3, Fin 2, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    canonicalCertificate4, by simp⟩

theorem gammaFiveCell_has_completion_atMost_five :
    HasCanonicalActiveCellCompletionAtMost
      CIGAMF.P13.D6Fin6GammaFiveSaturation.gammaFiveCell 5 := by
  exact ⟨Fin 6, Fin 7, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    gammaFiveWeightedCertificate, by simp⟩

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellCompletion

/-!
# Noncircular selector two-path candidate for active-cell cone completion

This scratch file deliberately starts before a certificate is supplied.  For
an arbitrary active cell it forms the literal two selected-coordinate paths
from the fixed selected residual extrema to the fixed response extrema.  The
resulting remainder is an exact functional, not a post-hoc definition from a
certificate.

The Fin-4 calculation below records an exact obstruction to treating this
fixed two-path expression as the universal mass-`n` construction: its raw
path has four nontrivial selected-coordinate steps while `n = 3`.  This does
not refute cone completion or the normalized balanced law; the existing
three-cycle Fin-4 certificate is a different recombined certificate.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellConeConstructionScratch

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6BalancedProductCoreScratch
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CanonicalPolyhedralCells
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PAECFin4
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Fin6GammaFiveSaturation

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- The noncircular two-path cycle expression determined solely by the
selectors stored in an active cell. -/
noncomputable def selectorTwoPathCyclePart {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pairedEndpointCycleAverage cell.q F
    cell.selectedMax cell.responseMax
    cell.selectedMin cell.responseMin
    (canonicalPatchOrder cell.selected)

/-- The exact remainder after the selector-determined two-path cycle part.
Unlike the earlier `canonicalRemainder`, this definition does not receive a
certificate as an argument. -/
noncomputable def selectorTwoPathRemainder {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  decisionLinearFunctional cell F - selectorTwoPathCyclePart cell F

/-- The raw coefficient budget of this literal construction: one product
cycle average for each selected coordinate at each endpoint.  It is only a
syntactic budget; cancellations or a different cone representation may lower
the actual certificate mass. -/
noncomputable def selectorTwoPathRawMass {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) : ℝ :=
  2 * cell.selected.card

theorem decisionLinearFunctional_eq_selectorTwoPath_add_remainder {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    decisionLinearFunctional cell F =
      selectorTwoPathCyclePart cell F + selectorTwoPathRemainder cell F := by
  unfold selectorTwoPathRemainder
  ring

/-- This is the actual selector-level two-path identity.  It is the object
whose cone membership would need to be proved constructively for the new
route; no sign condition is asserted here. -/
theorem selectorTwoPathRemainder_eq_explicit {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) :
    selectorTwoPathRemainder cell F =
      retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected
          (patchCoordinates cell.selectedMax cell.responseMax cell.selected) -
        retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected
          (patchCoordinates cell.selectedMin cell.responseMin cell.selected) -
        retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMax +
        retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMin := by
  have hPath := pairedEndpointPatch_eq_canonical_cycleAverage cell.q F
    cell.selected cell.selected (by rfl)
    cell.selectedMax cell.responseMax cell.selectedMin cell.responseMin hNorm
  unfold selectorTwoPathRemainder selectorTwoPathCyclePart
    decisionLinearFunctional
  linarith

/-- In the canonical Fin-4 cell both selected coordinates change at both
endpoint paths.  Thus the literal two-path construction has no zero step to
remove before a genuinely new recombination argument is supplied. -/
theorem canonicalCell4_upper_selected_steps_nontrivial :
    ∀ i ∈ selected4,
      canonicalCell4.selectedMax i ≠ canonicalCell4.responseMax i := by
  intro i hi
  fin_cases i <;> simp_all [canonicalCell4, selected4, s4, a4]

theorem canonicalCell4_lower_selected_steps_nontrivial :
    ∀ i ∈ selected4,
      canonicalCell4.selectedMin i ≠ canonicalCell4.responseMin i := by
  intro i hi
  fin_cases i <;> simp_all [canonicalCell4, selected4, t4, a4]

theorem canonicalCell4_selectorTwoPath_rawMass :
    selectorTwoPathRawMass canonicalCell4 = 4 := by
  norm_num [selectorTwoPathRawMass, canonicalCell4, selected4]

theorem canonicalCell4_selectorTwoPath_rawMass_exceeds_target :
    (3 : ℝ) < selectorTwoPathRawMass canonicalCell4 := by
  rw [canonicalCell4_selectorTwoPath_rawMass]
  norm_num

/-- By contrast, the exact Gamma-five Fin-6 cell has at least one degenerate
lower-endpoint update in this same raw construction.  This records that path
morphology varies across cells, so a fixed tree/leaf-removal template cannot
be inferred from the Fin-4 example. -/
theorem gammaFive_lower_step_one_is_degenerate :
    gammaFiveCell.selectedMin (1 : Fin 6) =
      gammaFiveCell.responseMin (1 : Fin 6) := by
  norm_num [gammaFiveCell, gammaFiveSelectedMin, gammaFiveResponseMin, a6]

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellConeConstructionScratch

import Mathlib
import «LeanD6CanonicalPathRemainderV1»

/-!
# Active-cell cone classification of a canonical remainder

For a supplied canonical certificate, the remainder is exactly a nonnegative
combination of the closed active-cell constraint syntax.  This is the cone
statement, not the false statement that an older raw correction is always
nonpositive.  It does not assert that every balanced cell already has such a
certificate; that existence problem is isolated in the next module.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellRemainderDecomposition

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PolyhedralActiveCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CanonicalUniformDecisionCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CanonicalPathRemainder

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem canonicalRemainder_eq_active_cell_cone {n : ℕ}
    {cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U}
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : CanonicalUniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    canonicalRemainder cert F =
      ∑ j, cert.beta j *
        canonicalConstraintValue cell (cert.constraintAtom j) F ∧
      ∀ j, 0 ≤ cert.beta j := by
  exact ⟨rfl, cert.beta_nonnegative⟩

theorem canonicalRemainder_nonpos_of_valid_cell {n : ℕ}
    {cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U}
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : CanonicalUniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hCell : cell.Valid F) :
    canonicalRemainder cert F ≤ 0 := by
  have hPoly : PolyhedralCellValid cell F :=
    (activeDecisionCell_valid_iff_polyhedral cell F).1 hCell
  unfold canonicalRemainder
  exact Finset.sum_nonpos fun j hj ↦
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (cert.beta_nonnegative j)
      (canonicalConstraintValue_nonpos_of_polyhedral cell F hPoly
        (cert.constraintAtom j))

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveCellRemainderDecomposition

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActiveDecisionCellV1.lean (163 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6H3Exchange»

/-!
# Uniform active decision cells for D6

The data below freezes the combinatorial/active-extremum regime before a
numerical world function is supplied.  In a valid cell the doubled
selected-versus-competitor loss gap is one fixed linear functional of `F`.
This is the non-instance-wise language needed by decision--interaction
complexity; it does not alter the legacy PAEC files.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

structure ActiveDecisionCell (n : ℕ) (U : Type*) where
  q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ
  selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1))
  competitor : Finset (Fin (n + 1))
  selectedMax : Fin (n + 1) → U
  selectedMin : Fin (n + 1) → U
  competitorMax : Fin (n + 1) → U
  competitorMin : Fin (n + 1) → U
  responseMax : Fin (n + 1) → U
  responseMin : Fin (n + 1) → U

def ActiveDecisionCell.Valid {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  cell.selected.card = cell.competitor.card ∧
  IsTopKByScore (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse cell.q F j))
    cell.selected cell.selected.card ∧
  maxVal (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected) =
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMax ∧
  minVal (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected) =
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMin ∧
  maxVal (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor) =
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMax ∧
  minVal (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor) =
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMin ∧
  (∀ j, maxVal (productResponse cell.q F j) =
    productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMax j)) ∧
  ∀ j, minVal (productResponse cell.q F j) =
    productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMin j)

def ActiveDecisionCell.BalancedComplement {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) : Prop :=
  n + 1 = 2 * cell.selected.card ∧
  Disjoint cell.selected cell.competitor ∧
  cell.selected ∪ cell.competitor = Finset.univ

noncomputable def decisionLinearFunctional {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMax -
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMin -
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMax +
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMin

private theorem productResponse_add {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F G : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) :
    productResponse q (fun z ↦ F z + G z) i u =
      productResponse q F i u + productResponse q G i u := by
  unfold productResponse productExpectation
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c hc
  ring

private theorem productResponse_smul {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) :
    productResponse q (a • F) i u = a * productResponse q F i u := by
  unfold productResponse productExpectation
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c hc
  ring

private theorem retainedResidual_add {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F G : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    retainedResidual q (fun x ↦ F x + G x) S z =
      retainedResidual q F S z + retainedResidual q G S z := by
  unfold retainedResidual
  simp_rw [productResponse_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

private theorem retainedResidual_smul {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    retainedResidual q (a • F) S z =
      a * retainedResidual q F S z := by
  unfold retainedResidual
  simp_rw [productResponse_smul]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

theorem decisionLinearFunctional_add {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F G : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    decisionLinearFunctional cell (F + G) =
      decisionLinearFunctional cell F + decisionLinearFunctional cell G := by
  change decisionLinearFunctional cell (fun x ↦ F x + G x) = _
  unfold decisionLinearFunctional
  rw [retainedResidual_add, retainedResidual_add,
    retainedResidual_add, retainedResidual_add]
  ring

theorem decisionLinearFunctional_smul {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) (a : ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    decisionLinearFunctional cell (a • F) =
      a * decisionLinearFunctional cell F := by
  simp only [decisionLinearFunctional, retainedResidual_smul]
  ring

noncomputable def decisionLinearMap {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) :
    ((Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun := decisionLinearFunctional cell
  map_add' := decisionLinearFunctional_add cell
  map_smul' := by
    intro a F
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using decisionLinearFunctional_smul cell a F

/-- In a fixed valid active cell, the nonlinear oscillation selectors have
already been resolved, leaving one exact linear functional of `F`. -/
theorem doubledDecisionGap_eq_linear {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hCell : cell.Valid F) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.selected -
      productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.competitor) =
      decisionLinearMap cell F := by
  rcases hCell with ⟨hCard, hTop, hsMax, hsMin, htMax, htMin,
    hResponseMax, hResponseMin⟩
  unfold productCompressionLoss
  change
    2 * (osc (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected) / 2 -
      osc (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor) / 2) = _
  simp only [osc, hsMax, hsMin, htMax, htMin]
  change _ = decisionLinearFunctional cell F
  unfold decisionLinearFunctional
  ring

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActualDiscoveryBridgeV1.lean (108 dong)
import «LeanD6DiscoveryStoppingV1»

/-! Instantiation with the actual D6 world/query means. Anchor and helper indices
are independent of A and mu. Every coordinate is sampled by four legal queries;
all hypotheses about the contrast law are discharged by the construction. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

abbrev Off (j : I n) := {i : I n // i ≠ j}

/-- Helper indices exist from three off-j coordinates, independently of A. -/
theorem helper_exists (j : I n) (a : Off j) (hn : 3 ≤ Fintype.card (Off j)) :
    ∃ helper : Off j → Off j, (∀ i, a ≠ helper i) ∧ (∀ i, i ≠ helper i) := by
  have hh (i : Off j) : ∃ k : Off j, a ≠ k ∧ i ≠ k := by
    have hc : ({a,i} : Finset (Off j)).card < (univ : Finset (Off j)).card := by
      have hp : ({a,i} : Finset (Off j)).card ≤ 2 := by
        simpa using card_insert_le a ({i} : Finset (Off j))
      simp only [card_univ]
      omega
    have hnotsub : ¬ (univ : Finset (Off j)) ⊆ {a,i} := fun h => (not_lt_of_ge (card_le_card h)) hc
    obtain ⟨k,_,hk⟩ := not_subset.mp hnotsub
    refine ⟨k,?_,?_⟩
    · intro h;subst k;exact hk (by simp)
    · intro h;subst k;exact hk (by simp)
  choose helper hh using hh
  exact ⟨helper,fun i => (hh i).1,fun i => (hh i).2⟩

def encodedB (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Finset (Off j) := univ.filter (fun i => i.val ∉ A)

def means (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j) (mu : ℝ)
    (i : Off j) (t : Fin 4) : ℝ := actualMean A j mu (queries a.val i.val (helper i).val t)

lemma actual_design_legal (j : I n) (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (q : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (i : Off j) (t : Fin 4) : Legal j q (queries a.val i.val (helper i).val t) := by
  have ha' : a.val ≠ (helper i).val := fun h => ha i (Subtype.ext h)
  have hi' : i.val ≠ (helper i).val := fun h => hi i (Subtype.ext h)
  fin_cases t
  · trivial
  · trivial
  · exact pair_legal j i.val (helper i).val i.property (helper i).property hi' q hq
  · exact pair_legal j a.val (helper i).val a.property (helper i).property ha' q hq

lemma actual_mean_identity (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ) (i : Off j) :
    (∑ t,signs t*means A j a helper mu i t) = target (encodedB A j) a i := by
  have hh := actual_contrast A j a.val i.val (helper i).val hj a.property i.property
    (helper i).property (fun h => ha i (Subtype.ext h)) (fun h => hi i (Subtype.ext h)) mu
  have he : target (encodedB A j) a i=label A i.val-label A a.val := by
    simp only [target,encodedB,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,label]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  rw [he]
  simpa [means,queries,signs,Fin.sum_univ_succ,sub_eq_add_neg,add_assoc] using hh

/-- The algorithm takes q as input. The equation hq verifies its model size;
B and its membership are not inputs to stageAccept or queryCost. -/
theorem actual_discovery_terminates (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (q r0 : ℕ) (hq : (encodedB A j).card=q) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu), ∃ s, stageAccept q r0 s x := by
  rw [← hq]
  exact discovery_terminates _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0

theorem actual_discovery_finite_expectation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (q r0 : ℕ) (hq : (encodedB A j).card=q) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,queryCost q r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) < ∞ := by
  rw [← hq]
  exact discovery_expected_cost_finite _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0

theorem actual_discovery_expected_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (q r0 : ℕ) (hq : (encodedB A j).card=q) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,queryCost q r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) ≤
      (4*Fintype.card (Off j)*r0:ℕ)*(1+2*eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0) := by
  rw [← hq]
  exact discovery_expected_cost _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0

theorem actual_discovery_wrong_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (q r0 : ℕ) (hq : (encodedB A j).card=q) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)
      (⋃ s,{x | ∃ S, Certified (repetitions r0 s) q x S ∧ S ≠ encodedB A j}) ≤
      eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0*(1-(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞))⁻¹ := by
  rw [← hq]
  exact discovery_ever_wrong _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0

#print axioms helper_exists
#print axioms actual_design_legal
#print axioms actual_mean_identity
#print axioms actual_discovery_terminates
#print axioms actual_discovery_finite_expectation
#print axioms actual_discovery_expected_bound
#print axioms actual_discovery_wrong_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActualDoublingEpochRiskV1.lean (46 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualMultiEpochRiskV1»
import «LeanD6EpochBudgetArithmeticV1»

/-! Actual length-weighted finite multi-epoch risk, with shared discovery and
fresh cyclic observations. O(E) refers to recommendation loss only. A pilot
block is acquired before deploying the recommendation; acquisition regret,
tracking, unknown phase and Gamma stopping are not hidden in this statement. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDoublingEpochRisk
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicPhaseLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochMarginalLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualMultiEpochRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochBudgetArithmetic
noncomputable section

theorem actual_doubling_recommendation_bound (q : ℕ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1)) :
    ∃ G : ZMod (2*q+1) → Finset (I (2*q+1)),
      (∀ t,Legal j q (.inr (G t,false)) ∧ (G t).card=q) ∧
      ∀ (fallback : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j)
        (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
        (ha : ∀ i,a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i,i ≠ helper i)
        (A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
        (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q)
        (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (L0 : ℕ) (hL0 : 0 < L0) (E : ℕ),
      (∫⁻ x,∑ s : Fin E,((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ≥0∞)*ENNReal.ofReal
        (epochLoss q j fallback A mu (epochSamples r0 s.val) (L0*2^s.val) (epochProj s x))
        ∂multiEpoch (vectorPath (means A j a helper mu))
          (fun s : Fin E => observations G A j mu (L0*2^s.val))) ≤
      (E:ℝ≥0∞)*ENNReal.ofReal (64*((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q:ℝ)^6)+
        2*((L0:ℝ≥0∞)*ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*
          eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0) := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hbound⟩ := actual_finite_epoch_bound q hq j
  refine ⟨G,hG,?_⟩
  intro fallback hf a helper ha hi A hA mu hm r0 hr0 L0 hL0 E
  have hL : ∀ s : Fin E,0 < L0*2^s.val := fun s => Nat.mul_pos hL0 (by positivity)
  exact (hbound fallback hf a helper ha hi A hA mu hm r0 hr0 E
    (fun s => L0*2^s.val) hL (fun s => ((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ≥0∞))).trans
      (doubling_recommendation_sum q L0 E (by omega) hL0 _ _)

#print axioms actual_doubling_recommendation_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDoublingEpochRisk

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActualMultiEpochRiskV1.lean (79 dong)
import «LeanD6EpochMarginalLawV1»
import «LeanD6WeightedEpochCompositionV1»
import «LeanD6GrowingUnknownLabelPhaseRiskV1»
