/-! Finite-horizon composition on one actual probability space. Discovery
prefixes are shared; cyclic blocks are fresh and A-free. We charge every wrong
recommendation. Weights count uses of the recommendation, not its acquisition
queries. The latter are accounted separately below. This is not a stopping or
Gamma theorem, nor an O(log T) bound on total acquisition regret. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualMultiEpochRisk
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicPhaseLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GrowingUnknownLabelPhaseRisk CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochLossMeasurability
open CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochMarginalLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6WeightedEpochComposition
noncomputable section

/-- Actual, history-sharing composition. There is no assumed marginal-law or
conditional-risk premise in this theorem. -/
theorem actual_finite_epoch_bound (q : ℕ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1)) :
    ∃ G : ZMod (2*q+1) → Finset (I (2*q+1)),
      (∀ t,Legal j q (.inr (G t,false)) ∧ (G t).card=q) ∧
      ∀ (fallback : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j)
        (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
        (ha : ∀ i,a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i,i ≠ helper i)
        (A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
        (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q)
        (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (E : ℕ)
        (L : Fin E → ℕ) (hL : ∀ s,0 < L s) (w : Fin E → ℝ≥0∞),
      (∫⁻ x,∑ s : Fin E,w s*ENNReal.ofReal
        (epochLoss q j fallback A mu (epochSamples r0 s.val) (L s) (epochProj s x))
        ∂multiEpoch (vectorPath (means A j a helper mu))
          (fun s => observations G A j mu (L s))) ≤
      ∑ s : Fin E,w s*(ENNReal.ofReal (64/(q:ℝ)^2)*
        ENNReal.ofReal (((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((L s:ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4))+
        ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*
          (eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hbound⟩ := actual_unknown_label_explicit_bound q hq j
  refine ⟨G,hG,?_⟩
  intro fallback hf a helper ha hi A hA mu hm r0 hr0 E L hL w
  letI : ∀ s : Fin E,IsProbabilityMeasure (observations G A j mu (L s)) :=
    fun s => by unfold observations; infer_instance
  refine epoch_weighted_le (vectorPath (means A j a helper mu))
    (fun s : Fin E => observations G A j mu (L s)) w
    (fun s y => ENNReal.ofReal (epochLoss q j fallback A mu (epochSamples r0 s.val) (L s) y))
    ?_ univ _ ?_
  · intro s
    exact ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
      (epoch_loss_measurable q (by omega) j fallback A hf hA mu hm _ _)
  · intro s hs
    exact hbound fallback hf a helper ha hi A hA mu hm r0 hr0 s.val (L s) (hL s)

/-- One epoch uses a discovery prefix and an independent cyclic block. Across
E epochs each discovery datum is acquired once, not once per prefix. -/
def acquisitionCost (d r0 E : ℕ) (L : Fin E → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  4*d*r0*E+d*∑ s,L s

/-- Incremental discovery cost telescopes exactly. -/
theorem shared_discovery_cost (d r0 E : ℕ) :
    (∑ _s ∈ range E,4*d*r0)=4*d*r0*E := by simp [mul_comm]

/-- For doubling cyclic blocks the acquisition budget is explicit. It is of
order the final block, even though recommendation loss sums logarithmically. -/
theorem doubling_acquisition_cost (d r0 L0 E : ℕ) :
    4*d*r0*E+d*(∑ s ∈ range E,L0*2^s)=
      4*d*r0*E+d*L0*(2^E-1) := by
  rw [doubling_budget]
  ring

#print axioms actual_finite_epoch_bound
#print axioms shared_discovery_cost
#print axioms doubling_acquisition_cost
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualMultiEpochRisk

/-! Likelihood computed from the literal adaptive query-response record.
The multiplicative transition is proved, including absorbing records after
a stopping decision. This permits a constant threshold without spending
additional error across observation times. Infinite-path error and expected
stopping time are separate interfaces; no termination claim is made here. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualRecordLikelihood
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveLikelihood CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveMixtureRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6StoppingGeometryBridge CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {n : ℕ} {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

def recordRatio (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (logLikelihood B j nu record-logLikelihood A j mu record)

/-- The exact record likelihood increments by the actual Gaussian response
ratio for the adaptively chosen query. -/
theorem record_ratio_cons (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu y : ℝ)
    (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (e : Measurement n) :
    recordRatio A B j mu nu ((e,y)::record)=
      recordRatio A B j mu nu record*likelihood (actualMean A j mu e) (actualMean B j nu e) y := by
  unfold recordRatio likelihood logLikelihood
  simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- After stopping, retain the record and use likelihood multiplier one.
Before stopping, the complete query-response pair is retained. -/
theorem frozen_record_transition (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (record : H → List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n)
    (stopped : H → Prop) (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H)
    (hrecord : ∀ t h y,record (update t (h,y))=
      if stopped h then record h else (policy t h,y)::record h)
    (t : ℕ) (h : H) (y : ℝ) :
    recordRatio A B j mu nu (record (update t (h,y)))=
      recordRatio A B j mu nu (record h)*likelihood (actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
        (if stopped h then actualMean A j mu (policy t h) else actualMean B j nu (policy t h)) y := by
  rw [hrecord]
  by_cases hs : stopped h
  · simp [hs,likelihood]
  · simpa only [if_neg hs] using record_ratio_cons A B j mu nu y (record h) (policy t h)

theorem actual_record_normalization (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (record : H → List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n)
    (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)))
    (stopped : H → Prop) (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (hrecord : ∀ t h y,record (update t (h,y))=
      if stopped h then record h else (policy t h,y)::record h)
    (hempty : ∀ᵐ h ∂initial (),record h=[])
    (htrue : Measurable (fun h => logLikelihood A j mu (record h)))
    (hcandidate : Measurable (fun h => logLikelihood B j nu (record h))) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (recordRatio A B j mu nu (record h))
      ∂trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
        (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N ())=1 := by
  apply adaptive_likelihood_normalization initial
    (fun t h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
    (fun t h => if stopped h then actualMean A j mu (policy t h) else actualMean B j nu (policy t h))
    hm update hu (fun _ h => recordRatio A B j mu nu (record h))
  · intro t
    exact (hcandidate.sub htrue).exp
  · intro t h
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · calc
      _ = ∫⁻ _h, (1:ENNReal) ∂initial () := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hempty] with h hh
        simp [recordRatio,hh,logLikelihood]
      _ = 1 := by simp
  · exact frozen_record_transition A B j mu nu record policy stopped update hrecord

attribute [local irreducible] logLikelihood

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
/-- A uniform finite-horizon bound on the actual stopped record, with the
record recursion discharged. Every candidate and nuisance uses the same
observed adaptive policy. No assumed likelihood normalization remains. -/
theorem actual_frozen_family_tail (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (record : H → List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n)
    (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)))
    (stopped : H → Prop) (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (hrecord : ∀ t h y,record (update t (h,y))=
      if stopped h then record h else (policy t h,y)::record h)
    (hempty : ∀ᵐ h ∂initial (),record h=[])
    (htrue : Measurable (fun h => logLikelihood A j mu (record h)))
    (prior : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior] (W : Finset (Finset (I n)))
    (hcandidate : ∀ B ∈ W,Measurable (fun x : H × ℝ => logLikelihood B j x.2 (record x.1)))
    (c : ENNReal) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc' : c ≠ ⊤) (N : ℕ) :
    trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
      (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N ()
      {h | ∃ B ∈ W,c ≤ mixture prior (fun nu h => recordRatio A B j mu nu (record h)) h}
      ≤ (W.card:ENNReal)/c := by
  have hstep : ∀ t,IsMarkovKernel
      (actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) := by
    intro t
    unfold actualStep
    exact Kernel.IsMarkovKernel.map _ (hu t)
  have htraj : ∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (trajectory initial
      (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) t) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (IsMarkovKernel initial)
    | succ t ih =>
      letI := ih
      letI := hstep t
      change IsMarkovKernel (_ ∘ₖ _)
      infer_instance
  letI := htraj N
  apply finite_family_tail _ prior W (fun B nu h => recordRatio A B j mu nu (record h)) ?_ ?_ c hc hc'
  · intro B hB
    exact ((hcandidate B hB).sub (htrue.comp measurable_fst)).exp
  · intro B hB nu
    have hnu : Measurable (fun h => logLikelihood B j nu (record h)) :=
      Measurable.of_uncurry_right (f := fun h u => logLikelihood B j u (record h))
        (y := nu) (hcandidate B hB)
    exact actual_record_normalization A B j mu nu initial record policy hm stopped update hu
      hrecord hempty htrue hnu N

#print axioms record_ratio_cons
#print axioms frozen_record_transition
#print axioms actual_record_normalization
#print axioms actual_frozen_family_tail
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualRecordLikelihood

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActualSampleMatchingV1.lean (70 dong)
import «LeanD6KnownLabelMatchingRiskV1»

/-! The constructive upper bound on raw observations from the legal B-off
query. The decision uses only q and the known boundary, not epsilon. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualSampleMatching
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel CIGAMF.P13.GaussianSampleProduct
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingDesign
open CIGAMF.P13.D6KnownLabelMatchingRisk CIGAMF.P13.GaussianThresholdDecision
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {n : ℕ}

def statistic (q mu0 : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (x : Samples ℝ N) : ℝ :=
  (N:ℝ)*(1+q-q*mu0)-sumSamples N x

def rawRisk (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x,if 0 ≤ statistic q mu0 N x then rightRegret A j q mu0 mu
    else leftRegret A j q mu
    ∂resource (gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu (.inr (others A j,false))) 1) N ()

theorem actual_statistic_law (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) (N : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (statistic q mu0 N) (gaussianReal ((N:ℝ)*(q*(mu-mu0))) (N:NNReal))
      (resource (gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu (.inr (others A j,false))) 1) N ()) := by
  rw [B_off_mean A j q hq hj hB mu]
  have h := gaussianReal_const_sub (gaussian_sum_law (1+q-q*mu) N)
    ((N:ℝ)*(1+q-q*mu0))
  have he : (N:ℝ)*(1+q-q*mu0)-(N:ℝ)*(1+q-q*mu)=(N:ℝ)*(q*(mu-mu0)) := by ring
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

theorem raw_risk_identity (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) (N : ℕ) :
    rawRisk A j q mu0 mu N =
      ∫ x,if choosePlus N x then rightRegret A j q mu0 mu else leftRegret A j q mu
        ∂resource (gaussianReal (q*(mu-mu0)) 1) N () := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if 0 ≤ x then rightRegret A j q mu0 mu else leftRegret A j q mu
  have hf : Measurable f := by
    exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ici measurable_const measurable_const
  have hraw := (actual_statistic_law A j q mu0 mu hq hj hB N).integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hcenter := (gaussian_sum_law (q*(mu-mu0)) N).integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  exact hraw.trans hcenter.symm

/-- Matching upper bound for a realizable experiment on the actual query
library. Both losses are the actual infimum-over-world oracle regrets. -/
theorem actual_constructive_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu0)) (hmI : Interior q (1-(mu0-eps)))
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (hplushi : mu0+eps ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hminus : 1/2 ≤ mu0-eps) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    max (rawRisk A j q mu0 (mu0-eps) N) (rawRisk A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) N) ≤
      localJump q mu0*eps*standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N)+
        (remainderConstant q mu0+|localCurvature q mu0|)*eps^2 := by
  have hm : q*(mu0-eps-mu0)=-(q*eps) := by ring
  have hp : q*(mu0+eps-mu0)=q*eps := by ring
  rw [raw_risk_identity A j q mu0 (mu0-eps) (by linarith) hj hB N,
    raw_risk_identity A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) (by linarith) hj hB N,hm,hp]
  exact constructive_upper A j q mu0 eps hq hI hmI h0lo hplushi hminus heps hj hA hB N hN

#print axioms actual_statistic_law
#print axioms raw_risk_identity
#print axioms actual_constructive_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualSampleMatching

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRiskV1.lean (88 dong)
import «LeanD6RandomLabelPhaseRegretV1»
import «LeanD6DiscoveryWorldRecommendationV1»

/-! An actual unknown-label one-epoch phase-III allocation bound. Discovery
and cyclic observations are generated on a canonical product probability space.
Both the label-error probability and the margin-estimator law are discharged.
The recommendation never takes true A as an input. This does not assert an
optimal total budget split, matching regret, or a full stopping/Gamma theorem. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRisk
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicMeanSquare CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicPhaseLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryWorldRecommendation CIGAMF.P13.D6RandomLabelPhaseRegret
noncomputable section

/-- True A appears only in evaluation of regret, not in the chosen allocation. -/
def epochLoss (q : ℕ) (j : I (2*q+1)) (fallback A : Finset (I (2*q+1)))
    (mu : ℝ) (r L : ℕ)
    (x : Sample (Off j) × (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  let W := candidate q j fallback r x.1
  oracleRegret A j q mu (D6PhaseThreePrimal.queries W j)
    (weights W j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q)
      (estimate (C:=ZMod (2*q+1)) q L x.2))))

/-- For fixed q, C(q) is uniform over phase III. The two terms respectively
charge learning mu and every wrong/missing-label event, including fallback.
Raw information-acquisition cost is 4*(2q+1)*r0*(s+1)+(2q+1)*L queries. -/
theorem actual_unknown_label_phase_bound (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1)) :
    ∃ (G : ZMod (2*q+1) → Finset (I (2*q+1))) (C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ t,Legal j q (.inr (G t,false)) ∧ (G t).card=q) ∧
      ∀ (fallback : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j)
        (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
        (ha : ∀ i,a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i,i ≠ helper i)
        (A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
        (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q)
        (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (s L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L),
        (∫⁻ x,ENNReal.ofReal (epochLoss q j fallback A mu (epochSamples r0 s) L x)
          ∂((vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)).prod (observations G A j mu L))) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal C*ENNReal.ofReal (((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((L:ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4))+
            ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*
              (eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hlaw⟩ := actual_design_law_exists q hq j
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := random_label_expected_regret q hq
  refine ⟨G,C,hC,hG,?_⟩
  intro fallback hf a helper ha hi A hA mu hm r0 hr0 s L hL
  have hp := world_parameters q j (by omega) hA
  have hcyc := hlaw A hp.1 (world_others_card q (by omega) j A hA) L hL mu
  let P := (vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)).prod (observations G A j mu L)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (observations G A j mu L) := hcyc.isProbabilityMeasure
  let X : Sample (Off j) × (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun x => estimate (C:=ZMod (2*q+1)) q L x.2
  have hX : HasLaw X _ P := hcyc.comp measurePreserving_snd.hasLaw
  let badSet : Set (Sample (Off j) × (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ)) :=
    Prod.fst ⁻¹' bad (encodedB A j) a (epochSamples r0 s)
  have hb : MeasurableSet badSet := (bad_measurable _ _ _).preimage measurable_fst
  have hrec : ∀ x,x ∉ badSet → candidate q j fallback (epochSamples r0 s) x.1=A := by
    intro x hx
    exact candidate_correct_on_good q hq j fallback A hA a _ x.1 hx
  have hh := hbound P j A hA mu hm X _ hX
    (fun x => candidate q j fallback (epochSamples r0 s) x.1)
    (fun x => candidate_valid q j fallback hf _ x.1) badSet hb hrec
  have hbad : P badSet ≤ eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
    have hf : HasLaw Prod.fst (vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) P := measurePreserving_fst.hasLaw
    have he := hf.measure_eq (bad_measurable (encodedB A j) a (epochSamples r0 s))
    change P badSet=vectorPath (means A j a helper mu) (bad (encodedB A j) a (epochSamples r0 s)) at he
    rw [he]
    exact epoch_tail _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hp.1 a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0 s
  have hv : (((((L*(2*q+1):ℕ):NNReal) /
      NNReal.mk (((L:ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^2)^2) (sq_nonneg _)):NNReal):ℝ) =
      ((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((L:ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4) := by
    have hq0 : (q:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show q ≠ 0 by omega)
    have hL0 : (L:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hL)
    push_cast
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hv] at hh
  exact hh.trans (add_le_add le_rfl
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbad (show 0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu)) from zero_le)))

#print axioms actual_unknown_label_phase_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRisk

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AdaptiveLikelihoodV1.lean (104 dong)
import «LeanD6AdaptiveTranscriptV1»
import «LeanD6MovingNuisanceRegretV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Basic

/-! Actual Gaussian likelihood increments and finite adaptive normalization.
The update identity is explicit: a likelihood state multiplies by the ratio
for the query chosen from its current history. This is the probability-side
foundation for a later mixture stopping theorem, not that theorem itself. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveLikelihood
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6MovingNuisanceRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section

/-- Candidate-to-true Gaussian likelihood ratio. -/
def likelihood (m v y : ℝ) := Real.exp ((v-m)*y+(m^2-v^2)/2)

lemma likelihood_factor (m v y : ℝ) :
    likelihood m v y=Real.exp ((m^2-v^2)/2)*Real.exp ((v-m)*y) := by
  rw [likelihood,Real.exp_add]
  ring

lemma likelihood_integrable (m v : ℝ) :
    Integrable (likelihood m v) (gaussianReal m 1) := by
  change Integrable (fun y => likelihood m v y) (gaussianReal m 1)
  simp_rw [likelihood_factor]
  exact (integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal (v-m)).const_mul _

theorem gaussian_likelihood_mean_one (m v : ℝ) :
    (∫ y,likelihood m v y ∂gaussianReal m 1)=1 := by
  simp_rw [likelihood_factor]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hg : (∫ y : ℝ,Real.exp ((v-m)*y) ∂gaussianReal m 1) =
      Real.exp (m*(v-m)+(v-m)^2/2) := by
    simpa only [mgf,NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] using
      congrFun (mgf_fun_id_gaussianReal (μ := m) (v := 1)) (v-m)
  rw [hg,← Real.exp_add]
  have he : (m^2-v^2)/2+(m*(v-m)+(v-m)^2/2)=0 := by ring
  rw [he,Real.exp_zero]

theorem gaussian_likelihood_lintegral (m v : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ y,ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood m v y) ∂gaussianReal m 1)=1 := by
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (likelihood_integrable m v)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (Real.exp_pos _).le)),
    gaussian_likelihood_mean_one]
  norm_num

theorem gaussian_log_likelihood_mean (m v : ℝ) :
    (∫ y,Real.log (likelihood m v y) ∂gaussianReal m 1)=-(m-v)^2/2 := by
  have hi : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) (gaussianReal m 1) := IsGaussian.integrable_id
  simp only [likelihood,Real.log_exp]
  rw [integral_add (hi.const_mul _) (integrable_const _),integral_const_mul,
    integral_id_gaussianReal,integral_const]
  simp only [probReal_univ,one_smul]
  ring

/-- The squared-world-mean information already used by the allocation game is
exactly expected negative log likelihood for the actual Gaussian response. -/
theorem actual_information_log_likelihood {n : ℕ} (A A' : Finset (I n))
    (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) :
    -(∫ y,Real.log (likelihood (actualMean A j mu e) (actualMean A' j nu e) y)
      ∂gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu e) 1)=information A A' j mu nu e := by
  rw [gaussian_log_likelihood_mean,information_eq_mean]
  ring

variable {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

theorem actual_step_preserves_likelihood (m v : H → ℝ) (hm : Measurable m)
    (update : H × ℝ → H) (hu : Measurable update)
    (L L' : H → ℝ) (hL' : Measurable L') (hL : ∀ h,0 ≤ L h)
    (transition : ∀ h y,L' (update (h,y))=L h*likelihood (m h) (v h) y) (h : H) :
    (∫⁻ h',ENNReal.ofReal (L' h') ∂actualStep m hm update hu h)=ENNReal.ofReal (L h) := by
  rw [actualStep_apply,lintegral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [transition,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hL h)]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (by unfold likelihood; fun_prop),gaussian_likelihood_lintegral,mul_one]

/-- Exact normalization across the full adaptive state law, allowing different
true/candidate means at each state and retaining the entire likelihood record. -/
theorem adaptive_likelihood_normalization
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) (m v : ℕ → H → ℝ) (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (m t))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (L : ℕ → H → ℝ) (hLm : ∀ t,Measurable (L t)) (hL : ∀ t h,0 ≤ L t h)
    (hinit : (∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (L 0 h) ∂initial ())=1)
    (transition : ∀ t h y,L (t+1) (update t (h,y))=
      L t h*likelihood (m t h) (v t h) y) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (L N h)
      ∂trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N ())=1 := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact hinit
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [trajectory,Kernel.lintegral_comp _ _ _ (by fun_prop)]
    simp_rw [actual_step_preserves_likelihood (m N) (v N) (hm N) (update N) (hu N)
      (L N) (L (N+1)) (hLm (N+1)) (hL N) (transition N)]
    exact ih

#print axioms gaussian_likelihood_mean_one
#print axioms gaussian_likelihood_lintegral
#print axioms gaussian_log_likelihood_mean
#print axioms actual_information_log_likelihood
#print axioms actual_step_preserves_likelihood
#print axioms adaptive_likelihood_normalization
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveLikelihood

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AdaptiveMixtureRiskV1.lean (96 dong)
import «LeanD6AdaptiveLikelihoodV1»
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Lebesgue.Markov
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Prod

/-! Mixtures over nuisance parameters preserve adaptive likelihood normalization.
The event bound is on the actual terminal state law. An anytime application
must freeze the likelihood at the stopping decision, or spend error over time;
a fixed-horizon bound alone is not called an anytime theorem here. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveMixtureRisk
open scoped BigOperators
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveLikelihood CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {H Θ B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H] [MeasurableSpace Θ]

def mixture (prior : Measure Θ) (L : Θ → H → ℝ) (h : H) : ENNReal :=
  ∫⁻ θ,ENNReal.ofReal (L θ h) ∂prior

theorem mixture_normalization (P : Measure H) [SFinite P]
    (prior : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior] (L : Θ → H → ℝ)
    (hm : Measurable (fun x : H × Θ => L x.2 x.1))
    (hn : ∀ θ,(∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (L θ h) ∂P)=1) :
    (∫⁻ h,mixture prior L h ∂P)=1 := by
  unfold mixture
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap ((Measurable.ennreal_ofReal hm).aemeasurable)]
  simp_rw [hn]
  simp

theorem measurable_mixture (prior : Measure Θ) [SFinite prior] (L : Θ → H → ℝ)
    (hm : Measurable (fun x : H × Θ => L x.2 x.1)) : Measurable (mixture prior L) := by
  unfold mixture
  exact (Measurable.ennreal_ofReal hm).lintegral_prod_right

theorem finite_family_tail (P : Measure H) [SFinite P]
    (prior : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior]
    (W : Finset B) (L : B → Θ → H → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ b ∈ W,Measurable (fun x : H × Θ => L b x.2 x.1))
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ W,∀ θ,(∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (L b θ h) ∂P)=1)
    (c : ENNReal) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc' : c ≠ ⊤) :
    P {h | ∃ b ∈ W,c ≤ mixture prior (L b) h} ≤ (W.card : ENNReal)/c := by
  have hs : {h | ∃ b ∈ W,c ≤ mixture prior (L b) h} =
      ⋃ b ∈ W,{h | c ≤ mixture prior (L b) h} := by ext h; simp
  rw [hs]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ W,P {h | c ≤ mixture prior (L b) h} := measure_biUnion_finset_le W _
    _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ W,(1:ENNReal)/c := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro b hb
      have hh := meas_ge_le_lintegral_div (μ := P)
        (measurable_mixture prior (L b) (hm b hb)).aemeasurable hc hc'
      rw [mixture_normalization P prior (L b) (hm b hb) (hn b hb)] at hh
      exact hh
    _ = _ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

/-- The normalization premise of the tail bound is discharged from the actual
Gaussian adaptive transitions, for every candidate label and nuisance. -/
theorem adaptive_family_tail
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (m : ℕ → H → ℝ) (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (m t))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (prior : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior] (W : Finset B)
    (v : B → Θ → ℕ → H → ℝ) (L : B → Θ → ℕ → H → ℝ)
    (hLm : ∀ b ∈ W,∀ θ t,Measurable (L b θ t))
    (hL : ∀ b ∈ W,∀ θ t h,0 ≤ L b θ t h)
    (hinit : ∀ b ∈ W,∀ θ,(∫⁻ h,ENNReal.ofReal (L b θ 0 h) ∂initial ())=1)
    (transition : ∀ b ∈ W,∀ θ t h y,L b θ (t+1) (update t (h,y))=
      L b θ t h*likelihood (m t h) (v b θ t h) y)
    (N : ℕ) (hjoint : ∀ b ∈ W,Measurable (fun x : H × Θ => L b x.2 N x.1))
    (c : ENNReal) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc' : c ≠ ⊤) :
    trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N ()
      {h | ∃ b ∈ W,c ≤ mixture prior (fun θ => L b θ N) h} ≤ (W.card : ENNReal)/c := by
  have hstep : ∀ t,IsMarkovKernel (actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) := by
    intro t
    unfold actualStep
    exact Kernel.IsMarkovKernel.map _ (hu t)
  have htraj : ∀ t,IsMarkovKernel
      (trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) t) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (IsMarkovKernel initial)
    | succ t ih =>
      letI := ih
      letI := hstep t
      change IsMarkovKernel (actualStep (m t) (hm t) (update t) (hu t) ∘ₖ _)
      infer_instance
  letI := htraj N
  apply finite_family_tail _ prior W (fun b θ => L b θ N) hjoint ?_ c hc hc'
  intro b hb θ
  exact adaptive_likelihood_normalization initial m (v b θ) hm update hu (L b θ)
    (hLm b hb θ) (hL b hb θ) (hinit b hb θ) (transition b hb θ) N

#print axioms mixture_normalization
#print axioms finite_family_tail
#print axioms adaptive_family_tail
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveMixtureRisk

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AdaptiveOracleRegretV1.lean (91 dong)
import «LeanGaussianProductDecisionRiskV1»
import «LeanD6CenteredTranscriptV1»
import «LeanD6LocalOracleRegretV1»

/-! Full finite-horizon adaptive lower bound for the actual D6 allocation
oracle regret. The probability law is generated by the real legal queries;
no transcript overlap or Gaussian-risk conclusion is assumed as a premise. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CenteredTranscript CIGAMF.P13.GaussianProductDecisionRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ} {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

lemma allocation_value_nonnegative (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) :
    0 ≤ allocationValue A j mu E w := by
  apply Real.sInf_nonneg
  rintro v ⟨A',nu,h,rfl⟩
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e he => mul_nonneg (hw e he) (information_nonnegative A A' j mu nu e))

lemma oracle_regret_bounded (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) :
    oracleRegret A j q mu E w ≤ max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu) := by
  apply max_le_max le_rfl
  exact sub_le_self _ (allocation_value_nonnegative A j mu E w hw)

/-- Every measurable allocation recommendation from a full adaptive Gaussian
query history has the local two-margin lower bound. The state H can contain
the entire history and an arbitrary parameter-independent random seed. -/
theorem adaptive_oracle_regret_lower
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hminus : Interior q (lam+eps))
    (hpluslo : marginMax q ≤ (1-lam)+eps) (hplushi : (1-lam)+eps ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hlo : eps ≤ 1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (hup : eps ≤ lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n) (legal : ∀ t h,Legal j q (policy t h))
    (ha : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => meanOffset A j (policy t h)))
    (hb : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => meanSlope A j (policy t h)))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : H → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (feasible : ∀ h,Feasible j q E (w h))
    (hmLoss : Measurable (fun h => oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)-eps) E (w h)))
    (hpLoss : Measurable (fun h => oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)+eps) E (w h)))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ hm : ∀ mu t,Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)),
      (rate q (lam+eps)+D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q ((1-lam)+eps)-2*rate q lam-eps^2)*
        standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N) ≤
      max
        (∫ h,oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)-eps) E (w h) ∂trajectory initial
          (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j ((1-lam)-eps) (policy t h))
            (hm ((1-lam)-eps) t) (update t) (hu t)) N ())
        (∫ h,oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)+eps) E (w h) ∂trajectory initial
          (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j ((1-lam)+eps) (policy t h))
            (hm ((1-lam)+eps) t) (update t) (hu t)) N ()) := by
  obtain ⟨hm,K,hK,ht⟩ := centered_transcript A j q (1-lam) (by linarith) hj hB
    initial policy legal ha hb update hu N
  letI := hK
  refine ⟨hm,?_⟩
  have h := markov_product_risk_lower (q*eps) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) heps) N hN K
    (fun h => oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)-eps) E (w h))
    (fun h => oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)+eps) E (w h)) hmLoss hpLoss
    (max 0 (oracleValue A j q ((1-lam)-eps))) (max 0 (oracleValue A j q ((1-lam)+eps)))
    (rate q (lam+eps)+D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q ((1-lam)+eps)-2*rate q lam-eps^2)
    (fun _ => le_max_left _ _) (fun _ => le_max_left _ _)
    (fun h => oracle_regret_bounded A j q ((1-lam)-eps) E (w h) (feasible h).2.1)
    (fun h => oracle_regret_bounded A j q ((1-lam)+eps) E (w h) (feasible h).2.1)
    (fun h => local_oracle_regret_separation A j q lam eps hq hI hminus hpluslo hplushi
      hj hA hB heps hlo hup E (w h) (feasible h))
  have hmMean : q*(((1-lam)-eps)-(1-lam))= -(q*eps) := by ring
  have hpMean : q*(((1-lam)+eps)-(1-lam))=q*eps := by ring
  have em := ht ((1-lam)-eps)
  have ep := ht ((1-lam)+eps)
  rw [hmMean] at em
  rw [hpMean] at ep
  rw [em,ep] at h
  exact h

#print axioms allocation_value_nonnegative
#print axioms oracle_regret_bounded
#print axioms adaptive_oracle_regret_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AdaptiveTranscriptV1.lean (184 dong)
import «LeanAdaptiveResourceMapV1»
import «LeanD6GaussianQueryDominanceV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Composition.CompMap

/-! Actual D6 finite-horizon state/transcript simulation. H can include the
entire query/response history and a parameter-independent policy seed. Fresh
standard noise is included in the resource law explicitly; removing that
ancillary randomness and reducing to the sample mean are separate results. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ} {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

lemma feed_deterministic_apply {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (f : H × X → H)
    (hf : Measurable f) (h : H) :
    feed P (Kernel.deterministic f hf) h = P.map (fun x => f (h,x)) := by
  rw [feed,Kernel.deterministic_comp_eq_map,Kernel.map_apply _ hf,
    Kernel.prod_apply,Kernel.id_apply,Kernel.const_apply,Measure.dirac_prod,
    Measure.map_map hf (by fun_prop)]
  rfl

def gaussianKernel (m : H → ℝ) (hm : Measurable m) : Kernel H ℝ where
  toFun h := gaussianReal (m h) 1
  measurable' := measurable_gaussianReal.comp (hm.prodMk measurable_const)

instance gaussianKernelMarkov (m : H → ℝ) (hm : Measurable m) :
    IsMarkovKernel (gaussianKernel m hm) := by
  constructor
  intro h
  change IsProbabilityMeasure (gaussianReal (m h) 1)
  infer_instance

def actualStep (m : H → ℝ) (hm : Measurable m)
    (update : H × ℝ → H) (hu : Measurable update) : Kernel H H :=
  (Kernel.id ×ₖ gaussianKernel m hm).map update

lemma actualStep_apply (m : H → ℝ) (hm : Measurable m)
    (update : H × ℝ → H) (hu : Measurable update) (h : H) :
    actualStep m hm update hu h =
      (gaussianReal (m h) 1).map (fun y => update (h,y)) := by
  rw [actualStep,Kernel.map_apply _ hu,Kernel.prod_apply,Kernel.id_apply,
    Measure.dirac_prod,Measure.map_map hu (by fun_prop)]
  rfl

/-- Resource consists of one B-off observation and free independent randomization. -/
def resourceLaw (q mu : ℝ) : Measure (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (gaussianReal (1+q-q*mu) 1).prod (gaussianReal 0 1)

instance resourceLawProbability (q mu : ℝ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (resourceLaw q mu) := by
  unfold resourceLaw
  infer_instance

/-- For any state-dependent legal query, the same measurable simulator yields
its exact Gaussian response law at every true margin. -/
theorem actual_step_from_resource
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (policy : H → Measurement n) (legal : ∀ h, Legal j q (policy h))
    (ha : Measurable (fun h => meanOffset A j (policy h)))
    (hb : Measurable (fun h => meanSlope A j (policy h)))
    (update : H × ℝ → H) (hu : Measurable update) (mu : ℝ) :
    ∃ hm : Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy h)),
      ∃ hf : Measurable (fun hx : H × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        update (hx.1,simulate A j q (policy hx.1) hx.2.1 hx.2.2)),
      actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy h)) hm update hu =
        feed (resourceLaw q mu) (Kernel.deterministic _ hf) := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy h)) := by
    simp_rw [actual_mean_affine A j hj q mu _ (legal _)]
    exact ha.add (hb.mul_const mu)
  have hf : Measurable (fun hx : H × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      update (hx.1,simulate A j q (policy hx.1) hx.2.1 hx.2.2)) := by
    apply hu.comp
    apply measurable_fst.prodMk
    unfold simulate
    have hax := ha.comp (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : H × (ℝ × ℝ) → H))
    have hbx := hb.comp (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : H × (ℝ × ℝ) → H))
    fun_prop
  refine ⟨hm,hf,?_⟩
  ext1 h
  rw [actualStep_apply,feed_deterministic_apply]
  have hX : HasLaw Prod.fst
      (gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu (.inr (others A j,false))) 1) (resourceLaw q mu) := by
    rw [B_off_mean A j q hq hj hB mu]
    refine ⟨by fun_prop,?_⟩
    simp [resourceLaw]
  have hZ : HasLaw Prod.snd (gaussianReal 0 1) (resourceLaw q mu) := by
    refine ⟨by fun_prop,?_⟩
    simp [resourceLaw]
  have hi : IndepFun (Prod.fst : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) Prod.snd (resourceLaw q mu) := by
    exact indepFun_prod measurable_id measurable_id
  have hd := actual_query_gaussian_dominance A j q hq hj hB (policy h) (legal h) mu hX hZ hi
  have hg : Measurable (fun y : ℝ => update (h,y)) := hu.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have ht := congrArg (fun P : Measure ℝ => P.map (fun y => update (h,y))) hd.map_eq
  rw [Measure.map_map hg (by unfold simulate; fun_prop)] at ht
  exact ht.symm

/-- A single parameter-free simulator generates the complete actual D6 state
law for every margin and every finite horizon. An independent policy seed can
be included in H and its initial law; update can retain all queries and answers. -/
theorem actual_full_transcript
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n) (legal : ∀ t h, Legal j q (policy t h))
    (ha : ∀ t, Measurable (fun h => meanOffset A j (policy t h)))
    (hb : ∀ t, Measurable (fun h => meanSlope A j (policy t h)))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t, Measurable (update t))
    (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ hm : ∀ mu t, Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)),
      ∃ K : Kernel (Samples (ℝ × ℝ) N) H, IsMarkovKernel K ∧ ∀ mu,
        K ∘ₖ resource (resourceLaw q mu) N =
          trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
            (hm mu t) (update t) (hu t)) N := by
  have hm : ∀ mu t, Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)) := by
    intro mu t
    simp_rw [actual_mean_affine A j hj q mu _ (legal t _)]
    exact (ha t).add ((hb t).mul_const mu)
  have hf : ∀ t, Measurable (fun hx : H × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      update t (hx.1,simulate A j q (policy t hx.1) hx.2.1 hx.2.2)) := by
    intro t
    apply (hu t).comp
    apply measurable_fst.prodMk
    unfold simulate
    have hax := (ha t).comp (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : H × (ℝ × ℝ) → H))
    have hbx := (hb t).comp (measurable_fst : Measurable (Prod.fst : H × (ℝ × ℝ) → H))
    fun_prop
  let sim : ℕ → Kernel (H × (ℝ × ℝ)) H := fun t => Kernel.deterministic _ (hf t)
  haveI : ∀ t, IsMarkovKernel (sim t) := fun t => inferInstanceAs
    (IsMarkovKernel (Kernel.deterministic _ (hf t)))
  refine ⟨hm,?_⟩
  apply uniform_transcript_simulation initial sim (resourceLaw q)
    (fun mu t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
      (hm mu t) (update t) (hu t)) ?_ N
  intro mu t
  obtain ⟨hm',hf',heq⟩ := actual_step_from_resource A j q hq hj hB
    (policy t) (legal t) (ha t) (hb t) (update t) (hu t) mu
  exact heq

def augmentGaussian : Kernel ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) := Kernel.id ×ₖ Kernel.const ℝ (gaussianReal 0 1)

instance augmentGaussianMarkov : IsMarkovKernel augmentGaussian := by
  unfold augmentGaussian
  infer_instance

lemma augmented_law (q mu : ℝ) : resourceLaw q mu =
    augmentGaussian ∘ₘ gaussianReal (1+q-q*mu) 1 := by
  unfold resourceLaw augmentGaussian
  rw [← Measure.compProd_eq_comp_prod,Measure.compProd_const]

/-- Full adaptive state/transcript domination by N actual B-off measurements.
All auxiliary randomization has been moved into a single margin-independent
Markov kernel; it is no longer supplied as an observed resource. -/
theorem actual_Boff_transcript
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n) (legal : ∀ t h, Legal j q (policy t h))
    (ha : ∀ t, Measurable (fun h => meanOffset A j (policy t h)))
    (hb : ∀ t, Measurable (fun h => meanSlope A j (policy t h)))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t, Measurable (update t)) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ hm : ∀ mu t, Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)),
      ∃ K : Kernel (Samples ℝ N) H, IsMarkovKernel K ∧ ∀ mu,
        K ∘ₖ resource (gaussianReal (1+q-q*mu) 1) N =
          trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
            (hm mu t) (update t) (hu t)) N := by
  obtain ⟨hm,K,hK,h⟩ := actual_full_transcript A j q hq hj hB initial policy legal ha hb update hu N
  letI := hK
  refine ⟨hm,?_⟩
  apply CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveResourceMap.remove_ancillary augmentGaussian
    (fun mu => gaussianReal (1+q-q*mu) 1) N K _
  intro mu
  rw [← augmented_law]
  exact h mu

#print axioms feed_deterministic_apply
#print axioms actualStep_apply
#print axioms actual_step_from_resource
#print axioms actual_full_transcript
#print axioms actual_Boff_transcript
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationDistributionV1.lean (143 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationSharpV1»

/-! Push the explicit indexed primal allocation onto the actual finite
measurement library. Repeated query indices are aggregated, so normalization
and the information identity do not silently assume query injectivity. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def primalQueries (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Finset (Measurement n) :=
  insert (.inr (others A j,true)) (A.image fun a => .inr (A.erase a,false))

def primalWeight (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) : ℝ :=
  (if e = .inr (others A j,true) then weight q (scale q) else 0) +
    ∑ a ∈ A, if e = .inr (A.erase a,false) then (1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1) else 0

/-- Finite pushforward identity, for any observable on actual measurements. -/
theorem primal_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (f : Measurement n → ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*f e) =
      ((1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1))*(∑ a ∈ A, f (.inr (A.erase a,false))) +
        weight q (scale q)*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by
  have hb : (.inr (others A j,true) : Measurement n) ∈ primalQueries A j := by
    simp [primalQueries]
  have ha : ∀ a ∈ A, (.inr (A.erase a,false) : Measurement n) ∈ primalQueries A j := by
    intro a ha
    exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_image_of_mem _ ha)
  unfold primalWeight
  simp only [add_mul, sum_add_distrib, sum_mul]
  have hbSum : (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j,
      (if e = .inr (others A j,true) then weight q (scale q) else 0)*f e) =
        weight q (scale q)*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by
    simp [ite_mul, hb]
  rw [hbSum, sum_comm]
  have haSum : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j,
      (if e = .inr (A.erase a,false) then (1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1) else 0)*f e) =
        ((1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1))*(∑ a ∈ A, f (.inr (A.erase a,false))) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro a hmem
    simp [ite_mul, ha a hmem]
  rw [haSum]
  ring

/-- This is a legal normalized distribution on `Measurement`, rather than
only a collection of indexed orbit weights. -/
theorem primal_distribution (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∀ e ∈ primalQueries A j, Legal j q e) ∧
    (∀ e : Measurement n, 0 ≤ primalWeight A j q e) ∧
    (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e)=1 := by
  have hp := primal_feasible A j q hq hj hA hB
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    rcases mem_insert.mp he with he | he
    · subst e
      exact hp.2.2.2.1
    · obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
      exact hp.2.2.2.2 a ha
  · intro e
    unfold primalWeight
    apply add_nonneg
    · split <;> first | exact hp.1 | exact le_refl 0
    · apply sum_nonneg
      intro a ha
      split <;> first | exact hp.2.1 | exact le_refl 0
  · have he := primal_sum A j q (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at he
    have hn := hp.2.2.1
    simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hn
    nlinarith [he]

/-- The weighted game expression on actual measurements is exactly the
primal already connected to the D6 world evaluations. -/
theorem primal_information_eq (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q nu : ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e) =
      actualPrimal A A' j q (scale q) (2*(1-nu)) := by
  rw [primal_sum]
  unfold actualPrimal
  have ht : 1-2*(1-nu)/2=nu := by ring
  rw [ht]
  rfl

/-- One feasible distribution guarantees the sharp value simultaneously
against every distinct legal D6 hidden set and every nuisance margin. -/
theorem primal_distribution_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    value q (scale q)/8 ≤
      ∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e := by
  rw [primal_information_eq]
  exact every_alternative_primal_lower A A' j q nu hq hj hj' hcard hne hA hB

/-- The actual primal has an admissible worst alternative attaining equality.
The hidden alternative is outside the sum over all measurements. -/
theorem primal_attains_information_value (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e) =
        value q (scale q)/8 := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hu⟩ :=
    arbitrary_allocation_upper A j q hq hj hA hB (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q)
      hp.1 (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  exact ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,
    le_antisymm hu (primal_distribution_lower A A' j q nu hq hj hj' hcard hne hA hB)⟩

/-- Both sides now use the same finite-measurement allocation game: an
explicit feasible allocation attains the rate, and every feasible allocation
has one admissible alternative with information at most that rate. -/
theorem sharp_finite_allocation_game (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∃ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ E, w e)=1 ∧
      (∀ A' : Finset (I n), j ∉ A' → A'.card=A.card → A' ≠ A → ∀ nu : ℝ,
        0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 → value q (scale q)/8 ≤
          ∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) → (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) → (∑ e ∈ E, w e)=1 →
      ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
        A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
        (∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e) ≤ value q (scale q)/8) := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  constructor
  · refine ⟨primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q, hp.1, (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e), hp.2.2, ?_⟩
    intro A' hj' hcard hne nu _ _
    exact primal_distribution_lower A A' j q nu hq hj hj' hcard hne hA hB
  · intro E w hl hw hn
    exact arbitrary_allocation_upper A j q hq hj hA hB E w hl hw hn

#print axioms primal_sum
#print axioms primal_distribution
#print axioms primal_information_eq
#print axioms primal_distribution_lower
#print axioms primal_attains_information_value
#print axioms sharp_finite_allocation_game
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationDualBridgeV1.lean (242 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPrimalBridgeV1»

/-! Actual scalar-response dual, legal query counts, and the sharp upper bound
against arbitrary allocations. The adversary is chosen after the allocation,
not after a sampled query. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def scalarKL (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (mu nu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (productResponse corner (world A j mu) i true-
    productResponse corner (world A' j nu) i true)^2/2

theorem scalar_A_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j i a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hi : i ∈ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (z : ℝ) :
    8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)=(1-z)^2*hit {i} a := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst i; exact hj hi
  have hib : i ≠ b := by intro he; subst i; exact hh.1 hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  by_cases hia : i=a
  · subst a
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hi, hij, hib, swapped, hit, bit_true]
    ring
  · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hi, hij, hib, hia, Ne.symm hia, swapped, hit, bit_true]

theorem scalar_B_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j i a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hi : i ∈ others A j) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (z : ℝ) :
    8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)=z^2+(1-z^2)*hit {i} b := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j i hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  by_cases hib : i=b
  · subst b
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hh.1, hh.2, swapped, hit, bit_true]
    ring
  · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hh.1, hh.2, hib, Ne.symm hib, swapped, hit, bit_true]
    ring

theorem scalar_j_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hb : b ∈ others A j) (z : ℝ) :
    8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j j (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)=z^2 := by
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  simp only [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hj, swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb, ↓reduceIte, bit_true, mul_one]
  ring

theorem sum_singleton_hit (H : Finset (I n)) (i : I n) (hi : i ∈ H) :
    ∑ a ∈ H, hit {i} a=1 := by
  rw [sum_hit]
  simp [inter_eq_left.mpr (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi)]

/-- Actual scalar dual average for each of the three coordinate orbits. -/
theorem actual_scalar_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (z : ℝ) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) =
      if i ∈ A then ((others A j).card : ℝ)*(1-z)^2 else if i=j then
        (A.card : ℝ)*(others A j).card*z^2 else
        (A.card : ℝ)*(1+(((others A j).card : ℝ)-1)*z^2) := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_sum]
  by_cases hiA : i ∈ A
  · rw [ite_eq_left hiA]
    have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, 8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) =
        ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, (1-z)^2*hit {i} a := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
      exact scalar_A_point A j i a b hj hiA ha hb z
    rw [he]
    simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_sum, sum_singleton_hit A i hiA]
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right hiA]
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
      have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, 8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j j (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) =
          ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, z^2 := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
        exact scalar_j_point A j a b hj hb z
      rw [he]
      simp [mul_assoc]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
      have hiB : i ∈ others A j := by simp [others, hiA, hij]
      have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, 8*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) =
          ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, (z^2+(1-z^2)*hit {i} b) := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
        exact scalar_B_point A j i a b hj hiB ha hb z
      rw [he]
      simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_sum,
        sum_singleton_hit (others A j) i hiB]
      ring

/-- Query counts obey the analytic triangle because A and B partition every
coordinate except j. This is proved from the construction's `others`. -/
theorem query_count_partition (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjG : j ∉ G) :
    (G ∩ A).card+(G ∩ others A j).card=G.card := by
  have hu : (G ∩ A) ∪ (G ∩ others A j)=G := by
    ext i
    by_cases hiA : i ∈ A
    · simp [others, hiA]
    · by_cases hiG : i ∈ G
      · have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst i; exact hjG hiG
        simp [others, hiA, hiG, hij]
      · simp [hiG]
  have hd : Disjoint (G ∩ A) (G ∩ others A j) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hi'
    have hh := others_not_mem A j i (mem_inter.mp hi').2
    exact hh.1 (mem_inter.mp hi).2
  rw [← card_union_of_disjoint hd, hu]

/-- A concrete query's adjacent-world KL sum is bounded by the analytic
value, without assuming an orbit formula or query-count condition. -/
theorem actual_joint_dual_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+root q (scale q))/2)) ≤
        q*(q+1)*value q (scale q) := by
  rw [actual_dual_sum A G j h q _ hj hA hB hjG hG]
  have hcnt : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card ≤ q := by
    have he : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card=G.card := by exact_mod_cast query_count_partition A G j hjG
    linarith
  have hb := all_width_both_query_dual q (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card hq
    (by positivity) (by positivity) hcnt
  have he := dual_value_equals_primal q hq
  have hp : q*(q+1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have he' := (div_eq_iff hp).mp he
  cases h <;> simp only [bit_false, bit_true] <;> nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]

#print axioms actual_scalar_sum
#print axioms query_count_partition
#print axioms actual_joint_dual_bound

theorem actual_scalar_dual_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1/2) (1-(1+root q (scale q))/2)) ≤
        q*(q+1)*value q (scale q) := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by dsimp [z]; nlinarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
  have hs := scalar_dual q z hq hz.1.le hzle
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have he := dual_value_equals_primal q hq
  have he' := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hp hk))).mp he
  change q^2*(1+z)^2=value q (scale q)*(q*(q+1)) at he'
  rw [actual_scalar_sum A j i hj, hA, hB]
  change (if i ∈ A then q*(1-z)^2 else if i=j then (q+1)*q*z^2 else
    (q+1)*(1+(q-1)*z^2)) ≤ q*(q+1)*value q (scale q)
  split_ifs
  · have h := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hk).mp hs.1
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hp.le
    nlinarith
  · have h := (le_div_iff₀ hk).mp hs.2.2
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hp.le
    nlinarith
  · have h := (div_le_div_iff₀ hp hk).mp hs.2.1
    nlinarith

abbrev Measurement (n : ℕ) := Sum (I n) (Finset (I n) × Bool)

def Legal (j : I n) (q : ℝ) : Measurement n → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr (G,h) => j ∉ G ∧ (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q ∧ (h=false → 2 ≤ G.card)

def information (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ) : Measurement n → ℝ
  | .inl i => scalarKL A A' j i mu nu
  | .inr (G,h) => queryKL A A' G j h mu nu

theorem actual_measurement_dual_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j (1/2) (1-(1+root q (scale q))/2) e) ≤
        q*(q+1)*value q (scale q) := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => exact actual_scalar_dual_bound A j i q hq hj hA hB
  | inr p => exact actual_joint_dual_bound A p.1 j p.2 q hq hj hA hB he.1 he.2.2 he.2.1

/-- One actual alternative defeats the entire allocation of all legal query
types. Both the hidden set and margin are valid, and the set differs from A. -/
theorem arbitrary_allocation_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1/2) nu e) ≤ value q (scale q)/8 := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  let nu := 1-(1+z)/2
  let L := fun a b => ∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1/2) nu e
  have hbound : 8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤ q*(q+1)*value q (scale q) := by
    have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) =
        ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
          information A (swapped A a b) j (1/2) nu e) := by
      dsimp [L]
      simp_rw [mul_sum]
      calc
        _ = ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ e ∈ E, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
            w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1/2) nu e := by
          apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
          exact sum_comm
        _ = _ := sum_comm
    rw [he, mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(q*(q+1)*value q (scale q)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (actual_measurement_dual_bound A j q hq hj hA hB e (hlegal e he)) (hw e he)
        dsimp [nu,z]
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul, hnorm, one_mul]
  have hAnon : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A.card by linarith))
  have hBnon : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < (others A j).card by linarith))
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤
      ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, value q (scale q)/8 := by
    simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hA, hB]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hal⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hAnon hsum
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hBnon hal
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hnu : 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 := by dsimp [nu,z]; constructor <;> nlinarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
  exact ⟨swapped A a b, nu, swapped_ne A j a b hb, swapped_card A j a b ha hb,
    swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb, hnu.1, hnu.2, hbl⟩

#print axioms actual_scalar_dual_bound
#print axioms actual_measurement_dual_bound
#print axioms arbitrary_allocation_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationFiniteBridgeV1.lean (150 dong)
import «LeanD6ExpandedMeasurementsV1»
import «LeanD6ExpandedAllocationV1»
import Aesop

/-! Finite-sum bridge from actual D6 worlds and queries to the analytic
allocation certificate. No averaging or observation identities are hypotheses. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def hit (G : Finset (I n)) (i : I n) : ℝ := if i ∈ G then 1 else 0

theorem hit_sq (G : Finset (I n)) (i : I n) : (hit G i)^2=hit G i := by
  unfold hit; split <;> norm_num

theorem sum_hit (G H : Finset (I n)) : ∑ i ∈ H, hit G i = ((G ∩ H).card : ℝ) := by
  simp [hit, inter_comm]

/-- Exact second moment over the finite product A x B. -/
theorem product_second_moment (A B G : Finset (I n)) (u v : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ B, (u+v*(hit G a-hit G b))^2) =
      (A.card : ℝ)*B.card*u^2 + 2*u*v*((B.card : ℝ)*(G ∩ A).card-(A.card : ℝ)*(G ∩ B).card) +
        v^2*((B.card : ℝ)*(G ∩ A).card+(A.card : ℝ)*(G ∩ B).card-
          2*((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)*(G ∩ B).card) := by
  have he : ∀ a b, (u+v*(hit G a-hit G b))^2 =
      u^2+2*u*v*hit G a-2*u*v*hit G b+v^2*hit G a+v^2*hit G b-
        2*v^2*hit G a*hit G b := by
    intro a b
    by_cases ha : a ∈ G <;> by_cases hb : b ∈ G <;> simp [hit, ha, hb] <;> ring
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [sum_add_distrib, sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sum, ← sum_mul,
    sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, sum_hit]
  ring

def swapped (A : Finset (I n)) (a b : I n) : Finset (I n) := insert b (A.erase a)

theorem others_not_mem (A : Finset (I n)) (j b : I n) (hb : b ∈ others A j) :
    b ∉ A ∧ b ≠ j := by simpa [others, and_comm] using hb

theorem swapped_j_not (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hb : b ∈ others A j) : j ∉ swapped A a b := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  simp [swapped, hj, Ne.symm hh.2]

theorem swapped_card (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (ha : a ∈ A)
    (hb : b ∈ others A j) : (swapped A a b).card=A.card := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  rw [swapped, card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hh.1])]
  exact card_erase_add_one ha

theorem swapped_ne (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hb : b ∈ others A j) :
    swapped A a b ≠ A := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  intro he
  have hmem : b ∈ swapped A a b := by simp [swapped]
  rw [he] at hmem
  exact hh.1 hmem

theorem others_swapped (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) :
    others (swapped A a b) j=insert a ((others A j).erase b) := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  have haj : a ≠ j := by intro he; subst a; exact hj ha
  have hab : a ≠ b := by intro he; subst a; exact hh.1 ha
  ext i
  by_cases hia : i=a
  · subst i
    simp [others, swapped, ha, haj, hab]
  · by_cases hib : i=b
    · subst i
      simp [others, swapped, hh.1, hh.2, hia]
    · simp [others, swapped, hia, hib]

/-- A world swap changes the actual B count by two membership indicators. -/
theorem swapped_query_count (A G : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) :
    ((G ∩ others (swapped A a b) j).card : ℝ) =
      (G ∩ others A j).card+hit G a-hit G b := by
  rw [others_swapped A j a b hj ha hb, ← sum_hit]
  have han : a ∉ (others A j).erase b := by simp [others, ha]
  rw [sum_insert han]
  have he := sum_erase_add (others A j) (hit G) hb
  rw [sum_hit G (others A j)] at he
  linarith

def query (G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) : I n → Bool :=
  if h then jointCorner G j else plainCorner G

theorem actual_query_mean (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (mu : ℝ) :
    world A j mu (query G j h) =
      (if h then 0 else 1)+(1-mu)*(((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h) := by
  cases h
  · simp only [query, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, bit_false]
    rw [actual_unanchored_measurement A G j hjG (hG rfl)]
    ring
  · simp only [query, ↓reduceIte, bit_true]
    rw [joint_measurement A G j hj]
    ring

def queryKL (A A' G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (mu nu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (world A j mu (query G j h)-world A' j nu (query G j h))^2/2

/-- Pointwise KL identity evaluated on the actual two threshold worlds. -/
theorem actual_swapped_query_KL (A G : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (z : ℝ) :
    8*queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2) =
      (z*(((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)+(1+z)*(hit G a-hit G b))^2 := by
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean (swapped A a b) G j h (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG,
    swapped_query_count A G j a b hj ha hb]
  ring

/-- The analytic dual polynomial IS the sum over the actual adjacent worlds.
Each indexed world is a distinct-from-A, same-cardinality admissible swap. -/
theorem actual_dual_sum (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q z : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) =
      CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation.dual q z (bit h)
        (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A, 8*(∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2))) =
      ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
        (z*(((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)+(1+z)*(hit G a-hit G b))^2 := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro b hb
    exact actual_swapped_query_KL A G j a b h hj ha hb hjG hG z
  rw [he, product_second_moment, hA, hB]
  unfold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation.dual
  ring

#print axioms product_second_moment
#print axioms swapped_query_count
#print axioms actual_query_mean
#print axioms actual_swapped_query_KL
#print axioms actual_dual_sum
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationMarginRegionV1.lean (147 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! Exact closed endpoints of the true-margin region for the actual D6
allocation theorem. The square root below is a positive expression for the
scalar-B dual constraint. No additional assumption about optimality is used. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
noncomputable section

def tilt (q : ℝ) : ℝ := root q (scale q)
def gain (q : ℝ) : ℝ := 1+tilt q
def radius (q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt ((q^2+2*q^2*tilt q+(tilt q)^2)/(q+1))
def lower (q : ℝ) : ℝ := 1/(1+radius q)
def upper (q : ℝ) : ℝ := 1/gain q
def marginMin (q : ℝ) : ℝ := (1-scale q)/(q-1)
def marginMax (q : ℝ) : ℝ := radius q/(1+radius q)

theorem tilt_pos (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : 0 < tilt q := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  exact (root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2).1

theorem gain_pos (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : 0 < gain q := by
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  unfold gain
  linarith

theorem radius_pos (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : 0 < radius q := by
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  unfold radius
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  positivity

/-- This identity also gives R²=q²T²/(q+1)-(q-1)z². -/
theorem radius_balance (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    (q+1)*(radius q)^2=q^2*(gain q)^2-(q^2-1)*(tilt q)^2 := by
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hk : q+1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hr : (radius q)^2=(q^2+2*q^2*tilt q+(tilt q)^2)/(q+1) := by
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have he := (eq_div_iff hk).mp hr
  unfold gain
  nlinarith [he]

theorem radius_sq_le (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    (radius q)^2 ≤ q*(gain q)^2 := by
  have he := radius_balance q hq
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hp : 0 ≤ q*(gain q)^2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hz : 0 ≤ (q^2-1)*(tilt q)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := q+1) ?_ hk
  nlinarith [hp,hz]

/-- Within the feasible nuisance range, satisfying the scalar-B bound implies
satisfying scalar A. Thus B is the active scalar constraint at the endpoint. -/
theorem scalar_B_implies_A (q lam : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hu : lam*gain q ≤ 1)
    (hB : (q+1)*((1-lam)^2+(q-1)*lam^2*(tilt q)^2) ≤
      q^2*lam^2*(gain q)^2) :
    (1-lam*gain q)^2 ≤ q*lam^2*(gain q)^2 := by
  have hz := (tilt_pos q hq).le
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hlz := mul_nonneg hlam hz
  have hlu : lam ≤ 1 := by dsimp [gain] at hu; nlinarith
  have hnon : 0 ≤ 1-lam*gain q := by linarith
  have hdiff : 1-lam*gain q ≤ 1-lam := by dsimp [gain]; nlinarith
  have hs : (1-lam*gain q)^2 ≤ (1-lam)^2 := by nlinarith
  have he := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => lam^2*x) (radius_balance q hq)
  have hBs : (1-lam)^2 ≤ lam^2*(radius q)^2 := by
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := q+1) ?_ hk
    nlinarith [he]
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (radius_sq_le q hq) (sq_nonneg lam)
  nlinarith [hr]

/-- Closed, exact interval in lambda=1-mu, with no missing scalar constraint. -/
theorem interior_iff (q lam : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    Interior q lam ↔ lower q ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ upper q := by
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  have ht := gain_pos q hq
  have hr := radius_pos q hq
  have hd : 0 < 1+radius q := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hl,hl1,hu,hA,hB⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => lam^2*x) (radius_balance q hq)
    have hBs : (1-lam)^2 ≤ (lam*radius q)^2 := by
      apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := q+1) ?_ hk
      dsimp [gain,tilt] at he
      nlinarith [he]
    have hprod : 0 ≤ lam*radius q := mul_nonneg hl.le hr.le
    have hline : 1 ≤ lam*(1+radius q) := by nlinarith [hBs]
    refine ⟨(div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr hline, ?_⟩
    exact (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr (by simpa [gain,tilt] using hu)
  · rintro ⟨hlo,hup⟩
    have hl : 0 < lam := lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (by norm_num) hd) hlo
    have hu : lam*gain q ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ ht).mp hup
    have hlz := mul_nonneg hl.le hz.le
    have hl1 : lam ≤ 1 := by dsimp [gain] at hu; nlinarith
    have hline : 1 ≤ lam*(1+radius q) := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mp hlo
    have hprod : 0 ≤ lam*radius q := mul_nonneg hl.le hr.le
    have hBs : (1-lam)^2 ≤ (lam*radius q)^2 := by nlinarith
    have he := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => lam^2*x) (radius_balance q hq)
    have hB : (q+1)*((1-lam)^2+(q-1)*lam^2*(tilt q)^2) ≤
        q^2*lam^2*(gain q)^2 := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBs hk.le
      nlinarith [he,hm]
    have hA := scalar_B_implies_A q lam hq hl.le hu hB
    exact ⟨hl,hl1,by simpa [gain,tilt] using hu,
      by simpa [gain,tilt] using hA,by simpa [gain,tilt] using hB⟩

/-- The lower endpoint in the true margin has a particularly simple form. -/
theorem marginMin_eq (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : marginMin q=1-upper q := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hd : q-2+scale q ≠ 0 := by linarith [hc.1]
  have hq1 : q-1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have ht : gain q=(q-1)/(q-2+scale q) := by
    unfold gain tilt root
    field_simp [hd]
    ring
  unfold marginMin upper
  rw [ht]
  field_simp [hd,hq1]
  ring

theorem marginMax_eq (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : marginMax q=1-lower q := by
  have hr := radius_pos q hq
  have hd : 1+radius q ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold marginMax lower
  field_simp [hd]
  ring

/-- Exact true-margin endpoints for every width m=2(q+1)>=8. -/
theorem interior_iff_margin (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    Interior q (1-mu) ↔ marginMin q ≤ mu ∧ mu ≤ marginMax q := by
  rw [interior_iff q (1-mu) hq,marginMin_eq q hq,marginMax_eq q hq]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

#print axioms radius_balance
#print axioms scalar_B_implies_A
#print axioms interior_iff
#print axioms marginMin_eq
#print axioms interior_iff_margin
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationMarginSharpV1.lean (190 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationDistributionV1»

/-! Sharp actual-measurement game throughout the nontrivial true-margin
region. The optimal allocation itself is independent of the unknown margin. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem actual_joint_margin_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))) ≤
        q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q) := by
  let T := 1+root q (scale q)
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1-lam) (1-lam*T)) =
      4*lam^2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-T/2)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
    exact joint_homogeneity A (swapped A a b) G j h hj (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG lam T
  have hb := actual_joint_dual_bound A G j h q hq hj hA hB hjG hG hsize
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg lam)
  change 2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
    queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1-lam) (1-lam*T)) ≤ _
  rw [he]
  dsimp [T]
  nlinarith

theorem actual_scalar_margin_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))) ≤
        q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q) := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by dsimp [z]; nlinarith [hz.1,hz.2.1]
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have he := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hp hk))).mp (dual_value_equals_primal q hq)
  have hem := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => lam^2*x) he
  change lam^2*(q^2*(1+z)^2)=lam^2*(value q (scale q)*(q*(q+1))) at hem
  have hAi : (1-lam*(1+z))^2 ≤ q*lam^2*(1+z)^2 := hI.2.2.2.1
  have hBi : (q+1)*((1-lam)^2+(q-1)*lam^2*z^2) ≤ q^2*lam^2*(1+z)^2 := hI.2.2.2.2
  rw [actual_scalar_margin_sum A j i hj,hA,hB]
  change (if i ∈ A then q*(1-lam*(1+z))^2 else if i=j then
    (q+1)*q*lam^2*z^2 else (q+1)*((1-lam)^2+(q-1)*lam^2*z^2)) ≤ _
  split_ifs
  · have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAi hp.le
    nlinarith
  · have hj0 := (le_div_iff₀ hk).mp (scalar_dual q z hq hz.1.le hzle).2.2
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj0 (show 0 ≤ q*lam^2 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  · nlinarith

theorem measurement_margin_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q))) e) ≤
        q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q) := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => exact actual_scalar_margin_bound A j i q lam hq hI hj hA hB
  | inr p => exact actual_joint_margin_bound A p.1 j p.2 q lam hq hj hA hB he.1 he.2.2 he.2.1

/-- A single actual adversary defeats the whole allocation for every true
margin in Interior. The adversary's nuisance margin is also legal. -/
theorem arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e) ≤ rate q lam := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  let nu := 1-lam*(1+z)
  let L := fun a b => ∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e
  have hbound : 2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤ q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q) := by
    have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) =
        ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
          information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e) := by
      dsimp [L]
      simp_rw [mul_sum]
      calc
        _ = ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ e ∈ E, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
            w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e := by
          apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
          exact sum_comm
        _ = _ := sum_comm
    rw [he,mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_margin_bound A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB e (hlegal e he)) (hw e he)
        dsimp [nu,z]
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hnorm,one_mul]
  have hAnon : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A.card by linarith))
  have hBnon : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < (others A j).card by linarith))
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤
      ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, rate q lam := by
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hA,hB]
    unfold rate
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hal⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hAnon hsum
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbl⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hBnon hal
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hnu : 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [nu,z]
    refine ⟨by linarith [hI.2.2.1], ?_⟩
    have hh := mul_nonneg hI.1.le (show 0 ≤ 1+root q (scale q) by linarith [hz.1])
    linarith
  exact ⟨swapped A a b,nu,swapped_ne A j a b hb,swapped_card A j a b ha hb,
    swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,hnu.1,hnu.2,hbl⟩

/-- The exact same probability vector serves every true margin in the region. -/
theorem margin_distribution_information (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam nu : ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e) =
      actualPrimalMargin A A' j q lam nu := by
  rw [primal_sum]
  rfl

theorem margin_distribution_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    rate q lam ≤ ∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e := by
  rw [margin_distribution_information]
  exact actual_primal_margin_lower A A' j q lam nu hq hlam hj hj' hcard hne hA hB

/-- Sharp information allocation throughout the explicit margin region,
with lower and upper bounds expressed in the same actual-measurement game. -/
theorem sharp_margin_game (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
