    (∃ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ E, w e)=1 ∧
      (∀ A' : Finset (I n), j ∉ A' → A'.card=A.card → A' ≠ A → ∀ nu : ℝ,
        0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 → rate q lam ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) → (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) → (∑ e ∈ E, w e)=1 →
      ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
        A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
        (∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e) ≤ rate q lam) := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  constructor
  · refine ⟨primalQueries A j,primalWeight A j q,hp.1,(fun e _ => hp.2.1 e),hp.2.2,?_⟩
    intro A' hj' hcard hne nu _ _
    exact margin_distribution_lower A A' j q lam nu hq hI.1 hj hj' hcard hne hA hB
  · intro E w hl hw hn
    exact arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB E w hl hw hn

theorem margin_value_attained (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j q e*information A A' j (1-lam) nu e)=rate q lam := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hu⟩ :=
    arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q)
      hp.1 (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  exact ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,
    le_antisymm hu (margin_distribution_lower A A' j q lam nu hq hI.1 hj hj' hcard hne hA hB)⟩

#print axioms actual_joint_margin_bound
#print axioms actual_scalar_margin_bound
#print axioms measurement_margin_bound
#print axioms arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper
#print axioms margin_distribution_information
#print axioms margin_distribution_lower
#print axioms sharp_margin_game
#print axioms margin_value_attained
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationMarginTheoremV1.lean (123 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginSharpV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginRegionV1»
import «LeanD6UniqueOptimumV1»

/-! End-to-end theorem for every explicit D6 width m=2(r+1)>=8.
A single allocation for a fixed world label A is optimal at every true margin
in the stated interval. It is an oracle information design: A is an argument
of the design, and no sequential learning or stopping theorem is asserted.
All means come from the constructed worlds; geometry uses the literal support
and the original cardinality-feasible lifted selections. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginTheorem
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section

private theorem width_counts (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hmem : A ∈ worlds r j) :
    j ∉ A ∧ (A.card : ℝ)=(r:ℝ)+1 ∧ ((others A j).card : ℝ)=(r:ℝ) := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j (by omega) hmem
  have hb : (others A j).card=r := by
    have hjc : j ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa using hp.1
    have he : (others A j).card+1=Aᶜ.card := by
      unfold others
      rw [← compl_eq_univ_sdiff A]
      exact card_erase_add_one hjc
    rw [hp.2.2.1,hp.2.1] at he
    omega
  exact ⟨hp.1,by exact_mod_cast hp.2.1,by exact_mod_cast hb⟩

private theorem alternative_mem (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (A A' : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hmem : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) : A' ∈ worlds r j := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j (by omega) hmem
  apply mem_powersetCard.mpr
  refine ⟨?_,hcard.trans hp.2.1⟩
  intro i hi
  have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst i; exact hj' hi
  simp [positiveGround,hij]

/-- The displayed closed form is the actual information-game value. -/
theorem rate_closed_form (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    rate q (1-mu) =
      (1-mu)^2*(scale q)^2*(q-1)^2/(2*(q-2+scale q)^2) := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hd : q-2+scale q ≠ 0 := by linarith [hc.1]
  unfold rate value
  field_simp [hd] <;> ring

/-- A fixed explicit probability vector works throughout the entire true-margin
interval. Its worst actual alternative attains the bound at every margin. -/
theorem all_width_uniform_interval_design (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hmem : A ∈ worlds r j) :
    (∀ e ∈ primalQueries A j, Legal j r e) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ primalQueries A j, 0 ≤ primalWeight A j r e) ∧
    (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j r e)=1 ∧
    (∀ mu : ℝ, marginMin r ≤ mu → mu ≤ marginMax r →
      (∀ A' ∈ worlds r j, A' ≠ A → ∀ nu : ℝ, 0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 →
        rate r (1-mu) ≤ ∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j,
          primalWeight A j r e*information A A' j mu nu e) ∧
      (∃ A' ∈ worlds r j, ∃ nu : ℝ, A' ≠ A ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
        (∑ e ∈ primalQueries A j, primalWeight A j r e*information A A' j mu nu e)=
          rate r (1-mu))) := by
  have hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hp := width_counts r j hr A hmem
  have hp0 := world_parameters r j (by omega) hmem
  have hd := primal_distribution A j r hq hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2
  refine ⟨hd.1,(fun e _ => hd.2.1 e),hd.2.2,?_⟩
  intro mu hlo hhi
  have hI := (interior_iff_margin r mu hq).mpr ⟨hlo,hhi⟩
  constructor
  · intro A' hm' hne nu _ _
    have hp' := world_parameters r j (by omega) hm'
    have he := margin_distribution_lower A A' j r (1-mu) nu hq hI.1 hp.1 hp'.1
      (hp'.2.1.trans hp0.2.1.symm) hne hp.2.1 hp.2.2
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using he
  · obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,he⟩ :=
      margin_value_attained A j r (1-mu) hq hI hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2
    exact ⟨A',alternative_mem r j hr A A' hmem hj' hcard,nu,hne,hnu,hnu1,
      by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using he⟩

/-- Every competing query distribution admits one real alternative world with
small information, a unique different geometric answer, and positive regret
for the original answer. The alternative is chosen after the whole allocation. -/
theorem all_width_interval_geometric_upper (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hmem : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (mu : ℝ) (hlo : marginMin r ≤ mu) (hhi : mu ≤ marginMax r)
    (E : Finset (Measurement (2*r+1))) (w : Measurement (2*r+1) → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j r e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) :
    ∃ A' ∈ worlds r j, ∃ nu : ℝ, A' ≠ A ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A A' j mu nu e) ≤ rate r (1-mu) ∧
      (∀ S ∈ actions r,
        (∀ T ∈ actions r,
          selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A' j nu) (productResponse corner (world A' j nu)))
            (liftedSelection S) ≤
          selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A' j nu) (productResponse corner (world A' j nu)))
            (liftedSelection T)) ↔ S=A'ᶜ) ∧
      0 < selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A' j nu) (productResponse corner (world A' j nu)))
        (liftedSelection Aᶜ) -
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A' j nu) (productResponse corner (world A' j nu)))
        (liftedSelection A'ᶜ) := by
  have hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hp := width_counts r j hr A hmem
  have hI := (interior_iff_margin r mu hq).mpr ⟨hlo,hhi⟩
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,he⟩ :=
    arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j r (1-mu) hq hI hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2 E w hlegal hw hnorm
  have hm' := alternative_mem r j hr A A' hmem hj' hcard
  refine ⟨A',hm',nu,hne,hnu,hnu1,by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using he,?_,?_⟩
  · intro S hS
    exact all_width_geometric_optimal_iff r j (by omega) A' S hm' hS nu hnu hnu1
  · exact geometric_wrong_optimum_regret r j hr A A' hmem hm' hne nu hnu hnu1

#print axioms rate_closed_form
#print axioms all_width_uniform_interval_design
#print axioms all_width_interval_geometric_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginTheorem

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationMarginV1.lean (201 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationSharpV1»

/-! Non-singleton true-margin regime of the actual D6 allocation game.
`lambda=1-mu`. The same two-orbit allocation is optimal throughout an explicit
semialgebraic region; this is derived from actual observations, not an assumed
quadratic experiment. Unit variance/cost and the existing Legal query library
are retained. Sequential sample complexity is not claimed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def rate (q lam : ℝ) : ℝ := lam^2*value q (scale q)/2

/-- Explicit region where the least-favourable margin is feasible and scalar
queries do not beat the two joint-query orbits. These are scalar polynomial
inequalities, not assumptions of statistical optimality. -/
def Interior (q lam : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ lam*(1+root q (scale q)) ≤ 1 ∧
  (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))^2 ≤ q*lam^2*(1+root q (scale q))^2 ∧
  (q+1)*((1-lam)^2+(q-1)*lam^2*(root q (scale q))^2) ≤
    q^2*lam^2*(1+root q (scale q))^2

/-- A whole interval belongs to Interior, so this result is not restricted to
mu=1/2. The exact region may extend below lambda=1/2 as well. -/
theorem interval_in_interior (q lam : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlam : 1/2 ≤ lam)
    (hupper : lam*(1+root q (scale q)) ≤ 1) : Interior q lam := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hzpos : 0 ≤ z := hz.1.le
  have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by dsimp [z]; nlinarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
  have hl : 0 < lam := by linarith
  have hlu : lam ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl.le hzpos]
  have hAl : 0 ≤ 1-lam*(1+z) := by linarith
  have hAh : 1-lam*(1+z) ≤ lam*(1-z) := by nlinarith
  have hAr : 0 ≤ lam*(1-z) := mul_nonneg hl.le (by linarith)
  have hAsq : (1-lam*(1+z))^2 ≤ (lam*(1-z))^2 := by nlinarith
  have hs := scalar_dual q z hq hzpos hzle
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hA0 := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hk).mp hs.1
  have hA1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA0 (sq_nonneg lam)
  have hB0 := (div_le_div_iff₀ hp hk).mp hs.2.1
  have hB1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB0 (sq_nonneg lam)
  have hBsq : (1-lam)^2 ≤ lam^2 := by nlinarith
  have hB2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBsq hk.le
  exact ⟨hl,hlu,hupper,by nlinarith,by nlinarith⟩

theorem half_in_interior (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : Interior q (1/2) := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  exact interval_in_interior q _ hq (by norm_num) (by nlinarith [hz.1,hz.2.1])

/-- Homogeneity for actual joint measurements, with arbitrary true and
alternative margins. The gate offsets cancel in the actual world difference. -/
theorem joint_homogeneity (A A' G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card)
    (lam t : ℝ) :
    queryKL A A' G j h (1-lam) (1-lam*t)=
      4*lam^2*queryKL A A' G j h (1/2) (1-t/2) := by
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean A' G j h hj' hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean A' G j h hj' hjG hG]
  ring

def actualPrimalMargin (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam nu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1))*(∑ a ∈ A,
    queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1-lam) nu) +
      weight q (scale q)*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true (1-lam) nu

/-- The same fixed allocation scales by lambda squared; it needs no estimate
of the true margin anywhere inside the regime. -/
theorem primal_homogeneity (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam t : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hA : 4 ≤ A.card) :
    actualPrimalMargin A A' j q lam (1-lam*t)=
      4*lam^2*actualPrimal A A' j q (scale q) t := by
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A, queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1-lam) (1-lam*t)) =
      4*lam^2*(∑ a ∈ A, queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    have hl := erased_query_legal A j a hj ha hA
    exact joint_homogeneity A A' (A.erase a) j false hj hj' hl.1 (by intro _; exact hl.2) lam t
  unfold actualPrimalMargin actualPrimal
  rw [he, joint_homogeneity A A' (others A j) j true hj hj' (by simp [others]) (by simp) lam t]
  ring

/-- Actual primal guarantee for every different legal A' and every real
alternative margin; no Interior hypothesis is needed for this direction. -/
theorem actual_primal_margin_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    rate q lam ≤ actualPrimalMargin A A' j q lam nu := by
  let t := (1-nu)/lam
  have ht : 1-lam*t=nu := by dsimp [t]; field_simp [ne_of_gt hlam]; ring
  have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q hj' hcard hne hB
  have hbase := actual_primal_lower A A' j q t hq hj hj' hcard hA hB hd.1 hd.2
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase (show 0 ≤ 4*lam^2 by positivity)
  have hAn : 4 ≤ A.card := by exact_mod_cast (show (4:ℝ) ≤ A.card by linarith)
  rw [← ht, primal_homogeneity A A' j q lam t hj hj' hAn]
  unfold rate
  nlinarith

/-- General-margin pointwise scalar identities for an actual world swap. -/
theorem scalar_A_margin_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j i a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hi : i ∈ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (lam z : ℝ) :
    2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))=
      (1-lam*(1+z))^2*hit {i} a := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j b hb
  have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst i; exact hj hi
  have hib : i ≠ b := by intro he; subst i; exact hh.1 hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  by_cases hia : i=a
  · subst a
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,hij,hib,swapped,hit,bit_true]
    ring
  · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,hib,hia,Ne.symm hia,swapped,hit,bit_true]

theorem scalar_B_margin_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j i a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hi : i ∈ others A j) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (lam z : ℝ) :
    2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))=
      lam^2*z^2+((1-lam)^2-lam^2*z^2)*hit {i} b := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j i hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  by_cases hib : i=b
  · subst b
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hh.1,hh.2,swapped,hit,bit_true]
    ring
  · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hh.1,hh.2,hib,Ne.symm hib,swapped,hit,bit_true]
    ring

theorem scalar_j_margin_point (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hb : b ∈ others A j) (lam z : ℝ) :
    2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j j (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))=lam^2*z^2 := by
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response (swapped A a b) j (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb)]
  simp only [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hj,swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,↓reduceIte,bit_true,mul_one]
  ring

theorem actual_scalar_margin_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (lam z : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))) =
      if i ∈ A then ((others A j).card : ℝ)*(1-lam*(1+z))^2 else if i=j then
        (A.card : ℝ)*(others A j).card*lam^2*z^2 else
        (A.card : ℝ)*((1-lam)^2+(((others A j).card : ℝ)-1)*lam^2*z^2) := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_sum]
  by_cases hiA : i ∈ A
  · rw [ite_eq_left hiA]
    have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
        2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))) =
        ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, (1-lam*(1+z))^2*hit {i} a := by
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
      apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
      exact scalar_A_margin_point A j i a b hj hiA ha hb lam z
    rw [he]
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,← mul_sum,sum_singleton_hit A i hiA]
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right hiA]
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
      have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
          2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j j (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))) =
          ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, lam^2*z^2 := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
        exact scalar_j_margin_point A j a b hj hb lam z
      rw [he]
      simp [mul_assoc]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
      have hiB : i ∈ others A j := by simp [others,hiA,hij]
      have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
          2*scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i (1-lam) (1-lam*(1+z))) =
          ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, (lam^2*z^2+((1-lam)^2-lam^2*z^2)*hit {i} b) := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
        exact scalar_B_margin_point A j i a b hj hiB hb lam z
      rw [he]
      simp only [sum_add_distrib,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,← mul_sum,sum_singleton_hit (others A j) i hiB]
      ring

#print axioms interval_in_interior

#print axioms primal_homogeneity
#print axioms actual_primal_margin_lower
#print axioms actual_scalar_margin_sum
end

import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-! Dimension-parametric analytic certificate for the unknown-margin D6 design.
q=k-1>=3, true mu=1/2. This module proves the saddle-point polynomial law.
The finite permutation-orbit reduction from actual measurements is a separate
bridge; this module does not silently assume that bridge or algorithm optimality. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationOrbit

noncomputable def rootEquation (q z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((q+1)*(q-2)^2-1)*z^2 - 2*(q+1)*(q-2)*z + 1

noncomputable def dualNumerator (q z s t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  q*(q+1)*z^2*(t-1)^2 + 2*q*z*(1+z)*(t-1)*s -
    2*(q+1)*z*(1+z)*(t-1)*t + (1+z)^2*(q*s+(q+1)*t-2*s*t)

noncomputable def valueNumerator (q z : ℝ) : ℝ := q*(q+z^2)

/-- Every joint measurement orbit is dominated by the two allocated extremes.
The proof holds for real s,t over the entire triangle, not just finite counts. -/
theorem dual_triangle_bound (q z s t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hzsmall : (2*q+1)*z ≤ 1) (hroot : rootEquation q z = 0)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dualNumerator q z s t ≤ valueNumerator q z := by
  have hqt : 0 ≤ q-t := by linarith
  have hcz : 0 ≤ 2-(q-2)*z := by nlinarith
  have hC : 0 ≤ q*(q-3)*z^2+2-(4*q-2)*z := by
    have hprod : 0 ≤ q*(q-3)*z^2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg z)
    nlinarith
  have h0id : valueNumerator q z - dualNumerator q z 0 t =
      (q+1)*(q-t)*z*(2-(q-2)*z)*(q*(q-3)+q-t) +
        ((q+1)*(q-t)-q)*rootEquation q z := by
    unfold valueNumerator dualNumerator rootEquation
    ring
  have h0 : dualNumerator q z 0 t ≤ valueNumerator q z := by
    rw [hroot, mul_zero, add_zero] at h0id
    have hh : 0 ≤ (q+1)*(q-t)*z*(2-(q-2)*z)*(q*(q-3)+q-t) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hqt) hz) hcz
      · have : 0 ≤ q*(q-3) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
        linarith
    linarith
  have h1id : valueNumerator q z - dualNumerator q z (q-t) t =
      t*(q-t)*(q*(q-3)*z^2+2-(4*q-2)*z)-t*rootEquation q z := by
    unfold valueNumerator dualNumerator rootEquation
    ring
  have h1 : dualNumerator q z (q-t) t ≤ valueNumerator q z := by
    rw [hroot, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h1id
    have hh := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht hqt) hC
    linarith
  have hid : (q-t)*(valueNumerator q z-dualNumerator q z s t) =
      (q-t-s)*(valueNumerator q z-dualNumerator q z 0 t) +
      s*(valueNumerator q z-dualNumerator q z (q-t) t) := by
    unfold valueNumerator dualNumerator
    ring
  by_cases hzero : q-t=0
  · have hs0 : s=0 := by linarith
    simpa [hs0] using h0
  · have hp : 0 < q-t := lt_of_le_of_ne hqt (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hl := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-t-s by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr h0)
    have hr := mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr h1)
    nlinarith

noncomputable def calibrationRoot (q : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / ((q+1)*(q-2) + Real.sqrt (q*(q+1)*(q-2)^2+1))

/-- The explicit algebraic root lies in the branch needed by the certificate. -/
theorem calibrationRoot_properties (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    0 < calibrationRoot q ∧ (2*q+1)*calibrationRoot q ≤ 1 ∧
      rootEquation q (calibrationRoot q) = 0 := by
  let R := Real.sqrt (q*(q+1)*(q-2)^2+1)
  have hx : 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*(q-2)^2+1 := by positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hRsq : R^2 = q*(q+1)*(q-2)^2+1 := Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hqminus : 0 < q-2 := by linarith
  have hRlower : q*(q-2) ≤ R := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ q*(q-2) := by positivity
    have hdiff : (q*(q-2))^2 ≤ R^2 := by
      rw [hRsq]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q-2)]
    nlinarith
  have hd : 0 < (q+1)*(q-2)+R := by positivity
  have hds : 2*q+1 ≤ (q+1)*(q-2)+R := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2*q+1 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ q-3 by linarith)]
  change 0 < 1/((q+1)*(q-2)+R) ∧
    (2*q+1)*(1/((q+1)*(q-2)+R)) ≤ 1 ∧
    rootEquation q (1/((q+1)*(q-2)+R)) = 0
  refine ⟨one_div_pos.mpr hd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hd]
    exact hds
  · unfold rootEquation
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hRsq]

/-- Closed form valid for every width k=q+1>=4, not fitted to m=10. -/
theorem all_width_joint_dual (q s t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dualNumerator q (calibrationRoot q) s t ≤ valueNumerator q (calibrationRoot q) := by
  have h := calibrationRoot_properties q hq
  exact dual_triangle_bound q _ s t hq h.1.le h.2.1 h.2.2 hs ht hst

#print axioms dual_triangle_bound
#print axioms calibrationRoot_properties
#print axioms all_width_joint_dual

noncomputable def calibrationWeight (q z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  z / ((q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z)+z)

noncomputable def primalA (q t : ℝ) : ℝ := (q+(t-1)^2)/(q+1)
noncomputable def primalB (q t : ℝ) : ℝ := ((q-1)-(q-2)*t)^2
noncomputable def normalizedValue (q z : ℝ) : ℝ := (q+z^2)/(q+1)

/-- The small calibration mass is positive, and leaves enough probability on
A-queries to reject every alternative at exchange distance >=2. -/
theorem calibrationWeight_properties (q z : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 < z)
    (hsmall : (2*q+1)*z ≤ 1) :
    0 < calibrationWeight q z ∧ calibrationWeight q z < 1 ∧
    calibrationWeight q z*(q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) =
      (1-calibrationWeight q z)*z ∧
    normalizedValue q z ≤ 1-calibrationWeight q z := by
  let E := (q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z)+z
  have hz3 : z ≤ 1/3 := by nlinarith
  have hcz : 0 ≤ (q-2)*z := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hz.le
  have hczhalf : (q-2)*z ≤ 1/2 := by nlinarith
  have hc : 1 ≤ q-2 := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hterm : (q+1)/2 ≤ (q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) := by
    have h1 : 1/2 ≤ (q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-3 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 1-(q-2)*z by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  have hE : 0 < E := by dsimp [E]; linarith
  change 0 < z/E ∧ z/E < 1 ∧
    (z/E)*(q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) = (1-z/E)*z ∧ normalizedValue q z ≤ 1-z/E
  refine ⟨div_pos hz hE, (div_lt_one hE).mpr (by dsimp [E]; linarith), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hid : (z/E)*E = z := div_mul_cancel₀ z (ne_of_gt hE)
    have hsplit : (z/E)*(q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) + (z/E)*z = z := by
      calc
        _ = (z/E)*E := by dsimp [E]; ring
        _ = z := hid
    linarith
  · have hweight : (q+1)*(z/E) ≤ 2*z := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hE]
      dsimp [E]
      nlinarith
    unfold normalizedValue
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hk).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg z, mul_nonneg hz.le (show 0 ≤ 1/3-z by linarith)]

/-- Completed square for the two-orbit design, with every real nuisance value.
The stationarity equality is proved by calibrationWeight_properties. -/
theorem primal_square_identity (q z w t : ℝ) (hq : q+1 ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rootEquation q z = 0)
    (hstat : w*(q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z) = (1-w)*z) :
    (q+1)*((1-w)*primalA q t+w*primalB q t-normalizedValue q z) =
      ((1-w)+w*(q+1)*(q-2)^2)*(t-1-z)^2 := by
  unfold primalA primalB normalizedValue
  field_simp
  have hid : (1-w)*(q+(t-1)^2)+w*(q+1)*((q-1)-(q-2)*t)^2-(q+z^2) -
      ((1-w)+w*(q+1)*(q-2)^2)*(t-1-z)^2 =
      w*rootEquation q z - 2*(t-1-z)*(w*(q+1)*(q-2)*(1-(q-2)*z)-(1-w)*z) := by
    unfold rootEquation
    ring
  rw [hroot, hstat] at hid
  nlinarith

/-- All nuisance alternatives at nearest exchange distance are rejected at
at least the proposed information rate by this explicit mixture. -/
theorem all_width_primal_lower (q t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) ≤
      (1-calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q))*primalA q t +
        calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)*primalB q t := by
  have hz := calibrationRoot_properties q hq
  have hw := calibrationWeight_properties q _ hq hz.1 hz.2.1
  have hid := primal_square_identity q (calibrationRoot q) (calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q))
    t (by linarith) hz.2.2 hw.2.2.1
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (1-calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)) +
      calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)*(q+1)*(q-2)^2 := by
    have hprod : 0 ≤ calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)*(q+1)*(q-2)^2 :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw.1.le (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith [hw.2.1]
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hcoef (sq_nonneg (t-1-calibrationRoot q))
  nlinarith

#print axioms calibrationWeight_properties
#print axioms primal_square_identity
#print axioms all_width_primal_lower

/-- The same dual also bounds every scalar Q measurement, including Q_j. -/
theorem all_width_scalar_dual (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    (1-calibrationRoot q)^2/(q+1) ≤ normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) ∧
    (1+(q-1)*(calibrationRoot q)^2)/q ≤ normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) ∧
    (calibrationRoot q)^2 ≤ normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) := by
  let z := calibrationRoot q
  have hz := calibrationRoot_properties q hq
  have hzpos : 0 < z := hz.1
  have hzsmall : (2*q+1)*z ≤ 1 := hz.2.1
  have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hsq : z^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  change (1-z)^2/(q+1) ≤ (q+z^2)/(q+1) ∧
    (1+(q-1)*z^2)/q ≤ (q+z^2)/(q+1) ∧ z^2 ≤ (q+z^2)/(q+1)
  refine ⟨(div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hk).mpr (by nlinarith), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hp hk).mpr
    have hc : 0 ≤ q^2-q-1 := by nlinarith
    have hh := mul_nonneg hc (show 0 ≤ 1-z^2 by linarith)
    nlinarith
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hk).mpr
    have hh := mul_nonneg hp.le (show 0 ≤ 1-z^2 by linarith)
    nlinarith

/-- A feasible nuisance value attains the lower bound: nu=(1+z)/2. -/
theorem all_width_primal_attainment (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    0 ≤ (1+calibrationRoot q)/2 ∧ (1+calibrationRoot q)/2 ≤ 1 ∧
    (1-calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q))*primalA q (1+calibrationRoot q) +
      calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)*primalB q (1+calibrationRoot q) =
        normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) := by
  have hz := calibrationRoot_properties q hq
  have hw := calibrationWeight_properties q _ hq hz.1 hz.2.1
  have hid := primal_square_identity q (calibrationRoot q) (calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q))
    (1+calibrationRoot q) (by linarith) hz.2.2 hw.2.2.1
  have hzero : 1+calibrationRoot q-1-calibrationRoot q = 0 := by ring
  rw [hzero] at hid
  norm_num at hid
  refine ⟨by linarith [hz.1], ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
  · rcases hid with hf | ht
    · linarith
    · linarith

/-- Distant alternatives are covered whenever their normalized A-query loss
is at least one, as occurs for exchange distance at least two. -/
theorem all_width_distant_lower (q a b : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    normalizedValue q (calibrationRoot q) ≤
      (1-calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q))*a +
        calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q)*b := by
  have hz := calibrationRoot_properties q hq
  have hw := calibrationWeight_properties q _ hq hz.1 hz.2.1
  have hA := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1-calibrationWeight q (calibrationRoot q) by linarith [hw.2.1])
    (show 0 ≤ a-1 by linarith)
  have hB := mul_nonneg hw.1.le hb
  linarith [hw.2.2.2]

#print axioms all_width_scalar_dual
#print axioms all_width_primal_attainment
#print axioms all_width_distant_lower
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationOrbit

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeCoreV1.lean (80 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginRegionV1»

/-! Algebraic core of the scalar-B / B-on phase. Conditions are explicit
balance and stationarity equations, not assumed optimality. Endpoint formulas
and their feasibility are still to be connected separately. All-distance
bounds cover distance one and every real distance >=2 up to q. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
noncomputable section

def mixedLoss (q mu w d u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1-w)*(d*mu^2+(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2)/q+
    w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2

def gammaTwice (q mu shift : ℝ) : ℝ := (mu^2+(q-1)*shift^2)/q

def coefficient (q w : ℝ) : ℝ := (1-w)*(q-1)/q+w*(q-2)^2

/-- Exact identity isolating the only two equations required for nearest
alternative optimality. -/
theorem square_remainder (q mu w shift u : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    q*(mixedLoss q mu w 1 u-gammaTwice q mu shift-
      coefficient q w*(u-((1-mu)+shift))^2) =
      w*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift)^2-mu^2-(q-1)*shift^2)+
      2*(u-((1-mu)+shift))*((1-w)*(q-1)*shift-w*q*(q-2)*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift)) := by
  unfold mixedLoss gammaTwice coefficient
  field_simp [hq]
  <;> ring

theorem nearest_completed_square (q mu w shift u : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (balance : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift)^2=mu^2+(q-1)*shift^2)
    (stationarity : (1-w)*(q-1)*shift=w*q*(q-2)*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift)) :
    mixedLoss q mu w 1 u=gammaTwice q mu shift+
      coefficient q w*(u-((1-mu)+shift))^2 := by
  have he := square_remainder q mu w shift u (ne_of_gt hq)
  rw [stationarity,sub_self,mul_zero,add_zero,balance] at he
  have hzero : q*(mixedLoss q mu w 1 u-gammaTwice q mu shift-
      coefficient q w*(u-((1-mu)+shift))^2)=0 := by nlinarith [he]
  have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hq)
  linarith

theorem distant_lower (q mu w shift d u : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q)
    (guard : (q-1)*shift^2 ≤ (1-2*w)*mu^2) :
    gammaTwice q mu shift ≤ mixedLoss q mu w d u := by
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hterm : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2 := by positivity
  have hterm2 : 0 ≤ q*w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2 := by positivity
  have hdterm : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(d-2)*mu^2 := by positivity
  unfold gammaTwice mixedLoss
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have he : ((1-w)*(d*mu^2+(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2)/q+
      w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2)*q =
      (1-w)*d*mu^2+(1-w)*(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2+
        q*w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp]
    <;> ring
  rw [he]
  nlinarith

/-- Once feasibility, balance and stationarity are proved for the explicit
phase formula, every integer alternative distance is covered. -/
theorem all_distances_lower (q mu w shift d u : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) (hd : d=1 ∨ 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q)
    (balance : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift)^2=mu^2+(q-1)*shift^2)
    (stationarity : (1-w)*(q-1)*shift=w*q*(q-2)*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift))
    (guard : (q-1)*shift^2 ≤ (1-2*w)*mu^2) :
    gammaTwice q mu shift ≤ mixedLoss q mu w d u := by
  rcases hd with he | he
  · subst d
    rw [nearest_completed_square q mu w shift u (by linarith) balance stationarity]
    have hc : 0 ≤ coefficient q w := by unfold coefficient; positivity
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg _))
  · exact distant_lower q mu w shift d u hq hw hw1 he hdq guard

#print axioms square_remainder
#print axioms nearest_completed_square
#print axioms distant_lower
#print axioms all_distances_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeDualV1.lean (178 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasibleV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! All-query dual for phase III. An adjacent-world mixture uses nuisance
nu = mu - shift. The same mixture bounds every legal measurement. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeDual
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

/-- Below the old tilt, the anchored B endpoint dominates the A endpoint. -/
theorem endpoint_order (q z : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hzz : z ≤ tilt q) :
    q*(1+z)^2 ≤ (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have ht := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  change 0 < tilt q ∧ 4*q*tilt q ≤ 1 ∧
    (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*tilt q)^2=q*(1+tilt q)^2 at ht
  have hleft : (1+z)^2 ≤ (1+tilt q)^2 := by nlinarith
  have htpos : 0 ≤ 1-(q-2)*tilt q := by nlinarith [ht.1,ht.2.1]
  have horder : 1-(q-2)*tilt q ≤ 1-(q-2)*z := by nlinarith
  have hright : (1-(q-2)*tilt q)^2 ≤ (1-(q-2)*z)^2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ htpos (le_trans htpos horder)).mpr horder
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleft (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith)
  linarith [ht.2.2]

/-- The existing continuous count envelope now has a phase-III endpoint. -/
theorem joint_envelope (q z s t : ℝ) (h : Bool) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hsmall : 4*q*z ≤ 1) (hzz : z ≤ tilt q)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dual q z (bit h) s t ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
  have he := endpoint_order q z hq hz hzz
  have hA : dual q z 0 q 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
    unfold dual
    nlinarith
  have hAon : dual q z 1 q 0 ≤ dual q z 0 q 0 := by
    have hqm : 0 ≤ q-1 := by linarith
    have hh : 0 ≤ q*z*(2*q+(q-1)*z) := by positivity
    unfold dual
    nlinarith
  have hBoff : dual q z 0 0 q ≤ dual q z 1 0 q := by
    have hh : 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*z*(2-(2*q-3)*z) := by
      apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    unfold dual
    nlinarith
  have hBon : dual q z 1 0 q=q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by unfold dual; ring
  cases h with
  | false =>
    exact dual_envelope q z 0 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hs ht hst hA (by linarith [hBoff,hBon])
  | true =>
    exact dual_envelope q z 1 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hs ht hst (le_trans hAon hA) hBon.le

theorem phase_nuisance_bounds (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    0 < 1-mu ∧ 0 ≤ mu-shift q mu ∧ mu-shift q mu ≤ 1 ∧
      0 ≤ shift q mu/(1-mu) ∧ 4*q*(shift q mu/(1-mu)) ≤ 1 ∧
      shift q mu/(1-mu) ≤ tilt q := by
  obtain ⟨hm,hm1,hd,hsmall⟩ := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hhigh : marginHigh q < 1 := (div_lt_one (by linarith : 0 < 1+Real.sqrt q)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hl : 0 < 1-mu := by linarith
  have hdmu : shift q mu ≤ mu := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨hl,by linarith,by linarith,div_nonneg hd hl.le,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    exact (div_le_one hl).mpr hsmall
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hl).mpr (by
      nlinarith [shift_le_boundary_tilt q mu hq (by linarith) hm1 hlo])

/-- Actual joint-world information is bounded for every legal group size,
not just the two groups that receive primal mass. -/
theorem actual_joint_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu (mu-shift q mu)) ≤
        (q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by
  let lam := 1-mu
  let z := shift q mu/lam
  have hp := phase_nuisance_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have ht : 1-lam*(1+z)=mu-shift q mu := by
    dsimp [z,lam]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp.1]
    ring
  have hmu : 1-lam=mu := by dsimp [lam]; ring
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu (mu-shift q mu)) =
      4*lam^2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro b hb
    rw [← ht,← hmu]
    exact joint_homogeneity A (swapped A a b) G j h hj
      (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG lam (1+z)
  have hcnt : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card ≤ q := by
    have he : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card=G.card :=
      by exact_mod_cast query_count_partition A G j hjG
    linarith
  have hb := joint_envelope q z (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card h hq
    hp.2.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2.2.2 (by positivity) (by positivity) hcnt
  have hs := actual_dual_sum A G j h q z hj hA hB hjG hG
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg lam)
  have hid : lam^2*(q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2)=
      (q+1)*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2) := by
    dsimp [lam,z]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp.1]
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  rw [balance q mu hq (by linarith [hm.1]) hm.2.1] at hid
  rw [he]
  nlinarith [hmul,hs,hid]

theorem actual_scalar_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i mu (mu-shift q mu)) ≤
        (q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by
  have hp := phase_nuisance_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have ht : 1-(1-mu)*(1+shift q mu/(1-mu))=mu-shift q mu := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp.1]
    ring
  have he := actual_scalar_margin_sum A j i hj (1-mu) (shift q mu/(1-mu))
  have hsq : (1-mu)^2*(shift q mu/(1-mu))^2=(shift q mu)^2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp.1]
  rw [ht,show 1-(1-mu)=mu by ring,hA,hB] at he
  have hs : (mu-shift q mu)^2 ≤ mu^2 := by
    nlinarith only [hp.2.1,hm.2.2.1]
  have hd : (shift q mu)^2 ≤ mu^2 := by
    nlinarith only [hp.2.1,hm.2.2.1,hm.1]
  have hnon : 0 ≤ (q-1)*(shift q mu)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [he]
  split_ifs
  · calc
      _ ≤ q*mu^2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by linarith)
      _ ≤ (q+1)*mu^2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_right hnon) (by linarith)
  · rw [mul_assoc ((q+1)*q),hsq]
    calc
      _ = (q+1)*((shift q mu)^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hd (le_refl _)) (by linarith)
  · rw [mul_assoc (q-1),hsq]


theorem measurement_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) ≤
        (q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => exact actual_scalar_bound A j i q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB
  | inr p => exact actual_joint_bound A p.1 j p.2 q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB he.1 he.2.2 he.2.1

#print axioms endpoint_order
#print axioms joint_envelope
#print axioms phase_nuisance_bounds
#print axioms actual_joint_bound
#print axioms actual_scalar_bound
#print axioms measurement_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeDual

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasibleV1.lean (174 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeParametersV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginRegionV1»

/-! Feasibility of the phase-III small root. The explicit radical is compared
with a super-solution, allowing the true margin interval to be connected to the
all-distance certificate without assuming the optimizer formula is correct. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
noncomputable section

def marginHigh (q : ℝ) := Real.sqrt q/(1+Real.sqrt q)

theorem upper_endpoint_numerator (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hu : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    mu ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ q*(1-mu)^2-mu^2 := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hd : 0 < 1+Real.sqrt q := by linarith
  have hline := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hu
  have hmu1 : mu ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hprod : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt q*(1-mu) := mul_nonneg hs.le (by linarith)
  have he := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
  have hb : mu ≤ Real.sqrt q*(1-mu) := by nlinarith
  have hb2 := sq_le_sq₀ hmu hprod |>.mpr hb
  rw [mul_pow,he] at hb2
  exact ⟨hmu1,by linarith⟩

theorem shift_nonnegative (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hmu : 0 < mu) (hu : mu ≤ marginHigh q) : 0 ≤ shift q mu := by
  have hn := upper_endpoint_numerator q mu hq hmu.le hu
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hmu
  unfold shift
  exact div_nonneg hn.2 (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith [hn.1])) hd.le)

/-- A super-solution bounds the smaller root, without any monotonicity assumption
on the quadratic outside its two roots. -/
theorem shift_le_of_supersolution (q mu x : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hx : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*x)^2-mu^2-(q-1)*x^2 ≤ 0) :
    shift q mu ≤ x := by
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hmu
  have he := rationalized_shift q mu hq hmu hmu1
  have hs := radical_square q mu hq
  have hid : (q*(q-2)*(1-mu)-K q*x)^2-(D q mu)^2 =
      K q*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*x)^2-mu^2-(q-1)*x^2) := by
    rw [hs]
    unfold radicand K
    ring
  have hnon := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hk.le hx
  have hsq : (q*(q-2)*(1-mu)-K q*x)^2 ≤ (D q mu)^2 := by linarith [hid]
  have hlinear : q*(q-2)*(1-mu)-K q*x ≤ D q mu := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q*(q-2)*(1-mu)-K q*x-D q mu)]
  nlinarith

/-- The old exact boundary is a super-solution throughout phase III. -/
theorem shift_le_boundary_tilt (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) :
    shift q mu ≤ (1-mu)*tilt q := by
  have hr := radius_pos q hq
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  have hd : 0 < 1+radius q := by linarith
  have hline := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mp hlo
  have hnon : 0 ≤ (1-mu)*radius q := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hr.le
  have hbound : ((1-mu)*radius q)^2 ≤ mu^2 := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ hnon hmu.le).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hzbal := (root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2).2.2
  change (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*tilt q)^2=q*(1+tilt q)^2 at hzbal
  have hrbal := radius_balance q hq
  have hidentity : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*((1-mu)*tilt q))^2-
      (q-1)*((1-mu)*tilt q)^2 = ((1-mu)*radius q)^2 := by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => q*(1-mu)^2*t) hzbal
    have h2 := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (1-mu)^2*t) hrbal
    unfold gain at h2
    have heq : (q+1)*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*((1-mu)*tilt q))^2-
        (q-1)*((1-mu)*tilt q)^2-((1-mu)*radius q)^2)=0 := by
      nlinarith [h1,h2]
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_left (by linarith : q+1 ≠ 0)
    linarith
  apply shift_le_of_supersolution q mu ((1-mu)*tilt q) hq hmu hmu1
  linarith [hidentity]

theorem marginMax_ge_half (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ marginMax q := by
  have hz := tilt_pos q hq
  have hqp : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q^2+2*q^2*tilt q+(tilt q)^2)/(q+1) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hqp).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2*q^2 by positivity) hz.le]
  have hr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ radius q := by
    have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb
    simpa [radius] using hs
  unfold marginMax
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1+radius q)).mpr
  linarith

theorem phase_shift_bounds (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ mu ∧ mu ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ shift q mu ∧ 4*q*shift q mu ≤ 1-mu := by
  have hm := le_trans (marginMax_ge_half q hq) hlo
  have hmpos : 0 < mu := by linarith
  have hu := upper_endpoint_numerator q mu hq hmpos.le hup
  have hs := shift_le_boundary_tilt q mu hq hmpos hu.1 hlo
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := (root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2).2.1
  change 4*q*tilt q ≤ 1 at hz
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0 ≤ 4*q by linarith)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (show 0 ≤ 1-mu by linarith [hu.1])
  exact ⟨hm,hu.1,shift_nonnegative q mu hq hmpos hup,by nlinarith [h1,h2]⟩

/-- The explicit phase-III weights are a probability mixture, uniformly in q. -/
theorem phase_mass_bounds (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    0 ≤ mass q mu ∧ mass q mu ≤ 1/4 := by
  obtain ⟨hm,hm1,hs,hsmall⟩ := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hmpos : 0 < mu := by linarith
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hmpos
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have hr := rationalized_shift q mu hq hmpos hm1
  have hcpos : 0 ≤ K q+4*(q-1) := by linarith
  have hc : K q+4*(q-1) ≤ 4*q*(q*(q-2)) := by
    unfold K
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-3 by linarith)
      (show 0 ≤ 3*q^2+5*q+8 by positivity)]
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall hcpos
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (show 0 ≤ 1-mu by linarith)
  have hC : (K q+4*(q-1))*shift q mu ≤ q*(q-2)*(1-mu) := by
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := 4*q) ?_ (by linarith)
    nlinarith [h1,h2]
  constructor
  · unfold mass
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hs) hd.le
  · unfold mass
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    nlinarith [hC,hr]

/-- The distant-alternative guard now follows from the actual phase interval. -/
theorem phase_guard (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    (q-1)*(shift q mu)^2 ≤ (1-2*mass q mu)*mu^2 := by
  obtain ⟨hm,hm1,hs,hsmall⟩ := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hsmall' : 4*q*shift q mu ≤ mu := by linarith
  have hsquare := (sq_le_sq₀ (show 0 ≤ 4*q*shift q mu by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ mu by linarith)).mpr hsmall'
  have hc : 2*(q-1) ≤ (4*q)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hc' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg (shift q mu))
  have hw' := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1/4-mass q mu by linarith [hw.2]) (sq_nonneg mu)
  nlinarith [hsquare,hc',hw']

theorem phase_all_distances_lower (q mu d u : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hd : d=1 ∨ 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore.gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) ≤
      CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore.mixedLoss q mu (mass q mu) d u := by
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  exact CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore.all_distances_lower q mu (mass q mu)
    (shift q mu) d u hq hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2]) hd hdq
    (balance q mu hq (by linarith [hm.1]) hm.2.1)
    (stationarity q mu hq (by linarith [hm.1]) hm.2.1)
    (phase_guard q mu hq hlo hup)

#print axioms upper_endpoint_numerator
#print axioms shift_nonnegative
#print axioms shift_le_of_supersolution
#print axioms shift_le_boundary_tilt
#print axioms phase_shift_bounds
#print axioms phase_mass_bounds
#print axioms phase_guard
#print axioms phase_all_distances_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeGameV1.lean (107 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreePrimalV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeDualV1»

/-! Both sides of the actual D6 allocation game throughout phase III. The
nuisance adversary is chosen after the whole allocation, not after its query. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeGame
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreePrimal
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeDual
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def rate (q mu : ℝ) := gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2

/-- One adjacent alternative defeats the entire legal allocation. -/
theorem allocation_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ a ∈ A,∃ b ∈ others A j,
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) ≤ rate q mu := by
  let L := fun a b => ∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b)=
      ∑ e ∈ E,w e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) := by
    dsimp [L]
    simp_rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ A,∑ e ∈ E,∑ b ∈ others A j,
          w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha; exact sum_comm
      _ = _ := sum_comm
  have hb : 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b) ≤
      (q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by
    rw [hsum,mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,w e*((q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_bound A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB e (hl e he)) (hw e he)
        nlinarith only [hh]
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hn,one_mul]
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hrate : 2*q*rate q mu=mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2 := by
    unfold rate gammaTwice
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hp]
  have hlower : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b) ≤
      ∑ _a ∈ A,∑ _b ∈ others A j,rate q mu := by
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hA,hB]
    nlinarith only [hb,congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (q+1)*x) hrate]
  have hAnon : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A.card by linarith))
  have hBnon : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < (others A j).card by linarith))
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hal⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hAnon hlower
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbl⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hBnon hal
  exact ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hbl⟩

/-- A legal probability allocation attains Gamma, and every legal allocation
has one admissible world with information at most Gamma. -/
theorem sharp_actual_game (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∃ E : Finset (Measurement n),∃ w : Measurement n → ℝ,
      (∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ E,w e)=1 ∧
      (∀ A' : Finset (I n),j ∉ A' → A'.card=A.card → A' ≠ A →
        ∀ nu : ℝ,0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 → rate q mu ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e)) ∧
    (∀ E : Finset (Measurement n),∀ w : Measurement n → ℝ,
      (∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) → (∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) → (∑ e ∈ E,w e)=1 →
      ∃ A' : Finset (I n),∃ nu : ℝ,A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧
        0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧ (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e) ≤ rate q mu) := by
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hp := distribution A j q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hB hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2])
  constructor
  · refine ⟨queries A j,weights A j q (mass q mu),hp.1,(fun e _ => hp.2.1 e),hp.2.2,?_⟩
    intro A' hj' hcard hne nu _ _
    exact all_actual_alternatives_lower A A' j q mu nu hq hlo hup hj hj' hcard hne hB
  · intro E w hl hw hn
    obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hu⟩ := allocation_upper A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
    have hnuis := phase_nuisance_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
    exact ⟨swapped A a b,mu-shift q mu,swapped_ne A j a b hb,
      swapped_card A j a b ha hb,swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,hnuis.2.1,hnuis.2.2.1,hu⟩

/-- The explicit allocation has an admissible worst world attaining Gamma. -/
theorem value_attained (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n),∃ nu : ℝ,A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧
      0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q (mass q mu) e*information A A' j mu nu e)=rate q mu := by
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hp := distribution A j q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hB hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2])
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hu⟩ :=
    (sharp_actual_game A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB).2
      (queries A j) (weights A j q (mass q mu)) hp.1 (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  exact ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,le_antisymm hu
    (all_actual_alternatives_lower A A' j q mu nu hq hlo hup hj hj' hcard hne hB)⟩

#print axioms allocation_upper
#print axioms sharp_actual_game
#print axioms value_attained
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeGame

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeParametersV1.lean (85 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeCoreV1»

/-! The phase-III radical formula satisfies the exact balance and stationarity
identities used by the all-distance core. Margin-interval feasibility bounds
are not claimed here; all assumptions are displayed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
noncomputable section

def K (q : ℝ) := q*(q-2)^2-q+1
def radicand (q mu : ℝ) := q*(q-1)*(1-mu)^2+K q*mu^2
def D (q mu : ℝ) := Real.sqrt (radicand q mu)
def shift (q mu : ℝ) := (q*(1-mu)^2-mu^2)/(q*(q-2)*(1-mu)+D q mu)
def mass (q mu : ℝ) := (q-1)*shift q mu/D q mu

theorem K_pos (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : 0 < K q := by
  have hp : 0 ≤ q*((q-2)^2-1) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
  unfold K
  nlinarith

theorem radical_positive (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hmu : 0 < mu) : 0 < D q mu := by
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
  unfold radicand
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have h1 : 0 ≤ q*(q-1)*(1-mu)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have h2 : 0 < K q*mu^2 := mul_pos hk (sq_pos_of_pos hmu)
  linarith

theorem radical_square (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : (D q mu)^2=radicand q mu := by
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  unfold radicand
  have hk := (K_pos q hq).le
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _))
    (mul_nonneg hk (sq_nonneg _))

theorem rationalized_shift (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    K q*shift q mu=q*(q-2)*(1-mu)-D q mu := by
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hmu
  have hp : 0 ≤ q*(q-2)*(1-mu) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith)
  have hn : q*(q-2)*(1-mu)+D q mu ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hs := radical_square q mu hq
  dsimp [radicand,K] at hs
  unfold shift K
  field_simp [hn]
  nlinarith [hs]

theorem balance (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2=mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2 := by
  have he := rationalized_shift q mu hq hmu hmu1
  have hs := radical_square q mu hq
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have he2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x^2) he
  have hid : K q*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2-mu^2-(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) =
      (K q*shift q mu)^2-2*(K q*shift q mu)*(q*(q-2)*(1-mu))+
        (q*(q-2)*(1-mu))^2-(D q mu)^2 := by
    rw [hs]
    unfold radicand K
    ring
  rw [he] at hid
  have hzero : K q*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2-mu^2-(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2)=0 := by
    nlinarith [hid]
  have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hk)
  linarith

theorem stationarity (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    (1-mass q mu)*(q-1)*shift q mu =
      mass q mu*q*(q-2)*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu) := by
  have he := rationalized_shift q mu hq hmu hmu1
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hmu
  have hrel : D q mu-(q-1)*shift q mu=q*(q-2)*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu) := by
    unfold K at he
    nlinarith
  unfold mass
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hd]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => ((q-1)*shift q mu)*x) hrel]

#print axioms K_pos
#print axioms radical_positive
#print axioms rationalized_shift
#print axioms balance
#print axioms stationarity
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreePrimalV1.lean (156 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasibleV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! Phase III on actual D6 world evaluations and a normalized distribution
on legal measurements. This file proves the primal against every hidden
alternative; optimality additionally requires the all-query dual. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreePrimal
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem scalar_B_point (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hi : i ∈ others A j) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*scalarKL A A' j i mu nu =
      (mu-nu)^2+(mu^2-(mu-nu)^2)*hit A' i := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j i hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response A' j hj']
  by_cases hi' : i ∈ A' <;>
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hh.1,hh.2,hi',hit,bit_true] <;> ring

/-- Exact sum of scalar information for every alternative distance. -/
theorem actual_scalar_B_sum (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ i ∈ others A j, scalarKL A A' j i mu nu) =
      (A \ A').card*mu^2+
        (((others A j).card : ℝ)-(A \ A').card)*(mu-nu)^2 := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  have he : (∑ i ∈ others A j, 2*scalarKL A A' j i mu nu) =
      ∑ i ∈ others A j, ((mu-nu)^2+(mu^2-(mu-nu)^2)*hit A' i) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact scalar_B_point A A' j i hj hj' hi mu nu
  rw [he]
  simp only [sum_add_distrib,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,← mul_sum,sum_hit]
  rw [intersection_others A' A j hj',card_sdiff_comm hcard]
  ring

theorem actual_Bon_information (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu =
      ((1-mu)*((others A j).card-1)-
        (1-nu)*(((others A j).card : ℝ)-(A \ A').card-1))^2 := by
  have hjB : j ∉ others A j := by simp [others]
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A (others A j) j true hj hjB (by simp),
    actual_query_mean A' (others A j) j true hj' hjB (by simp),
    inter_self,B_alternative_count A A' j hj' hcard]
  simp only [bit_true,↓reduceIte]
  ring

def queries (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Finset (Measurement n) :=
  insert (.inr (others A j,true)) ((others A j).image Sum.inl)

def weights (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) : ℝ :=
  (if e=.inr (others A j,true) then w else 0)+
    ∑ i ∈ others A j, if e=.inl i then (1-w)/q else 0

theorem distribution_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ)
    (f : Measurement n → ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ queries A j, weights A j q w e*f e) =
      (1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j, f (.inl i))+w*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by
  have hb : (.inr (others A j,true) : Measurement n) ∈ queries A j := by simp [queries]
  have hi : ∀ i ∈ others A j, (.inl i : Measurement n) ∈ queries A j := by
    intro i hi
    exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
  unfold weights
  simp only [add_mul,sum_add_distrib,sum_mul]
  have hbSum : (∑ e ∈ queries A j,
      (if e=.inr (others A j,true) then w else 0)*f e)=w*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by
    simp [ite_mul,hb]
  rw [hbSum,sum_comm]
  have hiSum : (∑ i ∈ others A j, ∑ e ∈ queries A j,
      (if e=.inl i then (1-w)/q else 0)*f e)=(1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j, f (.inl i)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hmem
    simp [ite_mul,hi i hmem]
  rw [hiSum]
  ring

theorem distribution (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) :
    (∀ e ∈ queries A j, Legal j q e) ∧
    (∀ e, 0 ≤ weights A j q w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ queries A j, weights A j q w e)=1 := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro e he
    rcases mem_insert.mp he with he | he
    · subst e
      exact ⟨by simp [others],hB.le,by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
      trivial
  · intro e
    unfold weights
    apply add_nonneg
    · split <;> linarith
    · apply sum_nonneg
      intro i hi
      split
      · exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hq.le
      · exact le_refl 0
  · have he := distribution_sum A j q w (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hB] at he
    rw [he]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hq]
    ring

/-- No abstract loss postulate: the finite actual-world sum is the quadratic. -/
theorem actual_information_eq (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu nu w : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    2*(∑ e ∈ queries A j, weights A j q w e*information A A' j mu nu e) =
      mixedLoss q mu w (A \ A').card (1-nu) := by
  rw [distribution_sum]
  change 2*((1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j, scalarKL A A' j i mu nu)+
    w*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu)=_
  have hs := actual_scalar_B_sum A A' j hj hj' hcard mu nu
  have hb := actual_Bon_information A A' j hj hj' hcard mu nu
  rw [hB] at hs hb
  calc
    _ = (1-w)/q*(2*(∑ i ∈ others A j, scalarKL A A' j i mu nu))+
        w*(2*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu) := by ring
    _ = mixedLoss q mu w (A \ A').card (1-nu) := by rw [hs,hb]; unfold mixedLoss; ring

/-- Every legal alternative, including nonadjacent worlds and any nuisance
margin, is separated at the explicit phase-III rate. -/
theorem all_actual_alternatives_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2 ≤
      ∑ e ∈ queries A j, weights A j q (mass q mu) e*information A A' j mu nu e := by
  have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q hj' hcard hne hB
  have hdn : 1 ≤ (A \ A').card := by exact_mod_cast hd.1
  have hcases : ((A \ A').card : ℝ)=1 ∨ 2 ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) := by
    by_cases he : (A \ A').card=1
    · left; exact_mod_cast he
    · right; exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ (A \ A').card by omega)
  have hl := phase_all_distances_lower q mu (A \ A').card (1-nu) hq hlo hup hcases hd.2
  rw [← actual_information_eq A A' j q mu nu (mass q mu) hj hj' hcard hB] at hl
  linarith

#print axioms actual_scalar_B_sum
#print axioms actual_Bon_information
#print axioms distribution_sum
#print axioms distribution
#print axioms actual_information_eq
#print axioms all_actual_alternatives_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreePrimal

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationPrimalBridgeV1.lean (143 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationFiniteBridgeV1»

/-! The actual two-orbit query allocation has exactly the analytic primal
loss, for every same-cardinality hidden alternative and every real margin. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem intersection_others (H A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjH : j ∉ H) :
    H ∩ others A j=H \ A := by
  ext i
  simp only [mem_inter, others, mem_erase, mem_sdiff, mem_univ, true_and]
  aesop

theorem card_erase_real (H : Finset (I n)) (a : I n) :
    ((H.erase a).card : ℝ)=H.card-hit H a := by
  by_cases ha : a ∈ H
  · have he : ((H.erase a).card : ℝ)+1=H.card := by exact_mod_cast card_erase_add_one ha
    simp only [hit, ite_eq_left ha]
    linarith
  · simp [hit, ha]

/-- Each A-minus-one query counts d minus one possible omitted mistake. -/
theorem erased_A_count (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j a : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) :
    (((A.erase a) ∩ others A' j).card : ℝ)=(A \ A').card-hit (A \ A') a := by
  have he : (A.erase a) ∩ others A' j=(A ∩ others A' j).erase a := by ext i; simp
  rw [he, intersection_others A A' j hj, card_erase_real]

/-- The B query counts q-d in any alternative with the same cardinality. -/
theorem B_alternative_count (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hcard : A'.card=A.card) :
    ((others A j ∩ others A' j).card : ℝ)=(others A j).card-(A \ A').card := by
  have hjB : j ∉ others A j := by simp [others]
  have hswap : (others A j) ∩ A'=A' \ A := by
    rw [inter_comm, intersection_others A' A j hj']
  have hds : (A' \ A).card=(A \ A').card := card_sdiff_comm hcard
  have hn := card_sdiff_add_card_inter (others A j) A'
  rw [hswap, hds, ← intersection_others (others A j) A' j hjB] at hn
  have hr : ((others A j ∩ others A' j).card : ℝ)+(A \ A').card=(others A j).card := by exact_mod_cast hn
  linarith

theorem erased_query_legal (A : Finset (I n)) (j a : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hA : 4 ≤ A.card) : j ∉ A.erase a ∧ 2 ≤ (A.erase a).card := by
  refine ⟨by simp [hj], ?_⟩
  rw [card_erase_of_mem ha]
  omega

/-- Pointwise actual unanchored KL, with no abstract loss assumption. -/
theorem erased_A_KL (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j a : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hA : 4 ≤ A.card) (t : ℝ) :
    8*queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2) =
      t^2*(((A \ A').card : ℝ)-hit (A \ A') a)^2 := by
  have hlegal := erased_query_legal A j a hj ha hA
  have htrue : ((A.erase a) ∩ others A j)=∅ := by
    rw [intersection_others (A.erase a) A j hlegal.1]
    exact sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mpr (erase_subset a A)
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A (A.erase a) j false hj hlegal.1 (by intro _; exact hlegal.2),
    actual_query_mean A' (A.erase a) j false hj' hlegal.1 (by intro _; exact hlegal.2),
    htrue, card_empty, erased_A_count A A' j a hj]
  simp only [bit_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_zero]
  ring

theorem single_second_moment (H G : Finset (I n)) (u v : ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ H, (u+v*hit G i)^2)=(H.card : ℝ)*u^2+(2*u*v+v^2)*(G ∩ H).card := by
  have he : ∀ i, (u+v*hit G i)^2=u^2+(2*u*v+v^2)*hit G i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ G <;> simp [hit, hi] <;> ring
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, sum_hit]

/-- Exact average over the k actual A-minus-one queries; d may be any
exchange distance, including non-nearest alternatives. -/
theorem actual_A_query_sum (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hA : 4 ≤ A.card) (t : ℝ) :
    8*(∑ a ∈ A, queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2)) =
      t^2*(A \ A').card*((A \ A').card*((A.card : ℝ)-2)+1) := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A, 8*queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2)) =
      ∑ a ∈ A, t^2*(((A \ A').card : ℝ)+(-1)*hit (A \ A') a)^2 := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    rw [erased_A_KL A A' j a hj hj' ha hA]
    ring
  rw [he, ← mul_sum, single_second_moment]
  rw [inter_eq_left.mpr (sdiff_subset : A \ A' ⊆ A)]
  ring

/-- Exact contribution of the actual anchored B query. -/
theorem actual_B_query_KL (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (t : ℝ) :
    8*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true (1/2) (1-t/2) =
      (((others A j).card : ℝ)-1-(((others A j).card : ℝ)-(A \ A').card-1)*t)^2 := by
  have hjB : j ∉ others A j := by simp [others]
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A (others A j) j true hj hjB (by simp),
    actual_query_mean A' (others A j) j true hj' hjB (by simp),
    inter_self, B_alternative_count A A' j hj' hcard]
  simp only [bit_true, ↓reduceIte]
  ring

def actualPrimal (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q c t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((1-weight q c)/(q+1))*(∑ a ∈ A, queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2)) +
    weight q c*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true (1/2) (1-t/2)

/-- Complete primal bridge: a sum of squared differences of ACTUAL worlds
is exactly the analytic designLoss, for every hidden alternative. -/
theorem actual_primal_eq (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q c t : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    8*actualPrimal A A' j q c t=designLoss q c (A \ A').card t := by
  have hAn : 4 ≤ A.card := by exact_mod_cast (show (4:ℝ) ≤ A.card by linarith)
  have hsum := actual_A_query_sum A A' j hj hj' hAn t
  have hb := actual_B_query_KL A A' j hj hj' hcard t
  rw [hA] at hsum
  rw [hB] at hb
  unfold actualPrimal
  calc
    _ = ((1-weight q c)/(q+1))*(8*(∑ a ∈ A, queryKL A A' (A.erase a) j false (1/2) (1-t/2))) +
        weight q c*(8*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true (1/2) (1-t/2)) := by ring
    _ = designLoss q c (A \ A').card t := by rw [hsum, hb]; unfold designLoss; ring

/-- The proved analytic lower bound now applies to the actual allocation. -/
theorem actual_primal_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q t : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hd : 1 ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ)) (hdq : ((A \ A').card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    value q (scale q)/8 ≤ actualPrimal A A' j q (scale q) t := by
  have he := actual_primal_eq A A' j q (scale q) t hq hj hj' hcard hA hB
  have hl := all_distances_lower q (A \ A').card t hq hd hdq
  linarith

#print axioms B_alternative_count
#print axioms actual_A_query_sum
#print axioms actual_B_query_KL
#print axioms actual_primal_eq
#print axioms actual_primal_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationRiskBridgeV1.lean (103 dong)
import «LeanD6MovingNuisanceRegretV1»
import «LeanD6GaussianOverlapV1»

/-! Allocation loss uses the infimum over actual same-cardinality alternative
worlds and all legal nuisance margins. Benchmark rates are explicit arguments;
this module does not silently assume the unproved phase-III oracle formula. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6MovingNuisanceRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def Admissible (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (nu : ℝ) : Prop :=
  A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1

def valueSet (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  {v | ∃ A' nu, Admissible A A' j nu ∧ v=∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e}

def allocationValue (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (valueSet A j mu E w)

def benchmarkRegret (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu G : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (G-allocationValue A j mu E w)

lemma information_nonnegative (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (e : Measurement n) : 0 ≤ information A A' j mu nu e := by
  rw [information_eq_mean]
  positivity

lemma valueSet_bounded_below (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) : BddBelow (valueSet A j mu E w) := by
  refine ⟨0,?_⟩
  rintro v ⟨A',nu,h,hv⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact sum_nonneg (fun e he => mul_nonneg (hw e he) (information_nonnegative A A' j mu nu e))

theorem allocationValue_le_actual (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (ha : Admissible A A' j nu) :
    allocationValue A j mu E w ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e := by
  exact csInf_le (valueSet_bounded_below A j mu E w hw) ⟨A',nu,ha,rfl⟩

/-- Actual infimum regrets inherit the dimension-free separation. -/
theorem actual_regret_separation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hlo : eps ≤ 1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (hup : eps ≤ lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1)
    (Gminus Gplus : ℝ) :
    Gminus+Gplus-2*rate q lam-eps^2 ≤
      benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)-eps) Gminus E w+
      benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)+eps) Gplus E w := by
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnum,hnuplus,hbound⟩ :=
    moving_adversary_two_margin A j q lam eps hq hI hj hA hB heps hlo hup E w hl hw hn
  have hm := allocationValue_le_actual A A' j ((1-lam)-eps) (nu-eps) E w hw
    ⟨hne,hcard,hj',hnum,by linarith⟩
  have hp := allocationValue_le_actual A A' j ((1-lam)+eps) (nu+eps) E w hw
    ⟨hne,hcard,hj',by linarith,hnuplus⟩
  have hrm := le_max_right (0 : ℝ) (Gminus-allocationValue A j ((1-lam)-eps) E w)
  have hrp := le_max_right (0 : ℝ) (Gplus-allocationValue A j ((1-lam)+eps) E w)
  unfold benchmarkRegret
  linarith

/-- Exact Gaussian experiment risk for measurable/integrable allocation rules.
Connecting a general adaptive record to this scalar sufficient statistic is
still a separate theorem, and is not an assumption hidden in the conclusion. -/
theorem gaussian_allocation_risk_lower
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam eps a : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hlo : eps ≤ 1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (hup : eps ≤ lam*(1+root q (scale q))) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : ℝ → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ x e, e ∈ E → 0 ≤ w x e)
    (hn : ∀ x, ∑ e ∈ E,w x e=1) (Gminus Gplus : ℝ)
    (him : Integrable (fun x => gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*
      benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)-eps) Gminus E (w x)))
    (hip : Integrable (fun x => gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*
      benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)+eps) Gplus E (w x))) :
    (Gminus+Gplus-2*rate q lam-eps^2)*standardTail a ≤
      max (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)-eps) Gminus E (w x))
        (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*benchmarkRegret A j ((1-lam)+eps) Gplus E (w x)) := by
  apply gaussian_max_risk_lower a ha _ _ _ him hip
  · intro x; exact le_max_left _ _
  · intro x; exact le_max_left _ _
  · intro x
    exact actual_regret_separation A j q lam eps hq hI hj hA hB heps hlo hup E (w x) hl
      (hw x) (hn x) Gminus Gplus

#print axioms allocationValue_le_actual
#print axioms actual_regret_separation
#print axioms gaussian_allocation_risk_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6AllocationSharpV1.lean (168 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationDualBridgeV1»
import «LeanD6GeometricRealizationV1»

/-! The sharp actual-query allocation certificate. The true margin is 1/2;
all alternative margins are in [0,1]. Unit Gaussian variance and unit query
cost are represented by squared mean difference / 2. The library consists of
all scalar Q_i and both joint query types with |G|<=q=k-1. This is an oracle
information-allocation theorem, not a sequential stopping-time theorem. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem alternative_distance_bounds (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    1 ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) ∧ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) ≤ q := by
  have hnot : ¬A ⊆ A' := by
    intro hs
    exact hne (eq_of_subset_of_card_le hs hcard.le).symm
  have hpos : 0 < (A \ A').card := card_pos.mpr (sdiff_nonempty.mpr hnot)
  have hs : A' \ A ⊆ others A j := by
    intro i hi
    have hij : i ≠ j := by intro he; subst i; exact hj' (mem_sdiff.mp hi).1
    simp [others, hij, (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2]
  have hds := card_sdiff_comm hcard
  have hle : (A \ A').card ≤ (others A j).card := by rw [← hds]; exact card_le_card hs
  refine ⟨by exact_mod_cast hpos, ?_⟩
  rw [← hB]
  exact_mod_cast hle

/-- The stated primal really is a probability allocation on legal queries. -/
theorem primal_feasible (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    0 ≤ weight q (scale q) ∧ 0 ≤ (1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1) ∧
    (∑ _a ∈ A, (1-weight q (scale q))/(q+1))+weight q (scale q)=1 ∧
    Legal j q (.inr (others A j,true)) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ A, Legal j q (.inr (A.erase a,false))) := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hw := parameters q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨hw.1.le, div_nonneg (by linarith [hw.2.1]) hk.le, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hA]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hk]
    ring
  · exact ⟨by simp [others], hB.le, by simp⟩
  · intro a ha
    have hAn : 4 ≤ A.card := by exact_mod_cast (show (4:ℝ) ≤ A.card by linarith)
    have hl := erased_query_legal A j a hj ha hAn
    have he : ((A.erase a).card : ℝ)+1=A.card := by exact_mod_cast card_erase_add_one ha
    exact ⟨hl.1, by linarith, by intro _; exact hl.2⟩

/-- Actual primal guarantee for EVERY distinct legal hidden set and margin;
the distance bounds are consequences, no longer extra assumptions. -/
theorem every_alternative_primal_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    value q (scale q)/8 ≤ actualPrimal A A' j q (scale q) (2*(1-nu)) := by
  have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q hj' hcard hne hB
  exact actual_primal_lower A A' j q _ hq hj hj' hcard hA hB hd.1 hd.2

/-- Matching lower and upper certificates on actual observations. The lower
holds simultaneously for all alternatives; the upper applies to any legal
query allocation and produces one actual adversarial alternative. -/
theorem sharp_actual_allocation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∀ A' : Finset (I n), j ∉ A' → A'.card=A.card → A' ≠ A → ∀ nu : ℝ,
      value q (scale q)/8 ≤ actualPrimal A A' j q (scale q) (2*(1-nu))) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) → (∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) → (∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) →
      ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
