namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6HalfFactor

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- High-upside conjecture suggested by exact/random/adversarial search.
    This improves the active decision-transfer additive term from
    `2 * n * delta` to `n * delta / 2`. -/
theorem D6_product_topC_decision_half_factor_conjecture {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (delta : ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hDeltaNonneg : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hdelta : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) selected k) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected ≤
      finiteObjectiveMin (fun S ↦
        productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) S) k +
          (n : ℝ) * delta / 2 := by
  sorry

end CIGAMF.P13.D6HalfFactor

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DecisionInteractionComplexityV1.lean (165 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6UniformDecisionCertificateV1»
import «LeanD6SymmetricDifferenceReductionV1»

/-!
# Predicate-level decision--interaction complexity

The primary definition avoids premature `sSup` engineering.  A constant is
uniform over every numerical world function in one fixed active decision
cell.  This is the correct layer at which a later sharp `m-1` theorem must be
proved or falsified.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DecisionInteractionComplexity

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformDecisionCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6SymmetricDifferenceReduction

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

def UnitInteractionBound {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i x c, |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ 1

def DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) (constant : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ F, cell.Valid F → UnitInteractionBound F →
    2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.selected -
      productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.competitor) ≤
      constant

/-- The decision-cell feasible set whose supremum is the uniform
decision--interaction complexity.  Unlike the legacy instance-wise PAEC
mass, this set ranges over *all* numerical worlds compatible with the fixed
cell before taking a supremum. -/
def admissibleDecisionGaps {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) : Set ℝ :=
  {gap | ∃ F, cell.Valid F ∧ UnitInteractionBound F ∧
    gap = 2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F)
        cell.selected -
      productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F)
        cell.competitor)}

/-- Uniform decision--interaction constant for one active decision cell. -/
noncomputable def kappaDI {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) : ℝ :=
  sSup (admissibleDecisionGaps cell)

theorem kappaDI_le_of_constant {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) (constant : ℝ)
    (hNonempty : (admissibleDecisionGaps cell).Nonempty)
    (hConstant : DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell constant) :
    kappaDI cell ≤ constant := by
  unfold kappaDI
  apply csSup_le hNonempty
  intro gap hGap
  rcases hGap with ⟨F, hCell, hUnit, rfl⟩
  exact hConstant F hCell hUnit

theorem decisionInteractionConstant_mono {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U) {c d : ℝ}
    (h : DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell d := by
  intro F hCell hUnit
  exact (h F hCell hUnit).trans hcd

/-- Any uniform certificate whose mass is at most `c` supplies a uniform
decision--interaction upper bound for the cell. -/
theorem decisionInteractionConstant_of_uniformCertificate {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : UniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (c : ℝ) (hMass : cert.mass ≤ c)
    (hConstraints : ∀ F, cell.Valid F → ConstraintsValid cert F) :
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell c := by
  intro F hCell hUnit
  have hSound := uniformDecisionCertificate_sound cell cert F 1
    (by norm_num) hCell (hConstraints F hCell) hUnit
  have hMassOne : cert.mass * 1 ≤ c := by simpa using hMass
  simpa using hSound.trans hMassOne

theorem kappaDI_le_certificate_mass {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : UniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (hNonempty : (admissibleDecisionGaps cell).Nonempty)
    (hConstraints : ∀ F, cell.Valid F → ConstraintsValid cert F) :
    kappaDI cell ≤ cert.mass := by
  apply kappaDI_le_of_constant cell cert.mass hNonempty
  exact decisionInteractionConstant_of_uniformCertificate cell cert cert.mass
    (le_refl _) hConstraints

/-- NEW-1 gives the sharp target constant on every active cell except the
single balanced-complement geometry.  This is a uniform result over all
numerical worlds in the cell, not an instance-wise PAEC rescaling. -/
theorem nonbalanced_decisionInteractionConstant_atMost_n {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1)
    (hNotBalanced : ¬ cell.BalancedComplement) :
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n := by
  intro F hCell hUnit
  rcases hCell with ⟨hCard, hTop, hsMax, hsMin, htMax, htMin,
    hResponseMax, hResponseMin⟩
  have hPair := pair_half_factor_except_balanced_complement
    cell.q F 1 hWeight hNorm (by norm_num) hUnit
    cell.selected cell.competitor cell.selected.card hTop hCard.symm
    hNotBalanced
  norm_num at hPair ⊢
  linarith

theorem nonbalanced_kappaDI_le_n {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1)
    (hNotBalanced : ¬ cell.BalancedComplement)
    (hNonempty : (admissibleDecisionGaps cell).Nonempty) :
    kappaDI cell ≤ n := by
  exact kappaDI_le_of_constant cell n hNonempty
    (nonbalanced_decisionInteractionConstant_atMost_n cell hWeight hNorm
      hNotBalanced)

/-- The uniform sharp problem has now been reduced exactly to the
balanced-complement cells. -/
theorem all_cells_bound_of_balanced_cells {n : ℕ}
    (hBalanced : ∀ (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U),
      (∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c) →
      (∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) →
      cell.BalancedComplement →
      DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n)
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) :
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n := by
  by_cases hCell : cell.BalancedComplement
  · exact hBalanced cell hWeight hNorm hCell
  · exact nonbalanced_decisionInteractionConstant_atMost_n cell hWeight
      hNorm hCell

theorem odd_coordinate_count_kappaDI_le_n {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1)
    (hOdd : Odd (n + 1))
    (hNonempty : (admissibleDecisionGaps cell).Nonempty) :
    kappaDI cell ≤ n := by
  apply nonbalanced_kappaDI_le_n cell hWeight hNorm
  · intro hBalanced
    rcases hBalanced with ⟨hEven, hDisjoint, hUnion⟩
    rcases hOdd with ⟨d, hd⟩
    omega
  · exact hNonempty

/-- The exact P0 target is deliberately exposed as a predicate, not assumed:
every balanced-complement active cell should have constant at most `n=m-1`.
No theorem in this file asserts that still-open statement. -/
def BalancedDecisionInteractionBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Type*) [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U),
    cell.BalancedComplement → DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n

end CIGAMF.P13.D6DecisionInteractionComplexity

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DiscoveryGeometryV1.lean (98 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualDiscoveryBridgeV1»
import «LeanD6StoppingGeometryBridgeV1»

/-! A terminating discovery decoder with an anytime error bound for literal D6
support geometry. This closes this standalone decoder, not the Gamma-optimal
allocation tracker. A certified off-j B-set returns B union {j}. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryGeometry
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum
open CIGAMF.P13.D6StoppingGeometryBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def embedding (j : I n) : Off j ↪ I n := ⟨Subtype.val,Subtype.val_injective⟩
def selection (j : I n) (S : Finset (Off j)) : Finset (I n) := insert j (S.map (embedding j))

lemma encodedB_map (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) :
    (encodedB A j).map (embedding j)=others A j := by
  ext i
  simp [encodedB,embedding,others]
  tauto

lemma true_selection (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) :
    selection j (encodedB A j)=Aᶜ := by
  rw [selection,encodedB_map]
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=j
  · subst i;simp [hj]
  · simp [others,hi]

lemma model_card (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) : (encodedB A j).card=r := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j hr hA
  have he := congrArg Finset.card (encodedB_map A j)
  rw [card_map] at he
  rw [he]
  unfold others
  rw [card_erase_of_mem (by simp [hp.1])]
  have hc : (univ \ A).card=Aᶜ.card := rfl
  rw [hc,hp.2.2.1,hp.2.1]
  omega

lemma true_selection_geometric (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) (mu : ℝ)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    GeometricOptimal A (selection j (encodedB A j)) j mu := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j hr hA
  rw [true_selection A j hp.1]
  exact (geometric_optimal_iff A Aᶜ j hp.1 mu hmu hmu1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2).mpr rfl

/-- Full world parameters discharge the discovery cardinality premise. -/
theorem decoder_terminates (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu), ∃ s, stageAccept r r0 s x := by
  exact actual_discovery_terminates A j (world_parameters r j hr hA).1 a helper ha hi mu
    r r0 (model_card r j hr A hA) hr0

theorem decoder_expected_cost_finite (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,queryCost r r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) < ∞ := by
  exact actual_discovery_finite_expectation A j (world_parameters r j hr hA).1 a helper ha hi mu
    r r0 (model_card r j hr A hA) hr0

theorem decoder_anytime_geometric_error (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i, a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i, i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)
      (⋃ s,{x | ∃ S, Certified (repetitions r0 s) r x S ∧ ¬GeometricOptimal A (selection j S) j mu}) ≤
      eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0*(1-(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞))⁻¹ := by
  apply (measure_mono ?_).trans (actual_discovery_wrong_bound A j (world_parameters r j hr hA).1
    a helper ha hi mu r r0 (model_card r j hr A hA) hr0)
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hbad⟩ := hs
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨s,S,hS,?_⟩
  intro he
  subst S
  exact hbad (true_selection_geometric r j hr A hA mu hmu hmu1)

#print axioms model_card
#print axioms true_selection_geometric
#print axioms decoder_terminates
#print axioms decoder_expected_cost_finite
#print axioms decoder_anytime_geometric_error
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryGeometry

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DiscoveryPathLawV1.lean (102 dong)
import «LeanD6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLawV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Independence.InfinitePi
import Mathlib.Probability.Moments.SubGaussian

/-! One canonical infinite raw-observation probability space for discovery.
Finite repeated contrasts are derived as marginals; Gaussian concentration is
proved from the resulting law rather than supplied as an assumption. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryPathLaw
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.FiniteGaussianSumLaw
noncomputable section

def path (means : Fin 4 → ℝ) : Measure ((ℕ × Fin 4) → ℝ) :=
  Measure.infinitePi (fun t => gaussianReal (means t.2) 1)

instance path_probability (means : Fin 4 → ℝ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (path means) := by
  unfold path;infer_instance

def restrict (r : ℕ) (x : (ℕ × Fin 4) → ℝ) (t : Fin r × Fin 4) : ℝ := x (t.1.val,t.2)

theorem finite_raw_law (means : Fin 4 → ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (restrict r) (law (fun t : Fin r × Fin 4 => means t.2)) (path means) := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun t : Fin r × Fin 4 => (t.1.val,t.2)) := by
    intro a b h
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Fin.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    · exact congrArg (fun x : ℕ × Fin 4 => x.2) h
  refine ⟨(measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => measurable_pi_apply (t.1.val,t.2))).aemeasurable,?_⟩
  unfold path restrict law
  rw [Measure.map_infinitePi_infinitePi_of_inj hinj,Measure.infinitePi_eq_pi]

def average (r : ℕ) (x : (ℕ × Fin 4) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t : Fin r × Fin 4,signs t.2*x (t.1.val,t.2))/(r:ℝ)

theorem repeated_contrast_law (means : Fin 4 → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    HasLaw (average r) (gaussianReal (∑ t,signs t*means t) (4/(r:NNReal))) (path means) := by
  have hs : ∀ t : Fin r × Fin 4, (signs t.2)^2=1 := by
    intro t;rcases t with ⟨u,t⟩;fin_cases t <;> norm_num [signs]
  have hh := (signed_sum_law (fun t : Fin r × Fin 4 => means t.2)
    (fun t => signs t.2) hs univ).fun_comp (finite_raw_law means r)
  have hm : (∑ t : Fin r × Fin 4, signs t.2*means t.2) =
      (r:ℝ)*(∑ t,signs t*means t) := by simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hv : NNReal.mk ((1/(r:ℝ))^2) (sq_nonneg _) * (Fintype.card (Fin r × Fin 4):NNReal) = 4/(r:NNReal) := by
    have hn : (r:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1/(r:ℝ))^2*(Fintype.card (Fin r × Fin 4):ℝ)=4/(r:ℝ)
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  have hn : (r:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have h := gaussianReal_const_mul hh (1/(r:ℝ))
  simp only [Finset.card_univ,hm,hv] at h
  have he : (1/(r:ℝ))*((r:ℝ)*(∑ t,signs t*means t)) = ∑ t,signs t*means t := by field_simp
  rw [he] at h
  unfold average
  simpa [restrict,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using h

lemma gaussian_centered_subgaussian {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {P : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (mu : ℝ) (v : NNReal)
    (hlaw : HasLaw X (gaussianReal mu v) P) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => X x-mu) v P := by
  have hc : HasLaw (fun x => X x-mu) (gaussianReal 0 v) P := by
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using gaussianReal_add_const hlaw (-mu)
  have hg : HasSubgaussianMGF id v (gaussianReal 0 v) := by
    refine ⟨fun t => integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal t,?_⟩
    intro t
    rw [mgf_id_gaussianReal]
    simp
  have ht : HasSubgaussianMGF id v (P.map (fun x => X x-mu)) := by rw [hc.map_eq];exact hg
  exact (HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hc.aemeasurable).mp ht

/-- Two-sided tail on the same path at every repetition count r. -/
theorem repeated_contrast_tail (means : Fin 4 → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    (path means).real {x | eps ≤ |average r x-(∑ t,signs t*means t)|} ≤
      2*Real.exp (-(r:ℝ)*eps^2/8) := by
  let X := fun x => average r x-(∑ t,signs t*means t)
  have h := gaussian_centered_subgaussian _ _ (repeated_contrast_law means r hr)
  have hp := h.measure_ge_le heps
  have hn := h.neg.measure_ge_le heps
  have he : {x | eps ≤ |X x|} = {x | eps ≤ X x} ∪ {x | eps ≤ -X x} := by
    ext x;simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_union,le_abs]
  have hu := measureReal_union_le (μ := path means) {x | eps ≤ X x} {x | eps ≤ -X x}
  have hr' : (r:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hex : -eps^2/(2*(↑(4/(r:NNReal)):ℝ)) = -(r:ℝ)*eps^2/8 := by
    simp only [NNReal.coe_div,NNReal.coe_ofNat,NNReal.coe_natCast]
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hex] at hp hn
  change (path means).real {x | eps ≤ |X x|} ≤ _
  rw [he]
  change (path means).real {x | eps ≤ X x} ≤ _ at hp
  change (path means).real {x | eps ≤ -X x} ≤ _ at hn
  linarith

#print axioms finite_raw_law
#print axioms repeated_contrast_law
#print axioms repeated_contrast_tail
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryPathLaw

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DiscoveryStoppingV1.lean (121 dong)
import «LeanD6DiscoveryVectorCertificateV1»
import «LeanDyadicCertifiedStoppingV1»

/-! Certified discovery: termination, finite expected raw-query cost, and an
unconditional bound on ever certifying a wrong label. No conditioning on earlier
correct estimates and no assumed path law or tail envelope. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.DyadicCertifiedStopping
noncomputable section
variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def repetitions (r0 s : ℕ) := r0*2^s

def eta (d r0 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (2*(d:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128))

def stageAccept (q r0 : ℕ) (s : ℕ) (x : Sample I) : Prop := accepts (repetitions r0 s) q x

def queryCost (q r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample I) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (4*Fintype.card I*r0:ℕ)*work (stageAccept q r0) x

lemma dyadic_exp_bound (r0 s : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    Real.exp (-(repetitions r0 s:ℝ)/128) ≤
      Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*(1/4:ℝ)^s := by
  have hr : (512:ℝ) ≤ r0 := by exact_mod_cast hr0
  have hex : Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128) ≤ (1:ℝ)/4 := by
    rw [show -(r0:ℝ)/128 = -((r0:ℝ)/128) by ring,Real.exp_neg]
    have hh : (4:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128) := by
      have ht := Real.add_one_le_exp ((r0:ℝ)/128)
      linarith
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4) hh
  have hs : (s:ℝ)+1 ≤ (2:ℝ)^s := by exact_mod_cast s.lt_two_pow_self
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (((s:ℝ)+1)*(-(r0:ℝ)/128)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      simp only [repetitions,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      nlinarith
    _ = Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)^(s+1) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      push_cast
      rfl
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*(1/4:ℝ)^s := by
      rw [pow_succ,mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_nonneg _) hex s) (Real.exp_nonneg _)

lemma actual_stage_tail (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (s : ℕ) :
    vectorPath means (bad B a (repetitions r0 s)) ≤
      eta (Fintype.card I) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
  have hr : 0 < repetitions r0 s := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by positivity)
  have hh := vector_tail means B a hm (repetitions r0 s) hr
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (dyadic_exp_bound r0 s hr0)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(Fintype.card I:ℝ))
  have hreal := hh.trans hd
  have hen := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
  rw [ofReal_measureReal] at hen
  have he : ENNReal.ofReal (2*(Fintype.card I:ℝ)*(Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*(1/4:ℝ)^s)) =
      eta (Fintype.card I) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
    rw [← mul_assoc,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num)]
    simp [eta,ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos]
  rwa [he] at hen

/-- The stopping event occurs almost surely, including paths with earlier
estimation errors. This theorem is for discovery, not full allocation tracking. -/
theorem discovery_terminates (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂vectorPath means, ∃ s, stageAccept B.card r0 s x := by
  exact almost_sure_termination (vectorPath means) (stageAccept B.card r0)
    (fun s => accepts_measurable _ _) (fun s => bad B a (repetitions r0 s))
    (fun s x hx => good_accepts B a _ x hx) (eta (Fintype.card I) r0)
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (actual_stage_tail means B a hm r0 hr0)

theorem discovery_expected_cost (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,queryCost B.card r0 x ∂vectorPath means) ≤
      (4*Fintype.card I*r0:ℕ)*(1+2*eta (Fintype.card I) r0) := by
  have hh := expected_work_bound (vectorPath means) (stageAccept B.card r0)
    (fun s => accepts_measurable _ _) (fun s => bad B a (repetitions r0 s))
    (fun s x hx => good_accepts B a _ x hx) (eta (Fintype.card I) r0)
    (actual_stage_tail means B a hm r0 hr0)
  unfold queryCost
  have hw : Measurable (work (stageAccept B.card r0) : Sample I → ℝ≥0∞) :=
    work_measurable (stageAccept B.card r0) (fun s => accepts_measurable _ _)
  rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hw]
  exact mul_le_mul le_rfl hh (by positivity) (by positivity)

theorem discovery_expected_cost_finite (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,queryCost B.card r0 x ∂vectorPath means) < ∞ := by
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (discovery_expected_cost means B a hm r0 hr0)
  dsimp [eta]
  finiteness

/-- This bounds every wrong certificate at every stage, hence also one chosen
at the first acceptance. It does not discard the error on a bad commitment. -/
theorem discovery_ever_wrong (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    vectorPath means (⋃ s, {x | ∃ S, Certified (repetitions r0 s) B.card x S ∧ S ≠ B}) ≤
      eta (Fintype.card I) r0*(1-(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞))⁻¹ := by
  apply ever_error_bound (vectorPath means) _ (fun s => bad B a (repetitions r0 s)) _ _
    (actual_stage_tail means B a hm r0 hr0)
  intro s x hx
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hn⟩ := hx
  by_contra hgood
  exact hn (good_certificate_correct B S a _ x hgood hS)

#print axioms actual_stage_tail
#print axioms discovery_terminates
#print axioms discovery_expected_cost
#print axioms discovery_expected_cost_finite
#print axioms discovery_ever_wrong
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DiscoveryVectorCertificateV1.lean (111 dong)
import «LeanD6DiscoveryPathLawV1»

/-! Simultaneous label discovery on one product of infinite raw-query paths.
The finite mean identity is the only construction-specific input in the generic
vector lemmas; the D6 bridge supplies it from actual legal queries. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryPathLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw
noncomputable section
variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

abbrev Sample (I : Type*) := I → ((ℕ × Fin 4) → ℝ)

def vectorPath (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) : Measure (Sample I) := Measure.pi (fun i => path (means i))

instance vector_probability (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (vectorPath means) := by
  unfold vectorPath;infer_instance

def score (r : ℕ) (x : Sample I) (i : I) : ℝ := average r (x i)

def target (B : Finset I) (a i : I) : ℝ := (if i ∈ B then 1 else 0)-(if a ∈ B then 1 else 0)

def bad (B : Finset I) (a : I) (r : ℕ) : Set (Sample I) :=
  {x | ∃ i, 1/4 ≤ |score r x i-target B a i|}

def Certified (r : ℕ) (q : ℕ) (x : Sample I) (S : Finset I) : Prop :=
  S.card=q ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, score r x j+1/2 < score r x i

def accepts (r q : ℕ) (x : Sample I) : Prop := ∃ S, Certified r q x S

lemma score_measurable (r : ℕ) (i : I) : Measurable (fun x : Sample I => score r x i) := by
  unfold score D6DiscoveryPathLaw.average
  exact (Finset.measurable_fun_sum (f := fun (t : Fin r × Fin 4) (x : Sample I) => signs t.2*x i (t.1.val,t.2)) univ (fun t _ =>
    measurable_const.mul ((measurable_pi_apply (t.1.val,t.2)).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))).div_const r

lemma accepts_measurable (r q : ℕ) : MeasurableSet {x : Sample I | accepts r q x} := by
  simp only [accepts,Certified,Set.setOf_exists]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro S
  by_cases hS : S.card=q
  · simp only [hS,true_and,Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter (fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ : i ∈ S =>
      MeasurableSet.iInter (fun j => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ : j ∉ S =>
        measurableSet_lt ((score_measurable r j).add_const _) (score_measurable r i)))))
  · simp [hS]

lemma error_lt_of_not_bad (B : Finset I) (a : I) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample I)
    (hx : x ∉ bad B a r) (i : I) : |score r x i-target B a i| < 1/4 := by
  exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hx ⟨i,h⟩)

theorem good_accepts (B : Finset I) (a : I) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample I)
    (hx : x ∉ bad B a r) : accepts r B.card x := by
  refine ⟨B,rfl,?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  have h1 := (abs_lt.mp (error_lt_of_not_bad B a r x hx i)).1
  have h2 := (abs_lt.mp (error_lt_of_not_bad B a r x hx j)).2
  simp only [target,hi,hj,↓reduceIte] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem good_certificate_correct (B S : Finset I) (a : I) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample I)
    (hx : x ∉ bad B a r) (hS : Certified r B.card x S) : S=B := by
  have hcard := hS.1
  apply eq_of_subset_of_card_le ?_ (by omega)
  intro i hi
  by_contra hiB
  have hn : ¬ B ⊆ S := by
    intro h
    have he : B=S := eq_of_subset_of_card_le h (by omega)
    exact hiB (he.symm ▸ hi)
  obtain ⟨j,hjB,hjS⟩ := not_subset.mp hn
  have hgap := hS.2 i hi j hjS
  have h1 := (abs_lt.mp (error_lt_of_not_bad B a r x hx i)).2
  have h2 := (abs_lt.mp (error_lt_of_not_bad B a r x hx j)).1
  simp only [target,hiB,hjB,↓reduceIte] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem vector_tail (means : I → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset I) (a : I)
    (hm : ∀ i, (∑ t,signs t*means i t)=target B a i)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (vectorPath means).real (bad B a r) ≤
      2*(Fintype.card I:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(r:ℝ)/128) := by
  have hi (i : I) : (vectorPath means).real {x | 1/4 ≤ |score r x i-target B a i|} ≤
      2*Real.exp (-(r:ℝ)/128) := by
    have he : HasLaw (fun x : Sample I => x i) (path (means i)) (vectorPath means) :=
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun i => path (means i)) i).hasLaw
    have hp := repeated_contrast_tail (means i) r hr (1/4) (by norm_num)
    rw [hm i] at hp
    have hmeas : MeasurableSet {y | (1:ℝ)/4 ≤ |D6DiscoveryPathLaw.average r y-target B a i|} := by
      apply measurableSet_le measurable_const
      have hmean : Measurable (D6DiscoveryPathLaw.average r) := by
        unfold D6DiscoveryPathLaw.average
        exact (Finset.measurable_fun_sum (f := fun (t : Fin r × Fin 4) (y : (ℕ × Fin 4) → ℝ) => signs t.2*y (t.1.val,t.2)) univ (fun t _ =>
          measurable_const.mul (measurable_pi_apply (t.1.val,t.2)))).div_const r
      exact (hmean.sub_const _).abs
    have heq := he.measureReal_eq hmeas
    have hex : -(r:ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/4)^2/8=-(r:ℝ)/128 := by ring
    simpa only [score,hex] using heq.trans_le hp
  have he : bad B a r = ⋃ i,{x | 1/4 ≤ |score r x i-target B a i|} := by ext x;simp [bad]
  rw [he]
  apply (measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : I, 2*Real.exp (-(r:ℝ)/128) := sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hi i)
    _ = _ := by simp;ring

#print axioms good_accepts
#print axioms good_certificate_correct
#print axioms vector_tail
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6DiscoveryWorldRecommendationV1.lean (107 dong)
import «LeanD6DiscoveryGeometryV1»
import «LeanD6RecommendationMeasurabilityV1»

/-! A total world-valued decoder. Its inputs are observations, q, j, and a
fixed feasible fallback; the true A is not an input. The decoder is re-evaluated
at each sample count rather than committing permanently after one certificate. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryWorldRecommendation
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RecommendationMeasurability
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

lemma encoded_injective {n : ℕ} (j : I n) (A W : Finset (I n))
    (ha : j ∉ A) (hw : j ∉ W) (h : encodedB A j=encodedB W j) : A=W := by
  have hh := congrArg (selection j) h
  rw [true_selection A j ha,true_selection W j hw] at hh
  exact compl_injective hh

def candidate (q : ℕ) (j : I (2*q+1)) (fallback : Finset (I (2*q+1)))
    (r : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) : Finset (I (2*q+1)) :=
  if h : ∃ W,W ∈ worlds q j ∧ encodedB W j=recommendation q r x
  then Classical.choose h else fallback

lemma candidate_valid (q : ℕ) (j : I (2*q+1)) (fallback : Finset (I (2*q+1)))
    (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) :
    candidate q j fallback r x ∈ worlds q j := by
  unfold candidate
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact (Classical.choose_spec h).1
  · exact hf

lemma candidate_correct (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
    (r : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) (hr : recommendation q r x=encodedB A j) :
    candidate q j fallback r x=A := by
  have hex : ∃ W,W ∈ worlds q j ∧ encodedB W j=recommendation q r x := ⟨A,hA,hr.symm⟩
  unfold candidate
  rw [dif_pos hex]
  have hc := Classical.choose_spec hex
  exact encoded_injective j _ A (world_parameters q j (by omega) hc.1).1
    (world_parameters q j (by omega) hA).1 (hc.2.trans hr)

/-- Correct on the Gaussian coordinate-good event. This discharges the
structural decoder premise of the random-label regret theorem. -/
theorem candidate_correct_on_good (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
    (a : Off j) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) (hx : x ∉ bad (encodedB A j) a r) :
    candidate q j fallback r x=A := by
  apply candidate_correct q hq j fallback A hA r x
  have hh := recommendation_correct_on_good (encodedB A j) a r x hx
  rwa [model_card q j (by omega) A hA] at hh

lemma candidate_eq_iff (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback W : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) :
    candidate q j fallback r x=W ↔
      (W ∈ worlds q j ∧ recommendation q r x=encodedB W j) ∨
      (W=fallback ∧ ¬∃ V,V ∈ worlds q j ∧ recommendation q r x=encodedB V j) := by
  by_cases hex : ∃ V,V ∈ worlds q j ∧ encodedB V j=recommendation q r x
  · have hnone : ¬(¬∃ V,V ∈ worlds q j ∧ recommendation q r x=encodedB V j) := by
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨V,hV,he⟩ := hex
      exact hn ⟨V,hV,he.symm⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      left
      unfold candidate at h
      rw [dif_pos hex] at h
      have hc := Classical.choose_spec hex
      rw [h] at hc
      exact ⟨hc.1,hc.2.symm⟩
    · rintro (⟨hw,hr⟩ | ⟨_,hn⟩)
      · exact candidate_correct q hq j fallback W hw r x hr
      · exact False.elim (hnone hn)
  · have hn : ¬∃ V,V ∈ worlds q j ∧ recommendation q r x=encodedB V j := by
      rintro ⟨V,hV,he⟩
      exact hex ⟨V,hV,he.symm⟩
    rw [candidate,dif_neg hex]
    constructor
    · intro h;exact Or.inr ⟨h.symm,hn⟩
    · rintro (⟨hw,hr⟩ | ⟨he,_⟩)
      · exact False.elim (hn ⟨W,hw,hr⟩)
      · exact he.symm

/-- Every level set of the finite world recommendation is measurable. -/
theorem candidate_level_measurable (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback W : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (r : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet {x | candidate q j fallback r x=W} := by
  simp only [candidate_eq_iff q hq j fallback W r]
  apply MeasurableSet.union
  · exact (MeasurableSet.const _).inter (recommendation_level_measurable r q (encodedB W j))
  · apply (MeasurableSet.const _).inter
    have hh : MeasurableSet {x : Sample (Off j) | ∃ V,V ∈ worlds q j ∧ recommendation q r x=encodedB V j} := by
      simp only [Set.ofPred_exists]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun V => (MeasurableSet.const _).inter
        (recommendation_level_measurable r q (encodedB V j)))
    exact hh.compl

#print axioms candidate_valid
#print axioms candidate_correct_on_good
#print axioms candidate_eq_iff
#print axioms candidate_level_measurable
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryWorldRecommendation

import «LeanD6WeightedEpochCompositionV1»

/-! Exact cancellation for doubling-epoch recommendation bounds. Acquisition
cost is stated separately and grows geometrically, not logarithmically.
This module alone proves neither total regret nor a stopping rate. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochBudgetArithmetic
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6WeightedEpochComposition
noncomputable section

lemma finite_half_sum (E : ℕ) : (∑ s : Fin E,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s.val) ≤ 2 := by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  exact (ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _).trans_eq ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two

lemma cancel_estimation (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (L:ℝ≥0∞)*(ENNReal.ofReal (64/(q:ℝ)^2)*
      ENNReal.ofReal (((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/((L:ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4)))=
      ENNReal.ofReal (64*((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q:ℝ)^6) := by
  have hqr : (0:ℝ)<q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hlr : (0:ℝ)<L := by exact_mod_cast hL
  rw [show (L:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (L:ℝ) by simp,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  <;> ring

/-- Weighted recommendation upper bound after cancelling the cyclic L. -/
theorem doubling_recommendation_sum (q L0 E : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hL0 : 0 < L0)
    (V eta : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ s : Fin E,((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ≥0∞)*
      (ENNReal.ofReal (64/(q:ℝ)^2)*
        ENNReal.ofReal (((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4))+
        V*(eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s.val))) ≤
      (E:ℝ≥0∞)*ENNReal.ofReal (64*((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q:ℝ)^6)+2*((L0:ℝ≥0∞)*V*eta) := by
  have hp (s : Fin E) : 0 < L0*2^s.val := Nat.mul_pos hL0 (by positivity)
  have he (s : Fin E) : ((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ≥0∞)*
      (ENNReal.ofReal (64/(q:ℝ)^2)*
        ENNReal.ofReal (((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(((L0*2^s.val:ℕ):ℝ)*(q:ℝ)^4))+
        V*(eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s.val))=
      ENNReal.ofReal (64*((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q:ℝ)^6)+
        ((L0:ℝ≥0∞)*V*eta)*(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s.val := by
    rw [mul_add,cancel_estimation q hq _ (hp s)]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [← two_mul_quarter_pow]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [sum_add_distrib,sum_const,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,← mul_sum]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (finite_half_sum E)
    (show 0 ≤ (L0:ℝ≥0∞)*V*eta from zero_le)
  calc _ ≤ (E:ℝ≥0∞)*ENNReal.ofReal (64*((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q:ℝ)^6)+
      ((L0:ℝ≥0∞)*V*eta)*2 := add_le_add le_rfl hh
       _ = _ := by ring

/-- Acquisition grows geometrically if a doubling pilot is repeated. It
cannot be called a logarithmic query cost. -/
theorem exploration_fraction_doubling (d L0 H0 E : ℕ) :
    d*(∑ s ∈ range E,L0*2^s)=d*L0*(2^E-1) ∧
    (∑ s ∈ range E,H0*2^s)=H0*(2^E-1) := by
  constructor
  · rw [doubling_budget];ring
  · exact doubling_budget H0 E

#print axioms cancel_estimation
#print axioms doubling_recommendation_sum
#print axioms exploration_fraction_doubling
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochBudgetArithmetic

/-! The one-epoch loss is an actual measurable integrable random variable.
This closes the distinction between an unrestricted lower integral and an
expectation for the decoder/cyclic allocation construction. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochLossMeasurability
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationTrackingStability CIGAMF.P13.D6ConstructiveTracking
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicMeanSquare
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicPhaseLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

lemma allocation_value_continuous {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] {n : ℕ}
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (halt : ∃ A' nu,Admissible A A' j nu) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hm : 0 ≤ mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : T → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ x e,e ∈ E → 0 ≤ w x e)
    (hc : ∀ e,e ∈ E → Continuous (fun x => w x e)) :
    Continuous (fun x => allocationValue A j mu E (w x)) := by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro x
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hg : Continuous (fun y => informationCap q*(∑ e ∈ E,|w y e-w x e|)) := by
    apply continuous_const.mul
    exact continuous_finset_sum E (fun e he => ((hc e he).sub continuous_const).abs)
  have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => informationCap q*(∑ e ∈ E,|w y e-w x e|))
      (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by simpa using (hg.continuousAt (x:=x)).tendsto
  apply squeeze_zero (fun y => norm_nonneg _) ?_ ht
  intro y
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    allocation_l1_modulus A j hj halt q mu hq hm hm1 E (w y) (w x) hl (hw y) (hw x)

lemma clipped_mass_continuous (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hi : marginMax q ≤ marginHigh q) :
    Continuous (fun x => mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) x)) := by
  have hD : Continuous (D q) := by unfold D radicand;fun_prop
  have hd : ∀ m ∈ phaseInterval q,0 < D q m := by
    intro m hm
    have hb := phase_shift_bounds q m hq hm.1 hm.2
    exact radical_positive q m hq (by linarith [hb.1])
  have hs : ContinuousOn (shift q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold shift
    apply ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    intro m hm
    have hb := phase_shift_bounds q m hq hm.1 hm.2
    have hh : 0 ≤ q*(q-2)*(1-m) := mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith [hb.2.1])
    linarith [hd m hm]
  have hc : ContinuousOn (mass q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold mass
    exact (continuousOn_const.mul hs).div hD.continuousOn (fun m hm => ne_of_gt (hd m hm))
  exact hc.comp_continuous (by unfold clip;fun_prop) (fun x => clip_mem _ _ _ hi)

lemma branch_loss_continuous (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (A W : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j) (hW : W ∈ worlds q j)
    (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    Continuous (fun x => oracleRegret A j q mu (D6PhaseThreePrimal.queries W j)
      (weights W j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) x)))) := by
  have hp := world_parameters q j (by omega) hA
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu (by exact_mod_cast hq) hm.1 hm.2
  have hc := clipped_mass_continuous q (by exact_mod_cast hq) (hm.1.trans hm.2)
  have hw (x : ℝ) := phase_mass_bounds q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) x)
    (by exact_mod_cast hq) (clip_mem _ _ x (hm.1.trans hm.2)).1
    (clip_mem _ _ x (hm.1.trans hm.2)).2
  have hd (x : ℝ) := distribution W j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) x))
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0<q by omega)) (hw x).1 (by linarith [(hw x).2])
    (by exact_mod_cast world_others_card q (by omega) j W hW)
  have hv := allocation_value_continuous A j hp.1 (world_has_alternative q j (by omega) A hA)
    q mu (by positivity) (by linarith [hb.1]) hb.2.1 (D6PhaseThreePrimal.queries W j)
    (fun x => weights W j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) x)))
    (hd 0).1 (fun x e _ => (hd x).2.1 e) (by
      intro e he
      unfold weights
      apply Continuous.add
      · split_ifs <;> first | exact hc | exact continuous_const
      · apply continuous_finsetSum
        intro i hi
        split_ifs
        · exact (continuous_const.sub hc).div_const _
        · exact continuous_const)
  unfold oracleRegret
  exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.sub hv)

theorem epoch_loss_measurable (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
    (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) (r L : ℕ) :
    Measurable (epochLoss q j fallback A mu r L) := by
  let Ω := D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate.Sample (Off j) × (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ)
  let branch (W : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (x : Ω) :=
    oracleRegret A j q mu (D6PhaseThreePrimal.queries W j)
      (weights W j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q)
        (estimate (C:=ZMod (2*q+1)) q L x.2))))
  have hb : ∀ W,W ∈ worlds q j → Measurable (branch W) := by
    intro W hW
    exact (branch_loss_continuous q hq j A W hA hW mu hm).measurable.comp
      (by
        change Measurable (fun x : D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate.Sample (Off j) ×
          (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ) => estimate (C:=ZMod (2*q+1)) q L x.2)
        unfold estimate
        fun_prop)
  have hs : Measurable (fun x : Ω => ∑ W ∈ worlds q j,
      {y : Ω | candidate q j fallback r y.1=W}.indicator (branch W) x) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro W hW
    exact (hb W hW).indicator ((candidate_level_measurable q hq j fallback W r).preimage measurable_fst)
  convert hs using 1
  funext x
  rw [sum_eq_single (candidate q j fallback r x.1)]
  · simp [epochLoss,branch]
  · intro W hW hne
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simpa [eq_comm] using hne) _
  · intro h
    exact False.elim (h (candidate_valid q j fallback hf r x.1))

theorem epoch_loss_integrable (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (fallback A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hf : fallback ∈ worlds q j) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
    (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) (r L : ℕ)
    (P : Measure (D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate.Sample (Off j) × (Fin L × ZMod (2*q+1) → ℝ)))
    [IsFiniteMeasure P] : Integrable (epochLoss q j fallback A mu r L) P := by
  apply (integrable_const (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))).mono'
    (epoch_loss_measurable q hq j fallback A hf hA mu hm r L).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  have hc := candidate_valid q j fallback hf r x.1
  have hz := clip_mem (marginMax q) (marginHigh q)
    (estimate (C:=ZMod (2*q+1)) q L x.2) (hm.1.trans hm.2)
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q _ (by exact_mod_cast hq) hz.1 hz.2
  have hd := distribution (candidate q j fallback r x.1) j q (mass q _)
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0<q by omega)) hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2])
    (by exact_mod_cast world_others_card q (by omega) j _ hc)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ epochLoss q j fallback A mu r L x from le_max_left _ _)]
  exact oracle_regret_bounded A j q mu _ _ (fun e _ => hd.2.1 e)

#print axioms allocation_value_continuous
#print axioms clipped_mass_continuous
#print axioms branch_loss_continuous
#print axioms epoch_loss_measurable
#print axioms epoch_loss_integrable
end

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6EpochMarginalLawV1.lean (93 dong)
import Mathlib

/-! # Step 1: the epoch-`s` marginal IS the one-epoch law

The one-epoch theorem `actual_unknown_label_explicit_bound` is stated on
`(vectorPath ...).prod (observations ...)`.  To sum it over epochs one must know
what law epoch `s` sees inside a multi-epoch run.  The usual answer is a
conditional one -- a tower property on a filtration -- but this design does not
need it, and the reason is the earlier optimality result: the cyclic design `G`
is FIXED and A-free, so the law of the epoch-`s` observations does not depend on
what happened in epochs `0..s-1`.  History enters only through the decoder, and
`epochLoss` already charges a wrong decode.

So the multi-epoch law is one shared component (the discovery path, reused by
every epoch -- `epochSamples r0 s = r0*(s+1)` are nested prefixes of the SAME
sample) and one fresh component per epoch, and reading off epoch `s` is measure
preserving onto exactly the one-epoch product.  That is this module.

`epoch_weighted_lintegral` is the form the composition consumes: the expectation
of a length-weighted finite sum over epochs equals the weighted sum of the
one-epoch expectations, with no conditioning anywhere.

Scope: the index type is a `Fintype`, so this is a FINITE horizon of epochs --
`Fin E` -- which is all the `O(log T)` statement needs.  An infinite horizon
would need `Kernel.traj` and `traj_comp_partialTraj` instead; that is a
different module and is not claimed here.  Nothing here is D6-specific: the D6
instantiation, which must supply `IsProbabilityMeasure (observations ...)` from
`actual_design_law_exists`, is a separate step and is NOT done in this file.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochMarginalLaw
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable section

variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {β : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (β i)]

/-- One shared component plus one fresh component per epoch. -/
def multiEpoch (mu : Measure α) (nu : (i : ι) → Measure (β i)) :
    Measure (α × (∀ i, β i)) := mu.prod (Measure.pi nu)

/-- Reading off the shared component together with epoch `i`'s own component. -/
def epochProj (i : ι) : α × (∀ j, β j) → α × β i := Prod.map id (Function.eval i)

lemma measurable_epochProj (i : ι) : Measurable (epochProj (α := α) (β := β) i) :=
  measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd)

/-- The epoch-`i` marginal of the multi-epoch law is the one-epoch law. -/
theorem epoch_projection (mu : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (nu : (i : ι) → Measure (β i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (nu i)] (i : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (epochProj (α := α) (β := β) i) (multiEpoch mu nu) (mu.prod (nu i)) :=
  (MeasurePreserving.id mu).prod (measurePreserving_eval nu i)

/-- Consequently a one-epoch integrand may be integrated against the one-epoch
law, inside a multi-epoch run. -/
theorem epoch_lintegral (mu : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (nu : (i : ι) → Measure (β i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (nu i)] (i : ι)
    {g : α × β i → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ x,g (epochProj i x) ∂multiEpoch mu nu = ∫⁻ y,g y ∂(mu.prod (nu i)) :=
  (epoch_projection mu nu i).lintegral_comp hg

/-- The bridge the composition consumes: a length-weighted finite sum over
epochs has expectation equal to the weighted sum of one-epoch expectations. -/
theorem epoch_weighted_lintegral (mu : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (nu : (i : ι) → Measure (β i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (nu i)]
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0∞) (g : (i : ι) → α × β i → ℝ≥0∞) (hg : ∀ i,Measurable (g i))
    (s : Finset ι) :
    ∫⁻ x,∑ i ∈ s,w i*g i (epochProj i x) ∂multiEpoch mu nu
      = ∑ i ∈ s,w i*∫⁻ y,g i y ∂(mu.prod (nu i)) := by
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum s (fun i _ => (show Measurable (fun x => w i*g i (epochProj i x)) from
    measurable_const.mul ((hg i).comp (measurable_epochProj i))))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [lintegral_const_mul (w i) (show Measurable (fun x => g i (epochProj i x)) from
    (hg i).comp (measurable_epochProj i)),
    epoch_lintegral mu nu i (hg i)]

/-- Monotone form: per-epoch bounds compose without any further hypothesis. -/
theorem epoch_weighted_le (mu : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (nu : (i : ι) → Measure (β i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (nu i)]
    (w : ι → ℝ≥0∞) (g : (i : ι) → α × β i → ℝ≥0∞) (hg : ∀ i,Measurable (g i))
    (s : Finset ι) (bound : ι → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s,∫⁻ y,g i y ∂(mu.prod (nu i)) ≤ bound i) :
    ∫⁻ x,∑ i ∈ s,w i*g i (epochProj i x) ∂multiEpoch mu nu ≤ ∑ i ∈ s,w i*bound i := by
  rw [epoch_weighted_lintegral mu nu w g hg s]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb i hi) (show 0 ≤ w i from zero_le))

#print axioms measurable_epochProj
#print axioms epoch_projection
#print axioms epoch_lintegral
#print axioms epoch_weighted_lintegral
#print axioms epoch_weighted_le
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6EpochMarginalLaw

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ExpandedAllocationV1.lean (288 dong)
import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-! Analytic certificate for the larger D6 measurement library: both j-on and
j-off groups of size <=q=k-1. True margin is 1/2. Values below are normalized
by eight, so actual variance-one Gaussian KL is `value / 8`.
This file proves the dimension-parametric algebra. The finite averaging bridge
from actual worlds is separately exact-checked, not assumed formalized here. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation

noncomputable def scale (q : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (q/(q+1))
noncomputable def weight (q c : ℝ) : ℝ := c/(q-2+c)
noncomputable def target (q c : ℝ) : ℝ := (q-1)/(q-2+c)
noncomputable def value (q c : ℝ) : ℝ := (c*(q-1)/(q-2+c))^2
noncomputable def designLoss (q c d t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1-weight q c)*(d*(d*(q-1)+1)/(q+1))*t^2 +
    weight q c*((q-1)-(q-d-1)*t)^2

/-- The closed-form scale has no fitted or dimension-specific constants. -/
theorem scale_properties (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    3/4 ≤ scale q ∧ scale q < 1 ∧ (q+1)*(scale q)^2=q := by
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hsq : (scale q)^2 = q/(q+1) := Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hp.le hk.le)
  have heq : (q+1)*(scale q)^2 = q := by
    nlinarith [(eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hk)).mp hsq]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ scale q := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hlt : q/(q+1) < 1 := (div_lt_one hk).mpr (by linarith)
  have hlo : (3/4 : ℝ) ≤ q/(q+1) := (le_div_iff₀ hk).mpr (by linarith)
  exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith, heq⟩

/-- Explicit mixture and least-favourable nuisance parameter are feasible. -/
theorem parameters (q c : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hc : 3/4 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) :
    0 < weight q c ∧ weight q c < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ target q c/2 ∧ target q c/2 ≤ 1 := by
  have hd : 0 < q-2+c := by linarith
  unfold weight target
  refine ⟨div_pos (by linarith) hd, (div_lt_one hd).mpr (by linarith), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact div_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) hd.le) (by norm_num)
  · have hh : (q-1)/(q-2+c) ≤ 2 := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr (by linarith)
    linarith

/-- Completed square of the two allocated query orbits at exchange distance
one. It is valid for every real nuisance value, without a parameter grid. -/
theorem nearest_completed_square (q c t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hscale : (q+1)*c^2=q) :
    designLoss q c 1 t = value q c+c*(q-2)*(t-target q c)^2 := by
  have hd : q-2+c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (show 0 < q-2+c by linarith)
  have hk : q+1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hcoef : (1*(1*(q-1)+1)/(q+1)) = c^2 := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hk).mpr
    nlinarith [hscale]
  unfold designLoss
  rw [hcoef]
  unfold weight value target
  field_simp [hd]
  ring

/-- The primal design rejects every nearest alternative at the proposed rate. -/
theorem nearest_lower (q t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    value q (scale q) ≤ designLoss q (scale q) 1 t := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  rw [nearest_completed_square q _ t hq (by linarith [hc.1]) hc.2.2]
  have hp := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ scale q by linarith [hc.1])
    (show 0 ≤ q-2 by linarith)) (sq_nonneg (t-target q (scale q)))
  linarith

/-- The same explicit value is attained by a feasible nuisance parameter. -/
theorem nearest_attainment (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    designLoss q (scale q) 1 (target q (scale q)) = value q (scale q) := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  rw [nearest_completed_square q _ _ hq (by linarith [hc.1]) hc.2.2]
  simp

/-- The coefficient inequality needed for every exchange distance, proved on
the full real interval [1,q], hence also for all legal integer distances. -/
theorem distance_coefficient (q d : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    q*(q-d-1)^2 ≤ d*(d*(q-1)+1)*(q-2)^2 := by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ d*(q-3)*(q-1)^2 := by positivity
  have h2 : q ≤ q*(q-1)^2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith) (show 0 ≤ (q-1)^2-1 by nlinarith)]
  have hp := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ d-1 by linarith)
    (show 0 ≤ d*(q-3)*(q-1)^2+q*(q-1)^2-d by linarith)
  have hid : d*(d*(q-1)+1)*(q-2)^2-q*(q-d-1)^2 =
      (d-1)*(d*(q-3)*(q-1)^2+q*(q-1)^2-d) := by ring
  linarith

/-- Scaled adjacent-alternative average for a query with s coordinates in A,
t coordinates in B, and distinguished-coordinate switch h in {0,1}. -/
noncomputable def dual (q z h s t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  q*(q+1)*z^2*(t-h)^2+2*q*z*(1+z)*(t-h)*s-
    2*(q+1)*z*(1+z)*(t-h)*t+(1+z)^2*(q*s+(q+1)*t-2*s*t)

/-- A general endpoint envelope, stronger than checking finitely many group
sizes. The switch can vary continuously over [0,1]. -/
theorem dual_envelope (q z h s t V : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hzsmall : 4*q*z ≤ 1) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q)
    (hA : dual q z h q 0 ≤ V) (hB : dual q z h 0 q ≤ V) :
    dual q z h s t ≤ V := by
  have hqt : 0 ≤ q-t := by linarith
  have hC : 0 ≤ q*(q-3)*z^2+2-(4*q-2)*z := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ q*(q-3)*z^2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg z)
    nlinarith
  have hM : 0 ≤ q*z^2*(q+t-2*h)-2*z*(1+z)*(q+t-h)+(1+z)^2 := by
    have h1 := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q*z^2 by positivity) (show 0 ≤ q+t-2*h by linarith)
    have h2 := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2*z*(1+z) by positivity) (show 0 ≤ 2*q-(q+t-h) by linarith)
    have h3 := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1+z by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 1+z-4*q*z by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have h0id : dual q z h 0 q-dual q z h 0 t =
      (q+1)*(q-t)*(q*z^2*(q+t-2*h)-2*z*(1+z)*(q+t-h)+(1+z)^2) := by
    unfold dual; ring
  have h0 : dual q z h 0 t ≤ V := by
    have hp := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith) hqt) hM
    linarith
  have hdiag : q*(V-dual q z h (q-t) t) =
      (q-t)*(V-dual q z h q 0)+t*(V-dual q z h 0 q)+
        q*t*(q-t)*(q*(q-3)*z^2+2-(4*q-2)*z) := by unfold dual; ring
  have h1 : dual q z h (q-t) t ≤ V := by
    have ha := mul_nonneg hqt (sub_nonneg.mpr hA)
    have hb := mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)
    have hc := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith) ht) hqt) hC
    nlinarith
  have hid : (q-t)*(V-dual q z h s t) =
      (q-t-s)*(V-dual q z h 0 t)+s*(V-dual q z h (q-t) t) := by unfold dual; ring
  by_cases hzero : q-t=0
  · have hs0 : s=0 := by linarith
    simpa [hs0] using h0
  · have hp : 0 < q-t := lt_of_le_of_ne hqt (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hl := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-t-s by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr h0)
    have hr := mul_nonneg hs (sub_nonneg.mpr h1)
    nlinarith

#print axioms scale_properties
#print axioms parameters
#print axioms nearest_completed_square
#print axioms nearest_lower
#print axioms nearest_attainment
#print axioms distance_coefficient
#print axioms dual_envelope

noncomputable def root (q c : ℝ) : ℝ := (1-c)/(q-2+c)

/-- The algebraic root balances the two query types and is small enough for
the dual endpoint envelope at every q>=3. -/
theorem root_properties (q c : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hc : 3/4 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hscale : (q+1)*c^2=q) :
    0 < root q c ∧ 4*q*root q c ≤ 1 ∧
      (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*root q c)^2=q*(1+root q c)^2 := by
  have hd : 0 < q-2+c := by linarith
  have hk : 0 ≤ q+1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨div_pos (by linarith) hd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : 4*q ≤ (q+1)*(7/4)*(q-5/4) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-3 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 28*q+13 by linarith)]
    have h1 : (q+1)*(7/4)*(q-5/4) ≤ (q+1)*(1+c)*(q-2+c) := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul (show (7/4:ℝ) ≤ 1+c by linarith) (show q-5/4 ≤ q-2+c by linarith)
          (show 0 ≤ q-5/4 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 1+c by linarith)) hk
      nlinarith
    have hrel : (q+1)*(1+c)*(1-c)=1 := by nlinarith [hscale]
    have heq : (q+1)*(1+c)*(q-2+c)*(1-c)=q-2+c := by
      calc
        _ = ((q+1)*(1+c)*(1-c))*(q-2+c) := by ring
        _ = q-2+c := by rw [hrel, one_mul]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans h0 h1) (show 0 ≤ 1-c by linarith)
    rw [heq] at hh
    unfold root
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_one hd]
    exact hh
  · have hbalance : 1-(q-2)*root q c=c*(1+root q c) := by
      unfold root
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hd]
      ring
    rw [hbalance, mul_pow]
    calc
      _ = ((q+1)*c^2)*(1+root q c)^2 := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hscale]

/-- Both endpoint allocations dominate all joint-query counts in the larger
library. This is a continuum bound over the two count triangles. -/
theorem both_query_dual (q z s t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hsmall : 4*q*z ≤ 1) (hroot : (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2=q*(1+z)^2)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dual q z 0 s t ≤ q^2*(1+z)^2 ∧ dual q z 1 s t ≤ q^2*(1+z)^2 := by
  have hA0 : dual q z 0 q 0=q^2*(1+z)^2 := by unfold dual; ring
  have hB1 : dual q z 1 0 q=q^2*(1+z)^2 := by
    have hid : dual q z 1 0 q=q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by unfold dual; ring
    rw [hid]
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => q*x) hroot]
  have hA1 : dual q z 1 q 0 ≤ q^2*(1+z)^2 := by
    have hp := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
      (show 0 ≤ (q-1)*z^2+2*q*z from add_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg z)) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hz))
    have hid : q^2*(1+z)^2-dual q z 1 q 0=q*((q-1)*z^2+2*q*z) := by unfold dual; ring
    linarith
  have hB0 : dual q z 0 0 q ≤ q^2*(1+z)^2 := by
    have hp := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*z by positivity)
      (show 0 ≤ 2-(2*q-3)*z by nlinarith)
    have hid : dual q z 1 0 q-dual q z 0 0 q=q*(q+1)*z*(2-(2*q-3)*z) := by unfold dual; ring
    linarith
  constructor
  · exact dual_envelope q z 0 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hs ht hst hA0.le hB0
  · exact dual_envelope q z 1 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hs ht hst hA1 hB1.le

/-- Closed-form dual certificate for every width m=2(q+1)>=8. -/
theorem all_width_both_query_dual (q s t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dual q (root q (scale q)) 0 s t ≤ q^2*(1+root q (scale q))^2 ∧
    dual q (root q (scale q)) 1 s t ≤ q^2*(1+root q (scale q))^2 := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  exact both_query_dual q _ s t hq hz.1.le hz.2.1 hz.2.2 hs ht hst

/-- The dual and primal certificates use exactly the same normalized value. -/
theorem dual_value_equals_primal (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    q^2*(1+root q (scale q))^2/(q*(q+1))=value q (scale q) := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hd : q-2+scale q ≠ 0 := by linarith [hc.1]
  have hp : q ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hk : q+1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have htarget : 1+root q (scale q)=target q (scale q) := by
    unfold root target
    field_simp [hd]
    ring
  rw [htarget]
  unfold target value
  field_simp [hd, hp, hk]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (q-1)^2*x) hc.2.2]

#print axioms root_properties
#print axioms both_query_dual
#print axioms all_width_both_query_dual
#print axioms dual_value_equals_primal

/-- The explicit mixture covers all alternative exchange distances, not only
the adjacent worlds used by the dual certificate. -/
theorem all_distances_lower (q d t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    value q (scale q) ≤ designLoss q (scale q) d t := by
  let v := (q-d-1)*t/(q-2)
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hw := parameters q _ hq hc.1 hc.2.1
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hr : 0 < q-2 := by linarith
  have hbase : q*(q-d-1)^2/(q-2)^2 ≤ d*(d*(q-1)+1) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hr)).mpr (distance_coefficient q d hq hd hdq)
  have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbase hk.le
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiv (sq_nonneg t))
    (show 0 ≤ 1-weight q (scale q) by linarith [hw.2.1])
  have hi : (q*(q-d-1)^2/(q-2)^2/(q+1))*t^2 =
      (1*(1*(q-1)+1)/(q+1))*v^2 := by
    dsimp [v]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hr, ne_of_gt hk]
    ring
  have hb : ((q-1)-(q-1-1)*v)^2=((q-1)-(q-d-1)*t)^2 := by
    dsimp [v]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]
    ring
  rw [hi] at hm
  have hn := nearest_lower q v hq
  unfold designLoss at hn ⊢
  rw [hb] at hn
  nlinarith

/-- Scalar Q measurements do not invalidate the larger-library dual. -/
theorem scalar_dual (q z : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1) :
    (1-z)^2/(q+1) ≤ q*(1+z)^2/(q+1) ∧
    (1+(q-1)*z^2)/q ≤ q*(1+z)^2/(q+1) ∧
    z^2 ≤ q*(1+z)^2/(q+1) := by
  have hk : 0 < q+1 := by linarith
  have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
  refine ⟨(div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hk).mpr ?_, (div_le_div_iff₀ hp hk).mpr ?_,
    (le_div_iff₀ hk).mpr ?_⟩
  · have hh := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-1 by linarith) (sq_nonneg z)
    have hh' := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith) hz
    nlinarith
  · have hh := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg q) hz
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg z]
  · have hh := mul_nonneg hp.le hz
    have hsq : z^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith

#print axioms all_distances_lower
#print axioms scalar_dual
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation

import «LeanD6ThresholdConstructionV1»

/-! Actual-world semantics for joint measurements without the distinguished
coordinate. This closes the observation bridge used by the expanded-query
allocation experiments. It does not claim the allocation game's finite-orbit
reduction or sequential optimality. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
variable {n : ℕ}

def plainCorner (G : Finset (I n)) : I n → Bool := fun i => decide (i ∈ G)

theorem count_plain (B G : Finset (I n)) : count B (plainCorner G) = (G ∩ B).card := by
  unfold count
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp [plainCorner, and_comm]

/-- Every unanchored query of size at least two has gate value one, for every
hidden A. Thus this query model is derived from the threshold construction. -/
theorem gate_plain (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : 2 ≤ G.card) :
    gate A j (plainCorner G) = 1 := by
  have he : (∃ i ∈ A, plainCorner G i = true) ∨ 2 ≤ count (others A j) (plainCorner G) := by
    by_cases h : ∃ i ∈ A, plainCorner G i = true
    · exact Or.inl h
    · right
      have hs : G ⊆ others A j := by
        intro i hi
        have hiA : i ∉ A := by
          intro hiA
          exact h ⟨i, hiA, by simp [plainCorner, hi]⟩
        have hij : i ≠ j := by intro hh; subst i; exact hjG hi
        simp [others, hiA, hij]
      rw [count_plain, inter_eq_left.mpr hs]
      exact hG
  have hjfalse : plainCorner G j = false := by simp [plainCorner, hjG]
  simp only [gate, hjfalse, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, if_pos he]

/-- Actual unanchored response: one plus lambda times the queried B count. -/
theorem actual_unanchored_measurement (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : 2 ≤ G.card) (mu : ℝ) :
    world A j mu (plainCorner G) = 1+(1-mu)*((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ) := by
  have hw : ∀ i, coeff A j mu i * bit (plainCorner G i) =
      if i ∈ G ∩ others A j then 1-mu else 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [plainCorner, bit, hjG, others]
    · by_cases hiA : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hiG : i ∈ G <;>
        simp [coeff, plainCorner, bit, others, hiA, hiG, hij]
  rw [world, gate_plain A G j hjG hG]
  unfold linear
  simp_rw [hw]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_mem, univ_inter, sum_const]
  simp
  ring

/-- The two query types differ by the same unknown lambda plus a known one.
Paired responses therefore identify the nuisance independently of hidden A. -/
theorem paired_measurement_calibrates_margin (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : 2 ≤ G.card) (mu : ℝ) :
    world A j mu (plainCorner G) - world A j mu (jointCorner G j) = 2-mu := by
  rw [actual_unanchored_measurement A G j hjG hG, joint_measurement A G j hjA]
  ring

#print axioms gate_plain
#print axioms actual_unanchored_measurement
#print axioms paired_measurement_calibrates_margin
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ExpectedStoppingEpochV1.lean (119 dong)
import «LeanD6UniformDiscoveryThresholdV1»

/-! # Step 4: the expected settling epoch

`eventually_correct` says the certification is eventually right almost surely,
but a.s. eventual correctness carries no rate: it does not say WHEN.  The
quantity that does is the index after which no epoch is ever bad again.

    settleIndex x = ∑' s0, 1{ some epoch at or after s0 is bad }

which counts, for each `s0`, whether trouble remains ahead.  On a path with
finitely many bad epochs it equals `last bad index + 1`; on a path with
infinitely many it is `∞`.  So a finite expectation for it is exactly the
statement that the algorithm settles in bounded expected epoch count.

`expected_settle_index` proves `E[settleIndex] <= 4 * eta d r0`, from the same
per-epoch tail `eta*(1/4)^s` used by `expected_bad_epoch_work`, summed twice --
once over the epochs at or after `s0`, once over `s0`.  Combined with Step 3,
`settle_index_threshold` makes the expected settling epoch smaller than any
target once `r0 >= 128*log(8*d/tol)`.

What this is and is not.  It is a last-bad-epoch result for the discovery /
revalidation layer: the layer with eventually correct labels. The last-bad index looks into
the future and is NOT a stopping time for the natural filtration.  It is
NOT the termination of the full adaptive allocation algorithm, and it is not the
`Gamma` rate, because it says nothing about the allocation inside good epochs
nor about phase-interval crossings.  It is the first of those three that the
existing tail estimate can actually pay for.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpectedStoppingEpoch
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

/-- Trouble still ahead at `s0`. -/
def tailBad (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r0 s0 : ℕ) : Set (Sample J) :=
  ⋃ k : ℕ,bad B a (epochSamples r0 (s0+k))

lemma tailBad_measurable (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r0 s0 : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (tailBad B a r0 s0) :=
  MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun k => bad_measurable B a _)

/-- The index after which no epoch is ever bad again. -/
def settleIndex (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample J) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' s0 : ℕ,(tailBad B a r0 s0).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) x

lemma quarter_le_half : (4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2⁻¹ := ENNReal.inv_le_inv.mpr (by norm_num)

lemma tsum_quarter_le_two : ∑' k : ℕ,(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^k ≤ 2 := by
  calc ∑' k : ℕ,(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^k ≤ ∑' k : ℕ,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^k := by
        apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
        intro k
        gcongr
        norm_num
    _ = 2 := ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two

/-- Trouble ahead decays geometrically in the starting epoch. -/
theorem bad_tail_after (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (s0 : ℕ) :
    vectorPath m (tailBad B a r0 s0) ≤ 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0 := by
  calc vectorPath m (tailBad B a r0 s0)
      ≤ ∑' k : ℕ,vectorPath m (bad B a (epochSamples r0 (s0+k))) := measure_iUnion_le _
    _ ≤ ∑' k : ℕ,eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^(s0+k) :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => epoch_tail m B a hm r0 hr0 (s0+k))
    _ = eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0*∑' k : ℕ,(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^k := by
        rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
        exact tsum_congr (fun k => by rw [pow_add];ring)
    _ ≤ eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0*2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left tsum_quarter_le_two (show 0 ≤ _ from zero_le)
    _ = 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0 := by ring

/-- The algorithm settles in bounded expected epoch count. -/
theorem expected_settle_index (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,settleIndex B a r0 x ∂vectorPath m) ≤ 4*eta (Fintype.card J) r0 := by
  unfold settleIndex
  rw [lintegral_tsum (fun s0 => (measurable_const.indicator
    (tailBad_measurable B a r0 s0)).aemeasurable)]
  calc ∑' s0 : ℕ,∫⁻ x,(tailBad B a r0 s0).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) x ∂vectorPath m
      = ∑' s0 : ℕ,vectorPath m (tailBad B a r0 s0) := by
        refine tsum_congr (fun s0 => ?_)
        rw [lintegral_indicator_const (tailBad_measurable B a r0 s0),one_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑' s0 : ℕ,2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0 :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun s0 => bad_tail_after m B a hm r0 hr0 s0)
    _ = 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0*∑' s0 : ℕ,(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s0 := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
    _ ≤ 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0*2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left tsum_quarter_le_two (show 0 ≤ _ from zero_le)
    _ = 4*eta (Fintype.card J) r0 := by ring

/-- Uniform in `q`: the expected settling epoch falls below any target once the
revalidation budget clears the logarithmic threshold of Step 3. -/
theorem settle_index_threshold (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0)
    (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol)
    (hlog : 128*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card J:ℝ)/(tol/2)) ≤ (r0:ℝ)) :
    (∫⁻ x,settleIndex B a r0 x ∂vectorPath m) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal tol := by
  letI : Nonempty J := ⟨a⟩
  have hhalf : (0:ℝ) < tol/2 := by linarith
  have hb := bad_epoch_threshold (Fintype.card J) r0 (tol/2) hhalf Fintype.card_pos hlog
  have h2 : (4:ℝ≥0∞)*eta (Fintype.card J) r0 = 2*(2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0) := by ring
  refine (expected_settle_index m B a hm r0 hr0).trans ?_
  rw [h2]
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (show (0:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 from zero_le)).trans ?_
  have he : (2:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal 2 := by simp
  rw [he,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  linarith

#print axioms tailBad_measurable
#print axioms tsum_quarter_le_two
#print axioms bad_tail_after
#print axioms expected_settle_index
#print axioms settle_index_threshold
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpectedStoppingEpoch

  fin_cases u <;> simp

theorem gammaFive_selected_is_topC :
    IsTopKByScore
      (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j))
      gammaFiveSelected 3 := by

noncomputable def gammaFiveContrast (i : Fin 6)
    (x : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  gammaFiveWorld6 (Function.update x i 1) -
    gammaFiveWorld6 (Function.update x i 0)

noncomputable def gammaFiveContrastLo (i : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
  ![(1 : ℝ), 0, 0, 0, 1, -2] i

noncomputable def gammaFiveContrastHi (i : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
  ![(2 : ℝ), 1, 1, 1, 2, -1] i

private theorem gammaFive_contrast_bounds (i : Fin 6)
    (x : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    gammaFiveContrastLo i ≤ gammaFiveContrast i x ∧
      gammaFiveContrast i x ≤ gammaFiveContrastHi i := by
  fin_cases i <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 0) with h0 | h0 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 1) with h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 2) with h2 | h2 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 3) with h3 | h3 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 4) with h4 | h4 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x 5) with h5 | h5 <;>
    simp [gammaFiveContrast, gammaFiveContrastLo, gammaFiveContrastHi,
      gammaFiveWorld6, h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, Function.update] <;>
    norm_num

private theorem gammaFive_contrast_width (i : Fin 6) :
    gammaFiveContrastHi i - gammaFiveContrastLo i = 1 := by
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [gammaFiveContrastHi, gammaFiveContrastLo]

private theorem mixed_eq_zero_of_zero_zero
    (i : Fin 6) (x c : Fin 6 → Fin 2)
    (hx : x i = 0) (hc : c i = 0) :
    mixedDifference gammaFiveWorld6 i x c = 0 := by
  unfold mixedDifference
  have hxu : Function.update x i (0 : Fin 2) = x := by
    exact Function.update_eq_self_iff.mpr hx.symm
  have hcu : Function.update c i (0 : Fin 2) = c := by
    exact Function.update_eq_self_iff.mpr hc.symm
  rw [hx, hc, hxu, hcu]
  ring

    (i : Fin 6) (x c : Fin 6 → Fin 2)

theorem gammaFive_mixed_difference_bound :
    ∀ (i : Fin 6) (x c : Fin 6 → Fin 2),
      |mixedDifference gammaFiveWorld6 i x c| ≤ 1 := by
  intro i x c
  rcases fin2_zero_or_one (x i) with hx | hx <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one (c i) with hc | hc
  · rw [mixed_eq_zero_of_zero_zero i x c hx hc]
    norm_num
  · rw [mixed_eq_c_minus_x i x c hx hc, abs_le]
    have hxB := gammaFive_contrast_bounds i x
    have hcB := gammaFive_contrast_bounds i c
    have hw := gammaFive_contrast_width i
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [mixed_eq_x_minus_c i x c hx hc, abs_le]
    have hxB := gammaFive_contrast_bounds i x
    have hcB := gammaFive_contrast_bounds i c
    have hw := gammaFive_contrast_width i
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [mixed_eq_zero_of_one_one i x c hx hc]
    norm_num

private theorem compressionLoss_eq_of_bounds
    (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (lo hi : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x, lo ≤ gammaFiveWorld6 x -
        S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (x j)) ∧
      gammaFiveWorld6 x -
        S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (x j)) ≤ hi)
    (xmin xmax : Fin 6 → Fin 2)
    (hmin : gammaFiveWorld6 xmin -
        S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (xmin j)) = lo)
    (hmax : gammaFiveWorld6 xmax -
        S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (xmax j)) = hi) :
    productCompressionLoss gammaFiveWorld6
      (productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6) S = (hi - lo) / 2 := by
  let r : (Fin 6 → Fin 2) → ℝ := fun x ↦ gammaFiveWorld6 x -
    S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (x j))
  have hrmax : maxVal r = hi := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact maxVal_le r (fun x ↦ (hbound x).2)
    · simpa [r, hmax] using le_maxVal r xmax
  have hrmin : minVal r = lo := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa [r, hmin] using minVal_le r xmin
    · exact le_minVal r (fun x ↦ (hbound x).1)
  simp [productCompressionLoss, r, osc, hrmax, hrmin]

private theorem gammaFive_selected_bounds (x : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    3 ≤ gammaFiveWorld6 x - gammaFiveSelected.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (x j)) ∧
    gammaFiveWorld6 x - gammaFiveSelected.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass6 gammaFiveWorld6 j (x j)) ≤ 9 := by
