import Mathlib
import «LeanD6FirstOrderInsufficiencyWitnessV1»

/-!
# D6-B7: full-singleton first-order insufficiency

This extension closes the presentation loophole in the original two-decision
witness.  A controller is now allowed to return *any* singleton retained set
over `Fin 3`.  The two worlds still have the identical complete first-order
product-response table, while their zero-regret singleton fibres are disjoint.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FirstOrderInsufficiencyWitness

open scoped BigOperators Matrix
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.TypedCertificateCompletion

def alternative2 : Finset (Fin 3) := {2}

private theorem alternative2_sum (g : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    alternative2.sum g = g 2 := by
  rw [show alternative2 = {2} from rfl, Finset.sum_singleton]

private theorem fin2_zero_or_one_v2 (u : Fin 2) : u = 0 ∨ u = 1 := by
  fin_cases u <;> simp

private theorem compressionLoss_eq_of_bounds_v2
    (F : (Fin 3 → Fin 2) → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin 3)) (lo hi : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x, lo ≤ F x -
        S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 F j (x j)) ∧
      F x - S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 F j (x j)) ≤ hi)
    (xmin xmax : Fin 3 → Fin 2)
    (hmin : F xmin - S.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 F j (xmin j)) = lo)
    (hmax : F xmax - S.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 F j (xmax j)) = hi) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse pointMass3 F) S =
      (hi - lo) / 2 := by
  let residual : (Fin 3 → Fin 2) → ℝ := fun x ↦ F x -
    S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 F j (x j))
  have hrmax : maxVal residual = hi := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact maxVal_le residual (fun x ↦ (hbound x).2)
    · simpa [residual, hmax] using le_maxVal residual xmax
  have hrmin : minVal residual = lo := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa [residual, hmin] using minVal_le residual xmin
    · exact le_minVal residual (fun x ↦ (hbound x).1)
  simp [productCompressionLoss, residual, osc, hrmax, hrmin]

private theorem additive_alternative2_bounds (x : Fin 3 → Fin 2) :
    0 ≤ additiveWorld3 x - alternative2.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3 j (x j)) ∧
    additiveWorld3 x - alternative2.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3 j (x j)) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [alternative2_sum, additive_response]
  rcases fin2_zero_or_one_v2 (x 0) with h0 | h0 <;>
    simp [additiveWorld3, h0]

private theorem interaction_alternative2_bounds (x : Fin 3 → Fin 2) :
    0 ≤ interactionWorld3 x - alternative2.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3 j (x j)) ∧
    interactionWorld3 x - alternative2.sum
      (fun j ↦ productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3 j (x j)) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [alternative2_sum, interaction_response]
  rcases fin2_zero_or_one_v2 (x 0) with h0 | h0 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one_v2 (x 1) with h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases fin2_zero_or_one_v2 (x 2) with h2 | h2 <;>
    simp [interactionWorld3, h0, h1, h2] <;> norm_num

theorem additive_alternative2_loss :
    productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
      (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) alternative2 = 1 / 2 := by
  convert compressionLoss_eq_of_bounds_v2 additiveWorld3 alternative2 0 1
    additive_alternative2_bounds a000 a100 (by
      rw [alternative2_sum, additive_response]
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
      norm_num [a000, additiveWorld3, anchor3, h20]) (by
      rw [alternative2_sum, additive_response]
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
      norm_num [a100, additiveWorld3, anchor3, Function.update, h20]) using 1 <;> norm_num

theorem interaction_alternative2_loss :
    productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
      (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) alternative2 = 1 / 2 := by
  convert compressionLoss_eq_of_bounds_v2 interactionWorld3 alternative2 0 1
    interaction_alternative2_bounds a000 a100 (by
      rw [alternative2_sum, interaction_response]
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
      norm_num [a000, interactionWorld3, anchor3, h20]) (by
      rw [alternative2_sum, interaction_response]
      have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
      norm_num [a100, interactionWorld3, anchor3, Function.update, h20]) using 1 <;> norm_num

theorem D6_B7_full_singleton_opposite_strict_ordering :
    productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) selected0 <
      productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) alternative1 ∧
    productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) selected0 <
      productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) alternative2 ∧
    productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) alternative1 <
      productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) selected0 ∧
    productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) alternative2 <
      productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) selected0 := by
  rw [additive_selected_loss, additive_alternative_loss,
    additive_alternative2_loss, interaction_selected_loss,
    interaction_alternative_loss, interaction_alternative2_loss]
  norm_num

abbrev SingletonDecisionSpace3 := {S : Finset (Fin 3) // S.card = 1}

def singletonDecision3 (i : Fin 3) : SingletonDecisionSpace3 :=
  ⟨{i}, by simp⟩

theorem singletonDecision3_complete (d : SingletonDecisionSpace3) :
    ∃ i : Fin 3, d.1 = (singletonDecision3 i).1 := by
  exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp d.2

@[simp] theorem singletonDecision3_zero : (singletonDecision3 0).1 = selected0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem singletonDecision3_one : (singletonDecision3 1).1 = alternative1 := rfl
@[simp] theorem singletonDecision3_two : (singletonDecision3 2).1 = alternative2 := rfl

noncomputable def fullSingletonRegret3
    (interaction : Bool) (decision : SingletonDecisionSpace3) : ℝ :=
  if interaction then
    productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) decision.1 - (1 / 2)
  else
    productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) decision.1

private theorem fullSingletonRegret3_at_zero (interaction : Bool) :
    fullSingletonRegret3 interaction (singletonDecision3 0) =
      if interaction then 1 / 2 else 0 := by
  cases interaction
  · change productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
      (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) (singletonDecision3 0).1 = 0
    rw [singletonDecision3_zero, additive_selected_loss]
  · change productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) (singletonDecision3 0).1 - 1 / 2 = 1 / 2
    rw [singletonDecision3_zero, interaction_selected_loss]
    norm_num

private theorem fullSingletonRegret3_at_one (interaction : Bool) :
    fullSingletonRegret3 interaction (singletonDecision3 1) =
      if interaction then 0 else 1 / 2 := by
  cases interaction
  · change productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
      (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) (singletonDecision3 1).1 = 1 / 2
    rw [singletonDecision3_one, additive_alternative_loss]
  · change productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) (singletonDecision3 1).1 - 1 / 2 = 0
    rw [singletonDecision3_one, interaction_alternative_loss]
    norm_num

private theorem fullSingletonRegret3_at_two (interaction : Bool) :
    fullSingletonRegret3 interaction (singletonDecision3 2) =
      if interaction then 0 else 1 / 2 := by
  cases interaction
  · change productCompressionLoss additiveWorld3
      (productResponse pointMass3 additiveWorld3) (singletonDecision3 2).1 = 1 / 2
    rw [singletonDecision3_two, additive_alternative2_loss]
  · change productCompressionLoss interactionWorld3
        (productResponse pointMass3 interactionWorld3) (singletonDecision3 2).1 - 1 / 2 = 0
    rw [singletonDecision3_two, interaction_alternative2_loss]
    norm_num

theorem D6_B7_full_singleton_zero_good_decisions_disjoint :
    Disjoint (Good fullSingletonRegret3 0 false)
      (Good fullSingletonRegret3 0 true) := by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro d hAdditive hInteraction
  rcases singletonDecision3_complete d with ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hd : d = singletonDecision3 i := Subtype.ext hi
  subst d
  fin_cases i
  · have hA : fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 0) = 0 :=
      fullSingletonRegret3_at_zero false
    have hI : fullSingletonRegret3 true (singletonDecision3 0) = 1 / 2 :=
      fullSingletonRegret3_at_zero true
    change fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 0) ≤ 0 at hAdditive
    change fullSingletonRegret3 true (singletonDecision3 0) ≤ 0 at hInteraction
    rw [hA] at hAdditive
    rw [hI] at hInteraction
    norm_num at hInteraction
  · have hA : fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 1) = 1 / 2 := by
      simpa using fullSingletonRegret3_at_one false
    change fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 1) ≤ 0 at hAdditive
    rw [hA] at hAdditive
    norm_num at hAdditive
  · have hA : fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 2) = 1 / 2 := by
      simpa using fullSingletonRegret3_at_two false
    change fullSingletonRegret3 false (singletonDecision3 2) ≤ 0 at hAdditive
    rw [hA] at hAdditive
    norm_num at hAdditive

theorem D6_B7_full_singleton_response_only_not_universally_zero_regret :
    ¬ ∃ controller : FirstOrderObservation3 → SingletonDecisionSpace3,
      fullSingletonRegret3 false
          (controller (firstOrderObservation3 false)) ≤ 0 ∧
      fullSingletonRegret3 true
          (controller (firstOrderObservation3 true)) ≤ 0 := by
  exact TCC2_indistinguishability_impossibility
    firstOrderObservation3 fullSingletonRegret3 0 false true
    D6_B7_observation_worlds_equal
    D6_B7_full_singleton_zero_good_decisions_disjoint

/- The `Fin 3` encoding covers exactly the full set of singleton retained
decisions.  This form exposes the result to a controller API which returns an
ordinary `Finset`, while the cardinality invariant remains explicit. -/
theorem D6_B7_no_finset_singleton_controller_universally_zero_regret :
    ¬ ∃ (controller : FirstOrderObservation3 → Finset (Fin 3))
      (hcard : ∀ observation, (controller observation).card = 1),
      fullSingletonRegret3 false
          ⟨controller (firstOrderObservation3 false),
            hcard (firstOrderObservation3 false)⟩ ≤ 0 ∧
      fullSingletonRegret3 true
          ⟨controller (firstOrderObservation3 true),
            hcard (firstOrderObservation3 true)⟩ ≤ 0 := by
  rintro ⟨controller, hcard, hAdditive, hInteraction⟩
  let encoded : FirstOrderObservation3 → SingletonDecisionSpace3 :=
    fun observation ↦ ⟨controller observation, hcard observation⟩
  apply D6_B7_full_singleton_response_only_not_universally_zero_regret
  refine ⟨encoded, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hAdditive
  · exact hInteraction

end CIGAMF.P13.D6FirstOrderInsufficiencyWitness

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6FrozenAllocationFeasibleV1.lean (83 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenScalarAllocationV1»

/-! Removes the frozen-design guard and nuisance premises on the whole
margin interval [1/2,1], for every q >= 3 and frozen B-on mass <= 1/4. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma frozen_coefficients (q w : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1/4) :
    0 < coefficient q w ∧ 0 < p q w ∧ 0 ≤ beta q w ∧ beta q w < p q w ∧
      0 ≤ w*(q-2)/coefficient q w ∧ w*(q-2)/coefficient q w ≤ 1 := by
  have hqp : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hC : 0 < coefficient q w := by
    unfold coefficient
    have h1 : 0 < (1-w)*(q-1)/q := div_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)) hqp
    have h2 : 0 ≤ w*(q-2)^2 := mul_nonneg hw (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have hp : 0 < p q w := div_pos (by linarith) hqp
  have hbeta : 0 ≤ beta q w := by
    unfold beta
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) hw) (mul_pos hqp hC).le
  have hpoly : -5 ≤ q*(q-2)^2-q*(q-1)-(q-1) := by
    have h := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-3 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ q^2-2*q-2 by nlinarith)
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hgap : 0 < coefficient q w-(q-1)*w := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hw
    have hid : q*(coefficient q w-(q-1)*w)=
        (q-1)+w*(q*(q-2)^2-q*(q-1)-(q-1)) := by
      unfold coefficient
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hqp]
      <;> ring
    have hpos : 0 < q*(coefficient q w-(q-1)*w) := by nlinarith only [hid,hh,hq,hw1]
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right hpos hqp.le
  have hbetap : beta q w < p q w := by
    unfold beta p
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hqp hC) hqp).mpr
    have hh := mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1-w) hqp) hgap
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ w*(q-2)/coefficient q w := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw (by linarith)) hC.le
  have ht1 : w*(q-2)/coefficient q w ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hC).mpr
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(q-1)/q := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) hqp.le
    have h2 : 0 ≤ w*(q-2)*(q-3) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw (by linarith)) (by linarith)
    unfold coefficient
    nlinarith only [h1,h2]
  exact ⟨hC,hp,hbeta,hbetap,ht0,ht1⟩

/-- The nearest-alternative guard holds and its nuisance stays legal on the
entire half interval; these are no longer external assumptions. -/
theorem frozen_half_interval_conditions (q w mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1/4) (hm : 1/2 ≤ mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    beta q w*(1-mu)^2 ≤ p q w*mu^2 ∧
      0 ≤ mu-delta q w mu ∧ mu-delta q w mu ≤ 1 := by
  obtain ⟨hc,hp,hb,hbp,ht0,ht1⟩ := frozen_coefficients q w hq hw hw1
  have hsq : (1-mu)^2 ≤ mu^2 := by nlinarith
  have hguard := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hb).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbp.le (sq_nonneg mu))
  have hd : delta q w mu=(w*(q-2)/coefficient q w)*(1-mu) := by unfold delta; ring
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ delta q w mu := by rw [hd]; exact mul_nonneg ht0 (by linarith)
  have hd1 : delta q w mu ≤ 1-mu := by
    rw [hd]
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht1 (show 0 ≤ 1-mu by linarith)
  exact ⟨hguard,by linarith,by linarith⟩

/-- Exact value for all actual alternatives, with only interval assumptions. -/
theorem frozen_half_interval_value (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1/4)
    (hm : 1/2 ≤ mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    allocationValue A j mu (queries A j) (weights A j q w)=D6FrozenScalarAllocation.value q w mu := by
  have hc := frozen_coefficients q w hq hw hw1
  have hf := frozen_half_interval_conditions q w mu hq hw hw1 hm hm1
  exact frozen_actual_value A j q w mu hq hw (by linarith) hc.1 hj hA hB hf.1 hf.2.1 hf.2.2

#print axioms frozen_coefficients
#print axioms frozen_half_interval_conditions
#print axioms frozen_half_interval_value
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6FrozenMixtureCertificateV1.lean (186 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualRecordLikelihoodV1»
import «LeanD6GaussianMixtureIntegralV1»
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! A likelihood-mixture certificate has an unconditional finite-horizon
error bound on the actual absorbing record process. It uses no known A in
its stopping rule. Nontermination is not counted as successful output. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenMixtureCertificate
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveMixtureRisk CIGAMF.P13.D6StoppingGeometryBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualRecordLikelihood CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {n : ℕ} {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

def absoluteMixture (prior : Measure ℝ) (B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ)) : ENNReal :=
  ∫⁻ nu,ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (logLikelihood B j nu record)) ∂prior

def Certificate (prior : Measure ℝ) (W : Finset (Finset (I n))) (j : I n)
    (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (answer : Finset (I n)) (c : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  answer ∈ W ∧ ∀ B ∈ W,B ≠ answer → ∀ nu : ℝ,0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 →
    c*ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (logLikelihood B j nu record)) ≤
      absoluteMixture prior answer j record

theorem relative_mixture_factor (prior : Measure ℝ) (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (mu : ℝ) (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ)) :
    (∫⁻ nu,ENNReal.ofReal (recordRatio A B j mu nu record) ∂prior)=
      absoluteMixture prior B j record*ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-logLikelihood A j mu record)) := by
  have he : ∀ nu,ENNReal.ofReal (recordRatio A B j mu nu record)=
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (logLikelihood B j nu record))*
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-logLikelihood A j mu record)) := by
    intro nu
    rw [recordRatio,sub_eq_add_neg,Real.exp_add,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le]
  simp_rw [he]
  exact lintegral_mul_const' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

lemma exp_cancel (s : ℝ) : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp s)*ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-s))=1 := by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le,← Real.exp_add]
  simp

/-- A wrong certified label forces an actual relative-mixture threshold
crossing, including all admissible nuisance alternatives. -/
theorem wrong_certificate_crosses (prior : Measure ℝ) (W : Finset (Finset (I n)))
    (A answer : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ W)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) (record : List (Measurement n × ℝ))
    (c : ENNReal) (hcert : Certificate prior W j record answer c) (hne : answer ≠ A) :
    c ≤ ∫⁻ nu,ENNReal.ofReal (recordRatio A answer j mu nu record) ∂prior := by
  have h := hcert.2 A hA (Ne.symm hne) mu hmu hmu1
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (show 0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-logLikelihood A j mu record)) from zero_le)
  rw [mul_assoc,exp_cancel,mul_one] at hh
  rwa [relative_mixture_factor]

/-- No external probability event is assumed: the bound follows from actual
Gaussian transitions, the retained record, and the displayed stopping rule. -/
theorem actual_frozen_label_error (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (record : H → List (Measurement n × ℝ)) (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n)
    (hm : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)))
    (stopped : H → Prop) (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (hrecord : ∀ t h y,record (update t (h,y))=
      if stopped h then record h else (policy t h,y)::record h)
    (hempty : ∀ᵐ h ∂initial (),record h=[])
    (htrue : Measurable (fun h => logLikelihood A j mu (record h)))
    (prior : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior] (W : Finset (Finset (I n)))
    (hcandidate : ∀ B ∈ W,Measurable (fun x : H × ℝ => logLikelihood B j x.2 (record x.1)))
    (answer : H → Finset (I n)) (hA : A ∈ W) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (c : ENNReal) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc' : c ≠ ⊤)
    (hcert : ∀ h,stopped h → Certificate prior W j (record h) (answer h) c) (N : ℕ) :
    trajectory initial (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h))
      (hm t) (update t) (hu t)) N () {h | stopped h ∧ answer h ≠ A} ≤ (W.card:ENNReal)/c := by
  apply le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (actual_frozen_family_tail A j mu initial record policy hm
    stopped update hu hrecord hempty htrue prior W hcandidate c hc hc' N)
  rintro h ⟨hs,hne⟩
  exact ⟨answer h,(hcert h hs).1,wrong_certificate_crosses prior W A (answer h) j mu
    hA hmu hmu1 (record h) c (hcert h hs) hne⟩

/-- Exact threshold calibration, including nonempty candidate families. -/
theorem delta_calibration (W : Finset (Finset (I n))) (hW : W.Nonempty)
    (delta : ENNReal) (hd : delta ≠ 0) (hdt : delta ≠ ⊤) :
    (W.card:ENNReal)/delta ≠ 0 ∧ (W.card:ENNReal)/delta ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (W.card:ENNReal)/((W.card:ENNReal)/delta)=delta := by
  have hk : (W.card:ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hW)
  exact ⟨ENNReal.div_ne_zero.mpr ⟨hk,hdt⟩,
    ENNReal.div_ne_top (by simp) hd,ENNReal.div_div_cancel hk (by simp)⟩

/-- The probability of a wrong literal support-geometric answer is bounded
by the label-error probability; never-stopped runs stay outside both events. -/
theorem geometric_error_le_label_error (P : Measure H) (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1))
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (stopped : H → Prop) (answer : H → Finset (I (2*r+1))) :
    P {h | stopped h ∧ ¬GeometricOptimal A (answer h)ᶜ j mu} ≤
      P {h | stopped h ∧ answer h ≠ A} := by
  apply measure_mono
  rintro h ⟨hs,hbad⟩
  refine ⟨hs,?_⟩
  intro he
  apply hbad
  rw [he]
  have hp := world_parameters r j hr hA
  exact (geometric_optimal_iff A Aᶜ j hp.1 mu hmu hmu1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2).mpr rfl

#print axioms relative_mixture_factor
#print axioms wrong_certificate_crosses
#print axioms actual_frozen_label_error
#print axioms delta_calibration
#print axioms geometric_error_le_label_error
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenMixtureCertificate

/-! The quadratic profile-gap rule in the experiment implies the actual
record-mixture certificate. The Gaussian nuisance integral is evaluated,
rather than assumed equal to its computational expression. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileMixtureCertificate
open scoped BigOperators
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6StoppingGeometryBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileStoppingGeometry CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianMixtureIntegral
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenMixtureCertificate
noncomputable section
variable {n N : ℕ}

theorem finite_record_score (e : Fin N → Measurement n) (y : Fin N → ℝ)
    (B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (nu : ℝ) :
    logLikelihood B j nu (List.ofFn (fun t => (e t,y t)))=score Finset.univ e y B j nu := by
  simp [logLikelihood,score,List.sum_ofFn,Function.comp_def]

theorem finite_record_mixture (e : Fin N → Measurement n) (y : Fin N → ℝ)
    (B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (hj : j ∉ B) (hl : ∀ t,Legal j q (e t)) :
    absoluteMixture (gaussianReal 0 1) B j (List.ofFn (fun t => (e t,y t)))=
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (mixtureExpression (C Finset.univ e y B j)
        (Z Finset.univ e y B j) (V Finset.univ e B j))) := by
  have he : ∀ nu,logLikelihood B j nu (List.ofFn (fun t => (e t,y t)))=
      quadraticScore (C Finset.univ e y B j) (Z Finset.univ e y B j) (V Finset.univ e B j) nu := by
    intro nu
    rw [finite_record_score]
    exact actual_score_quadratic Finset.univ e y B j nu q hj (fun t _ => hl t)
  have hv : 0 ≤ V Finset.univ e B j := by unfold V; positivity
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun nu => Real.exp (quadraticScore (C Finset.univ e y B j)
      (Z Finset.univ e y B j) (V Finset.univ e B j) nu)) := by unfold quadraticScore; fun_prop
  have hi : Integrable (fun nu => Real.exp (quadraticScore (C Finset.univ e y B j)
      (Z Finset.univ e y B j) (V Finset.univ e B j) nu)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    apply (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro nu
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    rw [← he nu]
    exact likelihood_nonpositive B j nu _
  unfold absoluteMixture
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)),
    gaussian_quadratic_integral _ _ _ hv]

/-- The implemented profile penalty gives a concrete, truth-independent
certificate at threshold exp(threshold), for every candidate alternative. -/
theorem profile_stop_certificate (e : Fin N → Measurement n) (y : Fin N → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Finset (I n))) (answer : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (q muhat threshold : ℝ) (hanswer : answer ∈ W) (hj : j ∉ answer)
    (hl : ∀ t,Legal j q (e t)) (hv : 0 < V Finset.univ e answer j)
    (hstop : ∀ B ∈ W,B ≠ answer → ∀ nu : ℝ,0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 →
      threshold+profilePenalty (Z Finset.univ e y answer j) (V Finset.univ e answer j) ≤
        score Finset.univ e y answer j muhat-score Finset.univ e y B j nu) :
    Certificate (gaussianReal 0 1) W j (List.ofFn (fun t => (e t,y t))) answer
      (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp threshold)) := by
  refine ⟨hanswer,?_⟩
  intro B hB hne nu hn hn1
  have hs := hstop B hB hne nu hn hn1
  have hp := actual_profile_majorant Finset.univ e y answer j muhat q hj (fun t _ => hl t) hv
  rw [finite_record_mixture e y answer j q hj hl,finite_record_score]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le,← Real.exp_add]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  linarith only [hs,hp]

#print axioms finite_record_score
#print axioms finite_record_mixture
#print axioms profile_stop_certificate
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileMixtureCertificate

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6FrozenOracleGapV1.lean (85 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenScalarAllocationV1»
import «LeanD6LocalOracleRegretV1»

/-! Exact oracle penalty for freezing a phase-III allocation. This is the
quadratic remainder needed by a matching local-risk upper bound. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenOracleGap
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

lemma balanced_loss (q w mu s : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (balance : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*s)^2=mu^2+(q-1)*s^2) :
    mixedLoss q mu w 1 ((1-mu)+s)=gammaTwice q mu s := by
  have he := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => w*x) balance
  unfold mixedLoss gammaTwice
  apply (eq_div_iff hq).mpr
  field_simp [hq]
  nlinarith only [he]

/-- Exact regret identity at any balanced oracle nuisance, for an arbitrary
frozen mixture weight. -/
theorem balanced_gap_identity (q w mu s : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hc : coefficient q w ≠ 0)
    (balance : q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*s)^2=mu^2+(q-1)*s^2) :
    gammaTwice q mu s/2-D6FrozenScalarAllocation.value q w mu=
      coefficient q w*(s-delta q w mu)^2/2 := by
  have h := frozen_completed_square q w mu ((1-mu)+s) hq hc
  rw [balanced_loss q w mu s hq balance] at h
  have he : (1-mu)+s-((1-mu)+delta q w mu)=s-delta q w mu := by ring
  rw [he] at h
  linarith only [h]

/-- Actual oracle regret, after all-alternative infimum and all-query
supremum have both been evaluated. -/
theorem actual_frozen_oracle_gap (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) (hc : 0 < coefficient q w)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (guard : beta q w*(1-mu)^2 ≤ p q w*mu^2)
    (hnu0 : 0 ≤ mu-delta q w mu) (hnu1 : mu-delta q w mu ≤ 1) :
    oracleRegret A j q mu (queries A j) (weights A j q w)=
      coefficient q w*(shift q mu-delta q w mu)^2/2 := by
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hmu : 0 < mu := by linarith [hm.1]
  have hmu1 : mu ≤ 1 := hm.2.1
  have he := balanced_gap_identity q w mu (shift q mu) (by linarith) (ne_of_gt hc)
    (D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters.balance q mu hq hmu hmu1)
  unfold oracleRegret
  rw [phase_three_oracle A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB,
    frozen_actual_value A j q w mu hq hw hw1 hc hj hA hB guard hnu0 hnu1]
  change max 0 (gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2-D6FrozenScalarAllocation.value q w mu)=_
  rw [he,max_eq_right (by positivity)]

/-- At the design margin, stationarity makes the frozen nuisance equal to
the oracle nuisance. This cancels the zeroth-order term in the gap. -/
theorem frozen_shift_at_design (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hc : coefficient q (mass q mu) ≠ 0) :
    delta q (mass q mu) mu=shift q mu := by
  have h := stationarity q mu hq hmu hmu1
  unfold delta
  apply (div_eq_iff hc).mpr
  unfold coefficient
  field_simp [show q ≠ 0 by linarith]
  nlinarith only [h]

/-- Equal boundary values identify the kink coefficient without differentiating
an infimum: J = p mu/(1-mu), hence J>0 for a nondegenerate frozen design. -/
theorem boundary_slope_jump (p b c mu : ℝ) (hmu : mu ≠ 1)
    (equal_values : (p*mu^2+b*(1-mu)^2)/2=c*(1-mu)^2/2) :
    p*mu-b*(1-mu)+c*(1-mu)=p*mu/(1-mu) := by
  apply (eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hmu))).mpr
  nlinarith only [equal_values]

#print axioms balanced_gap_identity
#print axioms actual_frozen_oracle_gap
#print axioms frozen_shift_at_design
#print axioms boundary_slope_jump
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenOracleGap

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6FrozenQuadraticBoundV1.lean (83 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenOracleGapV1»
import «LeanD6PhaseShiftLipschitzV1»
import «LeanD6FrozenAllocationFeasibleV1»

/-! Explicit quadratic oracle regret of the boundary-frozen phase-III design.
All-alternative feasibility is discharged, and the remainder constant is an
explicit function of the design margin and q, independent of sample size. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenOracleGap
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseShiftLipschitz CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def combinedModulus (q mu0 : ℝ) := shiftModulus q mu0+
    |mass q mu0*(q-2)/coefficient q (mass q mu0)|
def remainderConstant (q mu0 : ℝ) := coefficient q (mass q mu0)*(combinedModulus q mu0)^2/2

lemma modulus_nonnegative (q mu0 : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hm0 : 0 < mu0) :
    0 ≤ combinedModulus q mu0 := by
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have hd := radical_positive q mu0 hq hm0
  have ha : 0 ≤ q*(q-1) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hb : 0 ≤ q*(q-2) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  unfold combinedModulus shiftModulus radicalModulus
  positivity

lemma nuisance_displacement_bound (q mu mu0 eps : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hm : 0 < mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1) (hm0 : 0 < mu0) (hm01 : mu0 ≤ 1)
    (hc : coefficient q (mass q mu0) ≠ 0) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |mu-mu0| ≤ eps) :
    |shift q mu-delta q (mass q mu0) mu| ≤ combinedModulus q mu0*eps := by
  have hshift := shift_lipschitz q mu mu0 eps hq hm hm1 hm0 hm01 heps he
  have hanchor := frozen_shift_at_design q mu0 hq hm0 hm01 hc
  have hdiff : delta q (mass q mu0) mu0-delta q (mass q mu0) mu=
      (mass q mu0*(q-2)/coefficient q (mass q mu0))*(mu-mu0) := by unfold delta; ring
  have htriangle := abs_add_le (shift q mu-shift q mu0)
    (delta q (mass q mu0) mu0-delta q (mass q mu0) mu)
  rw [hanchor] at htriangle
  have heq : shift q mu-shift q mu0+(shift q mu0-delta q (mass q mu0) mu)=
      shift q mu-delta q (mass q mu0) mu := by ring
  rw [heq] at htriangle
  have hsmall : |shift q mu0-delta q (mass q mu0) mu| ≤
      |mass q mu0*(q-2)/coefficient q (mass q mu0)| *eps := by
    rw [← hanchor,hdiff,abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (abs_nonneg _)
  unfold combinedModulus
  nlinarith only [htriangle,hshift,hsmall]

/-- All premises describe the actual phase interval, label cardinalities and
margin distance. No oracle-gap, alternative guard or statistical conclusion
appears among them. -/
theorem actual_frozen_quadratic_regret (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (q mu mu0 eps : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hmlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hmhi : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |mu-mu0| ≤ eps) :
    oracleRegret A j q mu (queries A j) (weights A j q (mass q mu0)) ≤
      remainderConstant q mu0*eps^2 := by
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hmlo hmhi
  have h0 := phase_shift_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hc := frozen_coefficients q (mass q mu0) hq hw.1 hw.2
  have hf := frozen_half_interval_conditions q (mass q mu0) mu hq hw.1 hw.2 hm.1 hm.2.1
  rw [actual_frozen_oracle_gap A j q (mass q mu0) mu hq hmlo hmhi hw.1
    (by linarith [hw.2]) hc.1 hj hA hB hf.1 hf.2.1 hf.2.2]
  have hd := nuisance_displacement_bound q mu mu0 eps hq (by linarith [hm.1]) hm.2.1
    (by linarith [h0.1]) h0.2.1 (ne_of_gt hc.1) heps he
  have hmod := modulus_nonnegative q mu0 hq (by linarith [h0.1])
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hmod heps)).mpr hd
  rw [sq_abs,mul_pow] at hs
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hc.1.le
  unfold remainderConstant
  nlinarith only [ht]

#print axioms nuisance_displacement_bound
#print axioms actual_frozen_quadratic_regret
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6FrozenScalarAllocationV1.lean (128 dong)
import «LeanD6PhaseThreeSharpV1»

/-! Exact value of a scalar-B / B-on allocation whose weight is frozen while
mu changes. Covers all actual hidden alternatives, not only nearest swaps.
The displayed guard and nuisance constraints are explicit algebraic checks. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def p (q w : ℝ) := (1-w)/q
def beta (q w : ℝ) := (1-w)*(q-1)*w/(q*coefficient q w)
def delta (q w mu : ℝ) := w*(q-2)*(1-mu)/coefficient q w
def value (q w mu : ℝ) := (p q w*mu^2+beta q w*(1-mu)^2)/2

theorem frozen_completed_square (q w mu u : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hc : coefficient q w ≠ 0) :
    mixedLoss q mu w 1 u=2*value q w mu+
      coefficient q w*(u-((1-mu)+delta q w mu))^2 := by
  unfold mixedLoss value p beta delta
  field_simp [hq,hc]
  unfold coefficient
  field_simp [hq]
  <;> ring

theorem frozen_all_distances_lower (q w mu d u : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) (hc : 0 < coefficient q w)
    (hd : d=1 ∨ 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q)
    (guard : beta q w*(1-mu)^2 ≤ p q w*mu^2) :
    2*value q w mu ≤ mixedLoss q mu w d u := by
  rcases hd with hd | hd
  · rw [hd,frozen_completed_square q w mu u (by linarith) (ne_of_gt hc)]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hc.le (sq_nonneg _))
  · have hp : 0 < q := by linarith
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2 := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ w*((1-mu)*(q-d-1)+(1-mu)*d-(q-d-1)*u)^2 := by positivity
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(d-2)*mu^2 := by positivity
    have hb : 2*value q w mu ≤ 2*(1-w)*mu^2/q := by
      calc
        2*value q w mu = p q w*mu^2+beta q w*(1-mu)^2 := by unfold value; ring
        _ ≤ 2*p q w*mu^2 := by linarith only [guard]
        _ = 2*(1-w)*mu^2/q := by unfold p; ring
    apply hb.trans
    unfold mixedLoss
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
    have he : ((1-w)*(d*mu^2+(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2)/q+
        w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2)*q=
        (1-w)*d*mu^2+(1-w)*(q-d)*(u-(1-mu))^2+
          q*w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hp]
      <;> ring
    rw [he]
    have h4 : 0 ≤ q*w*((1-mu)*(q-1)-(q-d-1)*u)^2 := by positivity
    nlinarith

/-- A literal one-swap world has distance exactly one. -/
lemma swapped_distance_one (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) : (A \ swapped A a b).card=1 := by
  have hbA := (others_not_mem A j b hb).1
  have hab : a ≠ b := by intro h; subst b; exact hbA ha
  have he : A \ swapped A a b={a} := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i=a
    · subst i
      simp [swapped,ha,hab]
    · by_cases hia : i ∈ A <;> simp [swapped,hi,hia]
  rw [he,card_singleton]

/-- The frozen design's actual infimum is a quadratic in mu. No optimality
claim is needed for the frozen allocation away from its design margin. -/
theorem frozen_actual_value (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) (hc : 0 < coefficient q w)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (guard : beta q w*(1-mu)^2 ≤ p q w*mu^2)
    (hnu0 : 0 ≤ mu-delta q w mu) (hnu1 : mu-delta q w mu ≤ 1) :
    allocationValue A j mu (queries A j) (weights A j q w)=value q w mu := by
  have ha0 : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ)<A.card by linarith))
  have hb0 : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ)<(others A j).card by linarith))
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := ha0
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hb0
  have had : Admissible A (swapped A a b) j (mu-delta q w mu) :=
    ⟨swapped_ne A j a b hb,swapped_card A j a b ha hb,
      swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,hnu0,hnu1⟩
  have hp := distribution A j q w (by linarith) hw hw1 hB
  have he := actual_phase_information A (swapped A a b) j q w mu (mu-delta q w mu)
    hj had.2.2.1 had.2.1 hB
  rw [swapped_distance_one A j a b ha hb,Nat.cast_one,
    frozen_completed_square q w mu (1-(mu-delta q w mu)) (by linarith) (ne_of_gt hc)] at he
  have hu : 1-(mu-delta q w mu)-((1-mu)+delta q w mu)=0 := by ring
  rw [hu,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0),mul_zero,add_zero] at he
  have hev : (∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu
      (mu-delta q w mu) e)=value q w mu := by linarith
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (allocationValue_le_actual A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-delta q w mu) _ _
      (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) had).trans_eq hev
  · apply le_csInf (s := valueSet A j mu (queries A j) (weights A j q w))
      ⟨_,swapped A a b,mu-delta q w mu,had,rfl⟩
    rintro v ⟨A',nu,h,rfl⟩
    have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q h.2.2.1 h.2.1 h.1 hB
    have hdN : 1 ≤ (A \ A').card := by exact_mod_cast hd.1
    have hcase : ((A \ A').card:ℝ)=1 ∨ 2 ≤ ((A \ A').card:ℝ) := by
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hdN with h | h
      · left; exact_mod_cast h.symm
      · right; exact_mod_cast h
    have hlow := frozen_all_distances_lower q w mu (A \ A').card (1-nu) hq hw hw1 hc hcase hd.2 guard
    rw [← actual_phase_information A A' j q w mu nu hj h.2.2.1 h.2.1 hB] at hlow
    linarith

/-- Exact local expansion, with a known nonnegative quadratic remainder when
0 <= w <= 1. Connecting this quadratic to the oracle derivative is separate. -/
theorem frozen_local_expansion (q w mu eps : ℝ) :
    value q w (mu+eps)=value q w mu+
      (p q w*mu-beta q w*(1-mu))*eps+(p q w+beta q w)*eps^2/2 := by
  unfold value
  ring

#print axioms frozen_completed_square
#print axioms frozen_all_distances_lower
#print axioms frozen_actual_value
#print axioms frozen_local_expansion
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6GaussianMixtureIntegralV1.lean (63 dong)
import «LeanD6ProfileStoppingGeometryV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Real
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp

/-! The expression used in the stopping boundary is the actual integral
against a standard Gaussian nuisance prior, including its normalizing factor. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianMixtureIntegral
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileStoppingGeometry
noncomputable section

theorem square_completion (c z v u : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    -u^2/2+quadraticScore c z v u =
      -c/2+z^2/(2*(1+v))-(1+v)*(u-z/(1+v))^2/2 := by
  have hn : 1+v ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold quadraticScore
  field_simp [hn]
  <;> ring

lemma prefactor (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹ =
      (Real.sqrt (1+v))⁻¹*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(1/(1+v))))⁻¹ := by
  have hvp : 0 < 1+v := by linarith
  have he : 2*Real.pi*(1/(1+v))=(2*Real.pi)/(1+v) := by ring
  rw [he,Real.sqrt_div (by positivity),inv_div]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hvp)]

lemma mixture_density_identity (c z v u : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 1 u*Real.exp (quadraticScore c z v u) =
      ((Real.sqrt (1+v))⁻¹*Real.exp (-c/2+z^2/(2*(1+v))))*
        gaussianPDFReal (z/(1+v)) (NNReal.mk (1/(1+v)) (by positivity)) u := by
  have hn : 1+v ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hexp : -(u-z/(1+v))^2/(2*(1/(1+v))) =
      -(1+v)*(u-z/(1+v))^2/2 := by
    field_simp [hn]
    <;> ring
  simp only [gaussianPDFReal,NNReal.coe_one,NNReal.coe_mk,mul_one,sub_zero]
  rw [mul_assoc,← Real.exp_add,square_completion c z v u hv,hexp,prefactor v hv]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg,Real.exp_add]
  ring

theorem gaussian_quadratic_integral (c z v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    (∫ u,Real.exp (quadraticScore c z v u) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      Real.exp (mixtureExpression c z v) := by
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num : (1:NNReal) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [mixture_density_identity c z v _ hv]
  rw [integral_const_mul,integral_gaussianPDFReal_eq_one]
  · rw [mul_one]
    have hh : Real.exp (-(Real.log (1+v)/2))=(Real.sqrt (1+v))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg,Real.exp_half,Real.exp_log (by linarith)]
    have he : mixtureExpression c z v=-(Real.log (1+v)/2)+(-c/2+z^2/(2*(1+v))) := by
      unfold mixtureExpression; ring
    rw [he,Real.exp_add (-(Real.log (1+v)/2)) (-c/2+z^2/(2*(1+v))),hh]
  · apply ne_of_gt
    change 0 < 1/(1+v)
    positivity

#print axioms square_completion
#print axioms mixture_density_identity
#print axioms gaussian_quadratic_integral
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianMixtureIntegral

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6GaussianOverlapV1.lean (118 dong)
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Real
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Lebesgue.Integral
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Continuous common-density risk and exact overlap of the actual unit-variance
Gaussian laws. No adaptive-transcript comparison or D6 oracle optimality is
assumed proved by this module. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap
open ProbabilityTheory MeasureTheory Set
noncomputable section

/-- The right tail of the actual standard Gaussian probability measure. -/
def standardTail (a : ℝ) : ℝ := (gaussianReal 0 1 (Ioi a)).toReal

lemma pdf_reflection (a x : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal a 1 x = gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 (-x) := by
  have h : -(x-a)^2/(2*(↑(1 : NNReal) : ℝ)) =
      -((-x)-(-a))^2/(2*(↑(1 : NNReal) : ℝ)) := by ring
  simp only [gaussianPDFReal,h]

lemma pdf_left_le_right {a x : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x ≤ gaussianPDFReal a 1 x := by
  unfold gaussianPDFReal
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
  · apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    norm_num
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha hx]
  · positivity

/-- The smaller Gaussian density is the density with mean -a at |x|. -/
theorem gaussian_min_density (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : ℝ) :
    min (gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x) (gaussianPDFReal a 1 x) =
      gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 |x| := by
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [min_eq_left (pdf_left_le_right ha hx),abs_of_nonneg hx]
  · have hx' : x < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hx
    have hle : gaussianPDFReal a 1 x ≤ gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x := by
      calc
        _ = gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 (-x) := pdf_reflection a x
        _ ≤ gaussianPDFReal a 1 (-x) := pdf_left_le_right ha (by linarith)
        _ = gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x := by simpa using pdf_reflection a (-x)
    rw [min_eq_right hle,abs_of_neg hx',pdf_reflection a x]

lemma shifted_half_mass (a : ℝ) :
    gaussianReal (-a) 1 (Ioi 0) = gaussianReal 0 1 (Ioi a) := by
  have hm := congrArg (fun μ : Measure ℝ => μ (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
    (gaussianReal_map_sub_const (μ := 0) (v := 1) a)
  rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Ioi] at hm
  have hp : (fun x : ℝ => x-a) ⁻¹' Ioi 0 = Ioi a := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage,mem_Ioi]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  simpa only [hp,zero_sub] using hm.symm

/-- Exact overlap, expressed using a probability tail rather than a formal symbol. -/
theorem gaussian_overlap (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∫ x, min (gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x) (gaussianPDFReal a 1 x)) =
      2 * standardTail a := by
  simp_rw [gaussian_min_density a ha]
  rw [integral_comp_abs]
  have hm := gaussianReal_apply_eq_integral (-a) (v := 1) (by norm_num) (Ioi 0)
  rw [shifted_half_mass] at hm
  have hi : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x :=
    integral_nonneg (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg (-a) 1)
  have ht := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hm
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hi] at ht
  exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => 2*t) ht.symm

/-- Continuous analogue of the finite common-part risk inequality. -/
theorem common_density_risk_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (pminus pplus lossminus lossplus : Ω → ℝ) (separation : ℝ)
    (hpm : Integrable pminus μ) (hpp : Integrable pplus μ)
    (hrm : Integrable (fun x => pminus x*lossminus x) μ)
    (hrp : Integrable (fun x => pplus x*lossplus x) μ)
    (pm : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pminus x) (pp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pplus x)
    (lm : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lossminus x) (lp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lossplus x)
    (sep : ∀ x, separation ≤ lossminus x+lossplus x) :
    separation*(∫ x, min (pminus x) (pplus x) ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ x, pminus x*lossminus x ∂μ)+(∫ x, pplus x*lossplus x ∂μ) := by
  rw [← integral_const_mul,← integral_add hrm hrp]
  apply integral_mono ((hpm.inf hpp).const_mul separation) (hrm.add hrp)
  intro x
  change separation*min (pminus x) (pplus x) ≤
    pminus x*lossminus x+pplus x*lossplus x
  have hmin : 0 ≤ min (pminus x) (pplus x) := le_min (pm x) (pp x)
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sep x) hmin
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left (pminus x) (pplus x)) (lm x)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right (pminus x) (pplus x)) (lp x)
  nlinarith

/-- A separated pair of nonnegative losses has Gaussian max-risk at least
separation times the exact standard Gaussian tail. -/
theorem gaussian_max_risk_lower (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (lossminus lossplus : ℝ → ℝ) (separation : ℝ)
    (hrm : Integrable (fun x => gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*lossminus x))
    (hrp : Integrable (fun x => gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*lossplus x))
    (lm : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lossminus x) (lp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ lossplus x)
    (sep : ∀ x, separation ≤ lossminus x+lossplus x) :
    separation*standardTail a ≤
      max (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*lossminus x)
        (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*lossplus x) := by
  have hb := common_density_risk_lower volume (gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1)
    (gaussianPDFReal a 1) lossminus lossplus separation
    (integrable_gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1) (integrable_gaussianPDFReal a 1)
    hrm hrp (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg (-a) 1) (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg a 1) lm lp sep
  rw [gaussian_overlap a ha] at hb
  have hm := le_max_left (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*lossminus x)
    (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*lossplus x)
  have hp := le_max_right (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal (-a) 1 x*lossminus x)
    (∫ x, gaussianPDFReal a 1 x*lossplus x)
  linarith

#print axioms gaussian_min_density
#print axioms gaussian_overlap
#print axioms common_density_risk_lower
#print axioms gaussian_max_risk_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6GaussianQueryDominanceV1.lean (135 dong)
import «LeanD6PhaseTestingInformationV1»
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Real

/-! The known-A Gaussian experiment generated by B-off dominates every legal
D6 query. The simulator is independent of the margin. This is an equality of
actual probability laws for one query with fresh independent Gaussian noise.
No adaptive-transcript or stopping-time theorem is asserted here. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseTestingInformation
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def actualMean (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) : Measurement n → ℝ
  | .inl i => productResponse corner (world A j mu) i true
  | .inr (G,h) => world A j mu (query G j h)

def meanSlope (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Measurement n → ℝ
  | .inl i => if i ∈ A then 0 else if i=j then 1 else -1
  | .inr (G,h) => -(((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)

def meanOffset (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Measurement n → ℝ
  | .inl i => if i ∈ A then 1 else if i=j then -1 else 1
  | .inr (G,h) => (if h then 0 else 1)+(((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)

/-- Actual construction means, not hypothetical regression coefficients. -/
theorem actual_mean_affine (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (q mu : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    actualMean A j mu e = meanOffset A j e+meanSlope A j e*mu := by
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    dsimp [actualMean,meanOffset,meanSlope]
    rw [world_response A j hj]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ A
    · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,bit_true]
    · by_cases hij : i=j
      · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hj,hij,bit_true]
        <;> ring
      · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,hij,bit_true]
        <;> ring
  | inr p =>
    dsimp [actualMean,meanOffset,meanSlope]
    rw [actual_query_mean A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2]
    ring

theorem actual_mean_slope_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    (meanSlope A j e)^2 ≤ q^2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => dsimp [meanSlope]; split_ifs <;> nlinarith
  | inr p =>
    dsimp [meanSlope]
    rw [neg_sq]
    exact joint_sensitivity_bound A p.1 j p.2 q hq he.2.1

theorem B_off_mean (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) (mu : ℝ) :
    actualMean A j mu (.inr (others A j,false))=1+q-q*mu := by
  rw [actual_mean_affine A j hj q mu _ (B_off_attains A j q hq hj hB mu mu).1]
  simp only [meanOffset,meanSlope,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,inter_self,bit_false,sub_zero,hB]
  ring

/-- A fresh independent standard Gaussian fills exactly the missing variance. -/
theorem gaussian_garbling {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    {X Z : Ω → ℝ} (v c d : ℝ) (hc : c^2 ≤ 1)
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianReal v 1) P)
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianReal 0 1) P) (hXZ : IndepFun X Z P) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => c*X ω+Real.sqrt (1-c^2)*Z ω+d)
      (gaussianReal (c*v+d) 1) P := by
  let s := Real.sqrt (1-c^2)
  have hs : s^2=1-c^2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hX' := gaussianReal_const_mul hX c
  have hZ' := gaussianReal_const_mul hZ s
  have hi : IndepFun (fun ω => c*X ω) (fun ω => s*Z ω) P := by
    exact hXZ.comp (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hv : NNReal.mk (c^2) (sq_nonneg c)*1+
      NNReal.mk (s^2) (sq_nonneg s)*1=1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change c^2*1+s^2*1=(1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  have hsum : HasLaw (fun ω => c*X ω+s*Z ω) (gaussianReal (c*v) 1) P := by
    refine ⟨hX'.aemeasurable.add hZ'.aemeasurable,?_⟩
    have hh := gaussianReal_add_gaussianReal_of_indepFun hi hX' hZ'
    have hfun : ((fun ω => c*X ω) + (fun ω => s*Z ω)) =
        (fun ω => c*X ω+s*Z ω) := by
      funext ω
      rfl
    rw [hfun] at hh
    simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero,hv] using hh
  exact gaussianReal_add_const hsum d

/-- Coefficients of the query simulator depend on A, j, q and the requested
query, and do not depend on the unknown margin. -/
def simulate (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (e : Measurement n)
    (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (-(meanSlope A j e/q))*x+
    Real.sqrt (1-(-(meanSlope A j e/q))^2)*z+
      (meanOffset A j e+(meanSlope A j e/q)*(1+q))

/-- One B-off observation plus independent Gaussian randomization reproduces
exactly the Gaussian law of any actual legal query, simultaneously for all mu. -/
theorem actual_query_gaussian_dominance {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {P : Measure Ω} {X Z : Ω → ℝ} (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) (mu : ℝ)
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu (.inr (others A j,false))) 1) P)
    (hZ : HasLaw Z (gaussianReal 0 1) P) (hXZ : IndepFun X Z P) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => simulate A j q e (X ω) (Z ω))
      (gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu e) 1) P := by
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hqpos
  have hb := actual_mean_slope_bound A j q (by linarith) e he
  have hc : (-(meanSlope A j e/q))^2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [neg_sq,div_pow]
    exact (div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hqpos)).mpr hb
  rw [B_off_mean A j q hq hj hB mu] at hX
  have hh := gaussian_garbling (1+q-q*mu) (-(meanSlope A j e/q))
    (meanOffset A j e+(meanSlope A j e/q)*(1+q)) hc hX hZ hXZ
  have hm : -(meanSlope A j e/q)*(1+q-q*mu)+
      (meanOffset A j e+(meanSlope A j e/q)*(1+q)) = actualMean A j mu e := by
    rw [actual_mean_affine A j hj q mu e he]
    field_simp [hqne]
    ring
  rw [hm] at hh
  exact hh

#print axioms actual_mean_affine
#print axioms actual_mean_slope_bound
#print axioms B_off_mean
#print axioms gaussian_garbling
#print axioms actual_query_gaussian_dominance
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6GeometricRealizationV1.lean (105 dong)
import «LeanD6ThresholdConstructionV1»

/-! Literal support sets in a fixed real coordinate space. The coordinate
functions are projections, independent of A. Only the support set changes.
The interaction coordinate `none` is always omitted from feasible selections. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
variable {n : ℕ}

noncomputable def supportSet (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) :
    Finset (Option (I n) → ℝ) := Finset.univ.image (supportPoint F Q)

abbrev Geometry (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) :=
  {z // z ∈ supportSet F Q}

noncomputable def embed (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (x : I n → Bool) : Geometry F Q :=
  ⟨supportPoint F Q x, mem_image.mpr ⟨x, mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩

instance (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) : Nonempty (Geometry F Q) :=
  ⟨embed F Q zero⟩

/-- The same ambient linear projection is used for every possible support. -/
def projection (i : Option (I n)) (z : Option (I n) → ℝ) : ℝ := z i

def restrictedProjection (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (i : Option (I n)) (z : Geometry F Q) : ℝ := projection i z.val

theorem embed_surjective (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) :
    Function.Surjective (embed F Q) := by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := mem_image.mp hz
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hx

theorem osc_pullback {Ω Θ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] [Fintype Θ] [Nonempty Θ]
    (f : Θ → ℝ) (g : Ω → Θ) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    osc (fun x => f (g x)) = osc f := by
  have hmax : maxVal (fun x => f (g x)) = maxVal f := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact maxVal_le _ (fun x => le_maxVal f (g x))
    · apply maxVal_le
      intro y
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg y
      exact le_maxVal (fun x => f (g x)) x
  have hmin : minVal (fun x => f (g x)) = minVal f := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply le_minVal
      intro y
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg y
      exact minVal_le (fun x => f (g x)) x
    · exact le_minVal _ (fun x => minVal_le f (g x))
  simp [osc, hmax, hmin]

/-- The old loss is the radius on an actual finite subset of real space,
using fixed ambient coordinate functions. Repeated indexed states are removed
by taking an image; surjectivity proves this does not change any extrema. -/
theorem actual_geometric_radius (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (I n)) :
    selectedRadius (restrictedProjection F Q) (liftedSelection S) =
      productCompressionLoss F Q S := by
  rw [← actual_support_bridge F Q S]
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc
  congr 1
  rw [← osc_pullback (sumComponent (liftedSelection S)ᶜ (restrictedProjection F Q))
    (embed F Q) (embed_surjective F Q)]
  rfl

/-- In the indistinguishable D6 family, projection to all observed coordinates
has exactly the same geometric image; only the omitted coordinate varies. -/
theorem observed_support_image (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') :
    (supportSet (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0))).image
      (fun z => fun i : I n => z (some i)) =
    (supportSet (world A' j 0) (productResponse corner (world A' j 0))).image
      (fun z => fun i : I n => z (some i)) := by
  classical
  simp only [supportSet, image_image]
  congr 1
  funext x i
  exact support_observed_coordinates_equal A A' j hj hj' x i


/-- Same randomized information lower bound, now for literal support geometry
and fixed ambient projections, with the original cardinality constraint. -/
theorem geometric_randomized_lower (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (p : Finset (I (2*r+1)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ S ∈ actions r, 0 ≤ p S) (hnorm : ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S = 1) :
    ∃ A ∈ worlds r j,
      (r : ℝ)*(r+1)/(2*r+1) ≤ ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S *
        (selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j 0)
          (productResponse corner (world A j 0))) (liftedSelection S) -
         selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j 0)
          (productResponse corner (world A j 0))) (liftedSelection Aᶜ)) := by
  simp_rw [actual_geometric_radius]
  exact randomized_actual_lower r j hr p hp hnorm

#print axioms actual_geometric_radius
#print axioms observed_support_image
#print axioms geometric_randomized_lower
end CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry

import «LeanD6UniformPhaseThreeRemainderV1»

/-! A quantitative version of the compactness bound: for q>=8 the existing
explicit phase-III remainder is at most 64/q^2. This is an upper bound, not a
claim that 64 is sharp. It permits growing-q use without an unspecified C(q). -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6GrowingPhaseThreeRemainder
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseShiftLipschitz CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder
noncomputable section

lemma K_bounds (q : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) : q^3/2 ≤ K q ∧ 4*q^2 ≤ K q ∧ K q ≤ q^3 := by
  have h := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-8 by linarith) (sq_nonneg q)
  unfold K
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q-1)]

lemma radical_ge_q (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) : q ≤ D q mu := by
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hk := K_bounds q hq
  have hd := radical_positive q mu (by linarith) (by linarith [hb.1])
  have hs := radical_square q mu (by linarith)
  have hp : 0 ≤ q*(q-1)*(1-mu)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hx : 0 ≤ K q*(mu^2-1/4) := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hk.2.1]) (by nlinarith [hb.1])
  unfold radicand at hs
  nlinarith

lemma shift_modulus_scaled (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    q*shiftModulus q mu ≤ 6 := by
  have hk := K_bounds q hq
  have hkp := K_pos q (by linarith)
  have hd := radical_ge_q q mu hq hm
  have hrad : radicalModulus q mu ≤ 2*q^2+2*q := by
    unfold radicalModulus
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < D q mu)).mpr
    have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (show 0 ≤ 2*q^2+2*q by positivity)
    nlinarith [hk.2.2]
  unfold shiftModulus
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hkp).mpr
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
  nlinarith [hk.1]

lemma mass_scaled (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    mass q mu*(q-2)^2 ≤ 1 := by
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hk := K_bounds q hq
  have he := rationalized_shift q mu (by linarith) (by linarith [hb.1]) hb.2.1
  have hd := radical_positive q mu (by linarith) (by linarith [hb.1])
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.2.2.2 (show 0 ≤ q*(q-2) from mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have hp : (q-1)*(q-2)^2+K q ≤ 4*q^2*(q-2) := by
    have h := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q-8 by linarith) (sq_nonneg q)
    nlinarith [hk.2.2,sq_nonneg (q-2)]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hb.2.2.1
  unfold mass
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
  nlinarith [he,ht,hh]

lemma coefficient_le_two (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    coefficient q (mass q mu) ≤ 2 := by
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hh := mass_scaled q mu hq hm
  have hs : (1-mass q mu)*(q-1)/q ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < q)).mpr
    have hn := mul_nonneg hw.1 (show 0 ≤ q-1 by linarith)
    nlinarith
  unfold coefficient
  linarith

lemma combined_modulus_scaled (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    q*combinedModulus q mu ≤ 8 := by
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hc := frozen_coefficients q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hw.1 hw.2
  have hs := shift_modulus_scaled q mu hq hm
  have hp : mass q mu*(q-2)^2 ≤ coefficient q (mass q mu) := by
    unfold coefficient
    have hh : 0 ≤ (1-mass q mu)*(q-1)/q := by
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith [hw.2]) (by linarith)) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have he : q*(mass q mu*(q-2)/coefficient q (mass q mu)) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hc.1).mpr
    have hn := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw.1 (show 0 ≤ q-2 by linarith)) (show 0 ≤ q-4 by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hn : 0 ≤ mass q mu*(q-2)/coefficient q (mass q mu) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw.1 (by linarith)) hc.1.le
  unfold combinedModulus
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hn]
  linarith

/-- Uniform in both q>=8 and the entire phase-III design interval. -/
theorem remainder_scaled (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    remainderConstant q mu ≤ 64/q^2 := by
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hmod := modulus_nonnegative q mu (by linarith) (by linarith [hb.1])
  have hscaled := combined_modulus_scaled q mu hq hm
  have hcoeff := coefficient_le_two q mu hq hm
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu (by linarith) hm.1 hm.2
  have hc := (frozen_coefficients q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hw.1 hw.2).1
  have hs : (q*combinedModulus q mu)^2 ≤ 64 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ q*combinedModulus q mu := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hc.le
  unfold remainderConstant
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < q^2)).mpr
  rw [mul_pow] at ht
  nlinarith

#print axioms K_bounds
#print axioms radical_ge_q
#print axioms shift_modulus_scaled
#print axioms mass_scaled
#print axioms coefficient_le_two
#print axioms combined_modulus_scaled
#print axioms remainder_scaled
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6GrowingPhaseThreeRemainder

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6GrowingUnknownLabelPhaseRiskV1.lean (148 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualUnknownLabelPhaseRiskV1»
