/-!
# Safe local reductions for D6 centered interaction profiles

These lemmas deliberately stop at context-local contrast identities.  Equal
interaction profiles do *not* make two actions globally interchangeable:
their product-response values can still differ, and downstream selection can
therefore still change.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfileReduction

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- If two actions have the same centered interaction profile, their raw
local contrast is exactly the (context-independent) first-order response
contrast. -/
theorem identical_profiles_local_contrast {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (hProfile : ∀ z,
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v z)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i v) =
      productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i v := by
  have hz := hProfile z
  unfold interactionContrastProfile at hz
  linarith

/-- A two-level local interaction representation.  It says only that every
action can be replaced by one of two profile representatives *inside the
centered interaction term*; it deliberately preserves its own response
offset through `identical_profiles_local_contrast`. -/
def HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : U, ∀ u,
    (∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 a z) ∨
    (∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 b z)

theorem two_profile_level_local_representative {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hTwo : HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles q F i u0)
    (u : U) :
    ∃ r : U, ∀ z,
      F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i r) =
        productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i r := by
  rcases hTwo with ⟨a, b, hTwo⟩
  rcases hTwo u with hua | hub
  · exact ⟨a, identical_profiles_local_contrast q F i u0 u a hua⟩
  · exact ⟨b, identical_profiles_local_contrast q F i u0 u b hub⟩

/-- The already-proved rank-one factorization is exposed under a local
reduction name for downstream proof discovery. -/
theorem collinear_profiles_factor_all_cycles {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ), lambda u0 = 0 ∧ ∀ u v x c,
      cycleFunctional i (Function.update x i u) (Function.update c i v) F =
        (lambda u - lambda v) * (h x - h c) := by
  exact interactionContrastRankOne_cycle_factorization q F i u0 hRank

end CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfileReduction

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6InteractionContrastProfileV1.lean (154 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6CycleDual»

/-!
# Centered local interaction contrast profiles for D6

This module uses the existing product-response semantics verbatim.  A profile
is the local action contrast after subtracting its product-reference
first-order contrast.  It is intentionally a function of a full world state:
the distinguished coordinate is overwritten, so its value depends only on the
complement context extensionally.

No decision bound is claimed here.  The purpose is to identify exactly what
D6 mixed differences measure after first-order centering.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- The local contrast for action `u`, centered against anchor action `u0`
and against the same product-response contrast. -/
noncomputable def interactionContrastProfile {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  (F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i u0)) -
    (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0)

/-- Coordinate-additive worlds are the D6 gauge directions. -/
noncomputable def coordinateAdditiveWorld {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  (∑ j, g j (z j)) + b

theorem interactionContrastProfile_anchor {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 z = 0 := by
  simp [interactionContrastProfile]

private theorem coordinateAdditiveWorld_update_difference {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u v : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    coordinateAdditiveWorld g b (Function.update z i u) -
      coordinateAdditiveWorld g b (Function.update z i v) =
      g i u - g i v := by
  classical
  unfold coordinateAdditiveWorld
  have hsum :
      (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), g j ((Function.update z i u) j)) -
        (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), g j ((Function.update z i v) j)) =
          g i u - g i v := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [Function.update]
    · intro j _ hji
      simp [Function.update, hji]
    · simp
  linarith

private theorem productResponse_coordinateAdditive_difference {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u v : U) :
    productResponse q (coordinateAdditiveWorld g b) i u -
      productResponse q (coordinateAdditiveWorld g b) i v =
      g i u - g i v := by
  classical
  unfold productResponse productExpectation
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hterm : ∀ c : Fin (n + 1) → U,
      jointWeight q c *
          coordinateAdditiveWorld g b (Function.update c i u) -
        jointWeight q c *
          coordinateAdditiveWorld g b (Function.update c i v) =
        jointWeight q c * (g i u - g i v) := by
    intro c
    rw [← mul_sub]
    rw [coordinateAdditiveWorld_update_difference]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hNorm, one_mul]

theorem interactionContrastProfile_coordinateAdditive_invariant {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    interactionContrastProfile q
      (fun x ↦ F x + coordinateAdditiveWorld g b x) i u0 u z =
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  have hResponse : ∀ a : U,
      productResponse q (fun x ↦ F x + coordinateAdditiveWorld g b x) i a =
        productResponse q F i a +
          productResponse q (coordinateAdditiveWorld g b) i a := by
    intro a
    unfold productResponse productExpectation
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    ring
  rw [hResponse u, hResponse u0]
  have hLocal := coordinateAdditiveWorld_update_difference g b i u u0 z
  have hMean := productResponse_coordinateAdditive_difference q g b hNorm i u u0
  linarith

/-- Context variation of centered local contrasts is exactly the existing D6
mixed difference, with an explicit orientation. -/
theorem interactionContrastProfile_cycle_identity {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u x -
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v x) -
      (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u c -
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v c) =
      mixedDifference F i (Function.update x i u) (Function.update c i v) := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile mixedDifference
  simp [Function.update]
  ring

/-- A unit/delta mixed-difference bound controls every two-context change of
every centered local action contrast.  This is the strongest direct relation
that does not introduce an additional finite `sSup` API. -/
theorem interactionContrastProfile_two_context_bound {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (delta : ℝ)
    (hdelta : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    |(interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u x -
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v x) -
      (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u c -
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v c)| ≤ delta := by
  rw [interactionContrastProfile_cycle_identity]
  exact hdelta i (Function.update x i u) (Function.update c i v)

end CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneMinorsV1.lean (96 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneV1»

/-!
# Exact minor characterization of D6 interaction-contrast rank one

This is the semantic bridge for the B3 raw-world optimizer.  The optimizer
constrains every centred-profile `2 x 2` minor; this file proves that those
constraints are exactly the existing factorization predicate, including the
all-zero-profile degeneracy.

It deliberately proves no decision or half-factor bound.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOneMinors

open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

def AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u v : U) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U),
    interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u x *
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v y -
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u y *
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v x = 0

theorem interactionContrastRankOne_implies_all_minors_zero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q F i u0 := by
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, -, hProfile⟩
  intro u v x y
  rw [hProfile u x, hProfile v y, hProfile u y, hProfile v x]
  ring

theorem all_minors_zero_implies_interactionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hMinor : AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q F i u0) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hNonzero : ∃ (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z ≠ 0
  · rcases hNonzero with ⟨uStar, zStar, hStar⟩
    let h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ :=
      fun z ↦ interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar z
    let lambda : U → ℝ :=
      fun u ↦ interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u zStar /
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar zStar
    refine ⟨h, lambda, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show lambda u0 =
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 zStar /
            interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar zStar by rfl,
        interactionContrastProfile_anchor]
      simp
    · intro u z
      have hEq := hMinor u uStar z zStar
      change interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
        (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u zStar /
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar zStar) *
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar z
      calc
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
            (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u zStar *
              interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar z) /
              interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar zStar := by
                apply (eq_div_iff hStar).2
                linarith
        _ = (interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u zStar /
              interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar zStar) *
              interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 uStar z := by ring
  · refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ ↦ 0, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro u z
    have hZero : interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hNonzero ⟨u, z, h⟩
    simp [hZero]

theorem interactionContrastRankOne_iff_all_minors_zero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 ↔
      AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q F i u0 := by
  exact ⟨interactionContrastRankOne_implies_all_minors_zero q F i u0,
    all_minors_zero_implies_interactionContrastRankOne q F i u0⟩

end CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOneMinors

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneV1.lean (90 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastProfileV1»

/-!
# Rank-one centered interaction contrast profiles

The predicate here is deliberately factorization-based rather than a matrix
rank construction.  It says exactly that all local action profiles at one
coordinate are collinear as functions of the complement context.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

def InteractionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
    lambda u0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ u z,
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = lambda u * h z

noncomputable def canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor : U :=
  Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty U)

def AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, InteractionContrastRankOne q F i canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor

theorem binary_interactionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i 0 := by
  let h : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ :=
    fun z ↦ interactionContrastProfile q F i 0 1 z
  let lambda : Fin 2 → ℝ := fun u ↦ if u = 1 then 1 else 0
  refine ⟨h, lambda, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [lambda]
  · intro u z
    fin_cases u
    · simp [h, lambda, interactionContrastProfile_anchor]
    · simp [h, lambda]

theorem interactionContrastRankOne_cycle_factorization {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
      lambda u0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ (u v : U) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
        cycleFunctional i (Function.update x i u) (Function.update c i v) F =
          (lambda u - lambda v) * (h x - h c) := by
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, hProfile⟩
  refine ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u v x c
  rw [cycleFunctional_eq_mixedDifference,
    ← interactionContrastProfile_cycle_identity]
  rw [hProfile u x, hProfile v x, hProfile u c, hProfile v c]
  ring

/-- A nonzero `2 × 2` determinant of profile values is an exact obstruction
to rank one.  It supplies finite rational witnesses without matrix-rank API. -/
theorem interactionContrastProfile_determinant_obstruction {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hdet :
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u x *
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v y -
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u y *
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v x ≠ 0) :
    ¬ InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 := by
  intro hRank
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, _, hProfile⟩
  apply hdet
  rw [hProfile u x, hProfile v y, hProfile u y, hProfile v x]
  ring

end CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6KnownLabelMatchingRiskV1.lean (153 dong)
import «LeanD6LocalMatchingDesignV1»
import «LeanGaussianThresholdRiskV1»

/-! Constructive finite-epsilon matching upper bound with known A: take N
actual B-off samples, center them, and choose the two boundary allocations
by the sign of their sum. A fixed boundary design is used on the plus side.
No estimate of the magnitude epsilon is required by this recommendation. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6KnownLabelMatchingRisk
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open CIGAMF.P13.AdaptiveTranscriptKernel CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianOverlap
open CIGAMF.P13.GaussianThresholdDecision CIGAMF.P13.GaussianThresholdRisk
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingAlgebra
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingDesign
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {n : ℕ}

def minusRisk (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, if choosePlus N x then rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0-eps) else leftRegret A j q (mu0-eps)
    ∂resource (gaussianReal (-(q*eps)) 1) N ()
def plusRisk (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, if choosePlus N x then rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) else leftRegret A j q (mu0+eps)
    ∂resource (gaussianReal (q*eps) 1) N ()

/-- Explicit upper bound with the same leading constant as the adaptive
lower bound, plus a displayed second-order constant. -/
theorem constructive_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu0)) (hmI : Interior q (1-(mu0-eps)))
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (hplushi : mu0+eps ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hminus : 1/2 ≤ mu0-eps) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    max (minusRisk A j q mu0 eps N) (plusRisk A j q mu0 eps N) ≤
      localJump q mu0*eps*standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N)+
        (remainderConstant q mu0+|localCurvature q mu0|)*eps^2 := by
  have h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q := by linarith
  have hpluslo : marginMax q ≤ mu0+eps := by linarith
  have h0 := phase_shift_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hplus := phase_shift_bounds q (mu0+eps) hq hpluslo hplushi
  have h0lt : mu0 < 1 := by linarith [(D6PhaseThreeDual.phase_nuisance q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi).1]
  have hplt : mu0+eps < 1 := by
    linarith [(D6PhaseThreeDual.phase_nuisance q (mu0+eps) hq hpluslo hplushi).1]
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hc := frozen_coefficients q (mass q mu0) hq hw.1 hw.2
  have hboundary := boundary_equality A j q mu0 hq hI h0lo h0hi hj hA hB
  have hJ := jump_positive (p q (mass q mu0)) (D6FrozenScalarAllocation.beta q (mass q mu0)) (leftCoefficient q) mu0
    hc.2.1 (by linarith [h0.1]) h0lt hboundary
  have hcoef := hc.1
  have hM : 0 ≤ remainderConstant q mu0 := by unfold remainderConstant; positivity
  have ht : 0 ≤ standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N) := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have ht1 : standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N) ≤ 1 := measureReal_le_one
  have hm := minus_right_loss A j q mu0 (mu0-eps) hq hmI h0lo h0hi hminus
    (by linarith) hj hA hB
  have hright : rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) ≤ remainderConstant q mu0*eps^2 := by
    apply actual_frozen_quadratic_regret A j q (mu0+eps) mu0 eps hq hpluslo hplushi
      h0lo h0hi hj hA hB heps
    simp [abs_of_nonneg heps]
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) := le_max_left _ _
  have hwrong := plus_left_loss A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) hq hpluslo hplushi h0lo h0hi hplt hj hA hB
  have halg := threshold_pair_upper (p q (mass q mu0)) (D6FrozenScalarAllocation.beta q (mass q mu0)) (leftCoefficient q)
    mu0 eps (standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N))
    (rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0-eps)) (rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0+eps))
    (leftRegret A j q (mu0+eps)) (remainderConstant q mu0)
    hboundary heps ht ht1 hJ.le hM hm hr0 hright hwrong
  unfold minusRisk plusRisk
  rw [minus_risk (q*eps) _ _ N hN,plus_risk (q*eps) _ _ N hN,
    left_regret_zero A j q (mu0-eps) hq hmI hj hA hB]
  simpa only [zero_add,sub_zero,localJump,localCurvature] using halg

/-- The exact lower-bound separation dominates J epsilon - epsilon squared.
Combining with the compiled transcript lower bound yields the matching
leading term for every adaptive algorithm. -/
theorem adaptive_separation_leading (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu0))
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (hplushi : mu0+eps ≤ marginHigh q) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    localJump q mu0*eps-eps^2 ≤
      rate q (1-(mu0-eps))+D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q (mu0+eps)-2*rate q (1-mu0)-eps^2 := by
  have h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q := by linarith
  have hpluslo : marginMax q ≤ mu0+eps := by linarith
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hc := frozen_coefficients q (mass q mu0) hq hw.1 hw.2
  have hb := boundary_equality A j q mu0 hq hI h0lo h0hi hj hA hB
  have hd := plus_oracle_decomposition A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) hq hpluslo hplushi h0lo h0hi hj hA hB
  have hr : 0 ≤ rightRegret A j q mu0 (mu0+eps) := le_max_left _ _
  have hg : frozenValue (p q (mass q mu0)) (D6FrozenScalarAllocation.beta q (mass q mu0)) (mu0+eps) ≤
      D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q (mu0+eps) := by linarith only [hd,hr]
  have hleft : 0 ≤ leftCoefficient q := by unfold leftCoefficient D6ExpandedAllocation.value; positivity
  have h := separation_lower (p q (mass q mu0)) (D6FrozenScalarAllocation.beta q (mass q mu0)) (leftCoefficient q)
    mu0 eps (D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q (mu0+eps)) hc.2.1.le hc.2.2.1 hleft hb hg
  simpa only [left_rate,localJump] using h

open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveTranscript CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret
variable {H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace H]

/-- The matching leading lower bound on the real adaptive transcript law.
The nuisance feasibility conditions are the same explicit local-neighborhood
conditions used in the co-moving adversary theorem. -/
theorem adaptive_lower_leading (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu0)) (hmI : Interior q (1-(mu0-eps)))
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (hplushi : mu0+eps ≤ marginHigh q) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hnulo : eps ≤ 1-(1-mu0)*(1+D6ExpandedAllocation.root q (D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q)))
    (hnuhi : eps ≤ (1-mu0)*(1+D6ExpandedAllocation.root q (D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q)))
    (initial : Kernel Unit H) [IsMarkovKernel initial]
    (policy : ℕ → H → Measurement n) (legal : ∀ t h,Legal j q (policy t h))
    (ha : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => meanOffset A j (policy t h)))
    (hb : ∀ t,Measurable (fun h => meanSlope A j (policy t h)))
    (update : ℕ → H × ℝ → H) (hu : ∀ t,Measurable (update t))
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : H → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (feasible : ∀ h,Feasible j q E (w h))
    (hmLoss : Measurable (fun h => oracleRegret A j q (mu0-eps) E (w h)))
    (hpLoss : Measurable (fun h => oracleRegret A j q (mu0+eps) E (w h)))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ hm : ∀ mu t,Measurable (fun h => actualMean A j mu (policy t h)),
      localJump q mu0*eps*standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N)-eps^2 ≤
      max
        (∫ h,oracleRegret A j q (mu0-eps) E (w h) ∂trajectory initial
          (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j (mu0-eps) (policy t h))
            (hm (mu0-eps) t) (update t) (hu t)) N ())
        (∫ h,oracleRegret A j q (mu0+eps) E (w h) ∂trajectory initial
          (fun t => actualStep (fun h => actualMean A j (mu0+eps) (policy t h))
            (hm (mu0+eps) t) (update t) (hu t)) N ()) := by
  have hpLo : marginMax q ≤ mu0+eps := by linarith
  have hrate : (1-mu0)+eps=1-(mu0-eps) := by ring
  have hminus : Interior q ((1-mu0)+eps) := by rwa [hrate]
  obtain ⟨hm,hlower⟩ := adaptive_oracle_regret_lower A j q (1-mu0) eps hq hI hminus
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hpLo)
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hplushi) hj hA hB heps hnulo hnuhi
    initial policy legal ha hb update hu E w feasible
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hmLoss)
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hpLoss) N hN
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at hlower
  rw [hrate] at hlower
  refine ⟨hm,?_⟩
  apply le_trans ?_ hlower
  have hs := adaptive_separation_leading A j q mu0 eps hq hI h0lo hplushi heps hj hA hB
  have ht : 0 ≤ standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N) := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have ht1 : standardTail (q*eps*Real.sqrt N) ≤ 1 := measureReal_le_one
  have hst := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs ht
  have hcor := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1 (sq_nonneg eps)
  nlinarith only [hst,hcor]

#print axioms constructive_upper
#print axioms adaptive_separation_leading
#print axioms adaptive_lower_leading
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6KnownLabelMatchingRisk

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LabelDiscoveryInformationV1.lean (131 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! Information available for discovering the hidden label set. Adjacent
alternatives keep the same margin. This is an actual-world information budget
certificate. A sequential change-of-measure theorem is a separate probability
bridge; it is not silently assumed as part of this result. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LabelDiscoveryInformation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def twiceQueryCapacity (q mu : ℝ) := max (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2)

theorem same_margin_joint_point (A G : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (mu : ℝ) :
    2*queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu =
      (1-mu)^2*(hit G a-hit G b)^2 := by
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean (swapped A a b) G j h (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG,
    swapped_query_count A G j a b hj ha hb]
  ring

theorem same_margin_joint_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (mu : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu) ≤
      (A.card : ℝ)*(others A j).card*(1-mu)^2 := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  simp_rw [mul_sum]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ A,∑ _b ∈ others A j,(1-mu)^2 := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro a ha
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro b hb
      rw [same_margin_joint_point A G j a b h hj ha hb hjG hG]
      have hh : (hit G a-hit G b)^2 ≤ 1 := by unfold hit; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (sq_nonneg (1-mu))]
    _ = _ := by simp [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

theorem same_margin_scalar_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (mu : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i mu mu) =
      if i ∈ A then ((others A j).card : ℝ)*mu^2 else
        if i=j then 0 else (A.card : ℝ)*mu^2 := by
  have he := actual_scalar_margin_sum A j i hj (1-mu) 0
  simpa using he

/-- A single legal query has O(1/q) average adjacent-label information near
the allocation boundary, even though its margin information can be O(q^2). -/
theorem measurement_capacity (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) ≤
      q*(q+1)*twiceQueryCapacity q mu := by
  have hc1 := le_max_left (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2)
  have hc2 := le_max_right (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2)
  change mu^2/q ≤ twiceQueryCapacity q mu at hc1
  change (1-mu)^2 ≤ twiceQueryCapacity q mu at hc2
  have hnon : 0 ≤ twiceQueryCapacity q mu := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) hc2
  have hscalar : (q+1)*mu^2 ≤ q*(q+1)*twiceQueryCapacity q mu := by
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ hq).mp hc1
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith)
    nlinarith
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    change 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i mu mu) ≤ _
    rw [same_margin_scalar_sum A j i hj mu,hA,hB]
    split_ifs
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg mu]
    · positivity
    · exact hscalar
  | inr p =>
    have hb := same_margin_joint_bound A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2 mu
    rw [hA,hB] at hb
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc2 (show 0 ≤ q*(q+1) by positivity)
    change 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) p.1 j p.2 mu mu) ≤ _
    nlinarith

/-- Query counts may represent expectations, but this theorem assumes only
nonnegative real counts. It exposes the exact information-budget obligation
needed when attaching an adaptive stopping-time change of measure. -/
theorem discovery_budget (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu kappa : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (counts : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hc : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ counts e)
    (hneed : ∀ a ∈ A,∀ b ∈ others A j,
      kappa ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) :
    2*kappa ≤ twiceQueryCapacity q mu*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e) := by
  have hlower : (A.card : ℝ)*(others A j).card*kappa ≤
      ∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ E,counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _a ∈ A,∑ _b ∈ others A j,kappa := by simp [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum (fun a ha => sum_le_sum (fun b hb => hneed a ha b hb))
  have hreorder : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ E,
      counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e)=
      ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) := by
    simp_rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ A,∑ e ∈ E,∑ b ∈ others A j,
          counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha; exact sum_comm
      _ = _ := sum_comm
  rw [hreorder,hA,hB] at hlower
  have hupper : 2*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e)) ≤
      q*(q+1)*twiceQueryCapacity q mu*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(q*(q+1)*twiceQueryCapacity q mu) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_capacity A j q mu hq hj hA hB e (hl e he)) (hc e he)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring
  have hp : 0 < q*(q+1) := by positivity
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := q*(q+1)) ?_ hp
  nlinarith [hlower,hupper]

#print axioms same_margin_joint_point
#print axioms same_margin_joint_bound
#print axioms same_margin_scalar_sum
#print axioms measurement_capacity
#print axioms discovery_budget
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LabelDiscoveryInformation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LabelInformationV1.lean (139 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! Information for discovering the hidden set at a fixed true margin.
The adjacent average is bounded for every legal query. The final counting
corollary exposes its information-demand premise; it does not assume that
allocation learning must identify A exactly. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LabelInformation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def capacityTwice (q mu : ℝ) := max (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2)

theorem fixed_margin_joint_sum (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu) =
      (1-mu)^2*(q*(G ∩ A).card+(q+1)*(G ∩ others A j).card-
        2*(G ∩ A).card*(G ∩ others A j).card) := by
  have hm : 1-(1-mu)*1=mu := by ring
  have hm' : 1-(1-mu)=mu := by ring
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu) =
      4*(1-mu)^2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1/2)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
    have hh := joint_homogeneity A (swapped A a b) G j h hj
      (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG (1-mu) 1
    norm_num only [hm,hm'] at hh
    exact hh
  have hd := actual_dual_sum A G j h q 0 hj hA hB hjG hG
  norm_num only at hd
  unfold dual at hd
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0),mul_zero,zero_mul,zero_add,
    sub_zero,add_zero,one_pow,one_mul] at hd
  rw [he]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (1-mu)^2*x) hd]

theorem measurement_average_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) ≤
      q*(q+1)*capacityTwice q mu := by
  have hcapA := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2))
    (show 0 ≤ q*(q+1) by positivity)
  have hcapB := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right (mu^2/q) ((1-mu)^2))
    (show 0 ≤ q*(q+1) by positivity)
  have hid : q*(q+1)*(mu^2/q)=(q+1)*mu^2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hq]
  rw [hid] at hcapA
  change (q+1)*mu^2 ≤ q*(q+1)*capacityTwice q mu at hcapA
  change q*(q+1)*(1-mu)^2 ≤ q*(q+1)*capacityTwice q mu at hcapB
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    change 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i mu mu) ≤ _
    have hs := actual_scalar_margin_sum A j i hj (1-mu) 0
    have hm : 1-(1-mu)=mu := by ring
    simp only [add_zero,mul_one,hm,hA,hB,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0),
      mul_zero,add_zero] at hs
    rw [hs]
    split_ifs
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg mu]
    · have hc : 0 ≤ capacityTwice q mu := le_trans (sq_nonneg (1-mu)) (le_max_right _ _)
      positivity
    · exact hcapA
  | inr p =>
    change 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) p.1 j p.2 mu mu) ≤ _
    rw [fixed_margin_joint_sum A p.1 j p.2 q mu hj hA hB he.1 he.2.2]
    have hc : ((p.1 ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(p.1 ∩ others A j).card ≤ q := by
      have hh : ((p.1 ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(p.1 ∩ others A j).card=p.1.card := by
        exact_mod_cast query_count_partition A p.1 j he.1
      linarith [he.2.1]
    have hs : 0 ≤ ((p.1 ∩ A).card : ℝ) := by positivity
    have ht : 0 ≤ ((p.1 ∩ others A j).card : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hb : q*(p.1 ∩ A).card+(q+1)*(p.1 ∩ others A j).card-
        2*(p.1 ∩ A).card*(p.1 ∩ others A j).card ≤ q*(q+1) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs ht]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg (1-mu))
    nlinarith [hh,hcapB]

/-- Deterministic information accounting. To apply it to an adaptive stopped
experiment, a change-of-measure theorem must supply `demand` for the expected
counts. That probabilistic premise is intentionally explicit. -/
theorem cost_from_information_demand (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu k : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (counts : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hc : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ counts e)
    (demand : ∀ a ∈ A,∀ b ∈ others A j,
      k ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) :
    2*k ≤ capacityTwice q mu*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e) := by
  have hlow : q*(q+1)*k ≤
      ∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ E,
        counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e := by
    have hh : (∑ _a ∈ A,∑ _b ∈ others A j,k) ≤
        ∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ E,
          counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e := by
      apply sum_le_sum; intro a ha
      apply sum_le_sum; intro b hb
      exact demand a ha b hb
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hA,hB] at hh
    nlinarith [hh]
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ E,
      counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) =
      ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e) := by
    simp_rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ A,∑ e ∈ E,∑ b ∈ others A j,
          counts e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha; exact sum_comm
      _ = _ := sum_comm
  rw [he] at hlow
  have hhigh : 2*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j mu mu e)) ≤
      q*(q+1)*capacityTwice q mu*(∑ e ∈ E,counts e) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,counts e*(q*(q+1)*capacityTwice q mu) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_average_bound A j q mu hq hj hA hB e (hl e he)) (hc e he)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul]; ring
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := q*(q+1)) ?_ (by positivity)
  nlinarith [hlow,hhigh]

#print axioms fixed_margin_joint_sum
#print axioms measurement_average_bound
#print axioms cost_from_information_demand
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LabelInformation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LocalCurvatureLimitV1.lean (205 dong)
import «LeanD6GrowingPhaseThreeRemainderV1»
import «LeanD6LocalMatchingDesignV1»

/-! # The local curvature does not vanish with q

`LeanD6GrowingPhaseThreeRemainderV1.remainder_scaled` bounds the frozen
remainder constant by `64/q^2`.  The matching-risk bounds of
`LeanD6KnownLabelMatchingRiskV1` and `LeanD6ActualSampleMatchingV1` carry the
coefficient `remainderConstant q mu0 + |localCurvature q mu0|`, so it is
natural to look for a matching `O(1/q^2)` bound on the second summand.

There is none, and this module proves it.  On the phase-III interval

  `-(1/2) < localCurvature q mu <= -(1/2) + 2/q`   for every `q >= 8`,

the sandwich implies `|localCurvature q mu| -> 1/2` along admissible margins.
The matching coefficient is `Theta(1)`, squeezed into
`[1/2 - 2/q, 1/2 + 64/q^2]`. This does not obstruct growing-q matching:
the coefficient multiplies epsilon^2, which is O(q^-3) on the critical
epsilon=O(q^-3/2) scale, below the q^-2 target. The formal statements here
are the finite inequalities; asymptotic language describes their consequences.

The mechanism is a property of the design, not of the proof technique.  Both
frozen parameters vanish -- `p q w = (1-w)/q <= 1/q`, and `beta q w <= w` with
`w = mass q mu <= 1/(q-2)^2` -- while the left allocation's coefficient
`value q (scale q)` tends to one from below, because `scale q = sqrt(q/(q+1))`
tends to one.  The curvature difference `(p + beta - c)/2` inherits the gap.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalCurvatureLimit
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingAlgebra CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingDesign
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder CIGAMF.P13.D6GrowingPhaseThreeRemainder
noncomputable section
variable {q mu : ℝ}

/-! ## The left allocation's coefficient tends to one -/

lemma scale_pos (hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ q) : 0 < D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q := by
  unfold D6ExpandedAllocation.scale
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))

lemma scale_lt_one (hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ q) : D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q < 1 := by
  unfold D6ExpandedAllocation.scale
  have hlt : q/(q+1) < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]; linarith
  have h := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) hlt
  rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at h

/-- `sqrt(q/(q+1)) >= (q-1)/q`.  Squaring is legitimate because both sides are
nonnegative; the resulting polynomial inequality is `q^2+q >= 1`. -/
lemma scale_ge (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) : (q-1)/q ≤ D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q := by
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hb : (0:ℝ) ≤ (q-1)/q := div_nonneg (by linarith) hq0.le
  have hsq : ((q-1)/q)^2 ≤ q/(q+1) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hq0 2), div_mul_eq_mul_div,
      le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < q+1)]
    nlinarith
  have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
  rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hb] at h

lemma left_lt_one (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) : leftCoefficient q < 1 := by
  have hq3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ q := by linarith
  have hc0 := scale_pos hq3
  have hc1 := scale_lt_one hq3
  have hden : 0 < q - 2 + D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q := by linarith
  have hr : D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q*(q-1)/(q-2+D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q) < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hden]; nlinarith
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q*(q-1)/(q-2+D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q) :=
    div_nonneg (by nlinarith) hden.le
  unfold leftCoefficient D6ExpandedAllocation.value
  nlinarith

lemma left_ge (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) : ((q-1)/q)^2 ≤ leftCoefficient q := by
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hq3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ q := by linarith
  have hc0 := scale_pos hq3
  have hc1 := scale_lt_one hq3
  have hcg := scale_ge hq
  have hden : 0 < q - 2 + D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q := by linarith
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq0
  have he : (q-1)/q*q = q-1 := by field_simp
  have hcq : q - 1 ≤ D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q*q := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcg hq0.le
    rwa [he] at h
  have hratio : (q-1)/q ≤
      D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q*(q-1)/(q-2+D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hq0]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcq (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ q-1),
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < q-1)]
  have hb : (0:ℝ) ≤ (q-1)/q := div_nonneg (by linarith) hq0.le
  unfold leftCoefficient D6ExpandedAllocation.value
  nlinarith [hratio, hb]

/-! ## Both frozen parameters vanish -/

lemma coefficient_nonneg (hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ q) {w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1/4) :
    0 ≤ coefficient q w := by
  unfold coefficient
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (1-w)*(q-1)/q := div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (by linarith)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ w*(q-2)^2 := mul_nonneg hw0 (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

/-- `beta q w <= w`: the extra `w*(q-2)^2` in the denominator only helps. -/
lemma beta_le (hq : (3:ℝ) ≤ q) {w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1/4) :
    beta q w ≤ w := by
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hd1 : 0 < (1-w)*(q-1) := by nlinarith
  have hd2 : (1-w)*(q-1) ≤ q*coefficient q w := by
    unfold coefficient
    have hqne : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq0
    have hx : q*((1-w)*(q-1)/q+w*(q-2)^2) = (1-w)*(q-1)+q*(w*(q-2)^2) := by
      field_simp <;> ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ q*(w*(q-2)^2) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hw0 (sq_nonneg _))
    rw [hx]; linarith
  have hdpos : 0 < q*coefficient q w := by linarith
  unfold beta
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hdpos]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2 hw0]

lemma mass_le (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    mass q mu ≤ 1/(q-2)^2 := by
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < (q-2)^2 := pow_pos (by linarith) 2
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hp]
  linarith [mass_scaled q mu hq hm]

/-! ## The sandwich -/

/-- The local curvature is trapped in `(-(1/2), -(1/2)+2/q]` for every `q>=8`
and every margin in the closed phase-III interval.  The lower bound uses only
`leftCoefficient q < 1`; the upper bound uses `leftCoefficient q >= ((q-1)/q)^2`
together with `p <= 1/q` and `beta <= 1/(q-2)^2 <= 1/q`. -/
theorem local_curvature_sandwich (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    -(1/2) < localCurvature q mu ∧ localCurvature q mu ≤ -(1/2)+2/q := by
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hq3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hw0,hw1⟩ := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq3 hm.1 hm.2
  have hmle := mass_le hq hm
  have hbeta := beta_le hq3 hw0 hw1
  have hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta q (mass q mu) := by
    unfold beta
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) hw0
    · exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (coefficient_nonneg hq3 hw0 hw1)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p q (mass q mu) := by
    unfold p; exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hq0.le
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq0
  have hone : (1:ℝ)/q*q = 1 := by field_simp
  have hple : p q (mass q mu) ≤ 1/q := by
    unfold p; rw [div_le_iff₀ hq0, hone]; linarith
  have hinv : 1/(q-2)^2 ≤ 1/q := by
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq0
    nlinarith
  have hb2 : beta q (mass q mu) ≤ 1/q := le_trans hbeta (le_trans hmle hinv)
  have hL1 := left_lt_one hq
  have hkey : ((q-1)/q)^2 = 1-2/q+1/q^2 := by field_simp <;> ring
  have hLge : 1-2/q+1/q^2 ≤ leftCoefficient q := by rw [← hkey]; exact left_ge hq
  have hq2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/q^2 := by positivity
  unfold localCurvature curvatureDifference
  constructor
  · linarith
  · have htwo : (2:ℝ)/q=2*(1/q) := by ring
    rw [htwo] at hLge ⊢
    linarith

/-- Absolute form: the curvature magnitude rises to `1/2` and never reaches it. -/
theorem local_curvature_abs (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    1/2-2/q ≤ |localCurvature q mu| ∧ |localCurvature q mu| < 1/2 := by
  obtain ⟨hlo,hhi⟩ := local_curvature_sandwich hq hm
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have h2q : 2/q ≤ 1/4 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hq0]; linarith
  have hneg : localCurvature q mu ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hneg]
  constructor <;> linarith

/-- The matching-risk coefficient is `Theta(1)`, not `O(1/q^2)`.  The lower
bound tends to `1/2`, so no decaying bound on this coefficient exists, and the
`64/q^2` of `remainder_scaled` bounds only the smaller of the two summands. -/
theorem matching_coefficient_theta_one (hq : (8:ℝ) ≤ q) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q) :
    1/2-2/q ≤ remainderConstant q mu+|localCurvature q mu| ∧
      remainderConstant q mu+|localCurvature q mu| ≤ 64/q^2+1/2 := by
  obtain ⟨hlo,hhi⟩ := local_curvature_abs hq hm
  have hq3 : (3:ℝ) ≤ q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hw0,hw1⟩ := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq3 hm.1 hm.2
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ remainderConstant q mu := by
    unfold remainderConstant
    have hc := coefficient_nonneg hq3 hw0 hw1
    have hm2 : 0 ≤ coefficient q (mass q mu)*(combinedModulus q mu)^2 :=
      mul_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have hrs := remainder_scaled q mu hq hm
  constructor <;> linarith

#print axioms scale_ge
#print axioms left_lt_one
#print axioms left_ge
#print axioms beta_le
#print axioms mass_le
#print axioms local_curvature_sandwich
#print axioms local_curvature_abs
#print axioms matching_coefficient_theta_one
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalCurvatureLimit

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LocalMatchingAlgebraV1.lean (82 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenOracleGapV1»

/-! Finite-epsilon risk algebra. All constants are explicit; no asymptotic
notation or statistical assumption substitutes for the actual risk bridge. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingAlgebra
noncomputable section

def leftValue (c mu : ℝ) := c*(1-mu)^2/2
def frozenValue (p b mu : ℝ) := (p*mu^2+b*(1-mu)^2)/2
def jump (p b c mu0 : ℝ) := p*mu0-b*(1-mu0)+c*(1-mu0)
def curvatureDifference (p b c : ℝ) := (p+b-c)/2

theorem exact_difference (p b c mu0 eps : ℝ)
    (h0 : frozenValue p b mu0=leftValue c mu0) :
    frozenValue p b (mu0+eps)-leftValue c (mu0+eps)=
      jump p b c mu0*eps+curvatureDifference p b c*eps^2 := by
  unfold frozenValue leftValue at h0
  unfold frozenValue leftValue jump curvatureDifference
  nlinarith only [h0]

theorem jump_positive (p b c mu0 : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hm0 : 0 < mu0) (hm1 : mu0 < 1)
    (h0 : frozenValue p b mu0=leftValue c mu0) : 0 < jump p b c mu0 := by
  have h := D6FrozenOracleGap.boundary_slope_jump p b c mu0 (ne_of_lt hm1) h0
  unfold jump
  rw [h]
  exact div_pos (mul_pos hp hm0) (by linarith)

/-- Exact two-margin separation is at least J epsilon - epsilon^2. -/
theorem separation_lower (p b c mu0 eps gammaPlus : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h0 : frozenValue p b mu0=leftValue c mu0)
    (hg : frozenValue p b (mu0+eps) ≤ gammaPlus) :
    jump p b c mu0*eps-eps^2 ≤
      leftValue c (mu0-eps)+gammaPlus-2*leftValue c mu0-eps^2 := by
  have hsq : 0 ≤ (p+b+c)*eps^2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  unfold frozenValue leftValue at h0
  unfold frozenValue at hg
  unfold jump leftValue
  nlinarith only [h0,hg,hsq]

/-- Both losses of the threshold rule obey the same leading constant. -/
theorem threshold_pair_upper (p b c mu0 eps t Rminus Rplus wrongPlus M : ℝ)
    (h0 : frozenValue p b mu0=leftValue c mu0)
    (he : 0 ≤ eps) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hJ : 0 ≤ jump p b c mu0) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hm : Rminus=max 0 (leftValue c (mu0-eps)-frozenValue p b (mu0-eps)))
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ Rplus) (hp : Rplus ≤ M*eps^2)
    (hwrong : wrongPlus ≤ max 0 (frozenValue p b (mu0+eps)+Rplus-leftValue c (mu0+eps))) :
    max (Rminus*t) (Rplus+(wrongPlus-Rplus)*t) ≤
      jump p b c mu0*eps*t+(M+|curvatureDifference p b c|)*eps^2 := by
  have hd := exact_difference p b c mu0 eps h0
  have hdm := exact_difference p b c mu0 (-eps) h0
  simp only [← sub_eq_add_neg] at hdm
  have hcur := le_abs_self (curvatureDifference p b c)
  have hcur' := neg_le_abs (curvatureDifference p b c)
  have hcur0 := abs_nonneg (curvatureDifference p b c)
  have hbase : 0 ≤ jump p b c mu0*eps+|curvatureDifference p b c| *eps^2 := by positivity
  have hneg : leftValue c (mu0-eps)-frozenValue p b (mu0-eps) ≤
      jump p b c mu0*eps+|curvatureDifference p b c| *eps^2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcur' (sq_nonneg eps)
    nlinarith only [hdm,h]
  have hm' : Rminus ≤ jump p b c mu0*eps+|curvatureDifference p b c| *eps^2 := by
    rw [hm]
    exact max_le hbase hneg
  have hp' : wrongPlus ≤ Rplus+jump p b c mu0*eps+|curvatureDifference p b c| *eps^2 := by
    apply hwrong.trans
    apply max_le
    · linarith only [hbase,hp0]
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcur (sq_nonneg eps)
      linarith only [hd,h]
  have hmt := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm' ht
  have hpt := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp' ht
  have hct := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1 (mul_nonneg hcur0 (sq_nonneg eps))
  have hMe : 0 ≤ M*eps^2 := mul_nonneg hM (sq_nonneg eps)
  apply max_le <;> nlinarith only [hmt,hpt,hct,hp,hMe]

#print axioms exact_difference
#print axioms jump_positive
#print axioms separation_lower
#print axioms threshold_pair_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingAlgebra

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LocalMatchingDesignV1.lean (128 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenQuadraticBoundV1»
import «LeanD6LocalMatchingAlgebraV1»
import «LeanD6AdaptiveOracleRegretV1»

/-! Boundary equality and loss bounds for two concrete legal D6 allocations.
These connect the local risk algebra to the actual supremum/infimum game. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingDesign
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingAlgebra
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def leftCoefficient (q : ℝ) := D6ExpandedAllocation.value q (D6ExpandedAllocation.scale q)
def localJump (q mu0 : ℝ) := jump (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) (leftCoefficient q) mu0
def localCurvature (q mu0 : ℝ) := curvatureDifference (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) (leftCoefficient q)

def leftRegret (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ) :=
  oracleRegret A j q mu (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q)
def rightRegret (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ) :=
  oracleRegret A j q mu (D6PhaseThreePrimal.queries A j)
    (D6PhaseThreePrimal.weights A j q (mass q mu0))

lemma left_rate (q mu : ℝ) : rate q (1-mu)=leftValue (leftCoefficient q) mu := by
  unfold rate leftValue leftCoefficient
  ring

lemma frozen_rate (q w mu : ℝ) : D6FrozenScalarAllocation.value q w mu=frozenValue (p q w) (beta q w) mu := rfl

/-- Equality at the boundary follows from two proved oracle values, rather
than being assumed as an identity between guessed radical formulas. -/
theorem boundary_equality (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu0))
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (hup : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    frozenValue (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) mu0=leftValue (leftCoefficient q) mu0 := by
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu0 hq hlo hup
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq hlo hup
  have hf := frozen_half_interval_value A j q (mass q mu0) mu0 hq hw.1 hw.2 hm.1 hm.2.1 hj hA hB
  have ho := D6PhaseThreeSharp.optimal_allocation_value A j q mu0 hq hlo hup hj hA hB
  have hl := phase_two_oracle A j q (1-mu0) hq hI hj hA hB
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at hl
  rw [phase_three_oracle A j q mu0 hq hlo hup hj hA hB,left_rate] at hl
  rw [frozen_rate] at hf
  exact hf.symm.trans (ho.trans hl)

lemma left_regret_zero (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu))
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    leftRegret A j q mu=0 := by
  have ho := phase_two_oracle A j q (1-mu) hq hI hj hA hB
  have hv := phase_two_allocation_value A j q (1-mu) hq hI hj hA hB
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at ho hv
  simp [leftRegret,oracleRegret,ho,hv]

lemma left_value_lower_on_phase_three (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hmu : mu < 1) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    leftValue (leftCoefficient q) mu ≤ allocationValue A j mu (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q) := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  obtain ⟨A',nu,had,he⟩ := D6PhaseThreeSharp.actual_adversary A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB
    (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q) hp.1 (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  apply le_csInf (s := valueSet A j mu (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q)) ⟨_,A',nu,had,rfl⟩
  rintro v ⟨B,u,h,rfl⟩
  have hg := margin_distribution_lower A B j q (1-mu) u hq (by linarith) hj h.2.2.1
    h.2.1 h.1 hA hB
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel,left_rate] using hg

/-- Exact wrong-phase loss on the minus side, evaluated over every alternative. -/
theorem minus_right_loss (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q (1-mu))
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hm : 1/2 ≤ mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    rightRegret A j q mu0 mu=max 0 (leftValue (leftCoefficient q) mu-
      frozenValue (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) mu) := by
  have ho := phase_two_oracle A j q (1-mu) hq hI hj hA hB
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel,left_rate] at ho
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hv := frozen_half_interval_value A j q (mass q mu0) mu hq hw.1 hw.2 hm hm1 hj hA hB
  rw [frozen_rate] at hv
  simp only [rightRegret,oracleRegret,ho,hv]

/-- The exact plus oracle equals the frozen value plus its actual regret. -/
theorem plus_oracle_decomposition (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q mu=
      frozenValue (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) mu+rightRegret A j q mu0 mu := by
  have hm := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hw := phase_mass_bounds q mu0 hq h0lo h0hi
  have hv := frozen_half_interval_value A j q (mass q mu0) mu hq hw.1 hw.2 hm.1 hm.2.1 hj hA hB
  rw [frozen_rate] at hv
  have hp := D6PhaseThreePrimal.distribution A j q (mass q mu0) (by linarith) hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2]) hB
  have hu := D6PhaseThreeSharp.every_allocation_value_le A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB _ _
    hp.1 (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  rw [hv] at hu
  unfold rightRegret oracleRegret
  rw [phase_three_oracle A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB,hv,max_eq_right (by linarith)]
  ring

lemma plus_left_loss (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu0 mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (h0lo : marginMax q ≤ mu0) (h0hi : mu0 ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hmu : mu < 1) (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    leftRegret A j q mu ≤ max 0
      (frozenValue (p q (mass q mu0)) (beta q (mass q mu0)) mu+rightRegret A j q mu0 mu-
        leftValue (leftCoefficient q) mu) := by
  have hl := left_value_lower_on_phase_three A j q mu hq hlo hup hmu hj hA hB
  unfold leftRegret oracleRegret
  rw [phase_three_oracle A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB,
    plus_oracle_decomposition A j q mu0 mu hq hlo hup h0lo h0hi hj hA hB]
  exact max_le_max le_rfl (sub_le_sub_left hl _)

#print axioms boundary_equality
#print axioms minus_right_loss
#print axioms plus_oracle_decomposition
#print axioms plus_left_loss
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalMatchingDesign

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6LocalOracleRegretV1.lean (115 dong)
import «LeanD6PhaseThreeSharpV1»

/-! Regret relative to the actual supremum over every finite legal allocation,
not an externally supplied benchmark. Phase II and III rates are proved equal
to this supremum before substituting them into the local lower bound. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDistribution
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def Feasible (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ E,w e)=1

def gameValues (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  {v | ∃ E w,Feasible j q E w ∧ v=allocationValue A j mu E w}

def oracleValue (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ) := sSup (gameValues A j q mu)

def oracleRegret (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) :=
  max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu-allocationValue A j mu E w)

theorem oracle_eq_of_attainment (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu g : ℝ)
    (attains : ∃ E w,Feasible j q E w ∧ allocationValue A j mu E w=g)
    (upper : ∀ E w,Feasible j q E w → allocationValue A j mu E w ≤ g) :
    oracleValue A j q mu=g := by
  obtain ⟨E,w,hf,he⟩ := attains
  have hm : g ∈ gameValues A j q mu := ⟨E,w,hf,he.symm⟩
  have hb : BddAbove (gameValues A j q mu) := by
    refine ⟨g,?_⟩
    rintro v ⟨E',w',hf',rfl⟩
    exact upper E' w' hf'
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le ⟨g,hm⟩
    rintro v ⟨E',w',hf',rfl⟩
    exact upper E' w' hf'
  · exact le_csSup hb hm

theorem phase_two_allocation_value (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    allocationValue A j (1-lam) (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q)=rate q lam := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hu⟩ :=
    arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB _ _ hp.1
      (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  have ha : Admissible A A' j nu := ⟨hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_trans (allocationValue_le_actual A A' j (1-lam) nu _ _
      (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) ha) hu
  · apply le_csInf (s := valueSet A j (1-lam) (primalQueries A j) (primalWeight A j q))
      ⟨_,A',nu,ha,rfl⟩
    rintro v ⟨A'',nu',h,rfl⟩
    exact margin_distribution_lower A A'' j q lam nu' hq hI.1 hj h.2.2.1 h.2.1 h.1 hA hB

theorem phase_two_oracle (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    oracleValue A j q (1-lam)=rate q lam := by
  have hp := primal_distribution A j q hq hj hA hB
  apply oracle_eq_of_attainment A j q (1-lam) (rate q lam)
  · exact ⟨_,_,⟨hp.1,(fun e _ => hp.2.1 e),hp.2.2⟩,
      phase_two_allocation_value A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB⟩
  · rintro E w ⟨hl,hw,hn⟩
    obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hu⟩ :=
      arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
    exact le_trans (allocationValue_le_actual A A' j (1-lam) nu E w hw
      ⟨hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1⟩) hu

theorem phase_three_oracle (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    oracleValue A j q mu=D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q mu := by
  have hm := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hp := D6PhaseThreePrimal.distribution A j q (D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters.mass q mu)
    (by linarith) hm.1 (by linarith [hm.2]) hB
  apply oracle_eq_of_attainment A j q mu (D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q mu)
  · exact ⟨_,_,⟨hp.1,(fun e _ => hp.2.1 e),hp.2.2⟩,
      D6PhaseThreeSharp.optimal_allocation_value A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB⟩
  · rintro E w ⟨hl,hw,hn⟩
    exact D6PhaseThreeSharp.every_allocation_value_le A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB E w hl hw hn

/-- Both losses use the actual oracle value. The two rates on the left are
certified optima on their respective phases, over every actual legal query. -/
theorem local_oracle_regret_separation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hminus : Interior q (lam+eps))
    (hpluslo : marginMax q ≤ (1-lam)+eps) (hplushi : (1-lam)+eps ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hlo : eps ≤ 1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (hup : eps ≤ lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ) (hf : Feasible j q E w) :
    rate q (lam+eps)+D6PhaseThreeSharp.rate q ((1-lam)+eps)-2*rate q lam-eps^2 ≤
      oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)-eps) E w+oracleRegret A j q ((1-lam)+eps) E w := by
  have hm := phase_two_oracle A j q (lam+eps) hq hminus hj hA hB
  have hp := phase_three_oracle A j q ((1-lam)+eps) hq hpluslo hplushi hj hA hB
  have he : 1-(lam+eps)=(1-lam)-eps := by ring
  rw [he] at hm
  unfold oracleRegret
  rw [hm,hp]
  exact actual_regret_separation A j q lam eps hq hI hj hA hB heps hlo hup E w hf.1 hf.2.1 hf.2.2 _ _

#print axioms oracle_eq_of_attainment
#print axioms phase_two_allocation_value
#print axioms phase_two_oracle
#print axioms phase_three_oracle
#print axioms local_oracle_regret_separation
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
