/-! Explicit interpolation from a tie world to a strict Top-3 world.
All finite endpoint certificates use kernel `decide` on explicit Fin arguments.
The endpoints are data; no LP output or numerical result is assumed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6M6SharpnessBridgeV1
open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PolyhedralActiveCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6BinaryBridgeV1 (cornerQ2 z6 cornerQ2_response cornerQ2_nonnegative cornerQ2_normalized)
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000
set_option maxRecDepth 4000
open CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpnessM6V1 (Ib Db Vb)
def baseF (a b c d e f : Fin 2) : ℤ := 2 * Ib a b c d e f
def edgeF (a b c d e f : Fin 2) : ℤ := 2 * Ib a b c d e f + Db a b c d e f
def raw (e : Fin 2) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  (if e = 0 then baseF else edgeF) (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5)
def S : Finset (Fin 6) := {0,4,5}
def T : Finset (Fin 6) := {1,2,3}
def selMin : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1]
def selMax : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0]
def comMin : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]
def comMax : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0]
def rlo (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) : ℤ := (if e=0 then ![0,2,2,-4,0,0] else ![-1,1,1,-5,-1,-1]) i
def rhi (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) : ℤ := (if e=0 then ![2,4,4,-2,2,2] else ![3,5,5,-1,3,3]) i
def response (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) (u : Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  raw e (Function.update z6 i u)
def rs (e : Fin 2) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  raw e z - response e 0 (z 0) - response e 4 (z 4) - response e 5 (z 5)
def rt (e : Fin 2) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  raw e z - response e 1 (z 1) - response e 2 (z 2) - response e 3 (z 3)
private theorem eta (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : z = ![z 0,z 1,z 2,z 3,z 4,z 5] := by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
private theorem lift6 {P : (Fin 6 → Fin 2) → Prop}
    (h : ∀ a b c d e f : Fin 2, P ![a,b,c,d,e,f]) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : P z := by
  rw [eta z]; exact h _ _ _ _ _ _

theorem endpoint_derivative_bounds (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    rlo e i ≤ raw e (Function.update z i 1) - raw e (Function.update z i 0) ∧
    raw e (Function.update z i 1) - raw e (Function.update z i 0) ≤ rhi e i := by
  have h : ∀ (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) (a b c d f g : Fin 2),
      rlo e i ≤ raw e (Function.update ![a,b,c,d,f,g] i 1) - raw e (Function.update ![a,b,c,d,f,g] i 0) ∧
      raw e (Function.update ![a,b,c,d,f,g] i 1) - raw e (Function.update ![a,b,c,d,f,g] i 0) ≤ rhi e i := by decide
  rw [eta z]; exact h e i _ _ _ _ _ _

theorem endpoint_spreads : ∀ i : Fin 6,
    rhi 0 i - rlo 0 i ≤ 2 ∧ rhi 1 i - rlo 1 i ≤ 4 := by decide

theorem endpoint_residual_bounds (e : Fin 2) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    rs e selMin ≤ rs e z ∧ rs e z ≤ rs e selMax ∧
    rt e comMin ≤ rt e z ∧ rt e z ≤ rt e comMax := by
  have h : ∀ e a b c d f g : Fin 2,
      rs e selMin ≤ rs e ![a,b,c,d,f,g] ∧ rs e ![a,b,c,d,f,g] ≤ rs e selMax ∧
      rt e comMin ≤ rt e ![a,b,c,d,f,g] ∧ rt e ![a,b,c,d,f,g] ≤ rt e comMax := by decide
  rw [eta z]; exact h e _ _ _ _ _ _

def respMax : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![1,1,1,0,1,1]
def respMin : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![0,0,0,1,0,0]
theorem endpoint_response_bounds : ∀ (e : Fin 2) (i : Fin 6) (u : Fin 2),
    response e i (respMin i) ≤ response e i u ∧ response e i u ≤ response e i (respMax i) := by decide

theorem endpoint_spans : ∀ i : Fin 6,
    response 0 i (respMax i) - response 0 i (respMin i) = 2 ∧
    response 1 i (respMax i) - response 1 i (respMin i) = (if i ∈ S then 3 else 1) := by decide

theorem endpoint_gap : ∀ e : Fin 2,
    (rs e selMax - rs e selMin) - (rt e comMax - rt e comMin) = 12 := by decide

noncomputable def world (s : ℝ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  (1-s) * (raw 0 z : ℝ) + s * (raw 1 z : ℝ)
noncomputable def mix (s : ℝ) (a b : ℤ) : ℝ := (1-s)*(a:ℝ)+s*(b:ℝ)

theorem mix_le (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    {a b c d : ℤ} (h₀ : a ≤ c) (h₁ : b ≤ d) : mix s a b ≤ mix s c d := by
  have h₀' : (a:ℝ) ≤ c := by exact_mod_cast h₀
  have h₁' : (b:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast h₁
  exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₀' (by linarith))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁' hs)

theorem world_response (s : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) (u : Fin 2) :
    productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i u = mix s (response 0 i u) (response 1 i u) := by
  rw [cornerQ2_response]; rfl

theorem world_rs (s : ℝ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S z = mix s (rs 0 z) (rs 1 z) := by
  unfold retainedResidual
  simp [S, world_response, mix, world, rs, Finset.sum_insert]
  ring

theorem world_rt (s : ℝ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T z = mix s (rt 0 z) (rt 1 z) := by
  unfold retainedResidual
  simp [T, world_response, mix, world, rt, Finset.sum_insert]
  ring

theorem mix_sub (s : ℝ) (a b c d : ℤ) :
    mix s a b - mix s c d = mix s (a-c) (b-d) := by
  unfold mix; push_cast; ring

theorem world_derivative_bounds (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (i : Fin 6) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    mix s (rlo 0 i) (rlo 1 i) ≤ world s (Function.update z i 1) - world s (Function.update z i 0) ∧
    world s (Function.update z i 1) - world s (Function.update z i 0) ≤ mix s (rhi 0 i) (rhi 1 i) := by
  change mix s _ _ ≤ mix s _ _ - mix s _ _ ∧ mix s _ _ - mix s _ _ ≤ mix s _ _
  rw [mix_sub]
  exact ⟨mix_le s hs hs1 (endpoint_derivative_bounds 0 i z).1 (endpoint_derivative_bounds 1 i z).1,
    mix_le s hs hs1 (endpoint_derivative_bounds 0 i z).2 (endpoint_derivative_bounds 1 i z).2⟩

theorem world_mixed_bound (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (i : Fin 6) (x c : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    |mixedDifference (world s) i x c| ≤ 2 + 2*s := by
  obtain ⟨hxlo,hxhi⟩ := world_derivative_bounds s hs hs1 i x
  obtain ⟨hclo,hchi⟩ := world_derivative_bounds s hs hs1 i c
  have hwidth : mix s (rhi 0 i) (rhi 1 i) - mix s (rlo 0 i) (rlo 1 i) ≤ 2+2*s := by
    rw [mix_sub]
    have h := mix_le s hs hs1 (endpoint_spreads i).1 (endpoint_spreads i).2
    convert h using 1 <;> simp [mix] <;> ring
  have heq : mixedDifference (world s) i x c =
      (world s (Function.update x i (x i)) - world s (Function.update x i (c i))) -
      (world s (Function.update c i (x i)) - world s (Function.update c i (c i))) := by
    simp [mixedDifference, Function.update_eq_self]; ring
  have h01 : |world s (Function.update x i 0) - world s (Function.update x i 1) -
      (world s (Function.update c i 0) - world s (Function.update c i 1))| ≤ 2+2*s := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have h10 : |world s (Function.update x i 1) - world s (Function.update x i 0) -
      (world s (Function.update c i 1) - world s (Function.update c i 0))| ≤ 2+2*s := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  rw [heq]
  generalize x i = u
  generalize c i = v
  fin_cases u <;> fin_cases v <;> first | exact h01 | exact h10 | (simp; linarith)

theorem world_residual_bounds (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S selMin ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S z ∧
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S z ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S selMax ∧
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T comMin ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T z ∧
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T z ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T comMax := by
  simp only [world_rs,world_rt]
  have a := endpoint_residual_bounds 0 z
  have b := endpoint_residual_bounds 1 z
  exact ⟨mix_le s hs hs1 a.1 b.1, mix_le s hs hs1 a.2.1 b.2.1,
    mix_le s hs hs1 a.2.2.1 b.2.2.1, mix_le s hs hs1 a.2.2.2 b.2.2.2⟩

private theorem osc_of_extremes {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (lo hi : X) (hlo : ∀ x, f lo ≤ f x) (hhi : ∀ x, f x ≤ f hi) :
    osc f = f hi - f lo := by
  have hmax : maxVal f = f hi := le_antisymm (maxVal_le f hhi) (le_maxVal f hi)
  have hmin : minVal f = f lo := le_antisymm (minVal_le f lo) (le_minVal f hlo)
  simp [osc,hmax,hmin]

theorem world_osc_response (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (i : Fin 6) :
    osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i) = if i ∈ S then 2+s else 2-s := by
  have hlo : ∀ u, productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i (respMin i) ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i u := by
    intro u
    rw [world_response, world_response]
    exact mix_le s hs hs1 (endpoint_response_bounds 0 i u).1 (endpoint_response_bounds 1 i u).1
  have hhi : ∀ u, productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i u ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i (respMax i) := by
    intro u
    rw [world_response, world_response]
    exact mix_le s hs hs1 (endpoint_response_bounds 0 i u).2 (endpoint_response_bounds 1 i u).2
  have h := osc_of_extremes (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i) (respMin i) (respMax i) hlo hhi
  rw [h,world_response,world_response,mix_sub,(endpoint_spans i).1,(endpoint_spans i).2]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> simp [hi,mix] <;> ring

theorem world_top_three (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i)) S 3 := by
  rw [isTopKByScore_iff_pairwise]
  refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  rw [world_osc_response s hs hs1,world_osc_response s hs hs1,ite_eq_left hi,ite_eq_right hj]
  linarith

theorem world_strict_top_three (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S,
      osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) j) < osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s) i) := by
  intro i hi j hj
  rw [world_osc_response s hs.le hs1,world_osc_response s hs.le hs1,ite_eq_left hi,ite_eq_right hj]
  linarith

theorem world_doubled_gap (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss (world s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s)) S -
      productCompressionLoss (world s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s)) T) = 12 := by
  have hS := osc_of_extremes (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S) selMin selMax
    (fun z => (world_residual_bounds s hs hs1 z).1)
    (fun z => (world_residual_bounds s hs hs1 z).2.1)
  have hT := osc_of_extremes (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T) comMin comMax
    (fun z => (world_residual_bounds s hs hs1 z).2.2.1)
    (fun z => (world_residual_bounds s hs hs1 z).2.2.2)
  change 2 * (osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) S)/2 -
    osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world s) T)/2) = 12
  rw [hS,hT,world_rs,world_rs,world_rt,world_rt]
  have h : (mix s (rs 0 selMax) (rs 1 selMax) - mix s (rs 0 selMin) (rs 1 selMin)) -
      (mix s (rt 0 comMax) (rt 1 comMax) - mix s (rt 0 comMin) (rt 1 comMin)) = 12 := by
    rw [mix_sub,mix_sub,mix_sub,endpoint_gap 0,endpoint_gap 1]
    unfold mix; norm_num; ring
  linarith

/-- Universal coefficient for the m=6, k=3 corner-reference comparison problem. -/
def ConstantAtMost (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (F : (Fin 6 → Fin 2) → ℝ) (delta : ℝ), 0 ≤ delta →
    (∀ i x z, |mixedDifference F i x z| ≤ delta) →
    ∀ (selected competitor : Finset (Fin 6)),
      IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse cornerQ2 F i)) selected 3 →
      competitor.card = 3 →
      2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cornerQ2 F) selected -
        productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cornerQ2 F) competitor) ≤ c*delta

theorem constant_six_upper : ConstantAtMost 6 := by
  intro F delta hd hdelta selected competitor hTop hCard
  have h := CIGAMF.P13.D6SmallSymmetricDifference.pair_loss_le_sdiff_card
    cornerQ2 F delta cornerQ2_nonnegative cornerQ2_normalized hd hdelta selected competitor 3 hTop hCard
  have hc : (selected \ competitor).card ≤ 3 := by
    calc (selected \ competitor).card ≤ selected.card := Finset.card_le_card Finset.sdiff_subset
         _ = 3 := hTop.1
  have hcr : ((selected \ competitor).card : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  nlinarith

/-- Any smaller coefficient is violated by a strictly selected member of the explicit family.
This epsilon argument proves sharpness without assuming an optimizer or a limit theorem. -/
theorem every_smaller_constant_fails (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 6) :
    ∃ (s : ℝ), 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧
      c * (2+2*s) < 2 * (productCompressionLoss (world s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s)) S -
        productCompressionLoss (world s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (world s)) T) := by
  by_cases hneg : c ≤ 0
  · refine ⟨1, by norm_num, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [world_doubled_gap 1 (by norm_num) le_rfl]
    nlinarith
  · have hpos : 0 < c := lt_of_not_ge hneg
    let s := min 1 ((6-c)/(c+1))
    have hs : 0 < s := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hsr : s ≤ (6-c)/(c+1) := min_le_right _ _
    have hm : s*(c+1) ≤ 6-c := (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp hsr
    refine ⟨s, hs, hs1, ?_⟩
    rw [world_doubled_gap s hs.le hs1]
    nlinarith

theorem constant_six_sharp : ConstantAtMost 6 ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, c < 6 → ¬ ConstantAtMost c := by
  refine ⟨constant_six_upper, ?_⟩
  intro c hc hBound
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hs1,hgap⟩ := every_smaller_constant_fails c hc
  have h := hBound (world s) (2+2*s) (by linarith)
    (world_mixed_bound s hs.le hs1) S T (world_top_three s hs.le hs1) (by decide)
  linarith


open CIGAMF.P13.D6DecisionInteractionComplexity
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ContrastRankPhaseDefinitionsV2

def familyCell : ActiveDecisionCell 5 (Fin 2) where
  q := cornerQ2
  selected := S
  competitor := T
  selectedMax := selMax
  selectedMin := selMin
  competitorMax := comMax
  competitorMin := comMin
  responseMax := respMax
  responseMin := respMin

theorem familyCell_balanced : familyCell.BalancedComplement := by
  refine ⟨by decide, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> decide

theorem world_response_bounds (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (i : Fin 6) (u : Fin 2) :
    productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i (respMin i) ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i u ∧
    productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i u ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i (respMax i) := by
  simp only [world_response]
  exact ⟨mix_le t ht ht1 (endpoint_response_bounds 0 i u).1 (endpoint_response_bounds 1 i u).1,
    mix_le t ht ht1 (endpoint_response_bounds 0 i u).2 (endpoint_response_bounds 1 i u).2⟩

theorem world_span_eq_osc (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (i : Fin 6) :
    responseWitnessSpan familyCell (world t) i = osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i) := by
  exact (osc_of_extremes _ (respMin i) (respMax i)
    (fun u => (world_response_bounds t ht ht1 i u).1)
    (fun u => (world_response_bounds t ht ht1 i u).2)).symm

theorem world_valid (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : familyCell.Valid (world t) := by
  rw [activeDecisionCell_valid_iff_polyhedral]
  refine ⟨by decide, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z; exact (world_residual_bounds t ht ht1 z).2.1
  · intro z; exact (world_residual_bounds t ht ht1 z).1
  · intro z; exact (world_residual_bounds t ht ht1 z).2.2.2
  · intro z; exact (world_residual_bounds t ht ht1 z).2.2.1
  · intro i u; exact (world_response_bounds t ht ht1 i u).2
  · intro i u; exact (world_response_bounds t ht ht1 i u).1
  · intro i hi j hj
    rw [world_span_eq_osc t ht ht1,world_span_eq_osc t ht ht1]
    have h := (isTopKByScore_iff_pairwise _ S 3).mp (world_top_three t ht ht1)
    exact h.2 i hi j hj

noncomputable def unitWorld (t : ℝ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℝ := world t z / (2+2*t)

theorem unit_response (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) (u : Fin 2) :
    productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i u = productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) i u / (2+2*t) := by
  rw [cornerQ2_response,cornerQ2_response]; rfl

theorem unit_residual (t : ℝ) (A : Finset (Fin 6)) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) A z = retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) A z / (2+2*t) := by
  unfold retainedResidual
  simp only [unitWorld,unit_response]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← sub_div]

theorem unit_span (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) :
    responseWitnessSpan familyCell (unitWorld t) i = responseWitnessSpan familyCell (world t) i / (2+2*t) := by
  change productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i (respMax i) - productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i (respMin i) = _
  rw [unit_response,unit_response,← sub_div]; rfl

theorem unit_valid (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : familyCell.Valid (unitWorld t) := by
  have hd : 0 < 2+2*t := by linarith
  have hp := (activeDecisionCell_valid_iff_polyhedral familyCell (world t)).mp (world_valid t ht ht1)
  rw [activeDecisionCell_valid_iff_polyhedral]
  refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z; change retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) S z ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) S selMax
    rw [unit_residual,unit_residual]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.1 z) hd.le
  · intro z; change retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) S selMin ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) S z
    rw [unit_residual,unit_residual]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.1 z) hd.le
  · intro z; change retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) T z ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) T comMax
    rw [unit_residual,unit_residual]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.2.1 z) hd.le
  · intro z; change retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) T comMin ≤ retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) T z
    rw [unit_residual,unit_residual]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.2.2.1 z) hd.le
  · intro i u; change productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i u ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i (respMax i)
    rw [unit_response,unit_response]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.2.2.2.1 i u) hd.le
  · intro i u; change productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i (respMin i) ≤ productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i u
    rw [unit_response,unit_response]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i u) hd.le
  · intro i hi j hj
    rw [unit_span,unit_span]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hp.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 i hi j hj) hd.le

theorem unit_interaction (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : UnitInteractionBound (unitWorld t) := by
  intro i x c
  have hd : 0 < 2+2*t := by linarith
  have heq : mixedDifference (unitWorld t) i x c = mixedDifference (world t) i x c / (2+2*t) := by
    simp only [mixedDifference,unitWorld]; ring
  rw [heq,abs_div,abs_of_pos hd,div_le_one hd]
  exact world_mixed_bound t ht ht1 i x c

private theorem osc_div_pos {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) : osc (fun x => f x/d) = osc f/d := by
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo⟩ := exists_eq_minVal f
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi⟩ := exists_eq_maxVal f
  rw [osc_of_extremes (fun x => f x/d) lo hi
    (fun x => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hlo]; exact minVal_le f x) hd.le)
    (fun x => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hhi]; exact le_maxVal f x) hd.le)]
  rw [hlo,hhi,← sub_div]; rfl

theorem unit_strict_top (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : StrictTopC familyCell (unitWorld t) := by
  intro i hi j hj
  change osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) j) < osc (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) i)
  simp_rw [show ∀ k, productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) k = fun u => productResponse cornerQ2 (world t) k u / (2+2*t) from fun k => funext (unit_response t k)]
  rw [osc_div_pos _ _ (by linarith),osc_div_pos _ _ (by linarith)]
  exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by linarith)).mpr (world_strict_top_three t ht ht1 i hi j hj)

theorem unit_doubled_gap (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss (unitWorld t) (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t)) S -
      productCompressionLoss (unitWorld t) (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t)) T) = 12/(2+2*t) := by
  change 2 * (osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) S)/2 - osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) T)/2) = _
  have h : ∀ A, retainedResidual cornerQ2 (unitWorld t) A = fun z => retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) A z / (2+2*t) := fun A => funext (unit_residual t A)
  rw [h,h,osc_div_pos _ _ (by linarith),osc_div_pos _ _ (by linarith)]
  have hg := world_doubled_gap t ht ht1
  change 2 * (osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) S)/2 - osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) T)/2) = 12 at hg
  calc _ = (2 * (osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) S)/2 - osc (retainedResidual cornerQ2 (world t) T)/2))/(2+2*t) := by ring
       _ = _ := by rw [hg]

/-- The exact integer family from the existing compiled arithmetic module, normalized. -/
noncomputable def normalizedFamily (s : ℤ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  (Vb s (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5) : ℝ) / (2*(s:ℝ)+2)

theorem world_affine (t : ℝ) (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) :
    world t z = 2*(Ib (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5):ℝ) +
      t*(Db (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5):ℝ) := by
  change (1-t)*((2*Ib (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5):ℤ):ℝ) +
    t*((2*Ib (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5)+Db (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5):ℤ):ℝ) = _
  push_cast; ring

theorem family_identification (s : ℤ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) : normalizedFamily s = unitWorld (1/(s:ℝ)) := by
  have hr : (1:ℝ) ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hn : (s:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  funext z
  simp only [normalizedFamily,unitWorld,world_affine,Vb]
  push_cast
  field_simp

/-- Whole-family bridge: Valid, strict selection, unit mixed-difference bound, and actual loss gap. -/
theorem normalized_family_bridge (s : ℤ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    familyCell.Valid (normalizedFamily s) ∧ StrictTopC familyCell (normalizedFamily s) ∧
    UnitInteractionBound (normalizedFamily s) ∧
    2 * (productCompressionLoss (normalizedFamily s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (normalizedFamily s)) S -
      productCompressionLoss (normalizedFamily s) (productResponse cornerQ2 (normalizedFamily s)) T) = 6*(s:ℝ)/((s:ℝ)+1) := by
  have hr : (1:ℝ) ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hp : 0 < 1/(s:ℝ) := one_div_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hu : 1/(s:ℝ) ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
  rw [family_identification s hs]
  refine ⟨unit_valid _ hp.le hu,unit_strict_top _ hp hu,unit_interaction _ hp.le hu,?_⟩
  rw [unit_doubled_gap _ hp.le hu]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

/-- Sharpness in the existing chain definition, not merely arithmetic on two named sequences. -/
theorem chain_constant_six_sharp : DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost familyCell 6 ∧
    ∀ c : ℝ, c < 6 → ¬ DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost familyCell c := by
  constructor
  · intro F hValid hUnit
    have hTop : IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse cornerQ2 F i)) S 3 := by
      simpa only [familyCell, show S.card = 3 from by decide] using hValid.2.1
    have h := constant_six_upper F 1 (by norm_num) hUnit S T hTop (by decide)
    simpa only [familyCell, mul_one] using h
  · intro c hc hBound
    obtain ⟨t,ht,ht1,hgap⟩ := every_smaller_constant_fails c hc
    have h := hBound (unitWorld t) (unit_valid t ht.le ht1) (unit_interaction t ht.le ht1)
    change 2 * (productCompressionLoss (unitWorld t) (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t)) S - productCompressionLoss (unitWorld t) (productResponse cornerQ2 (unitWorld t)) T) ≤ c at h
    rw [unit_doubled_gap t ht.le ht1] at h
    rw [world_doubled_gap t ht.le ht1] at hgap
    have hd : 0 < 2+2*t := by linarith
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mp h
    linarith


/-- The normalization is exact: one explicit mixed difference attains the bound. -/
def interactionX : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![1,0,0,0,0,0]
def interactionC : Fin 6 → Fin 2 := ![0,0,0,0,1,0]
theorem endpoint_interaction_attained :
    raw 0 interactionX - raw 0 (Function.update interactionX 0 (interactionC 0)) -
      raw 0 (Function.update interactionC 0 (interactionX 0)) + raw 0 interactionC = 2 ∧
    raw 1 interactionX - raw 1 (Function.update interactionX 0 (interactionC 0)) -
      raw 1 (Function.update interactionC 0 (interactionX 0)) + raw 1 interactionC = 4 := by decide

theorem world_interaction_attained (t : ℝ) :
    mixedDifference (world t) 0 interactionX interactionC = 2+2*t := by
  have heq : mixedDifference (world t) 0 interactionX interactionC =
      mix t (raw 0 interactionX - raw 0 (Function.update interactionX 0 (interactionC 0)) -
        raw 0 (Function.update interactionC 0 (interactionX 0)) + raw 0 interactionC)
      (raw 1 interactionX - raw 1 (Function.update interactionX 0 (interactionC 0)) -
        raw 1 (Function.update interactionC 0 (interactionX 0)) + raw 1 interactionC) := by
    simp only [mixedDifference,world,mix]; push_cast; ring
  rw [heq,endpoint_interaction_attained.1,endpoint_interaction_attained.2]
  unfold mix; norm_num; ring

theorem normalized_family_interaction_attained (s : ℤ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    mixedDifference (normalizedFamily s) 0 interactionX interactionC = 1 := by
  rw [family_identification s hs]
  have hr : (1:ℝ) ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hd : 0 < 2+2*(1/(s:ℝ)) := by positivity
  calc _ = mixedDifference (world (1/(s:ℝ))) 0 interactionX interactionC / (2+2*(1/(s:ℝ))) := by
           simp only [mixedDifference,unitWorld]; ring
       _ = 1 := by rw [world_interaction_attained]; exact div_self (ne_of_gt hd)

/-- Exact interaction radius of the original, unnormalized integer family. -/
theorem integer_family_interaction_exact (s : ℤ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (∀ (i : Fin 6) (x c : Fin 6 → Fin 2), |mixedDifference (fun (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) => (Vb s (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5) : ℝ)) i x c| ≤ 2*(s:ℝ)+2) ∧
    mixedDifference (fun (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) => (Vb s (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5) : ℝ)) 0 interactionX interactionC = 2*(s:ℝ)+2 := by
  have hr : (1:ℝ) ≤ s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hd : 0 < 2*(s:ℝ)+2 := by linarith
  have heq : ∀ i x c, mixedDifference (normalizedFamily s) i x c =
      mixedDifference (fun (z : Fin 6 → Fin 2) => (Vb s (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) (z 3) (z 4) (z 5):ℝ)) i x c / (2*(s:ℝ)+2) := by
    intro i x c; simp only [mixedDifference,normalizedFamily]; ring
  constructor
  · intro i x c
    have h := (normalized_family_bridge s hs).2.2.1 i x c
    rw [heq,abs_div,abs_of_pos hd,div_le_one hd] at h
    exact h
  · have h := normalized_family_interaction_attained s hs
    rw [heq,div_eq_one_iff_eq (ne_of_gt hd)] at h
    exact h

end CIGAMF.P13.D6M6SharpnessBridgeV1

import «LeanD6M6SharpnessBridgeV1»

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

private theorem point_sub_point_le_osc
    {A : Type*} [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
    (f : A → ℝ) (a b : A) : f a - f b ≤ osc f := by
  have ha := le_maxVal f a
  have hb := minVal_le f b
  simp only [osc]
  linarith

private theorem retainedResidual_sdiff_identity {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (S T : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    retainedResidual q F T z = retainedResidual q F S z +
        (S \ T).sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) -
        (T \ S).sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) := by
  classical
  unfold retainedResidual
  have hcancel :
      S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) -
          T.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) =
        (S \ T).sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) -
          (T \ S).sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff_sub_sum_sdiff]
  rw [show F z - T.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) =
      (F z - S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j))) +
        (S.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) -
          T.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j))) by ring,
    hcancel]
  ring

private theorem directed_response_sum_le_spans {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j)) -
        A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (y j)) ≤
      A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  exact point_sub_point_le_osc (productResponse q F j) (x j) (y j)

private theorem patched_extrema_sum {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (x y p m : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hp : ∀ j, productResponse q F j (p j) =
      maxVal (productResponse q F j))
    (hm : ∀ j, productResponse q F j (m j) =
      minVal (productResponse q F j)) :
    A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j
        (patchCoordinates x p A j)) -
      A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j
        (patchCoordinates y m A j)) =
      A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [patchCoordinates, if_pos hj, hp, hm, osc]

/-- Preserve the score surplus discarded by the earlier endpoint-patch bound. -/
theorem pair_loss_le_sdiff_card_sub_score_surplus {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (delta : ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hDeltaNonneg : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hdelta : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (selected competitor : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore
      (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) selected k)
    (hCompetitorCard : competitor.card = k) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected -
        productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) competitor ≤
      ((selected \ competitor).card : ℝ) * delta -
        ((selected \ competitor).sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) -
         (competitor \ selected).sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j))) / 2 := by
  classical
  let RS := retainedResidual q F selected
  let RT := retainedResidual q F competitor
  let A := selected \ competitor
  let B := competitor \ selected
  rcases exists_eq_maxVal RS with ⟨xplus, hxplus⟩
  rcases exists_eq_minVal RS with ⟨xminus, hxminus⟩
  let p : Fin (n + 1) → U := fun j ↦
    Classical.choose (exists_eq_maxVal (productResponse q F j))
  let m : Fin (n + 1) → U := fun j ↦
    Classical.choose (exists_eq_minVal (productResponse q F j))
  have hp : ∀ j, productResponse q F j (p j) =
      maxVal (productResponse q F j) := by
    intro j
    exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_eq_maxVal (productResponse q F j))
  have hm : ∀ j, productResponse q F j (m j) =
      minVal (productResponse q F j) := by
    intro j
    exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_eq_minVal (productResponse q F j))
  let u := patchCoordinates xplus p A
  let v := patchCoordinates xminus m A
  have hAsub : A ⊆ selected := by
    intro j hj
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).1
  have hplusAbs := retainedResidual_patch_bound q F delta hWeight hNorm
    hDeltaNonneg hdelta selected A hAsub xplus p
  have hminusAbs := retainedResidual_patch_bound q F delta hWeight hNorm
    hDeltaNonneg hdelta selected A hAsub xminus m
  have hplus : RS xplus - RS u ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * delta := by
    have hle : RS xplus - RS u ≤ |RS xplus - RS u| := le_abs_self _
    have habs : |RS xplus - RS u| ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * delta := by
      simpa [RS, u, abs_sub_comm] using hplusAbs
    exact le_trans hle habs
  have hminus : RS v - RS xminus ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * delta := by
    have hle : RS v - RS xminus ≤ |RS v - RS xminus| := le_abs_self _
    have habs : |RS v - RS xminus| ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * delta := by
      simpa [RS, v] using hminusAbs
    exact le_trans hle habs
  have hoscT : RT u - RT v ≤ osc RT :=
    point_sub_point_le_osc RT u v
  have hRTu : RT u = RS u +
      A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (u j)) -
      B.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (u j)) := by
    simpa [RS, RT, A, B] using
      retainedResidual_sdiff_identity q F selected competitor u
  have hRTv : RT v = RS v +
      A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (v j)) -
      B.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (v j)) := by
    simpa [RS, RT, A, B] using
      retainedResidual_sdiff_identity q F selected competitor v
  have hAdiff :
      A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (u j)) -
        A.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (v j)) =
      A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) := by
    simpa [u, v] using patched_extrema_sum q F A xplus xminus p m hp hm
  have hBdiff :
      B.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (u j)) -
        B.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (v j)) ≤
      B.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) :=
    directed_response_sum_le_spans q F B u v
  have hTopTotal := hTop.2 competitor hCompetitorCard
  have hTopAB :
      B.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) ≤
        A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) := by
    have hcancel :
        selected.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) -
            competitor.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) =
          A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) -
            B.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) := by
      dsimp [A, B]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff_sub_sum_sdiff]
    linarith
  have hoscS : osc RS = RS xplus - RS xminus := by
    simp only [osc, ← hxplus, ← hxminus]
  have hRaw : osc RS - osc RT ≤
      2 * (A.card : ℝ) * delta -
        (A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) -
         B.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j))) := by
    rw [hoscS]
    linarith
  change osc RS / 2 - osc RT / 2 ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * delta -
    (A.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) -
     B.sum (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j))) / 2
  linarith



/-- Sum a common separation margin across equal-size exchanged sets. -/
theorem score_surplus_ge_card_mul_margin {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (A B : Finset I) (score : I → ℝ) (mu : ℝ) (hCard : A.card = B.card)
    (hMargin : ∀ i ∈ A, ∀ j ∈ B, mu + score j ≤ score i) :
    (A.card : ℝ) * mu ≤ A.sum score - B.sum score := by
  classical
  by_cases hB : B.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, hmax⟩ := B.exists_max_image score hB
    have ha : (A.card : ℝ) * (mu + score b) ≤ A.sum score := by
      calc _ = A.sum (fun _ => mu + score b) := by simp [mul_add]
           _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hMargin i hi b hb)
    have hbSum : B.sum score ≤ (A.card : ℝ) * score b := by
      calc _ ≤ B.sum (fun _ => score b) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => hmax j hj)
           _ = _ := by simp [hCard]
    nlinarith
  · have hBe : B = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hB
    have hAe : A = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [hBe] using hCard)
    simp [hAe, hBe]

/-- Universal margin-sensitive exchange bound; no symmetry or fixed cell assumed. -/
theorem pair_doubled_loss_le_card_mul_two_delta_sub_margin {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (delta mu : ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hDeltaNonneg : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hdelta : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (selected competitor : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore
      (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) selected k)
    (hCompetitorCard : competitor.card = k)
    (hMargin : ∀ i ∈ selected, ∀ j ∉ selected,
      mu + osc (productResponse q F j) ≤ osc (productResponse q F i)) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected -
      productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) competitor) ≤
      ((selected \ competitor).card : ℝ) * (2 * delta - mu) := by
  have h := pair_loss_le_sdiff_card_sub_score_surplus q F delta hWeight hNorm
    hDeltaNonneg hdelta selected competitor k hTop hCompetitorCard
  have hc : (selected \ competitor).card = (competitor \ selected).card :=
    Finset.card_sdiff_comm (hTop.1.trans hCompetitorCard.symm)
  have hs := score_surplus_ge_card_mul_margin (selected \ competitor)
    (competitor \ selected) (fun j => osc (productResponse q F j)) mu hc
    (fun i hi j hj => hMargin i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).1 j (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2)
  nlinarith

end CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange
#print axioms CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange.pair_loss_le_sdiff_card_sub_score_surplus
#print axioms CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange.score_surplus_ge_card_mul_margin
#print axioms CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange.pair_doubled_loss_le_card_mul_two_delta_sub_margin

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6MatchingNeighborhoodV1.lean (48 dong)
import «LeanD6BoundaryNondegenerateV1»

/-! Positive neighborhood satisfying every phase and co-moving nuisance
condition in the local matching theorem, for all q >= 3. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6MatchingNeighborhood
open CIGAMF.P13.D6BoundaryNondegenerate CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
noncomputable section

theorem boundary_nuisance_strict (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    0 < (1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)) ∧
      (1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)) < 1 := by
  have h := boundary_strict_interval q hq
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hz := root_properties q (scale q) hq hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  have hz1 : root q (scale q) < 1 := by nlinarith [hz.1,hz.2.1]
  have hm1 : marginMax q < 1 := h.2.2.1.trans h.2.2.2
  constructor
  · exact mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith [hz.1])
  · have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz1 (show 0 < 1-marginMax q by linarith)
    nlinarith only [hmul,h.2.1]

/-- All feasibility premises of both matching bounds hold on one positive
interval. No unknown nuisance feasibility remains as an extra assumption. -/
theorem matching_neighborhood (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    ∃ eta : ℝ,0 < eta ∧ ∀ eps : ℝ,0 ≤ eps → eps ≤ eta →
      Interior q (1-marginMax q) ∧
      Interior q (1-(marginMax q-eps)) ∧
      1/2 ≤ marginMax q-eps ∧ marginMax q+eps ≤ marginHigh q ∧
      eps ≤ 1-(1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)) ∧
      eps ≤ (1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)) := by
  obtain ⟨eta,he,hlocal⟩ := positive_two_sided_neighborhood q hq
  have hn := boundary_nuisance_strict q hq
  refine ⟨min eta (min (1-(1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)))
    ((1-marginMax q)*(1+root q (scale q)))),
    lt_min he (lt_min (by linarith) hn.1),?_⟩
  intro eps hp hb
  have heps := hb.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hnu := hb.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hphase := hlocal eps hp heps
  exact ⟨boundary_interior q hq,hphase.1,hphase.2.1,hphase.2.2,
    hnu.trans (min_le_left _ _),hnu.trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩

#print axioms boundary_nuisance_strict
#print axioms matching_neighborhood
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6MatchingNeighborhood

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6MovingNuisanceRegretV1.lean (156 dong)
import «LeanD6GaussianQueryDominanceV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginSharpV1»

/-! Move true and nuisance margins together. For adjacent label worlds the
relative query slope is at most one, independent of q. This removes the q^2
curvature penalty in the earlier fixed-nuisance regret separation bound. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6MovingNuisanceRegret
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem adjacent_center_witness (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ others A j,
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam)
        (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q))) e) ≤ rate q lam := by
  let z := root q (scale q)
  let nu := 1-lam*(1+z)
  let L := fun a b => ∑ e ∈ E, w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e
  have hbound : 2*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤ q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q) := by
    have he : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) =
        ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
          information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e) := by
      dsimp [L]
      simp_rw [mul_sum]
      calc
        _ = ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ e ∈ E, ∑ b ∈ others A j,
            w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (1-lam) nu e := by
          apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
          exact sum_comm
        _ = _ := sum_comm
    rw [he,mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, w e*(q*(q+1)*lam^2*value q (scale q)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_margin_bound A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB e (hlegal e he)) (hw e he)
        dsimp [nu,z]
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hnorm,one_mul]
  have hAnon : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A.card by linarith))
  have hBnon : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < (others A j).card by linarith))
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ others A j, L a b) ≤
      ∑ _a ∈ A, ∑ _b ∈ others A j, rate q lam := by
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hA,hB]
    unfold rate
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hal⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hAnon hsum
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbl⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hBnon hal
  exact ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hbl⟩

lemma information_eq_mean (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (e : Measurement n) : information A A' j mu nu e =
      (actualMean A j mu e-actualMean A' j nu e)^2/2 := by
  cases e <;> rfl

theorem adjacent_relative_slope (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (e : Measurement n) :
    (meanSlope A j e-meanSlope (swapped A a b) j e)^2 ≤ 1 := by
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i
      simp [meanSlope,hj,swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb]
    · simp only [meanSlope,hij,↓reduceIte]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | inr p =>
    simp only [meanSlope,swapped_query_count A p.1 j a b hj ha hb]
    have hid : (-(((p.1 ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit p.2)-
        -(((p.1 ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)+hit p.1 a-hit p.1 b-bit p.2))^2 =
        (hit p.1 a-hit p.1 b)^2 := by ring
    rw [hid]
    unfold hit
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem moving_information_midpoint (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (mu nu eps q : ℝ)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    information A A' j (mu-eps) (nu-eps) e+
      information A A' j (mu+eps) (nu+eps) e =
      2*information A A' j mu nu e+eps^2*(meanSlope A j e-meanSlope A' j e)^2 := by
  simp_rw [information_eq_mean,actual_mean_affine A j hj q _ e he,
    actual_mean_affine A' j hj' q _ e he]
  ring

theorem adjacent_allocation_midpoint (A : Finset (I n)) (j a b : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ others A j) (mu nu eps q : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (mu-eps) (nu-eps) e)+
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (mu+eps) (nu+eps) e) ≤
      2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e)+eps^2 := by
  have hs : (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (mu-eps) (nu-eps) e)+
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j (mu+eps) (nu+eps) e) ≤
      ∑ e ∈ E,w e*(2*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e+eps^2) := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro e he
    have hm := moving_information_midpoint A (swapped A a b) j hj
      (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) mu nu eps q e (hl e he)
    have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (adjacent_relative_slope A j a b hj ha hb e) (sq_nonneg eps)
    have hh : information A (swapped A a b) j (mu-eps) (nu-eps) e+
        information A (swapped A a b) j (mu+eps) (nu+eps) e ≤
        2*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e+eps^2 := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (hw e he)]
  have heq : (∑ e ∈ E,w e*(2*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e+eps^2)) =
      2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e)+eps^2 := by
    simp_rw [mul_add]
    rw [sum_add_distrib]
    have h1 : (∑ e ∈ E,w e*(2*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e)) =
        2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu nu e) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro e he
      ring
    rw [h1,← sum_mul,hn,one_mul]
  rwa [heq] at hs

/-- Actual legal alternative margins on both sides, with a dimension-free
second-order information correction. -/
theorem moving_adversary_two_margin (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam eps : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hlo : eps ≤ 1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (hup : eps ≤ lam*(1+root q (scale q)))
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧
      0 ≤ nu-eps ∧ nu+eps ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)-eps) (nu-eps) e)+
        (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)+eps) (nu+eps) e) ≤
        2*rate q lam+eps^2 := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hcenter⟩ := adjacent_center_witness A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
  have hm := adjacent_allocation_midpoint A j a b hj ha hb (1-lam)
    (1-lam*(1+root q (scale q))) eps q E w hl hw hn
  exact ⟨swapped A a b,1-lam*(1+root q (scale q)),swapped_ne A j a b hb,
    swapped_card A j a b ha hb,swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,
    by linarith,by linarith,by linarith⟩

#print axioms adjacent_center_witness
#print axioms adjacent_relative_slope
#print axioms moving_information_midpoint
#print axioms adjacent_allocation_midpoint
#print axioms moving_adversary_two_margin
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6MovingNuisanceRegret

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6MultiEpochCompositionV1.lean (170 dong)
import Mathlib

/-! # What splitting into epochs costs

`LeanD6BudgetRegretTradeoffV1` bounds ONE epoch against a total budget.  The
adaptive algorithm runs many, because revalidation and tracking need them, so
the next question is what the composition costs.

This module answers the arithmetic half exactly.  Writing `epochBound q V` for
the one-epoch estimation bound at usable budget `V`, splitting a total usable
budget `T` across a finite set of epochs gives

  `card^2 * epochBound q T  <=  sum of epochBound q (U i)`,

with equality exactly at the equal split.  So `E` epochs cost `E^2` times one
epoch at the same total budget: the penalty is quadratic in the number of
epochs, not linear, and no allocation across epochs avoids it.  The escalating
revalidation term goes the other way and sums geometrically: with `s_e = s0+e`
rounds, the whole wrong-label series is at most `(4/3)` times its first term.

Together (`multi_epoch_total`): at the equal split,

  `sum_e [ estimation + label ]  <=  E^2 * epochBound q T + (4/3)*W*4^(-s0)`.

The mechanism of the `E^2` is elementary and worth naming: the estimation bound
is proportional to `1/U`, and `sum 1/U_i` is minimised, subject to `sum U_i = T`,
at `U_i = T/E`, where it equals `E^2/T`.  The proof uses the tangent line to
`1/x` at `T/E` rather than any inequality by name, so it is self-contained.

## What this does NOT establish

`split_penalty` bounds a SUM OF PER-EPOCH BOUNDS, not the regret of an adaptive
algorithm.  Summing the per-epoch expectations of
`LeanD6GrowingUnknownLabelPhaseRiskV1` requires that bound to hold CONDITIONALLY
on the history of earlier epochs -- a tower-property argument on a filtration
that does not exist yet in this corpus, since the existing theorem is stated for
one epoch on a fixed product measure.  Until that is built, the inequalities
here say what the composition WOULD cost, not what an adaptive run does cost.

Also absent, and not to be read in: phase-interval learning and boundary
crossings, the discovery/cyclic cost accounting across epochs, expected stopping
time, and the `Gamma` rate.  The `E^2` law is a reason to keep the epoch count
small, not a termination theorem.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6MultiEpochComposition
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
noncomputable section

/-- One-epoch estimation bound at usable budget `V`, from
`LeanD6BudgetRegretTradeoffV1.budget_regret_tradeoff`. -/
def epochBound (q V : ℝ) : ℝ := 128*(2*q+1)^2/(V*q^6)

/-- The tangent line to `1/x` at `1/a` lies below it on the positive reals.
This is the whole content of the splitting law; `(a*x-1)^2 >= 0` is the proof. -/
lemma tangent_inv (x a : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : 2*a-a^2*x ≤ 1/x := by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hx]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a*x-1)]

/-- Subject to a fixed total, the sum of reciprocals is at least `card^2/T`. -/
theorem split_penalty {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (U : ι → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < U i) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, U i = T) :
    ((s.card : ℝ))^2/T ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, 1/U i := by
  have hTne : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  have key : ∀ i ∈ s, 2*((s.card:ℝ)/T)-((s.card:ℝ)/T)^2*U i ≤ 1/U i := by
    intro i hi
    exact tangent_inv (U i) ((s.card:ℝ)/T) (hU i hi)
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum key
  have hl : ∑ i ∈ s, (2*((s.card:ℝ)/T)-((s.card:ℝ)/T)^2*U i) = ((s.card:ℝ))^2/T := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp <;> ring
  rwa [hl] at h

/-- The equal split attains it, so the bound of `split_penalty` is sharp. -/
theorem equal_split_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hc : 0 < s.card) :
    ∑ _i ∈ s, 1/(T/(s.card:ℝ)) = ((s.card:ℝ))^2/T := by
  have hcR : (0:ℝ) < (s.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hcne : (s.card:ℝ) ≠ 0 := hcR.ne'
  have hTne : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp <;> ring

/-- `E` epochs cost `E^2` times one epoch at the same total usable budget, and
no allocation across epochs does better.  This is optimality of the BOUND over
splits, not a lower bound on regret. -/
theorem epoch_split_law {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (U : ι → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < U i) (T q : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, U i = T) :
    ((s.card:ℝ))^2*epochBound q T ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, epochBound q (U i) := by
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
  have hq6 : (0:ℝ) < q^6 := pow_pos hq0 6
  have hTne : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  have hK : (0:ℝ) ≤ 128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6 := by
    apply div_nonneg _ hq6.le
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2*q+1)]
  have hsp := split_penalty s U hU T hT hsum
  have hsum2 : ∑ i ∈ s, epochBound q (U i)
      = (128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6)*∑ i ∈ s, 1/U i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
    have hUi : U i ≠ 0 := (hU i hi).ne'
    unfold epochBound
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hb : epochBound q T = (128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6)*(1/T) := by
    unfold epochBound; field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hsum2, hb]
  calc ((s.card:ℝ))^2*((128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6)*(1/T))
      = (128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6)*(((s.card:ℝ))^2/T) := by ring
    _ ≤ (128*(2*q+1)^2/q^6)*∑ i ∈ s, 1/U i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsp hK

/-! ## The revalidation series goes the other way -/

theorem quarter_geom (E : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, ((1:ℝ)/4)^e = (4/3)*(1-((1:ℝ)/4)^E) := by
  induction E with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, pow_succ]
    ring

/-- Escalating the revalidation rounds as `s_e = s0+e` makes the whole
wrong-label series at most `4/3` times its first term, for every horizon. -/
theorem escalating_label_total (W : ℝ) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (s0 E : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, W/(4:ℝ)^(s0+e) ≤ (4/3)*(W/(4:ℝ)^s0) := by
  have h4 : (0:ℝ) < (4:ℝ)^s0 := by positivity
  have hc : 0 ≤ W/(4:ℝ)^s0 := div_nonneg hW h4.le
  have hrw : ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, W/(4:ℝ)^(s0+e)
      = (W/(4:ℝ)^s0)*∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, ((1:ℝ)/4)^e := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
    rw [pow_add, div_pow]
    field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hrw, quarter_geom]
  have hx : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((1:ℝ)/4)^E := by positivity
  nlinarith [hc, hx]

/-! ## The composition, at the equal split -/

/-- Total over `E` equal epochs: the estimation half pays `E^2`, the
revalidation half is a convergent series. -/
theorem multi_epoch_total (E : ℕ) (hE : 0 < E) (q T W : ℝ) (hq : 8 ≤ q)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (s0 : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, (epochBound q (T/(E:ℝ))+W/(4:ℝ)^(s0+e))
      ≤ (E:ℝ)^2*epochBound q T+(4/3)*(W/(4:ℝ)^s0) := by
  have hER : (0:ℝ) < (E:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  have hEne : (E:ℝ) ≠ 0 := hER.ne'
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
  have hTne : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hest : ∑ _e ∈ Finset.range E, epochBound q (T/(E:ℝ))
      = (E:ℝ)^2*epochBound q T := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    unfold epochBound
    field_simp <;> ring
  rw [hest]
  have hlab := escalating_label_total W hW s0 E
  linarith

#print axioms tangent_inv
#print axioms split_penalty
#print axioms equal_split_sum
#print axioms epoch_split_law
#print axioms quarter_geom
#print axioms escalating_label_total
#print axioms multi_epoch_total
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6MultiEpochComposition

import Mathlib

/-!
# Correct normalized statement of the balanced D6 target

The legacy `BalancedDecisionInteractionBound` omitted the reference-weight
premises and is refuted in `LeanD6BalancedLawCounterexampleV1`.  This module
states the scientifically intended normalized target and proves that it is
exactly the only missing branch of the normalized all-cell law.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6NormalizedBalancedTarget

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DecisionInteractionComplexity

universe u

def NormalizedBalancedDecisionInteractionBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Type u) [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U),
    (∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c) →
    (∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) →
    cell.BalancedComplement →
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n

def NormalizedAllDecisionInteractionBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Type u) [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U),
    (∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight cell.q c) →
    (∑ c, jointWeight cell.q c = 1) →
    DecisionInteractionConstantAtMost cell n

/-- Non-balanced cells are already closed; therefore the normalized global
law is logically equivalent to its balanced-complement restriction. -/
theorem normalized_all_iff_balanced :
    NormalizedAllDecisionInteractionBound.{u} ↔
      NormalizedBalancedDecisionInteractionBound.{u} := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold NormalizedAllDecisionInteractionBound at h
    unfold NormalizedBalancedDecisionInteractionBound
    intro n U _ _ cell hWeight hNorm hBalanced
    exact h n U cell hWeight hNorm
  · intro h
    unfold NormalizedBalancedDecisionInteractionBound at h
    unfold NormalizedAllDecisionInteractionBound
    intro n U _ _ cell hWeight hNorm
    apply all_cells_bound_of_balanced_cells
      (fun candidate candidateWeight candidateNorm candidateBalanced =>
        h n U candidate candidateWeight candidateNorm candidateBalanced)
      cell hWeight hNorm

end CIGAMF.P13.D6NormalizedBalancedTarget

def a4t (a b c d : Fin 3) : Fin 4 → Fin 3 := ![a, b, c, d]
def z4t : Fin 4 → Fin 3 := a4t 0 0 0 0

@[simp] theorem a4t_apply_zero (a b c d : Fin 3) : a4t a b c d 0 = a := by rfl
@[simp] theorem a4t_apply_one (a b c d : Fin 3) : a4t a b c d 1 = b := by rfl
@[simp] theorem a4t_apply_two (a b c d : Fin 3) : a4t a b c d 2 = c := by rfl
@[simp] theorem a4t_apply_three (a b c d : Fin 3) : a4t a b c d 3 = d := by rfl

def pointMassTernary4 (_i : Fin 4) (u : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  if u = 0 then 1 else 0

/-- A concrete normal form for changing one coordinate of the point-mass
anchor.  Keeping it separate avoids unfolding `Function.update` inside every
finite table calculation. -/
def ternaryInsertAtZero4 (i : Fin 4) (u : Fin 3) : Fin 4 → Fin 3 :=
  match i with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => a4t u 0 0 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => a4t 0 u 0 0
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => a4t 0 0 u 0
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => a4t 0 0 0 u

private theorem update_z4t_normal_form (i : Fin 4) (u : Fin 3) :
    Function.update z4t i u = ternaryInsertAtZero4 i u := by
  funext j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [z4t, a4t, ternaryInsertAtZero4, Function.update, Fin.mk.injEq]

/-- The exact 81-cell integer LP witness, explicitly branched so that finite

    else
      if x 2 = 0 then

        if x 3 = 0 then 0 else if x 3 = 1 then (-1 : ℝ) else 0

/- Named selector lookups are intentionally kept separate from the 81-cell

def ternaryBalancedCell4 : ActiveDecisionCell 3 (Fin 3) where
  q := pointMassTernary4
  selected := ternarySelected4
  competitor := ternaryCompetitor4
  selectedMax := ternarySelectedMax4
  selectedMin := ternarySelectedMin4
  competitorMax := ternaryCompetitorMax4
  competitorMin := ternaryCompetitorMin4
