########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PairContractionKernelV1.lean (111 dong)
import «LeanD6PairContractionCounterexample»

/-!
# Kernel-checked replacement for the two `native_decide` steps of the pair-contraction counterexample

`LeanD6PairContractionCounterexample` proves the uniform mixed-difference bound
`|mixedDifferenceZ i x c| <= 13` and one closed evaluation by `native_decide`,
which records its answer through the axiom `Lean.ofReduceBool`.  That bound is
not auxiliary: the module's headline theorem
`pair_contraction_route_killed_exact` consumes it directly, so the headline was
a COMPILED ARTIFACT rather than PROVED.

Nothing is deleted.  Both facts are integer arithmetic on a four-coordinate
binary domain, so they are re-proved here by kernel `decide`, and the two
statements that depend on them are repeated.

Scale of the kernel work: `Fin 4 -> Fin 2` has 16 elements, so the uniform
bound is `4 * 16 * 16 = 1024` leaf checks, each walking the depth-four integer
decision tree `pcWorld4Z` four times.  The enumeration is split by the
coordinate index into four theorems of 256 leaves, so that a kernel failure
localises to one index instead of the whole bound.  The closed evaluation is a
single leaf.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PairContractionKernel

open scoped BigOperators Matrix
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V6.FunctionalRanking
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PairContractionCounterexample

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-! ## The uniform mixed-difference bound, one coordinate at a time -/

theorem mdz_bound_zero : ∀ x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2, |mixedDifferenceZ 0 x c| ≤ 13 := by
  decide

theorem mdz_bound_one : ∀ x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2, |mixedDifferenceZ 1 x c| ≤ 13 := by
  decide

theorem mdz_bound_two : ∀ x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2, |mixedDifferenceZ 2 x c| ≤ 13 := by
  decide

theorem mdz_bound_three : ∀ x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2, |mixedDifferenceZ 3 x c| ≤ 13 := by
  decide

theorem mixedDifferenceZ_le_thirteen_kernel
    (i : Fin 4) (x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    |mixedDifferenceZ i x c| ≤ 13 := by
  fin_cases i
  · exact mdz_bound_zero x c
  · exact mdz_bound_one x c
  · exact mdz_bound_two x c
  · exact mdz_bound_three x c

/-! ## The cast to the real-valued mixed difference -/

theorem mixedDifference_eq_cast_kernel
    (i : Fin 4) (x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    mixedDifference pcWorld4 i x c = (mixedDifferenceZ i x c : ℝ) := by
  simp [mixedDifference, mixedDifferenceZ, pcWorld4]

theorem mixedDifference_le_thirteen_kernel
    (i : Fin 4) (x c : Fin 4 → Fin 2) :
    |mixedDifference pcWorld4 i x c| ≤ 13 := by
  have hz := mixedDifferenceZ_le_thirteen_kernel i x c
  rw [mixedDifference_eq_cast_kernel]
  exact_mod_cast hz

/-- Sharpness: the bound 13 is attained, so it is the exact modulus and not a
convenient over-estimate. -/
theorem mixedDifference_attains_thirteen_kernel :
    |mixedDifference pcWorld4 0 (action4 0 0 0 0) (action4 1 1 0 1)| = 13 := by
  rw [mixedDifference_eq_cast_kernel]
  have hz : mixedDifferenceZ 0 (action4 0 0 0 0) (action4 1 1 0 1) = (13 : ℤ) := by
    decide
  rw [hz]
  norm_num

/-! ## The headline conclusion, with no `Lean.ofReduceBool` in its dependencies -/

theorem pair_contraction_route_killed_exact_kernel :
    IsTopKByScore (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse pointMass4 pcWorld4 j))
        selected 2 ∧
    productCompressionLoss pcWorld4 (productResponse pointMass4 pcWorld4)
        selected -
      productCompressionLoss pcWorld4 (productResponse pointMass4 pcWorld4)
        competitor = 13 ∧
    (∀ i x c, |mixedDifference pcWorld4 i x c| ≤ 13) ∧
    (17 - 4 ≤ (3 : ℝ) * 13 / 2) ∧
    17 - 4 > 13 + (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    17 - 4 > 13 + (-1 : ℝ) := by
  refine ⟨selected_is_topC, ?_, mixedDifference_le_thirteen_kernel, by norm_num,
    by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  rw [selected_loss, competitor_loss]
  norm_num

#print axioms mdz_bound_zero
#print axioms mdz_bound_one
#print axioms mdz_bound_two
#print axioms mdz_bound_three
#print axioms mixedDifferenceZ_le_thirteen_kernel
#print axioms mixedDifference_le_thirteen_kernel
#print axioms mixedDifference_attains_thirteen_kernel
#print axioms pair_contraction_route_killed_exact_kernel

end CIGAMF.P13.D6PairContractionKernel

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PartialLabelPhaseQueryV1.lean (65 dong)
import «LeanD6GaussianQueryDominanceV1»

/-! Margin learning need not know the complete hidden label: any certified
subset of B supplies a label-invariant legal Gaussian experiment. In the
one-unresolved-swap construction it has size q-1, hence sensitivity q-1. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PartialLabelPhaseQuery
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseTestingInformation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem common_B_query (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q d mu : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hG : G ⊆ others A j) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ)=d)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    Legal j q (.inr (G,false)) ∧ actualMean A j mu (.inr (G,false))=1+d-d*mu := by
  have hjG : j ∉ G := by
    intro h
    have hh := hG h
    simpa [others] using hh
  have hn : 2 ≤ G.card := by exact_mod_cast (show (2:ℝ) ≤ G.card by linarith)
  have he : G ∩ others A j=G := inter_eq_left.mpr hG
  refine ⟨⟨hjG,by linarith,by intro _;exact hn⟩,?_⟩
  change world A j mu (query G j false)=_
  rw [actual_query_mean A G j false hj hjG (by intro _;exact hn),he,hsize]
  simp only [bit_false,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,sub_zero]
  ring

theorem common_B_information (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q d mu nu : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hG : G ⊆ others A j) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ)=d)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    information A A j mu nu (.inr (G,false))=d^2*(mu-nu)^2/2 := by
  have hl := (common_B_query A G j q d mu hj hG hsize hd hdq).1
  change queryKL A A G j false mu nu=_
  rw [same_set_joint_information A G j false hj hl.1 hl.2.2,
    inter_eq_left.mpr hG,hsize]
  simp only [bit_false,sub_zero]
  ring

/-- Simultaneously valid for every still-possible label, using exactly the same
query G. The Gaussian observation law therefore does not reveal which such
label is true, while retaining sensitivity equal to the certified B core. -/
theorem unresolved_family_phase_law (W : Finset (Finset (I n))) (G : Finset (I n))
    (j : I n) (q d : ℝ) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ)=d) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q)
    (hj : ∀ A ∈ W,j ∉ A) (hcommon : ∀ A ∈ W,G ⊆ others A j) :
    ∀ A ∈ W,∀ mu : ℝ,
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (actualMean A j mu (.inr (G,false))) 1 =
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (1+d-d*mu) 1 := by
  intro A hA mu
  rw [(common_B_query A G j q d mu (hj A hA) (hcommon A hA) hsize hd hdq).2]

/-- Losing one known B coordinate changes squared sensitivity from q² to
(q-1)², with the exact relative loss displayed. -/
theorem one_swap_information_ratio (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (q-1)^2/q^2=1-2/q+1/q^2 := by
  field_simp [hq]
  <;> ring

#print axioms common_B_query
#print axioms common_B_information
#print axioms unresolved_family_phase_law
#print axioms one_swap_information_ratio
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PartialLabelPhaseQuery

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseBoundaryRegretV1.lean (125 dong)
import «LeanD6PhaseTestingInformationV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginSharpV1»

/-! A common actual-world dual controls allocation regret on BOTH sides of
an interior margin. This is the deterministic foundation of a local statistical
lower bound. No total-variation, Gaussian testing or stopping theorem is assumed.
The same alternative world and nuisance are used on both sides, after the full
allocation is fixed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseBoundaryRegret
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseTestingInformation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def curvature (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Measurement n → ℝ
  | .inl i => if i ∈ A then 0 else 1
  | .inr (G,h) => (((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)^2

theorem curvature_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) : curvature A j e ≤ q^2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => dsimp [curvature]; split_ifs <;> nlinarith
  | inr p => exact joint_sensitivity_bound A p.1 j p.2 q hq he.2.1

/-- Actual means are affine in the true margin; the exact second difference
of information is independent of the alternative world and nuisance. -/
theorem information_midpoint (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu epsilon nu q : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    information A A' j (mu-epsilon) nu e + information A A' j (mu+epsilon) nu e =
      2*information A A' j mu nu e+epsilon^2*curvature A j e := by
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    change scalarKL A A' j i (mu-epsilon) nu+scalarKL A A' j i (mu+epsilon) nu =
      2*scalarKL A A' j i mu nu+epsilon^2*(if i ∈ A then 0 else 1)
    unfold scalarKL
    rw [world_response A j hj,world_response A j hj,world_response A j hj]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ A
    · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,bit_true]
      <;> ring
    · by_cases hij : i=j
      · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,hj,hij,bit_true]
        <;> ring
      · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hi,hj,hij,bit_true]
        <;> ring
  | inr p =>
    change queryKL A A' p.1 j p.2 (mu-epsilon) nu+queryKL A A' p.1 j p.2 (mu+epsilon) nu =
      2*queryKL A A' p.1 j p.2 mu nu+epsilon^2*(((p.1 ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit p.2)^2
    unfold queryKL
    rw [actual_query_mean A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2,
      actual_query_mean A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2,
      actual_query_mean A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2]
    ring

theorem allocation_midpoint_upper (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (mu epsilon nu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) :
    (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j (mu-epsilon) nu e)+
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j (mu+epsilon) nu e) ≤
      2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e)+epsilon^2*q^2 := by
  have hsum : (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j (mu-epsilon) nu e)+
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j (mu+epsilon) nu e) =
      2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e)+
        epsilon^2*(∑ e ∈ E,w e*curvature A j e) := by
    simp_rw [mul_sum,← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro e he
    have hh := information_midpoint A A' j hj mu epsilon nu q e (hl e he)
    have hh' := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => w e*x) hh
    nlinarith [hh']
  have hb : (∑ e ∈ E,w e*curvature A j e) ≤ q^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,w e*q^2 := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (curvature_bound A j q hq e (hl e he)) (hw e he)
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hn,one_mul]
  rw [hsum]
  linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg epsilon)]

/-- One actual admissible alternative simultaneously bounds the sum of
information on both sides of every margin in the already proved interval. -/
theorem common_adversary_two_margin (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam epsilon : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)-epsilon) nu e)+
        (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)+epsilon) nu e) ≤
        2*rate q lam+epsilon^2*q^2 := by
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hcenter⟩ :=
    arbitrary_margin_allocation_upper A j q lam hq hI hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
  have hh := allocation_midpoint_upper A A' j q (by linarith) hj (1-lam) epsilon nu E w hl hw hn
  exact ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,by linarith⟩

/-- Substitute any two established achievable rates for Gminus/Gplus. This
is a lower bound against every legal allocation, with actual information
regrets witnessed by a single real alternative. -/
theorem common_adversary_regret_separation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q lam epsilon : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hI : Interior q lam) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1)
    (Gminus Gplus : ℝ) :
    ∃ A' : Finset (I n), ∃ nu : ℝ,
      A' ≠ A ∧ A'.card=A.card ∧ j ∉ A' ∧ 0 ≤ nu ∧ nu ≤ 1 ∧
      Gminus+Gplus-2*rate q lam-epsilon^2*q^2 ≤
      (Gminus-∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)-epsilon) nu e)+
      (Gplus-∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j ((1-lam)+epsilon) nu e) := by
  obtain ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,hbound⟩ :=
    common_adversary_two_margin A j q lam epsilon hq hI hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
  exact ⟨A',nu,hne,hcard,hj',hnu,hnu1,by linarith⟩

#print axioms curvature_bound
#print axioms information_midpoint
#print axioms allocation_midpoint_upper
#print axioms common_adversary_two_margin
#print axioms common_adversary_regret_separation
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseBoundaryRegret

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseShiftLipschitzV1.lean (90 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeParametersV1»

/-! An explicit finite-neighborhood modulus for the radical nuisance shift.
This controls the frozen-design oracle remainder without an asymptotic axiom. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseShiftLipschitz
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
noncomputable section

lemma unit_square_bound (x y eps : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |x-y| ≤ eps) :
    |x^2-y^2| ≤ 2*eps := by
  have hi : x^2-y^2=(x-y)*(x+y) := by ring
  rw [hi,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hx hy)]
  have h := mul_le_mul he (show x+y ≤ 2 by linarith) (add_nonneg hx hy) heps
  nlinarith only [h]

lemma radicand_difference_bound (q x y eps : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |x-y| ≤ eps) :
    |radicand q x-radicand q y| ≤ 2*(q*(q-1)+K q)*eps := by
  have ha : 0 ≤ q*(q-1) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hk := (K_pos q hq).le
  have hsq := unit_square_bound x y eps hx hx1 hy hy1 heps he
  have hcomp : |(1-x)-(1-y)| ≤ eps := by
    have heq : (1-x)-(1-y)= -(x-y) := by ring
    rwa [heq,abs_neg]
  have hsqc := unit_square_bound (1-x) (1-y) eps (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith) (by linarith) heps hcomp
  have hid : radicand q x-radicand q y=
      q*(q-1)*((1-x)^2-(1-y)^2)+K q*(x^2-y^2) := by unfold radicand; ring
  rw [hid]
  calc
    _ ≤ |q*(q-1)*((1-x)^2-(1-y)^2)|+|K q*(x^2-y^2)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = q*(q-1)* |(1-x)^2-(1-y)^2|+K q* |x^2-y^2| := by
      rw [abs_mul (q*(q-1)),abs_mul (K q),abs_of_nonneg ha,abs_of_nonneg hk]
    _ ≤ q*(q-1)*(2*eps)+K q*(2*eps) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqc ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hk)
    _ = _ := by ring

def radicalModulus (q mu0 : ℝ) := 2*(q*(q-1)+K q)/D q mu0
def shiftModulus (q mu0 : ℝ) := (q*(q-2)+radicalModulus q mu0)/K q

theorem radical_lipschitz (q mu mu0 eps : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hm : 0 < mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1) (hm0 : 0 < mu0) (hm01 : mu0 ≤ 1)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |mu-mu0| ≤ eps) :
    |D q mu-D q mu0| ≤ radicalModulus q mu0*eps := by
  have hd := radical_positive q mu hq hm
  have hd0 := radical_positive q mu0 hq hm0
  have hrad := radicand_difference_bound q mu mu0 eps hq hm.le hm1 hm0.le hm01 heps he
  have hi : (D q mu-D q mu0)*(D q mu+D q mu0)=radicand q mu-radicand q mu0 := by
    nlinarith only [radical_square q mu hq,radical_square q mu0 hq]
  have ha := congrArg abs hi
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (add_pos hd hd0)] at ha
  have hle : |D q mu-D q mu0| *D q mu0 ≤ 2*(q*(q-1)+K q)*eps := by
    have h := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (D q mu-D q mu0)) hd.le
    nlinarith only [ha,hrad,h]
  calc
    |D q mu-D q mu0| ≤ (2*(q*(q-1)+K q)*eps)/D q mu0 := (le_div_iff₀ hd0).mpr hle
    _ = radicalModulus q mu0*eps := by unfold radicalModulus; ring

theorem shift_lipschitz (q mu mu0 eps : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hm : 0 < mu) (hm1 : mu ≤ 1) (hm0 : 0 < mu0) (hm01 : mu0 ≤ 1)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (he : |mu-mu0| ≤ eps) :
    |shift q mu-shift q mu0| ≤ shiftModulus q mu0*eps := by
  have hk := K_pos q hq
  have hq2 : 0 ≤ q*(q-2) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hrad := radical_lipschitz q mu mu0 eps hq hm hm1 hm0 hm01 heps he
  have hi : K q*(shift q mu-shift q mu0)=
      -(q*(q-2)*(mu-mu0))-(D q mu-D q mu0) := by
    nlinarith only [rationalized_shift q mu hq hm hm1,rationalized_shift q mu0 hq hm0 hm01]
  have ha := congrArg abs hi
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos hk] at ha
  have hb : K q* |shift q mu-shift q mu0| ≤ (q*(q-2)+radicalModulus q mu0)*eps := by
    rw [ha]
    calc
      _ ≤ |-(q*(q-2)*(mu-mu0))|+|D q mu-D q mu0| := abs_sub _ _
      _ = q*(q-2)* |mu-mu0|+|D q mu-D q mu0| := by rw [abs_neg,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hq2]
      _ ≤ q*(q-2)*eps+radicalModulus q mu0*eps :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hq2) hrad
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    |shift q mu-shift q mu0| ≤ ((q*(q-2)+radicalModulus q mu0)*eps)/K q :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hk).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hb)
    _ = shiftModulus q mu0*eps := by unfold shiftModulus; ring

#print axioms radicand_difference_bound
#print axioms radical_lipschitz
#print axioms shift_lipschitz
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseShiftLipschitz

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseTestingInformationV1.lean (126 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationDualBridgeV1»

/-! Actual D6 information for learning the side of a margin threshold.
The hidden set is held fixed. These theorems identify the largest per-query
Gaussian squared-mean information, not a stopping-time or probability theorem.
The attaining query is B-off (not the B-on query used in allocation phase II).
Consequently a two-point gap 2*epsilon has four times the information of the
limit experiment from a point epsilon away to the phase boundary. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseTestingInformation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem same_set_joint_information (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    queryKL A A G j h mu nu =
      (mu-nu)^2 * (((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)^2 / 2 := by
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG,
    actual_query_mean A G j h hj hjG hG]
  ring

theorem same_set_scalar_information (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    scalarKL A A j i mu nu = if i ∈ A then 0 else (mu-nu)^2/2 := by
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj, world_response A j hj]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ A
  · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hi, bit_true]
  · by_cases hij : i=j
    · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hj, hij, bit_true]
    · simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope, hi, hij, bit_true]
      ring

theorem joint_sensitivity_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    (((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ)-bit h)^2 ≤ q^2 := by
  have hc0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (G ∩ others A j).card := by positivity
  have hc : ((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast card_le_card (inter_subset_left :
      G ∩ others A j ⊆ G)) hsize
  cases h <;> simp only [bit_false, bit_true] <;> nlinarith

/-- Every actual legal scalar or joint query has information at most q^2
 times the scalar Gaussian information when only the true margin changes. -/
theorem actual_information_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    information A A j mu nu e ≤ q^2*(mu-nu)^2/2 := by
  cases e with
  | inl i =>
    change scalarKL A A j i mu nu ≤ _
    rw [same_set_scalar_information A j i hj mu nu]
    split_ifs
    · positivity
    · have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (show (1:ℝ) ≤ q^2 by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg (mu-nu))
      nlinarith
  | inr p =>
    change queryKL A A p.1 j p.2 mu nu ≤ _
    rw [same_set_joint_information A p.1 j p.2 hj he.1 he.2.2 mu nu]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (joint_sensitivity_bound A p.1 j p.2 q hq he.2.1) (sq_nonneg (mu-nu))
    nlinarith

/-- The maximum sensitivity is attained by the actual unanchored B query. -/
theorem B_off_attains (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (mu nu : ℝ) :
    Legal j q (.inr (others A j,false)) ∧
      information A A j mu nu (.inr (others A j,false)) = q^2*(mu-nu)^2/2 := by
  have hjB : j ∉ others A j := by simp [others]
  have hcard : 2 ≤ (others A j).card := by exact_mod_cast (show (2:ℝ) ≤ (others A j).card by linarith)
  refine ⟨⟨hjB,by linarith,by intro _; exact hcard⟩,?_⟩
  change queryKL A A (others A j) j false mu nu = _
  rw [same_set_joint_information A (others A j) j false hj hjB (by intro _; exact hcard) mu nu]
  simp only [inter_self,bit_false,sub_zero,hB]
  ring

/-- Two specified hypotheses on opposite sides, with separation 2*epsilon. -/
theorem separated_pair_information (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (boundary epsilon : ℝ) :
    information A A j (boundary-epsilon) (boundary+epsilon)
      (.inr (others A j,false)) = 2*q^2*epsilon^2 := by
  rw [(B_off_attains A j q hq hj hB _ _).2]
  ring

/-- The limit to the phase boundary has one quarter of the pair information.
This is the relevant information for a procedure correct for every nonzero gap. -/
theorem boundary_information (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (boundary epsilon : ℝ) :
    information A A j (boundary+epsilon) boundary
      (.inr (others A j,false)) = q^2*epsilon^2/2 := by
  rw [(B_off_attains A j q hq hj hB _ _).2]
  ring

/-- Mixing legal queries cannot improve on the attained margin information. -/
theorem every_allocation_information_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hj : j ∉ A) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E, Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E, 0 ≤ w e)
    (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E, w e=1) :
    (∑ e ∈ E, w e * information A A j mu nu e) ≤ q^2*(mu-nu)^2/2 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, w e * (q^2*(mu-nu)^2/2) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro e he
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (actual_information_upper A j q hq hj mu nu e (hlegal e he)) (hw e he)
    _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hnorm,one_mul]

#print axioms same_set_joint_information
#print axioms same_set_scalar_information
#print axioms actual_information_upper
#print axioms B_off_attains
#print axioms separated_pair_information
#print axioms boundary_information
#print axioms every_allocation_information_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseTestingInformation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseThreeDualV1.lean (233 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasibleV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginSharpV1»

/-! A dual certificate over every actual legal scalar and joint query in phase
III. The same adjacent adversary is selected after the whole allocation. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreeDual
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem endpoint_order (q z : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hu : z ≤ root q (scale q)) :
    q*(1+z)^2 ≤ (q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
  have hc := scale_properties q hq
  have hd : 0 < q-2+scale q := by linarith [hc.1]
  have hl := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hu
  have hleft : 0 ≤ scale q*(1+z) := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hc.1]) (by linarith)
  have hlinear : scale q*(1+z) ≤ 1-(q-2)*z := by linarith
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ hleft (le_trans hleft hlinear)).mpr hlinear
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith)
  have he := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t*(1+z)^2) hc.2.2
  nlinarith [hm,he]

theorem joint_envelope (q z s t : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hu : z ≤ root q (scale q)) (hsmall : 4*q*z ≤ 1)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hst : s+t ≤ q) :
    dual q z 0 s t ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 ∧
    dual q z 1 s t ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
  have ho := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (endpoint_order q z hq hz hu)
    (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
  have hA0 : dual q z 0 q 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
    have he : dual q z 0 q 0=q^2*(1+z)^2 := by unfold dual; ring
    rw [he]
    nlinarith [ho]
  have hA1 : dual q z 1 q 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
    have hp := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
      (show 0 ≤ (q-1)*z^2+2*q*z from add_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg z)) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hz))
    have he : dual q z 0 q 0-dual q z 1 q 0=q*((q-1)*z^2+2*q*z) := by unfold dual; ring
    linarith
  have hB1 : dual q z 1 0 q=q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by unfold dual; ring
  have hB0 : dual q z 0 0 q ≤ q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
    have hp := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q*(q+1)*z by positivity)
      (show 0 ≤ 2-(2*q-3)*z by nlinarith)
    have he : dual q z 1 0 q-dual q z 0 0 q=q*(q+1)*z*(2-(2*q-3)*z) := by unfold dual; ring
    linarith
  exact ⟨dual_envelope q z 0 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    hs ht hst hA0 hB0,
    dual_envelope q z 1 s t _ hq hz hsmall (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hs ht hst hA1 hB1.le⟩

theorem phase_nuisance (q mu : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q) :
    0 < 1-mu ∧ 0 ≤ mu-shift q mu ∧ mu-shift q mu ≤ 1 ∧
      0 ≤ shift q mu/(1-mu) ∧ shift q mu/(1-mu) ≤ root q (scale q) ∧
      4*q*(shift q mu/(1-mu)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hd : 0 < 1+Real.sqrt q := by positivity
  have hhigh : marginHigh q < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).mpr (by linarith)
  have hl : 0 < 1-mu := by linarith
  have hs : shift q mu ≤ mu := by nlinarith [hb.2.2.1,hb.2.2.2]
  refine ⟨hl,by linarith,by linarith [hb.2.1,hb.2.2.1],
    div_nonneg hb.2.2.1 hl.le,?_,?_⟩
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hl).mpr
    have he := shift_le_boundary_tilt q mu hq (by linarith [hb.1]) hb.2.1 hlo
    simpa [tilt,mul_comm] using he
  · rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hl).mpr
    simpa using hb.2.2.2

theorem actual_joint_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (hsize : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu (mu-shift q mu)) ≤
        q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) := by
  let z := shift q mu/(1-mu)
  have hn := phase_nuisance q mu hq hlo hup
  have hmu : 1-(1-mu)=mu := by ring
  have hnu : 1-(1-mu)*(1+z)=mu-shift q mu := by
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hn.1]
    <;> ring
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu (mu-shift q mu)) =
      4*(1-mu)^2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
    have hh := joint_homogeneity A (swapped A a b) G j h hj
      (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG (1-mu) (1+z)
    simpa only [hmu,hnu] using hh
  rw [he]
  have he' := actual_dual_sum A G j h q z hj hA hB hjG hG
  have hcnt : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card ≤ q := by
    have hh : ((G ∩ A).card : ℝ)+(G ∩ others A j).card=G.card := by
      exact_mod_cast query_count_partition A G j hjG
    linarith
  have heq : 2*(4*(1-mu)^2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1-(1+z)/2))) =
      (1-mu)^2*dual q z (bit h) (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card := by
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (1-mu)^2*t) he']
  rw [heq]
  have hb := joint_envelope q z (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card hq
    hn.2.2.2.1 hn.2.2.2.2.1 hn.2.2.2.2.2 (by positivity) (by positivity) hcnt
  have hb' : dual q z (bit h) (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card ≤
      q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2 := by
    cases h <;> simp only [bit_false,bit_true] <;> first | exact hb.1 | exact hb.2
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb' (sq_nonneg (1-mu))
  have hbal := balance q mu hq (by linarith [(phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup).1])
    (phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup).2.1
  have hzid : (1-mu)^2*(1-(q-2)*z)^2=((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2 := by
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hn.1]
    <;> ring
  have htarget : (1-mu)^2*(q*(q+1)*(1-(q-2)*z)^2) =
      q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) := by
    calc
      _ = (q+1)*(q*((1-mu)-(q-2)*shift q mu)^2) := by rw [← hzid]; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hbal]; unfold gammaTwice; field_simp [show q ≠ 0 by linarith]
  exact htarget ▸ hm

theorem actual_scalar_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      scalarKL A (swapped A a b) j i mu (mu-shift q mu)) ≤
        q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) := by
  let z := shift q mu/(1-mu)
  have hn := phase_nuisance q mu hq hlo hup
  have hb := phase_shift_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hmu : 1-(1-mu)=mu := by ring
  have hnu : 1-(1-mu)*(1+z)=mu-shift q mu := by
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hn.1]
    <;> ring
  have hz : (1-mu)^2*z^2=(shift q mu)^2 := by
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hn.1]
    <;> ring
  have he := actual_scalar_margin_sum A j i hj (1-mu) z
  rw [hmu,hnu,hA,hB] at he
  have he2 : (1-mu)^2*z^2=(shift q mu)^2 := hz
  simp only [mul_assoc] at he
  have he3 : (1-mu)^2*(z*z)=shift q mu*shift q mu := by nlinarith [hz]
  have ht : q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) =
      (q+1)*(mu^2+(q-1)*(shift q mu)^2) := by
    unfold gammaTwice; field_simp [show q ≠ 0 by linarith]
  rw [ht,he]
  have hs : (mu-shift q mu)^2 ≤ mu^2 := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ hn.2.1 (by linarith [hb.1])).mpr
    linarith [hb.2.2.1]
  have hs' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0 ≤ q by linarith)
  have hsmall : shift q mu ≤ mu := by linarith [hn.2.1]
  have hshift : (shift q mu)^2 ≤ mu^2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hb.2.2.1 (by linarith [hb.1])).mpr hsmall
  split_ifs
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q^2-1 by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg (shift q mu))]
  · nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (q+1)*q*t) hz,
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hshift)]
  · nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (q+1)*(q-1)*t) hz]

theorem measurement_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (e : Measurement n) (he : Legal j q e) :
    2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
      information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) ≤
        q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) := by
  cases e with
  | inl i => exact actual_scalar_bound A j i q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB
  | inr p => exact actual_joint_bound A p.1 j p.2 q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB he.1 he.2.2 he.2.1

theorem allocation_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hlegal : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hnorm : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ a ∈ A,∃ b ∈ others A j,
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) ≤
        gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2 := by
  let L := fun a b => ∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e
  have he : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b) =
      ∑ e ∈ E,w e*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e) := by
    dsimp [L]; simp_rw [mul_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ a ∈ A,∑ e ∈ E,∑ b ∈ others A j,
          w e*information A (swapped A a b) j mu (mu-shift q mu) e := by
        apply sum_congr rfl; intro a ha; exact sum_comm
      _ = _ := sum_comm
  have hb : 2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b) ≤
      q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu) := by
    rw [he,mul_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,w e*(q*(q+1)*gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum; intro e he
        have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (measurement_bound A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB e (hlegal e he)) (hw e he)
        nlinarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← sum_mul,hnorm,one_mul]
  have hAnon : A.Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A.card by linarith))
  have hBnon : (others A j).Nonempty := card_pos.mp
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < (others A j).card by linarith))
  have hs : (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,L a b) ≤
      ∑ _a ∈ A,∑ _b ∈ others A j,gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2 := by
    simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hA,hB]
    linarith [hb]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hal⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hAnon hs
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbl⟩ := exists_le_of_sum_le hBnon hal
  exact ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hbl⟩

#print axioms endpoint_order
#print axioms joint_envelope
#print axioms phase_nuisance
#print axioms actual_joint_bound
#print axioms actual_scalar_bound
#print axioms measurement_bound
#print axioms allocation_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreeDual

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseThreePrimalV1.lean (152 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasibleV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! The phase-III design, represented on the actual finite measurement library.
The lower bound is uniform over every same-size hidden alternative and every
real nuisance margin. No formula for the actual information is assumed. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedMeasurements
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPrimalBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem actual_scalar_B_point (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hi : i ∈ others A j) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*scalarKL A A' j i mu nu =
      (nu-mu)^2+(mu^2-(nu-mu)^2)*hit A' i := by
  have hh := others_not_mem A j i hi
  unfold scalarKL
  rw [world_response A j hj,world_response A' j hj']
  by_cases hi' : i ∈ A' <;>
    simp [CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.slope,hh.1,hh.2,hi',hit,bit_true] <;> ring

theorem actual_scalar_B_sum (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ i ∈ others A j,scalarKL A A' j i mu nu) =
      (A \ A').card*mu^2+(((others A j).card : ℝ)-(A \ A').card)*(nu-mu)^2 := by
  rw [mul_sum]
  have he : (∑ i ∈ others A j,2*scalarKL A A' j i mu nu) =
      ∑ i ∈ others A j,((nu-mu)^2+(mu^2-(nu-mu)^2)*hit A' i) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact actual_scalar_B_point A A' j i hj hj' hi mu nu
  rw [he]
  simp only [sum_add_distrib,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,← mul_sum,sum_hit]
  rw [intersection_others A' A j hj',card_sdiff_comm hcard]
  ring

theorem actual_Bon_KL (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    2*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu =
      ((1-mu)*((others A j).card-1)-
        (1-nu)*((others A j).card-(A \ A').card-1))^2 := by
  have hjB : j ∉ others A j := by simp [others]
  unfold queryKL
  rw [actual_query_mean A (others A j) j true hj hjB (by simp),
    actual_query_mean A' (others A j) j true hj' hjB (by simp),
    inter_self,B_alternative_count A A' j hj' hcard]
  simp only [bit_true,↓reduceIte]
  ring

def queries (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Finset (Measurement n) :=
  insert (.inr (others A j,true)) ((others A j).image Sum.inl)

def weights (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ) (e : Measurement n) : ℝ :=
  (if e = .inr (others A j,true) then w else 0)+
    ∑ i ∈ others A j,if e = .inl i then (1-w)/q else 0

theorem weighted_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ) (f : Measurement n → ℝ) :
    (∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q w e*f e) =
      (1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j,f (.inl i))+w*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by
  have hb : (.inr (others A j,true) : Measurement n) ∈ queries A j := by simp [queries]
  have hi : ∀ i ∈ others A j,(.inl i : Measurement n) ∈ queries A j := by
    intro i hi
    exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
  unfold weights
  simp only [add_mul,sum_add_distrib,sum_mul]
  have hs : (∑ e ∈ queries A j,(if e = .inr (others A j,true) then w else 0)*f e) =
      w*f (.inr (others A j,true)) := by simp [ite_mul,hb]
  rw [hs,sum_comm]
  have ht : (∑ i ∈ others A j,∑ e ∈ queries A j,
      (if e = .inl i then (1-w)/q else 0)*f e) =
      (1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j,f (.inl i)) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i him
    simp [ite_mul,hi i him]
  rw [ht]
  ring

theorem distribution (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∀ e ∈ queries A j,Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e,0 ≤ weights A j q w e) ∧
      (∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q w e)=1 := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro e he
    rcases mem_insert.mp he with he | he
    · subst e
      exact ⟨by simp [others],hB.le,by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
      trivial
  · intro e
    unfold weights
    apply add_nonneg
    · split <;> first | exact hw | exact le_refl 0
    · apply sum_nonneg
      intro i hi
      split <;> first | exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hq.le | exact le_refl 0
  · have he := weighted_sum A j q w (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hB] at he
    rw [he]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hq]
    <;> ring

theorem actual_phase_information (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q w mu nu : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    2*(∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q w e*information A A' j mu nu e) =
      mixedLoss q mu w (A \ A').card (1-nu) := by
  rw [weighted_sum]
  change 2*((1-w)/q*(∑ i ∈ others A j,scalarKL A A' j i mu nu)+
    w*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu)=_
  have hs := actual_scalar_B_sum A A' j hj hj' hcard mu nu
  have hb := actual_Bon_KL A A' j hj hj' hcard mu nu
  rw [hB] at hs hb
  calc
    _ = (1-w)/q*(2*(∑ i ∈ others A j,scalarKL A A' j i mu nu))+
        w*(2*queryKL A A' (others A j) j true mu nu) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hs,hb]; unfold mixedLoss; ring

theorem actual_phase_lower (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu nu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (hcard : A'.card=A.card) (hne : A' ≠ A)
    (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2 ≤
      ∑ e ∈ queries A j,weights A j q (mass q mu) e*information A A' j mu nu e := by
  have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q hj' hcard hne hB
  have hdn : 1 ≤ (A \ A').card := by exact_mod_cast hd.1
  have hcase : ((A \ A').card : ℝ)=1 ∨ 2 ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hdn with he | he
    · left; exact_mod_cast he.symm
    · right; exact_mod_cast he
  have hl := phase_all_distances_lower q mu (A \ A').card (1-nu) hq hlo hup hcase hd.2
  rw [← actual_phase_information A A' j q (mass q mu) mu nu hj hj' hcard hB] at hl
  linarith

#print axioms distribution
#print axioms actual_phase_information
#print axioms actual_phase_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PhaseThreeSharpV1.lean (87 dong)
import «LeanD6PhaseThreePrimalV1»
import «LeanD6PhaseThreeDualV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationRiskBridgeV1»

/-! Exact phase-III saddle value for the actual finite D6 query game.
The primal covers every different hidden set and every nuisance margin; the
dual covers every legal allocation. This is not a sequential rate theorem. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreeSharp
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def rate (q mu : ℝ) := gammaTwice q mu (shift q mu)/2

theorem actual_adversary (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    ∃ A' nu,Admissible A A' j nu ∧
      (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e) ≤ rate q mu := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,h⟩ := D6PhaseThreeDual.allocation_upper A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
  have hv := D6PhaseThreeDual.phase_nuisance q mu hq hlo hup
  exact ⟨swapped A a b,mu-shift q mu,
    ⟨swapped_ne A j a b hb,swapped_card A j a b ha hb,
      swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb,hv.2.1,hv.2.2.1⟩,h⟩

theorem sharp_game (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    (∃ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) ∧ (∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) ∧ (∑ e ∈ E,w e)=1 ∧
      (∀ A' nu,Admissible A A' j nu → rate q mu ≤
        ∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e)) ∧
    (∀ (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ),
      (∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) → (∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) → (∑ e ∈ E,w e)=1 →
      ∃ A' nu,Admissible A A' j nu ∧
        (∑ e ∈ E,w e*information A A' j mu nu e) ≤ rate q mu) := by
  have hm := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hp := distribution A j q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hm.1 (by linarith [hm.2]) hB
  constructor
  · refine ⟨queries A j,weights A j q (mass q mu),hp.1,(fun e _ => hp.2.1 e),hp.2.2,?_⟩
    intro A' nu h
    exact actual_phase_lower A A' j q mu nu hq hlo hup hj h.2.2.1 h.2.1 h.1 hB
  · intro E w hl hw hn
    exact actual_adversary A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB E w hl hw hn

theorem every_allocation_value_le (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hl : ∀ e ∈ E,Legal j q e) (hw : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ w e) (hn : ∑ e ∈ E,w e=1) :
    allocationValue A j mu E w ≤ rate q mu := by
  obtain ⟨A',nu,h,he⟩ := actual_adversary A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB E w hl hw hn
  exact le_trans (allocationValue_le_actual A A' j mu nu E w hw h) he

theorem optimal_allocation_value (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hq : 3 ≤ q) (hlo : marginMax q ≤ mu) (hup : mu ≤ marginHigh q)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card : ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card : ℝ)=q) :
    allocationValue A j mu (queries A j) (weights A j q (mass q mu))=rate q mu := by
  have hm := phase_mass_bounds q mu hq hlo hup
  have hp := distribution A j q (mass q mu) (by linarith) hm.1 (by linarith [hm.2]) hB
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact every_allocation_value_le A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB _ _ hp.1
      (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
  · obtain ⟨A',nu,h,he⟩ := actual_adversary A j q mu hq hlo hup hj hA hB _ _ hp.1
      (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e) hp.2.2
    apply le_csInf (s := valueSet A j mu (queries A j) (weights A j q (mass q mu)))
      ⟨_,A',nu,h,rfl⟩
    rintro v ⟨A'',nu',hh,rfl⟩
    exact actual_phase_lower A A'' j q mu nu' hq hlo hup hj hh.2.2.1 hh.2.1 hh.1 hB

#print axioms actual_adversary
#print axioms sharp_game
#print axioms every_allocation_value_le
#print axioms optimal_allocation_value
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreeSharp

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6PolyhedralActiveCellV1.lean (190 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6ActiveDecisionCellV1»

/-!
# Explicit polyhedral active cells for D6

`ActiveDecisionCell.Valid` is convenient scientific notation, but it mentions
finite maxima, minima, oscillations, and a Top-K optimizer.  This file expands
those selectors into a finite family of linear inequalities after all active
witnesses have been fixed by the cell.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6PolyhedralActiveCell

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

noncomputable def responseWitnessSpan {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ :=
  productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMax j) -
    productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMin j)

/-- A literal finite system of linear inequalities in `F`.  No finite
`maxVal`, `minVal`, `osc`, or optimization predicate occurs here. -/
def PolyhedralCellValid {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  cell.selected.card = cell.competitor.card ∧
  (∀ z, retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected z ≤
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMax) ∧
  (∀ z, retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected cell.selectedMin ≤
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected z) ∧
  (∀ z, retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor z ≤
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMax) ∧
  (∀ z, retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor cell.competitorMin ≤
    retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor z) ∧
  (∀ j u, productResponse cell.q F j u ≤
    productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMax j)) ∧
  (∀ j u, productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMin j) ≤
    productResponse cell.q F j u) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ cell.selected, ∀ j ∉ cell.selected,
    responseWitnessSpan cell F j ≤ responseWitnessSpan cell F i

private theorem max_eq_of_witness_ge {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (x : X) (h : ∀ z, f z ≤ f x) :
    maxVal f = f x := by
  exact le_antisymm (maxVal_le f h) (le_maxVal f x)

private theorem min_eq_of_witness_le {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (x : X) (h : ∀ z, f x ≤ f z) :
    minVal f = f x := by
  exact le_antisymm (minVal_le f x) (le_minVal f h)

private theorem sum_le_sum_of_disjoint_pairwise
    {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (score : I → ℝ)
    (A B : Finset I) (hCard : A.card = B.card)
    (hPair : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, score a ≤ score b) :
    A.sum score ≤ B.sum score := by
  classical
  induction A using Finset.induction_on generalizing B with
  | empty =>
      have hB : B = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using hCard.symm)
      simp [hB]
  | @insert a A ha ih =>
      have hBpos : 0 < B.card := by
        rw [← hCard]
        simp [ha]
      rcases Finset.card_pos.mp hBpos with ⟨b, hb⟩
      have hCard' : A.card = (B.erase b).card := by
        simp [ha, hb] at hCard ⊢
        omega
      have hPair' : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B.erase b, score x ≤ score y := by
        intro x hx y hy
        exact hPair x (by simp [hx]) y (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hy)
      have hInd := ih (B.erase b) hCard' hPair'
      have hab : score a ≤ score b := hPair a (by simp) b hb
      have hBSum := Finset.sum_erase_add B score hb
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      linarith

/-- Pairwise cross-boundary ordering is equivalent to the finite Top-K sum
optimizer once the selected cardinality is fixed. -/
theorem isTopKByScore_iff_pairwise {I : Type*}
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (score : I → ℝ) (selected : Finset I) (k : ℕ) :
    IsTopKByScore score selected k ↔
      selected.card = k ∧
        ∀ i ∈ selected, ∀ j ∉ selected, score j ≤ score i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.1, fun i hi j hj ↦
      topK_pairwise_score_order score selected k h hi hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨hCard, hPair⟩
    refine ⟨hCard, ?_⟩
    intro candidate hCandidate
    have hDiffCard : (candidate \ selected).card =
        (selected \ candidate).card := by
      exact Finset.card_sdiff_comm (by simpa [hCard] using hCandidate)
    have hDiffSum : (candidate \ selected).sum score ≤
        (selected \ candidate).sum score := by
      apply sum_le_sum_of_disjoint_pairwise score
        (candidate \ selected) (selected \ candidate) hDiffCard
      intro a ha b hb
      exact hPair b (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hb).1
        a (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).2
    have hCandidateSplit := candidate.sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff selected score
    have hSelectedSplit := selected.sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff candidate score
    have hInter : (candidate ∩ selected).sum score =
        (selected ∩ candidate).sum score := by
      rw [Finset.inter_comm]
    linarith

private theorem response_osc_eq_witnessSpan {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (hMax : ∀ u, productResponse cell.q F j u ≤
      productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMax j))
    (hMin : ∀ u, productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMin j) ≤
      productResponse cell.q F j u) :
    osc (productResponse cell.q F j) = responseWitnessSpan cell F j := by
  simp only [osc, responseWitnessSpan,
    max_eq_of_witness_ge _ _ hMax, min_eq_of_witness_le _ _ hMin]

/-- Selector-based validity is exactly the explicit polyhedral cell. -/
theorem activeDecisionCell_valid_iff_polyhedral {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    cell.Valid F ↔ PolyhedralCellValid cell F := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hCard, hTop, hsMax, hsMin, htMax, htMin,
      hResponseMax, hResponseMin⟩
    refine ⟨hCard, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      rw [← hsMax]
      exact le_maxVal _ z
    · intro z
      rw [← hsMin]
      exact minVal_le _ z
    · intro z
      rw [← htMax]
      exact le_maxVal _ z
    · intro z
      rw [← htMin]
      exact minVal_le _ z
    · intro j u
      rw [← hResponseMax j]
      exact le_maxVal _ u
    · intro j u
      rw [← hResponseMin j]
      exact minVal_le _ u
    · intro i hi j hj
      have hPair := topK_pairwise_score_order
        (fun r ↦ osc (productResponse cell.q F r))
        cell.selected cell.selected.card hTop hi hj
      simpa [responseWitnessSpan, osc, hResponseMax, hResponseMin] using hPair
  · rintro ⟨hCard, hsMax, hsMin, htMax, htMin,
      hResponseMax, hResponseMin, hPair⟩
    have hsMaxEq := max_eq_of_witness_ge
      (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected) cell.selectedMax hsMax
    have hsMinEq := min_eq_of_witness_le
      (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.selected) cell.selectedMin hsMin
    have htMaxEq := max_eq_of_witness_ge
      (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor) cell.competitorMax htMax
    have htMinEq := min_eq_of_witness_le
      (retainedResidual cell.q F cell.competitor) cell.competitorMin htMin
    have hRespMaxEq : ∀ j, maxVal (productResponse cell.q F j) =
        productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMax j) := by
      intro j
      exact max_eq_of_witness_ge _ _ (hResponseMax j)
    have hRespMinEq : ∀ j, minVal (productResponse cell.q F j) =
        productResponse cell.q F j (cell.responseMin j) := by
      intro j
      exact min_eq_of_witness_le _ _ (hResponseMin j)
    refine ⟨hCard, ?_, hsMaxEq, hsMinEq, htMaxEq, htMinEq,
      hRespMaxEq, hRespMinEq⟩
    rw [isTopKByScore_iff_pairwise]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    intro i hi j hj
    rw [response_osc_eq_witnessSpan cell F i (hResponseMax i) (hResponseMin i),
      response_osc_eq_witnessSpan cell F j (hResponseMax j) (hResponseMin j)]
    exact hPair i hi j hj

end CIGAMF.P13.D6PolyhedralActiveCell

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ProductCyclePathV1.lean (89 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6H3Exchange»
import «LeanD6CycleDual»

/-!
# Product-reference residual steps are finite PAEC-atom averages

This is the mechanical product-reference bridge needed before any balanced
two-path splice can be attempted.  A single selected-coordinate residual
update is exactly a product-weighted finite sum of actual D6 cycle atoms.
It uses only `hNorm`, not the stronger row-normalization premise from the
older residual API.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ProductCyclePath

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6H3Exchange
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem retainedResidual_step_eq_cycle_average {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : i ∈ selected)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) (u : U)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1) :
    retainedResidual q F selected (Function.update z i u) -
        retainedResidual q F selected z =
      productExpectation q (fun c ↦
        cycleFunctional i (Function.update z i u)
          (Function.update c i (z i)) F) := by
  have hsum :
      selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j
          ((Function.update z i u) j)) -
        selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j)) =
      productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i (z i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j hj hji
      simp [Function.update, hji]
    · intro hnot
      exact (hnot hi).elim
  unfold retainedResidual
  rw [show
      (F (Function.update z i u) -
        selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j
          ((Function.update z i u) j))) -
        (F z - selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j))) =
      (F (Function.update z i u) - F z) -
        (selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j
          ((Function.update z i u) j)) -
          selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (z j))) by ring,
      hsum]
  change F (Function.update z i u) - F z -
      (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i (z i)) =
    productExpectation q (fun c ↦
      mixedDifference F i (Function.update z i u)
        (Function.update c i (z i)))
  simpa only [Function.update_eq_self] using
    (coordinate_contrast_error_eq_expectation_mixed q F hNorm i u (z i) z)

theorem retainedResidual_step_eq_finite_cycle_sum {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : i ∈ selected)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) (u : U)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1) :
    retainedResidual q F selected (Function.update z i u) -
        retainedResidual q F selected z =
      ∑ c, jointWeight q c *
        cycleFunctional i (Function.update z i u)
          (Function.update c i (z i)) F := by
  rw [retainedResidual_step_eq_cycle_average q F selected i hi z u hNorm]
  rfl

theorem selected_residual_step_cycle_mass_one {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1) :
    ∑ c, |jointWeight q c| = 1 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c hc ↦ abs_of_nonneg (hWeight c)), hNorm]

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ProductCyclePath

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ProfileFibreAdditiveSteeringV1.lean (111 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastProfileReductionV1»

/-!
# Profile-fibre additive steering

Two actions in the SAME interaction fibre of a rank-one coordinate can still
carry different first-order response offsets.  That offset moves the
coordinate's response span, hence Top-C selection, while leaving the
interaction rank untouched.

The context-local half of this is already proved upstream:
`identical_profiles_local_contrast` says equal centred profiles force the raw
local contrast to be exactly the context-independent response contrast.  What
is added here is the rank-one form -- equal `lambda` values put two actions in
one fibre -- and the predicate that would forbid the steering.

`ProfileFibreConsistent` is stated as a PREDICATE ON A WORLD, deliberately not
as a theorem: whether rank one implies it is an open question and is not
asserted anywhere in this file.  Nothing here proves, or assumes, any decision
or half-factor bound.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileFibreAdditiveSteering

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfileReduction

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- Under rank one, equal action coefficients put two actions in one interaction
fibre: their centred profiles agree at every context. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_profiles_eq {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hProfile : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z)
    (huv : lambda u = lambda v) :
    ∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
      interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v z := by
  intro z
  rw [hProfile u z, hProfile v z, huv]

/-- Actions in one interaction fibre differ, at every context, by exactly their
first-order response contrast.  The interaction part is gone; what remains is a
pure additive offset. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_implies_additive_difference {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hProfile : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z)
    (huv : lambda u = lambda v) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i v) =
      productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i v :=
  identical_profiles_local_contrast q F i u0 u v
    (interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_profiles_eq q F i u0 u v h lambda hProfile huv) z

/-- The offset really is unconstrained by the fibre: the difference above is a
constant in the context, so it is carried entirely by `productResponse`. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_difference_is_context_free {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hProfile : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z)
    (huv : lambda u = lambda v) (y z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update y i u) - F (Function.update y i v) =
      F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i v) := by
  rw [interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_implies_additive_difference
        q F i u0 u v h lambda hProfile huv y,
    interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_implies_additive_difference
        q F i u0 u v h lambda hProfile huv z]

/-- The candidate condition that would forbid profile-fibre additive steering:
actions sharing an interaction coefficient must also share their first-order
response.  This is a HYPOTHESIS on a world.  It is NOT claimed to follow from
rank one, and no bound is derived from it here. -/
def ProfileFibreConsistent {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
    lambda u0 = 0 →
    (∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z) →
    ∀ u v, lambda u = lambda v → productResponse q F i u = productResponse q F i v

/-- Under `ProfileFibreConsistent`, fibre-mates are genuinely interchangeable:
the world value itself is unchanged at every context, not merely the
interaction part. -/
theorem profileFibreConsistent_fibre_mates_interchangeable {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hAnchor : lambda u0 = 0)
    (hProfile : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z)
    (hConsistent : ProfileFibreConsistent q F i u0)
    (huv : lambda u = lambda v) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update z i u) = F (Function.update z i v) := by
  have hAdd := interactionContrastRankOne_same_lambda_implies_additive_difference
    q F i u0 u v h lambda hProfile huv z
  have hResp := hConsistent h lambda hAnchor hProfile u v huv
  rw [hResp] at hAdd
  linarith

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileFibreAdditiveSteering

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ProfileMixtureCertificateV1.lean (4 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenMixtureCertificateV1»

/-! The profile-to-certificate proof is compiled together with the certificate
module to avoid loading the large geometry dependency graph twice. -/

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ProfileStoppingGeometryV1.lean (116 dong)
import «LeanD6GaussianQueryDominanceV1»
import «LeanD6UniqueOptimumV1»

/-! Exact profile algebra from actual query means and the pathwise implication
from a likelihood certificate to the literal geometric answer. The probability
of the uniform likelihood event is a separate obligation. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileStoppingGeometry
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ} {T : Type*}

def score (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(∑ t ∈ F,(y t-actualMean A j mu (e t))^2)/2

def C (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ F,(y t-meanOffset A j (e t))^2

def Z (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ F,meanSlope A j (e t)*(y t-meanOffset A j (e t))

def V (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ F,(meanSlope A j (e t))^2

def quadraticScore (c z v mu : ℝ) := -(c-2*mu*z+mu^2*v)/2

def mixtureExpression (c z v : ℝ) := -c/2-Real.log (1+v)/2+z^2/(2*(1+v))
def profilePenalty (z v : ℝ) := Real.log (1+v)/2+z^2/(2*v*(1+v))

theorem actual_score_quadratic (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu q : ℝ) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hl : ∀ t ∈ F,Legal j q (e t)) :
    score F e y A j mu=quadraticScore (C F e y A j) (Z F e y A j) (V F e A j) mu := by
  have he : (∑ t ∈ F,(y t-actualMean A j mu (e t))^2) =
      C F e y A j-2*mu*Z F e y A j+mu^2*V F e A j := by
    unfold C Z V
    simp_rw [mul_sum,← sum_sub_distrib,← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro t ht
    rw [actual_mean_affine A j hj q mu (e t) (hl t ht)]
    ring
  unfold score quadraticScore
  rw [he]

theorem profile_mixture_identity (c z v mu : ℝ) (hv : 0 < v) :
    mixtureExpression c z v+profilePenalty z v-quadraticScore c z v mu =
      v*(mu-z/v)^2/2 := by
  have hv' : 1+v ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold mixtureExpression profilePenalty quadraticScore
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hv,hv']
  <;> ring

theorem actual_profile_majorant (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu q : ℝ) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hl : ∀ t ∈ F,Legal j q (e t)) (hv : 0 < V F e A j) :
    score F e y A j mu ≤ mixtureExpression (C F e y A j) (Z F e y A j) (V F e A j)+
      profilePenalty (Z F e y A j) (V F e A j) := by
  rw [actual_score_quadratic F e y A j mu q hj hl]
  have he := profile_mixture_identity (C F e y A j) (Z F e y A j) (V F e A j) mu hv
  have hp := mul_nonneg hv.le (sq_nonneg (mu-Z F e y A j/V F e A j))
  linarith

/-- The displayed uniform likelihood event makes a profile-gap stop correct.
This is pathwise and does not assume an unproved probability bound. -/
theorem certificate_identifies_label (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Finset (I n))) (A Ahat : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (mu muhat q threshold : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ W) (hhat : Ahat ∈ W)
    (hjhat : j ∉ Ahat) (hl : ∀ t ∈ F,Legal j q (e t))
    (hv : 0 < V F e Ahat j) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (good : ∀ B ∈ W,mixtureExpression (C F e y B j) (Z F e y B j) (V F e B j)-
      score F e y A j mu < threshold)
    (stop : ∀ B ∈ W,B ≠ Ahat → ∀ nu : ℝ,0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 →
      threshold+profilePenalty (Z F e y Ahat j) (V F e Ahat j) ≤
        score F e y Ahat j muhat-score F e y B j nu) : Ahat=A := by
  by_contra hne
  have hs := stop A hA (Ne.symm hne) mu hmu hmu1
  have hg := good Ahat hhat
  have hm := actual_profile_majorant F e y Ahat j muhat q hjhat hl hv
  linarith

/-- Certified output is optimal on the actual finite real support, with fixed
ambient projections and the original cardinality constraint. -/
theorem certificate_geometric_optimal (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement (2*r+1)) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A Ahat : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) (hhat : Ahat ∈ worlds r j)
    (mu muhat threshold : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hl : ∀ t ∈ F,Legal j r (e t)) (hv : 0 < V F e Ahat j)
    (good : ∀ B ∈ worlds r j,
      mixtureExpression (C F e y B j) (Z F e y B j) (V F e B j)-score F e y A j mu < threshold)
    (stop : ∀ B ∈ worlds r j,B ≠ Ahat → ∀ nu : ℝ,0 ≤ nu → nu ≤ 1 →
      threshold+profilePenalty (Z F e y Ahat j) (V F e Ahat j) ≤
        score F e y Ahat j muhat-score F e y B j nu) :
    ∀ S : Finset (I (2*r+1)),S.card=A.card →
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection Ahatᶜ) ≤
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection S) := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j hr hA
  have hh := world_parameters r j hr hhat
  have he := certificate_identifies_label F e y (worlds r j) A Ahat j mu muhat r threshold
    hA hhat hh.1 hl hv hmu hmu1 good stop
  rw [he]
  exact (geometric_optimal_iff A Aᶜ j hp.1 mu hmu hmu1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2).mpr rfl

#print axioms actual_score_quadratic
#print axioms profile_mixture_identity
#print axioms actual_profile_majorant
#print axioms certificate_identifies_label
#print axioms certificate_geometric_optimal
end

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6QueryWidthInformationV1.lean (69 dong)
import «LeanD6AllocationMarginV1»

/-! Width cap for the actual, uniformly averaged adjacent-swap KL at a fixed
nuisance. q=k-1. This is not a bound for each individual alternative, nor an
optimal composite-nuisance allocation theorem. Variance rescales KL by sigma2. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6QueryWidthInformation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationFiniteBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMargin
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

theorem actual_fixed_margin_sum (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool) (q mu : ℝ)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card:ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card:ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) :
    (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu)=
      ((1-mu)^2/2)*(q*(G ∩ A).card+(q+1)*(G ∩ others A j).card-
        2*((G ∩ A).card:ℝ)*(G ∩ others A j).card) := by
  have hp (a : I n) (ha : a ∈ A) (b : I n) (hb : b ∈ others A j) :
      queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu=
        4*(1-mu)^2*queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1/2) := by
    have he := joint_homogeneity A (swapped A a b) G j h hj
      (swapped_j_not A j a b hj hb) hjG hG (1-mu) 1
    convert he using 1 <;> ring
  have hd := actual_dual_sum A G j h q 0 hj hA hB hjG hG
  simp only [CIGAMF.P13.D6ExpandedAllocation.dual,zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
    mul_zero,zero_mul,zero_add,add_zero,one_pow,one_mul] at hd
  calc
    _ = 4*(1-mu)^2*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1/2)) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [mul_sum]
      exact sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => hp a ha b hb)
    _ = ((1-mu)^2/2)*(8*(∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,
        queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h (1/2) (1/2))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by norm_num at hd; rw [hd]

lemma count_polynomial_bound (q s t r : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hr : s+t ≤ r) :
    q*s+(q+1)*t-2*s*t ≤ (q+1)*r := by
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs ht,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (show 0 ≤ q+1 by linarith)]

/-- Uniform adjacent-world average of actual KL. At mu=0 this is precisely
r/(2*sigma2*(k-1)). The switch h does not affect same-margin differences. -/
theorem actual_average_width_bound (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (h : Bool)
    (q mu r sigma2 : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hsigma : 0 < sigma2)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hA : (A.card:ℝ)=q+1) (hB : ((others A j).card:ℝ)=q)
    (hjG : j ∉ G) (hG : h=false → 2 ≤ G.card) (hsize : (G.card:ℝ) ≤ r) :
    (∑ a ∈ A,∑ b ∈ others A j,queryKL A (swapped A a b) G j h mu mu)/
      (sigma2*q*(q+1)) ≤ (1-mu)^2*r/(2*sigma2*q) := by
  rw [actual_fixed_margin_sum A G j h q mu hj hA hB hjG hG]
  have hc : ((G ∩ A).card:ℝ)+((G ∩ others A j).card:ℝ) ≤ r := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_add,query_count_partition A G j hjG]
    exact hsize
  have hp := count_polynomial_bound q (G ∩ A).card (G ∩ others A j).card r hq.le
    (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hc
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg (1-mu)) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2))
  have hden : 0 < sigma2*q*(q+1) := by positivity
  calc _ ≤ (((1-mu)^2/2)*((q+1)*r))/(sigma2*q*(q+1)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh hden.le
       _ = _ := by field_simp <;> ring

#print axioms actual_fixed_margin_sum
#print axioms actual_average_width_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6QueryWidthInformation

/-! Total one-epoch recommendation regret in phase III, including wrong labels.
The label and margin estimate need not be independent. A later bridge supplies
the Gaussian law and bad-label probability from the actual discovery/cyclic
query experiments. This is not a full adaptive stopping-rate theorem. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RandomLabelPhaseRegret
open scoped ENNReal
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder CIGAMF.P13.D6CyclicMeanSquare
noncomputable section

lemma world_others_card (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j) : (others A j).card=q := by
  have hh := congrArg Finset.card (D6DiscoveryGeometry.encodedB_map A j)
  rw [Finset.card_map,D6DiscoveryGeometry.model_card q j hq A hA] at hh
  exact hh.symm

/-- The constant is proved to exist from the explicit phase-III geometry.
`hcorrect` specifies the decoder's behavior; it is not a regret premise.
The bad-label contribution is retained at its full loss scale. -/
theorem random_label_expected_regret (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
      (j : I (2*q+1)) (A : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds q j)
      (mu : ℝ) (hm : mu ∈ phaseInterval q)
      (X : Ω → ℝ) (v : NNReal) (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianReal mu v) P)
      (candidate : Ω → Finset (I (2*q+1)))
      (hcan : ∀ x,candidate x ∈ worlds q j)
      (bad : Set Ω) (hb : MeasurableSet bad)
      (hcorrect : ∀ x,x ∉ bad → candidate x=A),
      (∫⁻ x,ENNReal.ofReal (oracleRegret A j q mu (queries (candidate x) j)
        (weights (candidate x) j q (mass q (clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) (X x))))) ∂P) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal C*ENNReal.ofReal (v:ℝ)+
          ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*P bad := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hquad⟩ := uniform_actual_quadratic q (by exact_mod_cast hq)
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro Ω inst P j A hA mu hm X v hX candidate hcan bad hb hcorrect
  let z : Ω → ℝ := fun x => clip (marginMax q) (marginHigh q) (X x)
  let loss : Ω → ℝ := fun x => oracleRegret A j q mu (queries (candidate x) j)
    (weights (candidate x) j q (mass q (z x)))
  let M : ℝ := max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu)
  have hz : ∀ x,z x ∈ phaseInterval q := fun x => clip_mem _ _ _ (hm.1.trans hm.2)
  have hparams := world_parameters q j (by omega) hA
  have ha : (A.card:ℝ)=(q:ℝ)+1 := by exact_mod_cast hparams.2.1
  have hB : ((others A j).card:ℝ)=(q:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast world_others_card q (by omega) j A hA
  have hpoint : ∀ x,ENNReal.ofReal (loss x) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal C*ENNReal.ofReal ((z x-mu)^2)+
        bad.indicator (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal M) x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ bad
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      have hc := world_parameters q j (by omega) (hcan x)
      have hw := phase_mass_bounds q (z x) (by exact_mod_cast hq) (hz x).1 (hz x).2
      have hp := distribution (candidate x) j q (mass q (z x)) (by exact_mod_cast (show 0<q by omega))
        hw.1 (by linarith [hw.2]) (by exact_mod_cast world_others_card q (by omega) j (candidate x) (hcan x))
      have hh := oracle_regret_bounded A j q mu (queries (candidate x) j)
        (weights (candidate x) j q (mass q (z x))) (fun e _ => hp.2.1 e)
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hh).trans (le_add_left le_rfl)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx,add_zero,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hC]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      dsimp only [loss]
      rw [hcorrect x hx]
      exact hquad A j mu (z x) hm (hz x) hparams.1 ha hB
  have hzmeas : AEMeasurable z P := by dsimp [z,clip];fun_prop
  have hmse := clipped_mean_square hX hm.1 hm.2
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x,ENNReal.ofReal C*ENNReal.ofReal ((z x-mu)^2)+
          bad.indicator (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal M) x ∂P := lintegral_mono hpoint
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal C*(∫⁻ x,ENNReal.ofReal ((z x-mu)^2) ∂P)+
          ENNReal.ofReal M*P bad := by
      rw [lintegral_add_left' (by fun_prop),
        lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,lintegral_indicator_const hb]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmse (show 0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C from zero_le)) le_rfl

#print axioms random_label_expected_regret
end

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RankOneLocalAffineSliceV1.lean (86 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneV1»

/-!
# D6-R1: the local affine slice form of interaction-contrast rank one

Rank one of the centered interaction-contrast profiles at coordinate `i` is
literally an affine slice statement about the world function itself: along the
`i`-th coordinate, `F` is its anchor value plus the (context-free) product
response contrast plus a single rank-one interaction term `lambda u * h z`.

This file is pure rearrangement of the existing factorization predicate.  No
decision bound, no half-factor claim, and no cardinality claim is made here.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneLocalAffineSlice

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- Rank one gives an explicit affine-in-the-slice normal form for `F`. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_local_affine_slice {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
      lambda u0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ u z,
          F (Function.update z i u) =
            F (Function.update z i u0) +
              (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
              lambda u * h z := by
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, hProfile⟩
  refine ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have hz := hProfile u z
  unfold interactionContrastProfile at hz
  linarith

/-- The affine slice form is not weaker: it returns the rank-one predicate. -/
theorem local_affine_slice_implies_interactionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hSlice : ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
      lambda u0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ u z,
          F (Function.update z i u) =
            F (Function.update z i u0) +
              (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
              lambda u * h z) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 := by
  rcases hSlice with ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, hSliceEq⟩
  refine ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have hz := hSliceEq u z
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  linarith

/-- Exact equivalence of the factorization predicate and the slice normal
form. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_iff_local_affine_slice {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 ↔
      ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ),
        lambda u0 = 0 ∧
          ∀ u z,
            F (Function.update z i u) =
              F (Function.update z i u0) +
                (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
                lambda u * h z := by
  constructor
  · intro hRank
    exact interactionContrastRankOne_local_affine_slice q F i u0 hRank
  · intro hSlice
    exact local_affine_slice_implies_interactionContrastRankOne q F i u0 hSlice

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneLocalAffineSlice

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RankOneReferenceInvarianceV1.lean (168 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneMinorsV1»

/-!
# The D6 rank-one class does not depend on the product reference

The centred interaction-contrast profile subtracts exactly the reference
expectation of the raw slice contrast.  Changing the product reference
therefore shifts every profile by a single constant per action, which is
absorbed into the context factor and leaves the action factor untouched.

Consequence: `InteractionContrastRankOne` is a property of the world `F`
alone, not of the pair `(q, F)`, for every normalized product reference.
The only hypothesis is normalization of the target reference -- no strict
positivity, so deterministic (point-mass) references are covered.

This is the formal justification for reusing one linear rank-one fibre
across every reference in the raw-world search: the fibre is reference-free,
only the decision objective is not.

No decision or half-factor bound is claimed here.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneReferenceInvariance

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOneMinors

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- The product-response contrast is the reference expectation of the raw
