slice contrast.  This is the only place the reference enters a profile. -/
theorem productResponse_contrast_eq_productExpectation {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U) :
    productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0 =
      productExpectation q
        (fun c => F (Function.update c i u) - F (Function.update c i u0)) := by
  classical
  unfold productResponse productExpectation
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro c _
  ring

theorem productExpectation_congr {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (G G' : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ c, G c = G' c) :
    productExpectation q G = productExpectation q G' := by
  classical
  unfold productExpectation
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro c _
  rw [hG c]

/-- A normalized product reference sends a constant plus a scaled function to
the constant plus the scaled expectation. -/
theorem productExpectation_const_add_smul {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (K lam : ℝ) (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    productExpectation q (fun c => K + lam * h c) =
      K + lam * productExpectation q h := by
  classical
  unfold productExpectation
  calc
    (∑ c, jointWeight q c * (K + lam * h c))
        = ∑ c, (jointWeight q c * K + lam * (jointWeight q c * h c)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro c _
          ring
    _ = (∑ c, jointWeight q c * K) + ∑ c, lam * (jointWeight q c * h c) :=
          Finset.sum_add_distrib
    _ = (∑ c, jointWeight q c) * K + lam * ∑ c, jointWeight q c * h c := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = K + lam * ∑ c, jointWeight q c * h c := by
          rw [hNorm, one_mul]

/-- Rank one transfers to any normalized product reference, with the SAME
action factor `lambda` and the context factor recentred. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer {n : ℕ}
    (q q' : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q' c = 1)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q' F i u0 := by
  classical
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, hProfile⟩
  refine ⟨fun z => h z - productExpectation q' h, lambda, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  show interactionContrastProfile q' F i u0 u z =
    lambda u * (h z - productExpectation q' h)
  have hslice : ∀ c : Fin (n + 1) → U,
      F (Function.update c i u) - F (Function.update c i u0) =
        (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
          lambda u * h c := by
    intro c
    have hc := hProfile u c
    unfold interactionContrastProfile at hc
    linarith
  have hq' : productResponse q' F i u - productResponse q' F i u0 =
      (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
        lambda u * productExpectation q' h := by
    rw [productResponse_contrast_eq_productExpectation q' F i u0 u,
      productExpectation_congr q'
        (fun c => F (Function.update c i u) - F (Function.update c i u0))
        (fun c => (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) +
          lambda u * h c) hslice,
      productExpectation_const_add_smul q' hNorm
        (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) (lambda u) h]
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  rw [hq', hslice z]
  ring

theorem interactionContrastRankOne_reference_free {n : ℕ}
    (q q' : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hNorm' : ∑ c, jointWeight q' c = 1) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 ↔
      InteractionContrastRankOne q' F i u0 :=
  ⟨interactionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q q' F i u0 hNorm',
    interactionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q' q F i u0 hNorm⟩

theorem allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer {n : ℕ}
    (q q' : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q' c = 1)
    (hAll : AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q F) :
    AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q' F := by
  intro i
  exact interactionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q q' F i
    canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor hNorm (hAll i)

theorem allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne_reference_free {n : ℕ}
    (q q' : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hNorm' : ∑ c, jointWeight q' c = 1) :
    AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q F ↔
      AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q' F :=
  ⟨allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q q' F hNorm',
    allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q' q F hNorm⟩

/-- The exact minor constraints imposed by the raw-world search are themselves
reference-free.  Composing the two directions of the minor bridge, the
constraint set a solver writes at one reference is the constraint set at every
normalized reference. -/
theorem allInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero_reference_transfer {n : ℕ}
    (q q' : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q' c = 1)
    (hMinor : AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q F i u0) :
    AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q' F i u0 :=
  interactionContrastRankOne_implies_all_minors_zero q' F i u0
    (interactionContrastRankOne_reference_transfer q q' F i u0 hNorm
      (all_minors_zero_implies_interactionContrastRankOne q F i u0 hMinor))

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneReferenceInvariance

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RankOneTwoCornerInterpolationV1.lean (101 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RankOneLocalAffineSliceV1»

/-!
# D6-R2a: pivot action and two-corner interpolation under rank one

Under interaction-contrast rank one at coordinate `i`, the abstract context
factor `h` is not needed: a single pivot action `v` carries the whole profile
space, and every other action's centered profile is a scalar multiple of the
pivot profile.  The scalar is anchored, `phi u0 = 0`, in both the degenerate
and the nondegenerate case.

This is the seed of the two-corner (Bernstein-form) representation.  No
subset induction, no multiaffine normal form, and no decision bound is
claimed here.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneTwoCornerInterpolation

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneLocalAffineSlice

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- Rank one is exactly collinearity with one pivot action's profile. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_pivot_profile {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (v : U) (phi : U → ℝ),
      phi u0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ u z,
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
            phi u * interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v z := by
  classical
  rcases hRank with ⟨h, lambda, hAnchor, hProfile⟩
  by_cases hLam : ∃ w : U, lambda w ≠ 0
  · rcases hLam with ⟨w, hw⟩
    have key : ∀ (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U),
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
          lambda u / lambda w * interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z := by
      intro u z
      have hcancel : lambda u / lambda w * lambda w = lambda u :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ (lambda u) hw
      rw [hProfile u z, hProfile w z, ← mul_assoc, hcancel]
    exact ⟨w, fun u ↦ lambda u / lambda w, by simp [hAnchor], key⟩
  · push_neg at hLam
    refine ⟨u0, fun _ ↦ 0, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro u z
    simp [hProfile, hLam]

/-- World-level two-corner interpolation: every raw local contrast, centered
by its product response, is a scalar multiple of the pivot's centered
contrast. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_two_corner_interpolation {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (v : U) (phi : U → ℝ),
      phi u0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ u z,
          F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i u0) -
              (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) =
            phi u *
              (F (Function.update z i v) - F (Function.update z i u0) -
                (productResponse q F i v - productResponse q F i u0)) := by
  rcases interactionContrastRankOne_pivot_profile q F i u0 hRank with
    ⟨v, phi, hAnchor, hPivot⟩
  refine ⟨v, phi, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have hz := hPivot u z
  unfold interactionContrastProfile at hz
  linarith

/-- The same statement in explicit affine-combination (Bernstein seed) form:
the anchor corner carries weight `1 - phi u`, the pivot corner `phi u`. -/
theorem interactionContrastRankOne_affine_combination {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0) :
    ∃ (v : U) (phi : U → ℝ),
      phi u0 = 0 ∧
        ∀ u z,
          interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
            (1 - phi u) * interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 z +
              phi u * interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 v z := by
  rcases interactionContrastRankOne_pivot_profile q F i u0 hRank with
    ⟨v, phi, hAnchor, hPivot⟩
  refine ⟨v, phi, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  rw [interactionContrastProfile_anchor q F i u0 z, hPivot u z]
  ring

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneTwoCornerInterpolation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RawLocalContrastRankOneV1.lean (479 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneV1»

/-!
# Raw (uncentred) local contrast rank one

`interactionContrastProfile` is the local action contrast **after** subtracting
the product-reference first-order contrast.  That subtraction is exactly a
gauge quotient: it discards the additive layer.  This module keeps the additive
layer and studies the *raw* local contrast

  `rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z = F (z[i ← u]) - F (z[i ← u0])`.

The main content:

* `rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_minors_zero` — the raw predicate is exactly the
  vanishing of every `2 × 2` minor of the (action × context) matrix of raw
  contrasts.  This is a *definition-level* falsifier: no anchor, no reference
  measure, no factorisation witness is needed to refute it.
* `rawLocalContrastRankOne_implies_interactionContrastRankOne` — raw rank one is
  strictly stronger than the centred predicate.  Centring is a projection, so it
  can only lose rank.
* `rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_aligned` — the exact gap between the two.  Raw
  rank one holds iff the centred profile is rank one **and** the first-order
  response contrast is a scalar multiple of the very same `lambda`.  In the
  `alpha`/`lambda` language: `alpha = kappa • lambda`.  Raw rank one is therefore
  precisely "centred rank one with no independent additive gauge".
* `rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_alignment_determinant` — the determinant test
  `mu i (u,v) = alpha u * lambda v - alpha v * lambda u = 0` is *sufficient*
  for raw rank one, with no non-degeneracy hypothesis at all.
* `binary_rawLocalContrastRankOne` — a two-letter alphabet forces raw rank one
  unconditionally, for every `F`.  After anchoring there is exactly one
  non-anchor contrast, and the span of a single function has dimension at most
  one.  This is the alphabet phase, with no analytic input.

### Deliberate non-claim (degeneracy)

The converse of `rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_alignment_determinant` is **not**
stated, and is false as stated: `mu` is computed against a *chosen* centred
witness `(lambda, h)`, and when `h` is constant the witness `lambda` is not
determined by `F`, so `mu` can be made nonzero while raw rank one still holds
(then every raw contrast is a multiple of the constant function).  Any
equivalence `RawLocalContrastRankOne <-> mu = 0` must carry a hypothesis that
`h` is non-constant.  Nothing here depends on that equivalence: the falsifier
used downstream is the minor obstruction, which is witness-free.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- The raw (uncentred) local action contrast at coordinate `i`, anchored at
`u0`.  It is a function of a full world state; coordinate `i` is overwritten. -/
noncomputable def rawLocalContrast {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  F (Function.update z i u) - F (Function.update z i u0)

/-- All raw local contrasts at coordinate `i` are collinear as functions of the
complement context.  No reference measure occurs. -/
def RawLocalContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (theta : U → ℝ),
    theta u0 = 0 ∧ ∀ u z, rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z = theta u * H z

def AllCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor

@[simp] theorem rawLocalContrast_anchor {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    rawLocalContrast F i u0 u0 z = 0 := by
  simp [rawLocalContrast]

/-- The centred profile is the raw contrast minus its first-order part. -/
theorem interactionContrastProfile_eq_raw_sub_response {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
      rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z -
        (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) := rfl

/-! ## Minor characterisation -/

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_minor_zero {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRank : RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (u v : U) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    rawLocalContrast F i u0 u x * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v y -
      rawLocalContrast F i u0 u y * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v x = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨H, theta, _, hfac⟩ := hRank
  rw [hfac u x, hfac v y, hfac u y, hfac v x]
  ring

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_minors_zero {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hmin : ∀ (u v : U) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      rawLocalContrast F i u0 u x * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v y -
        rawLocalContrast F i u0 u y * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v x = 0) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : ∀ (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U), rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z = 0
  · refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ ↦ 0, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro u z
    simp [hzero u z]
  · push_neg at hzero
    obtain ⟨u1, z1, hne⟩ := hzero
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ rawLocalContrast F i u0 u1 z,
      fun u ↦ rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z1 / rawLocalContrast F i u0 u1 z1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro u z
      have h := hmin u u1 z z1
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hne]
      linarith [h]

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_minors_zero {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 ↔
      ∀ (u v : U) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U),
        rawLocalContrast F i u0 u x * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v y -
          rawLocalContrast F i u0 u y * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v x = 0 :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ rawLocalContrastRankOne_minor_zero F i u0 h,
   rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_minors_zero F i u0⟩

/-- Witness-free falsifier: one nonzero `2 × 2` raw minor refutes raw rank one.
No reference measure and no factorisation candidate are involved. -/
theorem not_rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_minor_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hdet :
      rawLocalContrast F i u0 u x * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v y -
        rawLocalContrast F i u0 u y * rawLocalContrast F i u0 v x ≠ 0) :
    ¬ RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 := by
  intro hRank
  exact hdet (rawLocalContrastRankOne_minor_zero F i u0 hRank u v x y)

/-! ## Anchor invariance -/

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_anchor {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 a : U)
    (hRank : RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i a := by
  obtain ⟨H, theta, _, hfac⟩ := hRank
  refine ⟨H, fun u ↦ theta u - theta a, by simp, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have h1 := hfac u z
  have h2 := hfac a z
  simp only [rawLocalContrast] at h1 h2 ⊢
  linear_combination h1 - h2

/-! ## Raw rank one slaves the additive layer to the interaction layer -/

/-- Under a raw factorisation the first-order response contrast is the *same*
`theta`, scaled by the reference mean of the context factor.  This is the
statement that raw rank one leaves no independent additive gauge.  No
normalisation of `q` is required. -/
theorem rawLocalContrast_response_contrast {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (H : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (theta : U → ℝ)
    (hfac : ∀ u z, rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z = theta u * H z)
    (u : U) :
    productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0 =
      theta u * productExpectation q H := by
  classical
  simp only [productResponse, productExpectation]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro c _
  have hc := hfac u c
  simp only [rawLocalContrast] at hc
  linear_combination jointWeight q c * hc

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_implies_interactionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hRaw : RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 := by
  obtain ⟨H, theta, hAnchor, hfac⟩ := hRaw
  refine ⟨fun z ↦ H z - productExpectation q H, theta, hAnchor, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have hl := hfac u z
  simp only [rawLocalContrast] at hl
  have hr := rawLocalContrast_response_contrast q F i u0 H theta hfac u
  simp only [interactionContrastProfile]
  linear_combination hl - hr

theorem allCoordinatesRaw_implies_allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne
    {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hRaw : AllCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne F) :
    AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q F := fun i ↦
  rawLocalContrastRankOne_implies_interactionContrastRankOne q F i
    canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor (hRaw i)

/-! ## The exact gap: centred rank one plus additive alignment -/

theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_iff_aligned {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 ↔
      ∃ (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ) (kappa : ℝ),
        lambda u0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ u z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = lambda u * h z) ∧
        (∀ u, productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0 =
          kappa * lambda u) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H, theta, hAnchor, hfac⟩
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ H z - productExpectation q H, theta, productExpectation q H,
      hAnchor, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u z
      have hl := hfac u z
      simp only [rawLocalContrast] at hl
      have hr := rawLocalContrast_response_contrast q F i u0 H theta hfac u
      simp only [interactionContrastProfile]
      linear_combination hl - hr
    · intro u
      rw [rawLocalContrast_response_contrast q F i u0 H theta hfac u]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨h, lambda, kappa, hAnchor, hprof, halpha⟩
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ h z + kappa, lambda, hAnchor, ?_⟩
    intro u z
    have h1 := hprof u z
    simp only [interactionContrastProfile] at h1
    have h2 := halpha u
    simp only [rawLocalContrast]
    linear_combination h1 + h2

/-! ## The determinant criterion -/

/-- Pairwise vanishing of `2 × 2` determinants of a family of plane vectors
forces a common direction.  Elementary, but it is the step that turns the
pointwise test `mu = 0` into a genuine factorisation. -/
theorem exists_common_direction {U : Type*} (alpha lam : U → ℝ)
    (hdet : ∀ u v, alpha u * lam v - alpha v * lam u = 0) :
    ∃ (a b : ℝ) (t : U → ℝ), (∀ u, alpha u = t u * a) ∧ (∀ u, lam u = t u * b) := by
  classical
  by_cases hA : ∃ u1, alpha u1 ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨u1, hu1⟩ := hA
    refine ⟨alpha u1, lam u1, fun u ↦ alpha u / alpha u1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u
      field_simp
    · intro u
      have key : lam u * alpha u1 = alpha u * lam u1 := by linarith [hdet u u1]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hu1]
      linarith [key]
  · push_neg at hA
    by_cases hB : ∃ u1, lam u1 ≠ 0
    · obtain ⟨u1, hu1⟩ := hB
      refine ⟨0, lam u1, fun u ↦ lam u / lam u1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        simp [hA u]
      · intro u
        field_simp
    · push_neg at hB
      exact ⟨0, 0, fun _ ↦ 0, fun u ↦ by simp [hA u], fun u ↦ by simp [hB u]⟩

/-- Alignment of the first-order layer with the interaction layer, expressed as
the vanishing of the `alpha`/`lambda` determinant, is **sufficient** for raw
rank one.  There is no non-degeneracy hypothesis: when the interaction layer
collapses the raw contrasts are multiples of a constant function. -/
theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_alignment_determinant {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hAnchor : lambda u0 = 0)
    (hprof : ∀ u z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = lambda u * h z)
    (hdet : ∀ u v,
      (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) * lambda v -
        (productResponse q F i v - productResponse q F i u0) * lambda u = 0) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, t, hta, htb⟩ :=
    exists_common_direction
      (fun w ↦ productResponse q F i w - productResponse q F i u0) lambda hdet
  have ha0 : t u0 * a = 0 := by have := hta u0; linarith
  have hb0 : t u0 * b = 0 := by
    have := htb u0
    rw [hAnchor] at this
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun z ↦ b * h z + a, fun u ↦ t u - t u0, by simp, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  have hp := hprof u z
  simp only [interactionContrastProfile] at hp
  have hA := hta u
  have hB := htb u
  simp only [rawLocalContrast]
  linear_combination hp + hA + h z * hB + h z * hb0 + ha0

/-- Necessity, with the non-degeneracy hypothesis made explicit.  If the centred
profile factors through `(lambda, h)` with `h` separating two contexts, then a
nonzero `alpha`/`lambda` determinant refutes raw rank one.  The hypothesis
`h x <> h y` is exactly what the degeneracy remark in the header demands: it is
what pins `lambda` down up to scale.  Without it `lambda` is not determined by
`F` and the determinant carries no information. -/
theorem not_rawLocalContrastRankOne_of_misaligned {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (lambda : U → ℝ)
    (hprof : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z = lambda w * h z)
    (x y : Fin (n + 1) → U) (hnc : h x ≠ h y)
    (u v : U)
    (hmis :
      (productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0) * lambda v -
        (productResponse q F i v - productResponse q F i u0) * lambda u ≠ 0) :
    ¬ RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0 := by
  intro hRaw
  obtain ⟨H, theta, _, hfac⟩ := hRaw
  have halpha : ∀ w, productResponse q F i w - productResponse q F i u0 =
      theta w * productExpectation q H := fun w ↦
    rawLocalContrast_response_contrast q F i u0 H theta hfac w
  have hprof' : ∀ w z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 w z =
      theta w * (H z - productExpectation q H) := by
    intro w z
    have hl := hfac w z
    simp only [rawLocalContrast] at hl
    have hr := halpha w
    simp only [interactionContrastProfile]
    linear_combination hl - hr
  have key : ∀ w : U, lambda w * (h x - h y) =
      theta w * ((H x - productExpectation q H) -
        (H y - productExpectation q H)) := by
    intro w
    have e1 : lambda w * h x = theta w * (H x - productExpectation q H) := by
      rw [← hprof w x, hprof' w x]
    have e2 : lambda w * h y = theta w * (H y - productExpectation q H) := by
      rw [← hprof w y, hprof' w y]
    linear_combination e1 - e2
  apply hmis
  rw [halpha u, halpha v]
  have hD : h x - h y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hnc
  have hz : ((theta u * productExpectation q H) * lambda v -
      (theta v * productExpectation q H) * lambda u) * (h x - h y) = 0 := by
    linear_combination (theta u * productExpectation q H) * key v -
      (theta v * productExpectation q H) * key u
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h3 | h3
  · exact h3
  · exact absurd h3 hD

/-! ## Interpolation form: raw rank one pins each coordinate slice

The predicate `RawLocalContrastRankOne` is existential in `(H, theta)`.  The
lemmas below remove that existential entirely: once one action `r` is known to
move `F` at one context `zstar`, the value at EVERY action is an explicit affine
combination of the values at the anchor and at `r`, with weights that depend on
the action only.  Nothing downstream has to carry a factorisation witness.

Note that the anchor `u0` and the pair `(r, zstar)` are chosen from `F` itself,
never from the (non-unique) factorisation.
-/

/-- Coordinate `i` moves `F` somewhere.  Stated in terms of `F` alone. -/
def ActiveCoordinate {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U), rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z ≠ 0

/-- An inactive coordinate is a coordinate `F` does not depend on.  No rank
hypothesis is needed: this is just the definition of inactivity. -/
theorem inactive_coordinate_constant {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hInactive : ¬ ActiveCoordinate F i u0)
    (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update z i u) = F (Function.update z i u0) := by
  unfold ActiveCoordinate at hInactive
  push_neg at hInactive
  have h := hInactive u z
  simp only [rawLocalContrast] at h
  linarith

/-- The normalised action weight.  `rawTheta ... u0 = 0` and, when `r` moves `F`
at `zstar`, `rawTheta ... r = 1`. -/
noncomputable def rawTheta {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 r : U)
    (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U) (u : U) : ℝ :=
  rawLocalContrast F i u0 u zstar / rawLocalContrast F i u0 r zstar

@[simp] theorem rawTheta_anchor {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 r : U)
    (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    rawTheta F i u0 r zstar u0 = 0 := by
  simp [rawTheta]

theorem rawTheta_representative {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 r : U)
    (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hr : rawLocalContrast F i u0 r zstar ≠ 0) :
    rawTheta F i u0 r zstar r = 1 := by
  simp [rawTheta, div_self hr]

/-- Every raw contrast is the same multiple of the representative contrast, with
a coefficient that does not depend on the context. -/
theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_contrast_interpolation {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 r : U)
    (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hRank : RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : rawLocalContrast F i u0 r zstar ≠ 0)
    (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    rawLocalContrast F i u0 u z =
      rawTheta F i u0 r zstar u * rawLocalContrast F i u0 r z := by
  have hmin := rawLocalContrastRankOne_minor_zero F i u0 hRank u r z zstar
  rw [rawTheta, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hr]
  linarith [hmin]

/-- **(star)**  Exact linear interpolation between two slices.

`F (z[i <- u]) = (1 - theta u) * F (z[i <- u0]) + theta u * F (z[i <- r])`

This is the statement that makes the reconstruction argument go through: raw
rank one does not merely bound a rank, it forces each coordinate of `F` to be an
affine interpolation between the anchor slice and one representative slice, with
context-free weights. -/
theorem rawLocalContrastRankOne_interpolation {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 r : U)
    (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hRank : RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : rawLocalContrast F i u0 r zstar ≠ 0)
    (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F (Function.update z i u) =
      (1 - rawTheta F i u0 r zstar u) * F (Function.update z i u0) +
        rawTheta F i u0 r zstar u * F (Function.update z i r) := by
  have h := rawLocalContrastRankOne_contrast_interpolation
    F i u0 r zstar hRank hr u z
  simp only [rawLocalContrast] at h
  linear_combination h

/-- The interpolation weights are recovered from `F` at the two slices, so an
active coordinate always supplies a usable `(r, zstar)`. -/
theorem exists_representative_of_active {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hActive : ActiveCoordinate F i u0) :
    ∃ (r : U) (zstar : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      rawLocalContrast F i u0 r zstar ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨u, z, hz⟩ := hActive
  exact ⟨u, z, hz⟩

/-! ## Binary alphabets force raw rank one -/

theorem binary_rawLocalContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i 0 := by
  let H : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ := fun z ↦ rawLocalContrast F i 0 1 z
  let theta : Fin 2 → ℝ := fun u ↦ if u = 1 then 1 else 0
  refine ⟨H, theta, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [theta]
  · intro u z
    fin_cases u
    · simp [H, theta]
    · simp [H, theta]

theorem binary_rawLocalContrastRankOne_any_anchor {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : Fin 2) :
    RawLocalContrastRankOne F i a :=
  rawLocalContrastRankOne_anchor F i 0 a (binary_rawLocalContrastRankOne F i)

theorem binary_allCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ) :
    AllCoordinatesRawLocalContrastRankOne F := fun i ↦
  binary_rawLocalContrastRankOne_any_anchor F i canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RawRankOneMultiaffineV1.lean (147 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RawRankOneReconstructionV1»

/-!
# Raw rank one puts `F` in the multiaffine span of the action coefficients

`rawRankOne_corner_reconstruction` writes `F` as a combination of the `2^(n+1)`
tensor-product (Bernstein) weights attached to the corners.  This file converts
that to membership in the span of the **subset monomials**
`x ↦ ∏ i ∈ S, theta i (x i)`, which is the statement that matters:

  the raw-rank-one worlds with a given action coefficient `theta` are exactly the
  span of the `2^(n+1)` subset monomials in `theta`,

so the fibre searched by the raw-fibre falsification driver is the whole raw
variety at that `theta`, not a slice of it.  Numerically this is the dimension
`1 + m + (2^m - 1 - m) = 2^m` measured exactly in `E1_rawfiber_m6_K3.json`
(64, against 70 for the centred fibre).

The conversion deliberately avoids Moebius inversion and the explicit
inclusion-exclusion coefficient formula.  Working with `Submodule.span`
membership instead of explicit coefficients means the Bernstein-to-monomial step
is a two-term recursion

  `(∏_S theta) * ∏_{insert a A} (1 - theta) =
     (∏_S theta) * ∏_A (1 - theta)  -  (∏_{insert a S} theta) * ∏_A (1 - theta)`

closed under `Submodule.sub_mem`, with no signs, no binomial coefficients and no
incidence algebra.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneMultiaffine

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneReconstruction

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] [DecidableEq U]

/-- The subset monomials in a family of scalar action coefficients. -/
def monomialSet {n : ℕ} (t : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) :
    Set ((Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :=
  Set.range fun S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) => fun x => ∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)

/-- A Bernstein weight lies in the span of the subset monomials.  Induction on
the complement block `A`, splitting off one factor `1 - t a` at a time. -/
theorem bernstein_mem_monomialSpan {n : ℕ}
    (t : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (A : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)), Disjoint A S →
      (fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) =>
        (∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)) * ∏ i ∈ A, (1 - t i (x i))) ∈
        Submodule.span ℝ (monomialSet t) := by
  induction A using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro S _
      have : (fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) =>
          (∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)) * ∏ i ∈ (∅ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))),
                (1 - t i (x i)))
          = fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) => ∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i) := by
        funext x
        simp
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨S, rfl⟩
  | @insert a A' ha ih =>
      intro S hdisj
      have haS : a ∉ S := (Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mp hdisj).1
      have hA'S : Disjoint A' S := (Finset.disjoint_insert_left.mp hdisj).2
      have hA'aS : Disjoint A' (insert a S) :=
        Finset.disjoint_insert_right.mpr ⟨ha, hA'S⟩
      have key :
          (fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) => (∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)) *
              ∏ i ∈ insert a A', (1 - t i (x i)))
            = (fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) =>
                (∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)) * ∏ i ∈ A', (1 - t i (x i)))
              - (fun (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) => (∏ i ∈ insert a S, t i (x i)) *
                  ∏ i ∈ A', (1 - t i (x i))) := by
        funext x
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert haS]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (ih S hA'S) (ih (insert a S) hA'aS)

section Reconstruction

variable {n : ℕ} (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
  (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))

/-- With every coordinate reduced, the corner no longer depends on `x`: the
`2^(n+1)` corners are fixed points of the action space. -/
theorem cornerPoint_univ (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    cornerPoint r u0 Finset.univ S x = fun j => if j ∈ S then r j else u0 := by
  funext j
  simp [cornerPoint]

/-- `F` is the Bernstein combination of its corner values. -/
theorem rawRankOne_eq_bernstein_combination
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) :
    F = ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
      (F fun j => if j ∈ S then r j else u0) •
        fun x => cornerWeight F u0 r zs Finset.univ S x := by
  funext x
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [rawRankOne_corner_reconstruction F u0 r zs hRank hr x]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro S _
  rw [cornerPoint_univ (r := r) (u0 := u0) S x]
  ring

/-- **Raw rank one puts `F` in the multiaffine span.**

Every world satisfying raw local contrast rank one at every coordinate, with
every coordinate active, lies in the span of the `2^(n+1)` subset monomials in
its own normalised action coefficients `rawTheta`.  Since `rawTheta` is built
from `F` alone, no factorisation witness appears in the statement. -/
theorem rawRankOne_mem_monomialSpan
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) :
    F ∈ Submodule.span ℝ
      (monomialSet fun i u => rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) u) := by
  let t : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ :=
    fun i u => rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) u
  change F ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (monomialSet t)
  have hcomb := rawRankOne_eq_bernstein_combination F u0 r zs hRank hr
  have hmem :
      (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
        (F fun j => if j ∈ S then r j else u0) •
          fun x => cornerWeight F u0 r zs Finset.univ S x) ∈
        Submodule.span ℝ (monomialSet t) := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ ?_
    intro S _
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have hrewrite :
        (fun x => cornerWeight F u0 r zs Finset.univ S x)
          = fun x => (∏ i ∈ S, t i (x i)) *
              ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ \ S, (1 - t i (x i)) := by
      funext x
      simp only [t]
      rfl
    rw [hrewrite]
    exact bernstein_mem_monomialSpan t (Finset.univ \ S) S Finset.sdiff_disjoint
  rw [hcomb]
  exact hmem

end Reconstruction

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneMultiaffine

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RawRankOneNormalFormV1.lean (89 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RawRankOneMultiaffineV1»

/-!
# `RawRankOne ⟹ F = P(theta)` with `P` multiaffine

`rawRankOne_mem_monomialSpan` says `F` lies in the span of the subset monomials.
Over a finite index type, span membership is the same as an explicit coefficient
family, so this file extracts it and states the normal form

  `F x = ∑ S, c S * ∏ i ∈ S, theta i (x i)`,

which is the boxed conclusion of the interpolation route: raw local contrast
rank one at every coordinate forces `F` to be multiaffine in its own normalised
action coefficients.  Splitting off `S = ∅` gives the `P(phi) + const` shape, and
the `|S| = 1` terms are the additive layer -- which is now *forced* to be affine
in `theta i`, exactly the raw-fibre constraint whose dimension
`1 + m + (2^m - 1 - m) = 2^m` was measured exactly in `E1_rawfiber_m6_K3.json`.

### What is still assumed

`hr` requires every coordinate to be ACTIVE.  A world with an inactive
coordinate is not covered: `rawTheta` is then built from a division by zero and
carries no information.  Removing that hypothesis needs a canonical choice of
representative (`Classical.choose` on `ActiveCoordinate`) together with the
convention `theta i ≡ 0` on inactive coordinates, at which point the
interpolation identity holds unconditionally -- on an inactive coordinate it
degenerates to `inactive_coordinate_constant`.  That generalisation is NOT done
here and the theorems below must not be quoted as if it were.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneNormalForm

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneReconstruction
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneMultiaffine

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] [DecidableEq U]

/-- **Multiaffine normal form.**  Under raw rank one at every coordinate, with
every coordinate active, `F` is a multiaffine polynomial in the normalised
action coefficients `rawTheta`, with coefficients indexed by subsets. -/
theorem rawRankOne_exists_multiaffine_coefficients {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ,
      ∀ x, F x = ∑ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)),
        c S * ∏ i ∈ S, rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i) := by
  classical
  have hmem := rawRankOne_mem_monomialSpan F u0 r zs hRank hr
  rw [monomialSet] at hmem
  -- `Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun` takes the ring explicitly and
  -- needs `Fintype` on the index, which here is `Finset (Fin (n+1))`.
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
  refine ⟨c, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hx := congrFun hc x
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hx
  exact hx.symm

/-- The same statement split into a constant and a purely interacting part, i.e.
`F = P(theta) + const` with `P` having no constant term. -/
theorem rawRankOne_normal_form_const_plus_interaction {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (b : ℝ) (c : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ),
      c ∅ = 0 ∧
      ∀ x, F x = b + ∑ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)),
        c S * ∏ i ∈ S, rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := rawRankOne_exists_multiaffine_coefficients F u0 r zs hRank hr
  refine ⟨c ∅, fun S => if S = ∅ then 0 else c S, by simp, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hc x]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (∅ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))))]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (∅ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))))]
  have hzero : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (n + 1)))).erase ∅,
      (if S = ∅ then (0 : ℝ) else c S) *
          ∏ i ∈ S, rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i)
        = c S * ∏ i ∈ S, rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i) := by
    intro S hS
    rw [if_neg (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hS)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hzero]
  simp

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneNormalForm

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RawRankOneReconstructionV1.lean (194 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RawLocalContrastRankOneV1»

/-!
# Corner reconstruction from raw rank one

`rawLocalContrastRankOne_interpolation` (star) says that at one coordinate the
value of `F` at an arbitrary action is an affine interpolation between its value
at the anchor and its value at one representative action, with weights that do
not depend on the context.  Applying it once per coordinate drives every
coordinate to one of two values, so `F` is determined by its values on the
`2^|T|` corners.

The statement proved here is the *partial* one, over an arbitrary
`T : Finset (Fin (n+1))` of already-reduced coordinates.  That is the form the
induction needs; the intended corollary is `T = univ`.

Two deliberate choices:

* the interpolation weight `rawTheta` is built from `F` alone -- no factorisation
  witness `(H, theta)` is carried anywhere, so no uniqueness or gauge lemma is
  ever required;
* the reduction is written so that each step produces `constant + theta * rest`
  directly.  Nothing here builds Bernstein weights and then inverts them, so no
  Moebius inversion is needed.

The hypothesis `hr` says every coordinate of `T` is *active*: some action moves
`F` somewhere.  Inactive coordinates are not covered and must be removed first
with `inactive_coordinate_constant`, which shows `F` does not depend on them.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneReconstruction

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] [DecidableEq U]

/-- The corner point: coordinates in `S` take the representative action, the
other coordinates of `T` take the anchor, everything outside `T` keeps `x`. -/
def cornerPoint {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (u0 : U)
    (T S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) : Fin (n + 1) → U :=
  fun j => if j ∈ S then r j else if j ∈ T then u0 else x j

/-- The tensor-product interpolation weight attached to a corner. -/
noncomputable def cornerWeight {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (T S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  (∏ i ∈ S, rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i)) *
    (∏ i ∈ T \ S, (1 - rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) (x i)))

section Corners

variable {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (u0 : U)
  {T S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {a : Fin (n + 1)} (x : Fin (n + 1) → U)

theorem cornerPoint_empty : cornerPoint r u0 ∅ ∅ x = x := by
  funext j
  simp [cornerPoint]

theorem cornerPoint_apply_of_not_mem (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    cornerPoint r u0 T S x a = x a := by
  simp [cornerPoint, haT, haS]

theorem cornerPoint_update_anchor (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    Function.update (cornerPoint r u0 T S x) a u0 =
      cornerPoint r u0 (insert a T) S x := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = a
  · subst hj
    simp [cornerPoint, Function.update_apply, haS]
  · simp [cornerPoint, Function.update_apply, hj, Finset.mem_insert]

theorem cornerPoint_update_representative (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    Function.update (cornerPoint r u0 T S x) a (r a) =
      cornerPoint r u0 (insert a T) (insert a S) x := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = a
  · subst hj
    simp [cornerPoint, Function.update_apply]
  · simp [cornerPoint, Function.update_apply, hj, Finset.mem_insert]

end Corners

section Weights

variable {n : ℕ} {F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ} {u0 : U}
  {r : Fin (n + 1) → U} {zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U)}
  {T S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {a : Fin (n + 1)} {x : Fin (n + 1) → U}

private theorem insert_sdiff_of_not_mem_right (haS : a ∉ S) :
    insert a T \ S = insert a (T \ S) := by
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j = a
  · subst hj
    simp [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_insert, haS]
  · simp [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_insert, hj]

private theorem insert_sdiff_insert (haT : a ∉ T) :
    insert a T \ insert a S = T \ S := by
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j = a
  · subst hj
    simp [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_insert, haT]
  · simp [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_insert, hj]

theorem cornerWeight_of_not_mem (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    cornerWeight F u0 r zs (insert a T) S x =
      (1 - rawTheta F a u0 (r a) (zs a) (x a)) *
        cornerWeight F u0 r zs T S x := by
  unfold cornerWeight
  rw [insert_sdiff_of_not_mem_right haS,
    Finset.prod_insert (fun h => haT (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h).1)]
  ring

theorem cornerWeight_of_mem (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    cornerWeight F u0 r zs (insert a T) (insert a S) x =
      rawTheta F a u0 (r a) (zs a) (x a) * cornerWeight F u0 r zs T S x := by
  unfold cornerWeight
  rw [insert_sdiff_insert haT, Finset.prod_insert haS]
  ring

end Weights

/-- One reduction step: (star) applied at a coordinate outside `T`. -/
theorem rawRankOne_split_at {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    {T S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {a : Fin (n + 1)} (x : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (hRank : RawLocalContrastRankOne F a u0)
    (hra : rawLocalContrast F a u0 (r a) (zs a) ≠ 0)
    (haT : a ∉ T) (haS : a ∉ S) :
    F (cornerPoint r u0 T S x) =
      (1 - rawTheta F a u0 (r a) (zs a) (x a)) *
          F (cornerPoint r u0 (insert a T) S x) +
        rawTheta F a u0 (r a) (zs a) (x a) *
          F (cornerPoint r u0 (insert a T) (insert a S) x) := by
  have hval : cornerPoint r u0 T S x a = x a :=
    cornerPoint_apply_of_not_mem r u0 x haT haS
  have hself :
      Function.update (cornerPoint r u0 T S x) a (x a) = cornerPoint r u0 T S x := by
    rw [← hval]
    exact Function.update_eq_self a _
  have h := rawLocalContrastRankOne_interpolation F a u0 (r a) (zs a) hRank hra
    (x a) (cornerPoint r u0 T S x)
  rw [hself, cornerPoint_update_anchor r u0 x haT haS,
    cornerPoint_update_representative r u0 x haT haS] at h
  exact h

/-- **Partial corner reconstruction.**  Every coordinate of `T` has been driven
to the anchor or to its representative, and `F x` is the tensor-product
interpolation of the resulting corner values. -/
theorem rawRankOne_partial_reconstruction {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) (T : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (∀ i ∈ T, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) →
      F x = ∑ S ∈ T.powerset,
        cornerWeight F u0 r zs T S x * F (cornerPoint r u0 T S x) := by
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro _
      simp [cornerWeight, cornerPoint_empty]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hr
      rw [Finset.sum_powerset_insert ha, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ih (fun i hi => hr i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro S hS
      have hSs : S ⊆ s := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hS
      have haS : a ∉ S := fun h => ha (hSs h)
      have hra : rawLocalContrast F a u0 (r a) (zs a) ≠ 0 :=
        hr a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      rw [cornerWeight_of_not_mem ha haS, cornerWeight_of_mem ha haS,
        rawRankOne_split_at F u0 r zs x (hRank a) hra ha haS]
      ring

/-- The intended corollary: with every coordinate active, `F` is determined by
its `2^(n+1)` corner values. -/
theorem rawRankOne_corner_reconstruction {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F x = ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
      cornerWeight F u0 r zs Finset.univ S x *
        F (cornerPoint r u0 Finset.univ S x) :=
  rawRankOne_partial_reconstruction F u0 r zs hRank x Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => hr i)

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneReconstruction

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RawRankOneVarietyCoverageV1.lean (53 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RawRankOneMultiaffineV1»

/-!
# Raw rank-one coverage by searched monomial fibres

This is the sound coverage direction needed for the E2 raw-fibre search.
For every active raw-rank-one world, the coefficients recovered directly from
the world by `rawTheta` define a searched monomial fibre containing that world.

The reverse inclusion is deliberately not claimed here: it requires the
separate closure theorem that every scalar-multiaffine fibre point with a
zero-anchor coefficient is raw rank one.  This module therefore does not
silently turn a coverage result into an equality-of-varieties claim.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneVarietyCoverage

open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawLocalContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneReconstruction
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneMultiaffine

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] [DecidableEq U]

/-- The raw normal-form fibre searched at a fixed family of action coefficients.
The anchor-zero condition removes the affine gauge at each coordinate. -/
def InRawMonomialFibre {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (t : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, t i u0 = 0) ∧ F ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (monomialSet t)

/-- Union over all anchor-normalized raw fibres. -/
def InSomeRawMonomialFibre {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, InRawMonomialFibre F u0 t

/-- **Lemma 6 (coverage).**  Given fixed active representatives, raw local
rank one places the world in the raw monomial fibre generated directly from
its own contrasts.  No factorization witness is chosen or used. -/
theorem rawRankOne_active_covered_by_rawMonomialFibre {n : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (u0 : U)
    (r : Fin (n + 1) → U) (zs : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → U))
    (hRank : ∀ i, RawLocalContrastRankOne F i u0)
    (hr : ∀ i, rawLocalContrast F i u0 (r i) (zs i) ≠ 0) :
    InSomeRawMonomialFibre F u0 := by
  let t : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ :=
    fun i u => rawTheta F i u0 (r i) (zs i) u
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simp [t, rawTheta_anchor]
  · simpa [t] using rawRankOne_mem_monomialSpan F u0 r zs hRank hr

end CIGAMF.P13.D6RawRankOneVarietyCoverage

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RecommendationMeasurabilityV1.lean (87 dong)
import «LeanD6RevalidationRegretBridgeV1»

/-! Certificates determine a unique top-q set on every observation vector.
This removes ambiguity in the Classical.choose recommendation and proves its
level sets measurable, including the no-certificate fallback. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RecommendationMeasurability
open scoped ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RevalidationRegretBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

lemma certified_unique (r q : ℕ) (x : Sample J) (S T : Finset J)
    (hS : Certified r q x S) (hT : Certified r q x T) : S=T := by
  have hcard : S.card=T.card := hS.1.trans hT.1.symm
  apply eq_of_subset_of_card_le ?_ hcard.ge
  intro i hi
  by_contra hit
  have hn : ¬ T ⊆ S := by
    intro h
    have he : T=S := eq_of_subset_of_card_le h hcard.le
    exact hit (he.symm ▸ hi)
  obtain ⟨j,hjt,hjs⟩ := not_subset.mp hn
  have h1 := hS.2 i hi j hjs
  have h2 := hT.2 j hjt i hit
  linarith

lemma certified_measurable (r q : ℕ) (S : Finset J) :
    MeasurableSet {x : Sample J | Certified r q x S} := by
  by_cases hS : S.card=q
  · simp only [Certified,hS,true_and,Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter (fun i => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ : i ∈ S =>
      MeasurableSet.iInter (fun j => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ : j ∉ S =>
        measurableSet_lt ((score_measurable r j).add_const _) (score_measurable r i)))))
  · simp [Certified,hS]

theorem recommendation_eq_iff (r q : ℕ) (x : Sample J) (S : Finset J) :
    recommendation q r x=S ↔ Certified r q x S ∨ (S=∅ ∧ ¬ accepts r q x) := by
  by_cases ha : accepts r q x
  · rw [recommendation,dif_pos ha]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Or.inl (h ▸ Classical.choose_spec ha)
    · rintro (hS | ⟨_,hn⟩)
      · exact certified_unique r q x _ S (Classical.choose_spec ha) hS
      · exact False.elim (hn ha)
  · simp [recommendation,ha,show ¬ Certified r q x S from fun h => ha ⟨S,h⟩,eq_comm]

theorem recommendation_level_measurable (r q : ℕ) (S : Finset J) :
    MeasurableSet {x : Sample J | recommendation q r x=S} := by
  simp_rw [recommendation_eq_iff]
  by_cases hS : S=∅
  · simp only [hS,true_and,Set.setOf_or]
    exact (certified_measurable r q ∅).union (accepts_measurable r q).compl
  · simpa only [hS,false_and,or_false] using certified_measurable r q S

theorem wrong_epoch_work_measurable (B : Finset J) (r0 : ℕ) :
    Measurable (wrongEpochWork B r0) := by
  unfold wrongEpochWork
  apply Measurable.ennreal_tsum
  intro s
  exact measurable_const.indicator (recommendation_level_measurable (epochSamples r0 s) B.card B).compl

/-- For measurable per-epoch actual oracle losses, the accumulated bad-label
loss is a measurable random variable, so its lintegral is an expectation. -/
theorem bad_regret_work_measurable {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : ℕ → Sample (Off j) → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hloss : ∀ s,Measurable (fun x => oracleRegret A j q mu E (w s x))) (r0 : ℕ) :
    Measurable (badRegretWork A j q mu E w r0) := by
  unfold badRegretWork
  apply Measurable.ennreal_tsum
  intro s
  apply measurable_const.mul
  exact (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (hloss s)).indicator
    (recommendation_level_measurable (epochSamples r0 s) (encodedB A j).card (encodedB A j)).compl

#print axioms certified_unique
#print axioms recommendation_eq_iff
#print axioms recommendation_level_measurable
#print axioms wrong_epoch_work_measurable
#print axioms bad_regret_work_measurable
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6RecommendationMeasurability

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RecordGapDecompositionV1.lean (68 dong)
import «LeanD6ProfileStoppingGeometryV1»

/-! Exact record likelihood gap and its grouping by the queries actually used.
These are pathwise identities; no independence of adaptive observations is used. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RecordGapDecomposition
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6ProfileStoppingGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ} {T : Type*}

def residual (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ) (t : T) := y t-actualMean A j mu (e t)

def difference (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ) (u : Measurement n) :=
  actualMean A j mu u-actualMean B j nu u

theorem actual_record_gap (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    score F e y A j mu-score F e y B j nu =
      ∑ t ∈ F,((difference A B j mu nu (e t))^2/2+
        difference A B j mu nu (e t)*residual A j mu e y t) := by
  unfold score difference residual
  rw [← sum_div, ← sum_div, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  ring

theorem actual_grouped_gap (F : Finset T) (e : T → Measurement n) (y : T → ℝ)
    (A B : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu nu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (hE : ∀ t ∈ F,e t ∈ E) :
    score F e y A j mu-score F e y B j nu =
      ∑ u ∈ E,(((F.filter (fun t => e t=u)).card : ℝ)*
        (difference A B j mu nu u)^2/2 + difference A B j mu nu u*
          ∑ t ∈ F.filter (fun t => e t=u),residual A j mu e y t) := by
  classical
  rw [actual_record_gap, ← sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hE]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  have he : (∑ t ∈ F.filter (fun t => e t=u),
      ((difference A B j mu nu (e t))^2/2+
        difference A B j mu nu (e t)*residual A j mu e y t)) =
      ∑ t ∈ F.filter (fun t => e t=u),
      ((difference A B j mu nu u)^2/2+
        difference A B j mu nu u*residual A j mu e y t) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [(mem_filter.mp ht).2]
  rw [he, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]
  simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- A query-wise residual bound controls every alternative simultaneously. -/
theorem noise_lower (c d s b eta : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (heta : 0 < eta)
    (hs : s^2 ≤ 2*c*b) : -eta*c*d^2/2-b/eta ≤ d*s := by
  have hsq := sq_nonneg (eta*c*d+s)
  have hpos : 0 < 2*eta*c := by positivity
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hpos).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_pos hc heta]

#print axioms actual_record_gap
#print axioms actual_grouped_gap
#print axioms noise_lower
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6RecordGapDecomposition

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ReferencePhaseThresholdV1.lean (101 dong)
import «LeanD6ReferencePhaseValueV1»

/-! # The finite-k threshold of the reference phase law.

`LeanD6ReferencePhaseValueV1` proves the value and that it collapses to zero
once `k * r <= e`. This module proves the converse direction as well, so the
threshold is an IFF rather than a one-sided sufficient condition, and restates
it in the margin variable:

    floor is alive   <->   e < k * r   <->   rho < 2 * a - e / k.

`rho_crit = 2 * a - e / k` is therefore exact at finite `k`. At the corner
(`a = 1`, `e = 0`) it is `rho_crit = 2`, recovering the published Top-C
threshold; every `t > 0` strictly lowers it, which is the precise sense in
which buying reference evidence shrinks the region of decision insufficiency.

This module says nothing about the asymptotic budget law `tau = k * t`; that is
measured in `research/master_reference_20260912`, not proved here.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferencePhaseThreshold
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferencePhaseValue
noncomputable section

theorem max_zero_pos_iff (x : ℝ) : 0 < max 0 x ↔ 0 < x := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_max_iff.mp h with h'|h'
    · exact absurd h' (lt_irrefl 0)
    · exact h'
  · intro h
    exact lt_max_iff.mpr (Or.inr h)

/-- The floor is strictly positive exactly when `e < k * r`. The `only if`
direction is `phaseValueFull_zero`; this supplies the `if` direction, which is
what turns the sufficient condition into a genuine threshold. -/
theorem phaseValueFull_pos_iff (k p c e r : ℝ) (hk : 1 < k) (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 < c) :
    0 < phaseValueFull k p c e r ↔ e < k*r := by
  have hk1 : (0:ℝ) < k-1 := by linarith
  have hden : (0:ℝ) < 4*(c*(k-1)) := by positivity
  have hsec : (0:ℝ) < p*(k-1)+max 0 (e-r) := by
    have h1 : (0:ℝ) < p*(k-1) := mul_pos hp hk1
    have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ max 0 (e-r) := le_max_left _ _
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hz : max 0 (k*r-e)=0 := max_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hzero : phaseValueFull k p c e r=0 := by
      unfold phaseValueFull
      rw [hz]
      simp
    rw [hzero] at h
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  · intro h
    have hm : 0 < max 0 (k*r-e) := (max_zero_pos_iff _).mpr (by linarith)
    unfold phaseValueFull
    exact div_pos (mul_pos hm hsec) hden

/-- The same threshold in the margin variable: `rho_crit = 2 * a - e / k`. -/
theorem threshold_margin (k a e rho : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    e < k*(2*a-rho) ↔ rho < 2*a-e/k := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hd : e/k < 2*a-rho := (div_lt_iff₀ hk).mpr (by linarith)
    linarith
  · intro h
    have hd : e/k < 2*a-rho := by linarith
    have hx := (div_lt_iff₀ hk).mp hd
    linarith

/-- Floor alive, stated entirely in the margin. -/
theorem floor_alive_iff_margin (k p c a e rho : ℝ) (hk : 1 < k) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hc : 0 < c) :
    0 < phaseValueFull k p c e (2*a-rho) ↔ rho < 2*a-e/k := by
  rw [phaseValueFull_pos_iff k p c e (2*a-rho) hk hp hc]
  exact threshold_margin k a e rho (by linarith)

/-- At the corner the threshold is exactly the published `2 * delta_square`. -/
theorem corner_threshold (k rho : ℝ) (hk : 1 < k) :
    rho < 2*(1:ℝ)-(0:ℝ)/k ↔ rho < 2 := by
  rw [zero_div]
  norm_num

/-- Every positive correction strictly lowers the threshold below the corner
value: buying reference evidence shrinks the insufficiency region. -/
theorem threshold_strictly_below_corner (k a e : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (he : 0 < e)
    (ha : a ≤ 1) : 2*a-e/k < 2 := by
  have : 0 < e/k := div_pos he hk
  linarith

#print axioms max_zero_pos_iff
#print axioms phaseValueFull_pos_iff
#print axioms threshold_margin
#print axioms floor_alive_iff_margin
#print axioms corner_threshold
#print axioms threshold_strictly_below_corner

end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferencePhaseThreshold

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ReferencePhaseValueV1.lean (295 dong)
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! # Reference-dependent phase value: two-action dominance, endpoint worlds,
and the matching 2x2 certificate WITH the correction term.

This closes the purely algebraic segment named as the next Lean target in
`D6_REFERENCE_PHASE_DERIVATION_20260911.md`:

    two-action dominance -> endpoint-world reduction -> finite minimax value.

Everything is stated over abstract slope data `(p, r, c, e, b)`, so it applies at
every product reference, not only the corner. `LeanD6ReferenceReducedGameV1`
proves the value for the special case `e = 0`; the theorems here carry the
correction `e = min a (2 * b)` that the actual oscillation formula produces, and
`corner_value` recovers `k * rho * (2 - rho) / 4` at `a = 1, b = 0`.

NOT closed here, deliberately:
* the product-sum computation of the three slopes at a general reference, and
* the exact oscillation formula producing `risk0 / riskOne / riskGen`.
Those remain the open bridge. Every statement below is an algebraic consequence
of the loss SHAPE, with that shape taken as a definition, not as a theorem about
`productResponse`. Do not read this module as the general-reference minimax
theorem; read it as the half of that theorem which is now machine-checked.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferencePhaseValue
noncomputable section

/-! ## The symmetrised risk shape -/

/-- The `u`-free part of twice-the-regret after symmetrising over `T`:
`d` coordinates dropped, hidden intersection `h`, expected overlap `h * d / k`. -/
def base (k p c e r h d : ℝ) : ℝ := (p*d-2*c*(h*d/k)+max e (r*h))/2

/-- Decision `d = 0`; its correction is the full `e`. -/
def risk0 (e r h : ℝ) : ℝ := (max e (r*h)-e)/2

/-- Decision `d = 1`; its expected correction is `b * (k - h) / k`. -/
def riskOne (k p c e r b h : ℝ) : ℝ := base k p c e r h 1-b*(k-h)/k/2

/-- Any decision `2 <= d <= k`; no correction. -/
def riskGen (k p c e r h d : ℝ) : ℝ := base k p c e r h d

theorem risk0_eq (k p c e r h : ℝ) : risk0 e r h = base k p c e r h 0-e/2 := by
  unfold risk0 base; ring

/-- `base` is affine in `d`: mixing `d = 0` and `d = k` reproduces it exactly. -/
theorem base_affine (k p c e r h d : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (1-d/k)*base k p c e r h 0+(d/k)*base k p c e r h k = base k p c e r h d := by
  unfold base; field_simp; ring

/-! ## L1: two-action dominance -/

/-- Every decision `2 <= d <= k` is no better than the mixture of `d = 0` and
`d = k` with weights `1 - d/k` and `d/k`. The whole gap is the correction `e`
that only the `d = 0` action pays. -/
theorem dominance_gen (k p c e r h d : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hdk : d ≤ k) :
    (1-d/k)*risk0 e r h+(d/k)*base k p c e r h k ≤ riskGen k p c e r h d := by
  have hne : k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hk
  have haff := base_affine k p c e r h d hne
  have hw : 0 ≤ 1-d/k := by
    have hle : d/k ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hk).mpr hdk
    linarith
  have hpos : 0 ≤ (1-d/k)*(e/2) := mul_nonneg hw (by linarith)
  have hexp : (1-d/k)*(base k p c e r h 0-e/2)+(d/k)*base k p c e r h k
      = ((1-d/k)*base k p c e r h 0+(d/k)*base k p c e r h k)-(1-d/k)*(e/2) := by ring
  unfold riskGen
  rw [risk0_eq k p c e r h, hexp, haff]
  linarith

/-- The decision `d = 1` is dominated by the same mixture, because its expected
correction `b (k - h) / k` never exceeds the mixture's `(k - 1) e / k`.
This is the step the LP tables cannot supply. -/
theorem dominance_one (k p c e r b h : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hbe : b ≤ e)
    (hh1 : 1 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) :
    (1-1/k)*risk0 e r h+(1/k)*base k p c e r h k ≤ riskOne k p c e r b h := by
  have hne : k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hk
  have he : 0 ≤ e := le_trans hb hbe
  have hkh : 0 ≤ k-h := by linarith
  have haff := base_affine k p c e r h 1 hne
  have hexp : (1-1/k)*(base k p c e r h 0-e/2)+(1/k)*base k p c e r h k
      = ((1-1/k)*base k p c e r h 0+(1/k)*base k p c e r h k)-(1-1/k)*(e/2) := by ring
  have hnum : 0 ≤ e*(k-1)-b*(k-h) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg he (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ h-1),
      mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ e-b) hkh]
  have hsplit : (1-1/k)*(e/2)-b*(k-h)/k/2 = (e*(k-1)-b*(k-h))/(2*k) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hkey : b*(k-h)/k/2 ≤ (1-1/k)*(e/2) := by
    have hdiv : 0 ≤ (e*(k-1)-b*(k-h))/(2*k) := div_nonneg hnum (by linarith)
    linarith
  unfold riskOne
  rw [risk0_eq k p c e r h, hexp, haff]
  linarith

/-! ## L2: the endpoint-world reduction -/

/-- `x ↦ max e (r * x)` is convex, in the explicit segment form needed below. -/
theorem max_affine_convex (e r x y l : ℝ) (hl0 : 0 ≤ l) (hl1 : l ≤ 1) :
    max e (r*((1-l)*x+l*y)) ≤ (1-l)*max e (r*x)+l*max e (r*y) := by
  have hx : r*x ≤ max e (r*x) := le_max_right _ _
  have hy : r*y ≤ max e (r*y) := le_max_right _ _
  have hex : e ≤ max e (r*x) := le_max_left _ _
  have hey : e ≤ max e (r*y) := le_max_left _ _
  have hl' : 0 ≤ 1-l := by linarith
  rcases le_total (r*((1-l)*x+l*y)) e with hcase|hcase
  · rw [max_eq_left hcase]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl' (sub_nonneg.mpr hex), mul_nonneg hl0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hey)]
  · rw [max_eq_right hcase]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl' (sub_nonneg.mpr hx), mul_nonneg hl0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hy)]

/-- The two-action decision: `d = 0` with probability `q`, `d = k` otherwise. -/
def mixRisk (k p c e r q h : ℝ) : ℝ := q*risk0 e r h+(1-q)*base k p c e r h k

theorem mixRisk_convex (k p c e r q x y l : ℝ) (hl0 : 0 ≤ l) (hl1 : l ≤ 1) :
    mixRisk k p c e r q ((1-l)*x+l*y)
      ≤ (1-l)*mixRisk k p c e r q x+l*mixRisk k p c e r q y := by
  have key := max_affine_convex e r x y l hl0 hl1
  have hid : (1-l)*mixRisk k p c e r q x+l*mixRisk k p c e r q y
      -mixRisk k p c e r q ((1-l)*x+l*y)
      = ((1-l)*max e (r*x)+l*max e (r*y)-max e (r*((1-l)*x+l*y)))/2 := by
    unfold mixRisk risk0 base; ring
  linarith

/-- Hence the worst hidden intersection is an endpoint: `h = 1` or `h = k`.
No world in the interior can beat both. -/
theorem endpoint_max (k p c e r q h : ℝ) (hk : 1 < k) (hh1 : 1 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) :
    mixRisk k p c e r q h ≤ max (mixRisk k p c e r q 1) (mixRisk k p c e r q k) := by
  have hk1 : (0:ℝ) < k-1 := by linarith
  have hne : k-1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hk1
  set l : ℝ := (h-1)/(k-1) with hldef
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := div_nonneg (by linarith) hk1.le
  have hl1 : l ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hk1).mpr (by linarith)
  have hlk : l*(k-1) = h-1 := by rw [hldef]; field_simp
  have hz : (1-l)*1+l*k = h := by linarith
  have hc := mixRisk_convex k p c e r q 1 k l hl0 hl1
  rw [hz] at hc
  have hA : mixRisk k p c e r q 1 ≤ max (mixRisk k p c e r q 1) (mixRisk k p c e r q k) :=
    le_max_left _ _
  have hB : mixRisk k p c e r q k ≤ max (mixRisk k p c e r q 1) (mixRisk k p c e r q k) :=
    le_max_right _ _
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1-l) (sub_nonneg.mpr hA),
    mul_nonneg hl0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)]

/-! ## L3: the matching 2x2 certificate -/

def uOne (r e : ℝ) : ℝ := (max 0 (r-e))/2
def vTerm (k p e r : ℝ) : ℝ := (p*(k-1)+max 0 (e-r))/2
def uTop (k r e : ℝ) : ℝ := (k*r-e)/2
def phaseValue (k p c e r : ℝ) : ℝ := uTop k r e*vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1))

/-- The full formula, valid on both sides of the threshold. -/
def phaseValueFull (k p c e r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (max 0 (k*r-e))*(p*(k-1)+max 0 (e-r))/(4*(c*(k-1)))

theorem max_diff (x y : ℝ) : max 0 (y-x)-max 0 (x-y) = y-x := by
  rcases le_total x y with h|h
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ y-x), max_eq_left (by linarith : x-y ≤ (0:ℝ))]
    ring
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : y-x ≤ (0:ℝ)), max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ x-y)]
    ring

/-- The denominator of the game value is exactly `c (k - 1)`. This is where
`p + r = 2c` (i.e. `(rho - 2b) + (2a - rho) = 2(a - b)`) does all the work, and
it is why the correction `e` cancels out of the denominator but not the value. -/
theorem denom_eq (k p c e r : ℝ) (hpr : p+r = 2*c) :
    uTop k r e-uOne r e+vTerm k p e r = c*(k-1) := by
  unfold uTop uOne vTerm
  have h := max_diff r e
  have hmul : (p+r)*(k-1) = 2*c*(k-1) := by rw [hpr]
  linarith

/-- Both equalisers for an abstract 2x2 matrix `[[u, v], [U, 0]]` whose
denominator is `D = U - u + v`. Primal mixes the two decisions, dual mixes the
two endpoint worlds; all four products equal `U v / D`. -/
theorem equalizer_generic (U u v D : ℝ) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hDef : U = D+u-v) :
    ((v/D)*u+(1-v/D)*v = U*v/D) ∧ ((v/D)*U+(1-v/D)*0 = U*v/D) ∧
    ((1-(v-u)/D)*u+((v-u)/D)*U = U*v/D) ∧ ((1-(v-u)/D)*v+((v-u)/D)*0 = U*v/D) := by
  subst hDef
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp <;> ring
  · field_simp <;> ring
  · field_simp <;> ring
  · field_simp <;> ring

theorem phase_equalizers (k p c e r : ℝ) (hpr : p+r = 2*c) (hD : c*(k-1) ≠ 0) :
    ((vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)))*uOne r e
        +(1-vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)))*vTerm k p e r = phaseValue k p c e r) ∧
    ((vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)))*uTop k r e
        +(1-vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)))*0 = phaseValue k p c e r) ∧
    ((1-(vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)))*uOne r e
        +((vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)))*uTop k r e = phaseValue k p c e r) ∧
    ((1-(vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)))*vTerm k p e r
        +((vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)))*0 = phaseValue k p c e r) := by
  have hd := denom_eq k p c e r hpr
  have hDef : uTop k r e = c*(k-1)+uOne r e-vTerm k p e r := by linarith
  exact equalizer_generic (uTop k r e) (uOne r e) (vTerm k p e r) (c*(k-1)) hD hDef

/-! ## Weights are legitimate probabilities -/

theorem uOne_le_uTop (k r e : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hact : e ≤ k*r) :
    uOne r e ≤ uTop k r e := by
  unfold uOne uTop
  rcases le_total r e with h|h
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : r-e ≤ (0:ℝ))]; linarith
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ r-e)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ k-1) hr]

theorem uOne_le_vTerm (k p e r : ℝ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : 1/2 ≤ p) (hr1 : r ≤ 1)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) : uOne r e ≤ vTerm k p e r := by
  unfold uOne vTerm
  rcases le_total r e with h|h
  · rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : r-e ≤ (0:ℝ))]
    have : 0 ≤ max 0 (e-r) := le_max_left _ _
    nlinarith
  · rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ r-e)]
    have hm : 0 ≤ max 0 (e-r) := le_max_left _ _
    nlinarith

theorem uTop_nonneg (k r e : ℝ) (hact : e ≤ k*r) : 0 ≤ uTop k r e := by
  unfold uTop; linarith

theorem vTerm_nonneg (k p e r : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 0 ≤ p) : 0 ≤ vTerm k p e r := by
  unfold vTerm
  have hm : 0 ≤ max 0 (e-r) := le_max_left _ _
  nlinarith

theorem weights_valid (k p c e r : ℝ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hr1 : r ≤ 1) (hp : 1/2 ≤ p) (hact : e ≤ k*r) (hpr : p+r = 2*c)
    (hc : 0 < c*(k-1)) :
    0 ≤ vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)) ∧ vTerm k p e r/(c*(k-1)) ≤ 1 ∧
    0 ≤ (vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)) ∧
    (vTerm k p e r-uOne r e)/(c*(k-1)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hd := denom_eq k p c e r hpr
  have hv := vTerm_nonneg k p e r (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hU := uTop_nonneg k r e hact
  have h1 := uOne_le_uTop k r e (by linarith) hr hact
  have h2 := uOne_le_vTerm k p e r hk hp hr1 he
  refine ⟨div_nonneg hv hc.le, (div_le_one hc).mpr (by linarith),
    div_nonneg (by linarith) hc.le, (div_le_one hc).mpr (by linarith)⟩

/-! ## The value, the threshold, and the corner specialisation -/

theorem phaseValueFull_eq (k p c e r : ℝ) (hact : e ≤ k*r) (hD : c*(k-1) ≠ 0) :
    phaseValueFull k p c e r = phaseValue k p c e r := by
  unfold phaseValueFull phaseValue uTop vTerm
  rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ k*r-e)]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Above the phase boundary `k r <= e` the value collapses to zero: the
decision `d = 0` is optimal in every world. This is the finite-`k` form of
`2 (1 + tau) exp (-2 tau) = rho`. -/
theorem phaseValueFull_zero (k p c e r : ℝ) (hinact : k*r ≤ e) :
    phaseValueFull k p c e r = 0 := by
  unfold phaseValueFull
  rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : k*r-e ≤ (0:ℝ))]
  simp

/-- At the corner reference `a = 1, b = 0` we have `c = 1`, `e = 0`, `p = rho`,
`r = 2 - rho`, and the general value collapses to the already published corner
law. The corner law is therefore a special case, not an independent result. -/
theorem corner_value (k rho : ℝ) (hk : 1 < k) (hr1 : 1 ≤ rho) (hr2 : rho ≤ 2) :
    phaseValueFull k rho 1 0 (2-rho) = k*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  have hk1 : (0:ℝ) < k-1 := by linarith
  have hne : k-1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hk1
  unfold phaseValueFull
  rw [max_eq_right (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ k*(2-rho)-0),
    max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ)-(2-rho) ≤ (0:ℝ))]
  field_simp
  ring

#print axioms risk0_eq
#print axioms base_affine
#print axioms dominance_gen
#print axioms dominance_one
#print axioms max_affine_convex
#print axioms mixRisk_convex
#print axioms endpoint_max
#print axioms max_diff
#print axioms denom_eq
#print axioms equalizer_generic
#print axioms phase_equalizers
#print axioms uOne_le_uTop
#print axioms uOne_le_vTerm
#print axioms uTop_nonneg
#print axioms vTerm_nonneg
#print axioms weights_valid
#print axioms phaseValueFull_eq
#print axioms phaseValueFull_zero
#print axioms corner_value

end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferencePhaseValue

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ReferenceReducedGameV1.lean (72 dong)
import «LeanD6SameResponseMarginGameV1»

/-! Algebraic game for the reference scale t=tau/k.
This is the reduced bilinear game, NOT yet a Lean bridge from productResponse
at non-corner references. The actual finite-cube bridge and approximation error
are derived separately and checked by run_d6_reference_phase_reduction.py.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferenceReducedGame
noncomputable section

def payoff (k a b rho h d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((rho-2*b)*d-2*(a-b)*h*d/k+(2*a-rho)*h)/2

def value (k a b rho : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  k*(rho-2*b)*(2*a-rho)/(4*(a-b))

def pZero (a b rho : ℝ) : ℝ := (rho-2*b)/(2*(a-b))

theorem weights_valid (a b rho : ℝ) (hab : b < a)
    (hlo : 2*b ≤ rho) (hhi : rho ≤ 2*a) :
    0 ≤ pZero a b rho ∧ pZero a b rho ≤ 1 := by
  unfold pZero
  have hd : 0 < 2*(a-b) := by linarith
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hd.le
  · apply (div_le_one hd).mpr
    linarith

theorem primal_equalizer (k a b rho h : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    pZero a b rho * payoff k a b rho h 0 +
      (1-pZero a b rho)*payoff k a b rho h k = value k a b rho := by
  unfold pZero payoff value
  have hc : a-b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  field_simp
  <;> ring

theorem dual_equalizer (k a b rho d : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    pZero a b rho * payoff k a b rho k d +
      (1-pZero a b rho)*payoff k a b rho 0 d = value k a b rho := by
  unfold pZero payoff value
  have hc : a-b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  field_simp
  <;> ring

/-- Moving the missing h=0 dual world to h=1 costs at most a-b.
This addresses the actual combinatorial restriction |A intersect T| >= 1.
-/
theorem replace_zero_world (k a b rho d : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) (hab : b < a)
    (hlo : 2*b ≤ rho) (hhi : rho ≤ 2*a) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hdk : d ≤ k) :
    |payoff k a b rho 1 d-payoff k a b rho 0 d| ≤ a-b := by
  have hc : 0 ≤ a-b := by linarith
  have hz : 0 ≤ d/k := div_nonneg hd hk.le
  have ho : d/k ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hk).mpr hdk
  have hp : 0 ≤ (a-b)*(d/k) := mul_nonneg hc hz
  have hu : (a-b)*(d/k) ≤ a-b := by nlinarith
  have he : payoff k a b rho 1 d-payoff k a b rho 0 d =
      (2*a-rho)/2-(a-b)*(d/k) := by unfold payoff;ring
  rw [he,abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith

/-- The known corner law is recovered at a=1, b=0. -/
theorem corner_value (k rho : ℝ) : value k 1 0 rho=k*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  unfold value
  ring

#print axioms weights_valid
#print axioms primal_equalizer
#print axioms dual_equalizer
#print axioms replace_zero_world
#print axioms corner_value
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ReferenceReducedGame

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RepeatedDiscoveryV1.lean (147 dong)
import «LeanD6ActualDiscoveryBridgeV1»
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.BorelCantelli

/-! Revalidation on one raw-query path: r0 fresh contrasts per epoch, and
exponentially growing allocation epochs. The expected total length of epochs
with failed/wrong discovery is finite. This controls erroneous commitments;
it does not by itself prove tracking, allocation regret, or a Gamma rate. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

def epochSamples (r0 s : ℕ) := r0*(s+1)

def badEpochWork (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample J) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' s : ℕ,(bad B a (epochSamples r0 s)).indicator (fun _ => (2:ℝ≥0∞)^s) x

lemma bad_measurable (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (bad B a r) := by
  simp only [bad,Set.ofPred_exists]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => measurableSet_le measurable_const
    (((score_measurable r i).sub_const _).abs))

lemma linear_exp_bound (r0 s : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    Real.exp (-(epochSamples r0 s:ℝ)/128) ≤ Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*(1/4:ℝ)^s := by
  have hr : (512:ℝ) ≤ r0 := by exact_mod_cast hr0
  have he : Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128) ≤ (1:ℝ)/4 := by
    rw [show -(r0:ℝ)/128 = -((r0:ℝ)/128) by ring,Real.exp_neg]
    have hh : (4:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128) := by
      have ht := Real.add_one_le_exp ((r0:ℝ)/128);linarith
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4) hh
  have hid : -(epochSamples r0 s:ℝ)/128=(s+1:ℕ)*(-(r0:ℝ)/128) := by
    simp only [epochSamples,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one];ring
  rw [hid,Real.exp_nat_mul,pow_succ,mul_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_nonneg _) he s) (Real.exp_nonneg _)

lemma epoch_tail (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) (s : ℕ) :
    vectorPath m (bad B a (epochSamples r0 s)) ≤ eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
  have hh := vector_tail m B a hm (epochSamples r0 s) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (linear_exp_bound r0 s hr0)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(Fintype.card J:ℝ))
  have he := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hh.trans hd)
  rw [ofReal_measureReal] at he
  have heq : ENNReal.ofReal (2*(Fintype.card J:ℝ)*(Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*(1/4:ℝ)^s)) =
      eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
    rw [← mul_assoc,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num)]
    simp [eta]
  rwa [heq] at he

/-- Cost weighted by whole future epoch lengths, so one early wrong label is
not charged as merely one failed query. No independence across epochs is used. -/
theorem expected_bad_epoch_work (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,badEpochWork B a r0 x ∂vectorPath m) ≤ 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0 := by
  unfold badEpochWork
  rw [lintegral_tsum (fun s => (measurable_const.indicator (bad_measurable B a _)).aemeasurable)]
  calc
    _ = ∑' s : ℕ,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*vectorPath m (bad B a (epochSamples r0 s)) := by
      apply tsum_congr;intro s
      exact lintegral_indicator_const (bad_measurable B a _) _
