    _ ≤ ∑' s : ℕ,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :=
      ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun s => mul_le_mul le_rfl (epoch_tail m B a hm r0 hr0 s) (by positivity) (by positivity))
    _ = eta (Fintype.card J) r0*∑' s : ℕ,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
      rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
      apply tsum_congr;intro s
      have he : (2:ℝ≥0∞)*4⁻¹=2⁻¹ := by
        apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).mp
        norm_num
      calc
        _ = eta (Fintype.card J) r0*((2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) := by ac_rfl
        _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow,he]
    _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two,mul_comm]

/-- Rechecking yields eventual correct certification almost surely, including
paths that previously certified a wrong label. -/
theorem eventually_correct (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂vectorPath m, ∀ᶠ s in Filter.atTop,
      accepts (epochSamples r0 s) B.card x ∧
      ∀ S, Certified (epochSamples r0 s) B.card x S → S=B := by
  have hs : (∑' s : ℕ,vectorPath m (bad B a (epochSamples r0 s))) ≠ ∞ := by
    apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top (b := eta (Fintype.card J) r0*2) (by dsimp [eta];finiteness)
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑' s : ℕ,eta (Fintype.card J) r0*(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun s => (epoch_tail m B a hm r0 hr0 s).trans (by
          have he : (4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2⁻¹ := by exact ENNReal.inv_le_inv.mpr (by norm_num)
          gcongr))
      _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left,ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two]
  filter_upwards [ae_eventually_notMem hs] with x hx
  filter_upwards [hx] with s hs
  exact ⟨good_accepts B a _ x hs,fun S hS => good_certificate_correct B S a _ x hs hS⟩

/-- The recommendation uses only observations and the known cardinality q.
When no certificate exists it returns an explicit fallback and is checked anew
at the next epoch; that fallback's entire epoch is included in the loss bound. -/
def recommendation (q r : ℕ) (x : Sample J) : Finset J :=
  if h : accepts r q x then Classical.choose h else ∅

lemma recommendation_correct_on_good (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r : ℕ) (x : Sample J)
    (hx : x ∉ bad B a r) : recommendation B.card r x=B := by
  have ha := good_accepts B a r x hx
  rw [recommendation,dif_pos ha]
  exact good_certificate_correct B _ a r x hx (Classical.choose_spec ha)

def wrongEpochWork (B : Finset J) (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample J) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' s : ℕ,{y | recommendation B.card (epochSamples r0 s) y ≠ B}.indicator
    (fun _ => (2:ℝ≥0∞)^s) x

theorem wrong_epoch_work_le (B : Finset J) (a : J) (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample J) :
    wrongEpochWork B r0 x ≤ badEpochWork B a r0 x := by
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro s
  by_cases hb : x ∈ bad B a (epochSamples r0 s)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hb]
    by_cases hw : x ∈ {y | recommendation B.card (epochSamples r0 s) y ≠ B}
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hw,le_refl]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hw];exact zero_le
  · have hc := recommendation_correct_on_good B a _ x hb
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hb,hc]

theorem expected_wrong_epoch_work (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,wrongEpochWork B r0 x ∂vectorPath m) ≤ 2*eta (Fintype.card J) r0 :=
  (lintegral_mono (wrong_epoch_work_le B a r0)).trans (expected_bad_epoch_work m B a hm r0 hr0)

/-- Actual D6 query means discharge the only generic mean premise. -/
theorem actual_expected_bad_epoch_work {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.I n))
    (j : CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold.I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i,a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i,i ≠ helper i) (mu : ℝ)
    (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,badEpochWork (encodedB A j) a r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) ≤
      2*eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0 :=
  expected_bad_epoch_work _ _ a (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0

#print axioms epoch_tail
#print axioms expected_bad_epoch_work
#print axioms eventually_correct
#print axioms expected_wrong_epoch_work
#print axioms actual_expected_bad_epoch_work
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery

/-!
# Packaged residual API for the PAEC programme

This file only packages the already proved product-centering facts.  It does
not use the killed free-response relaxation: every identity is derived from a
single product reference `q` and its row normalizations.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualAPI

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualCentering
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualOrthogonality

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem residual_core {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1) :
    productExpectation q (productResidual q F) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i u, productResponse q (productResidual q F) i u = 0) ∧
      (∀ i x c,
        mixedDifference (productResidual q F) i x c =
          mixedDifference F i x c) := by
  refine ⟨R0_productResidual_expectation_zero q hRow F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i u
    exact R1_productResidual_response_zero q hRow F i u
  · intro i x c
    exact R2_mixedDifference_residual q F i x c

theorem residual_loss_api {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected =
      osc (fun x ↦ productResidual q F x +
        selectedᶜ.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j))) / 2 := by
  exact R3_residual_loss_rewrite q F selected

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualAPI

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ResidualCentering.lean (111 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanProductMixedDifferenceV4»

/-!
# D6 residual centering identities

This P13 module keeps the P12 baseline immutable.  It starts from the literal
product-reference reconstruction `productA` and its residual `F - productA`.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualCentering

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

noncomputable def productResidual {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  F x - productA q F x

theorem mixedDifference_sum_coordinates_zero {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (c0 : ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    mixedDifference (fun a ↦ (∑ j, g j (a j)) + c0) i x c = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold mixedDifference
  have hterm : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      g j (x j) - g j ((Function.update x i (c i)) j) -
          g j ((Function.update c i (x i)) j) + g j (c j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp
    · simp [Function.update, hji]
  rw [show
      ((∑ j, g j (x j)) + c0) -
          ((∑ j, g j ((Function.update x i (c i)) j)) + c0) -
          ((∑ j, g j ((Function.update c i (x i)) j)) + c0) +
          ((∑ j, g j (c j)) + c0) =
        ∑ j, (g j (x j) - g j ((Function.update x i (c i)) j) -
          g j ((Function.update c i (x i)) j) + g j (c j)) by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      ring]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ ↦ hterm j)

theorem productA_mixedDifference_zero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    mixedDifference (productA q F) i x c = 0 := by
  unfold productA surrogate
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using
    (mixedDifference_sum_coordinates_zero
      (productResponse q F)
      (-(((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * productB q F)) i x c)

theorem R2_mixedDifference_residual {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    mixedDifference (productResidual q F) i x c = mixedDifference F i x c := by
  rw [show productResidual q F = fun a ↦ F a - productA q F a by
    funext a; rfl]
  unfold mixedDifference
  have hzero := productA_mixedDifference_zero q F i x c
  unfold mixedDifference at hzero
  linarith

theorem residual_retained_decomposition {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    F x - selected.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j)) =
      productResidual q F x +
        selectedᶜ.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j)) -
          ((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * productB q F := by
  classical
  have hsum := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl selected
    (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j))
  unfold productResidual productA surrogate
  linarith

theorem R3_residual_loss_rewrite {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (selected : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected =
      osc (fun x ↦ productResidual q F x +
        selectedᶜ.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j))) / 2 := by
  let core : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ := fun x ↦
    productResidual q F x +
      selectedᶜ.sum (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j))
  let shift : ℝ := -(((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * productB q F)
  have hfun :
      (fun x ↦ F x - selected.sum
        (fun j ↦ productResponse q F j (x j))) =
      (fun x ↦ core x + shift) := by
    funext x
    rw [residual_retained_decomposition q F selected x]
    rfl
  unfold productCompressionLoss
  rw [hfun, osc_add_const]

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualCentering

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ResidualGlobalNormV1.lean (149 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6ResidualCentering»

/-!
# Product residual centering from global normalization

The older residual API uses row normalization
`∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1`.  For the actual finite product weights used by the
D6 headline, the weaker global normalization
`∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1` is already sufficient.  The key algebra is a
weight-preserving swap of one coordinate between two full product worlds.

This module proves the first bridge in that direction: the product average of
each first-order response is the product baseline under `hNorm` alone.  It
does not modify P12 or replace the older API.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualGlobalNorm

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualCentering

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- Swap the `i`-th coordinates of two full worlds. -/
noncomputable def coordinatePairSwap {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Fin (n + 1) → U) × (Fin (n + 1) → U)) ≃
      ((Fin (n + 1) → U) × (Fin (n + 1) → U)) where
  toFun z :=
    (Function.update z.2 i (z.1 i), Function.update z.1 i (z.2 i))
  invFun z :=
    (Function.update z.2 i (z.1 i), Function.update z.1 i (z.2 i))
  left_inv z := by
    rcases z with ⟨x, c⟩
    simp [Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]
  right_inv z := by
    rcases z with ⟨x, c⟩
    simp [Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]

/-- Swapping one coordinate between two worlds preserves the product of their
joint weights.  No row normalization is used. -/
private theorem jointWeight_coordinatePairSwap {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    jointWeight q x * jointWeight q c =
      jointWeight q (Function.update c i (x i)) *
        jointWeight q (Function.update x i (c i)) := by
  classical
  unfold jointWeight
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun j ↦ q j (x j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun j ↦ q j (c j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ
      (fun j ↦ q j ((Function.update c i (x i)) j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ
      (fun j ↦ q j ((Function.update x i (c i)) j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [Function.update_self]
  have hx :
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        q j ((Function.update x i (c i)) j)) =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j (x j) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
    simp [Function.update, hji]
  have hc :
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        q j ((Function.update c i (x i)) j)) =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j (c j) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
    simp [Function.update, hji]
  rw [hx, hc]
  ring

/-- Under global product normalization, averaging the `i`-th response back
over a full product world recovers the baseline.  This is the exact place
where the former `hRow` proof artifact is removed. -/
theorem productResponse_global_mean {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1) :
    productExpectation q (fun x ↦ productResponse q F i (x i)) =
      productB q F := by
  classical
  unfold productExpectation productResponse productB
  simp only [productExpectation]
  rw [show
      (∑ x, jointWeight q x *
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c * F (Function.update c i (x i)))) =
        ∑ z : (Fin (n + 1) → U) × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
          jointWeight q z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 *
            F (Function.update z.2 i (z.1 i)) by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      ring]
  have hswap :
      (∑ z : (Fin (n + 1) → U) × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
        jointWeight q z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 *
          F (Function.update z.2 i (z.1 i))) =
        ∑ z : (Fin (n + 1) → U) × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
          jointWeight q z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 * F z.1 := by
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (coordinatePairSwap i)
    intro z
    rcases z with ⟨x, c⟩
    change jointWeight q x * jointWeight q c *
        F (Function.update c i (x i)) =
      jointWeight q (Function.update c i (x i)) *
        jointWeight q (Function.update x i (c i)) *
          F (Function.update c i (x i))
    rw [jointWeight_coordinatePairSwap]
  rw [hswap, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  change
      (∑ x : Fin (n + 1) → U,
        ∑ c : Fin (n + 1) → U,
          jointWeight q x * jointWeight q c * F x) =
        ∑ x, jointWeight q x * F x
  rw [show
      (∑ x : Fin (n + 1) → U,
        ∑ c : Fin (n + 1) → U,
          jointWeight q x * jointWeight q c * F x) =
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c) *
          (∑ x, jointWeight q x * F x) by
      calc
        _ = ∑ x : Fin (n + 1) → U,
            (jointWeight q x * F x) * (∑ c, jointWeight q c) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x hx
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro c hc
          ring
        _ = _ := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          ring]
  rw [hNorm, one_mul]

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualGlobalNorm

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ResidualOrthogonality.lean (347 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6ResidualCentering»

/-!
# Product-reference residual orthogonality

For normalized finite product-reference rows, the ANOVA residual
`e = F - A_q` has zero product expectation and zero first-order product
responses.  Both conclusions are derived from the literal P12 definitions;
they are not assumed as centering hypotheses.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualOrthogonality

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualCentering

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

private lemma product_modified_at_coordinate {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (g : U → ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    (∏ j, if j = i then q j (c j) * g (c j) else q j (c j)) =
      jointWeight q c * g (c i) := by
  classical
  unfold jointWeight
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ
    (fun j ↦ if j = i then q j (c j) * g (c j) else q j (c j))
    (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun j ↦ q j (c j))
    (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [if_pos]
  have hsame :
      (∏ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        if x = i then q x (c x) * g (c x) else q x (c x)) =
      ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q x (c x) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
    simp [hji]
  rw [hsame]
  ring

theorem productExpectation_coordinate {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (g : U → ℝ) :
    productExpectation q (fun c ↦ g (c i)) = ∑ u, q i u * g u := by
  classical
  unfold productExpectation
  rw [show (∑ c, jointWeight q c * g (c i)) =
      ∑ (c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
        ∏ j, if j = i then q j (c j) * g (c j) else q j (c j) by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c hc
    exact (product_modified_at_coordinate q i g c).symm]
  rw [← Fintype.piFinset_univ]
  rw [Finset.sum_prod_piFinset (Finset.univ : Finset U)
    (fun j u ↦ if j = i then q j u * g u else q j u)]
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ
    (fun j ↦ ∑ u, if j = i then q j u * g u else q j u)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [if_pos]
  have hrest :
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ∑ u, if j = i then q j u * g u else q j u) = 1 := by
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
    simp [hji, hRow j]
  rw [hrest]
  ring

noncomputable def coordinateSwap {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (U × (Fin (n + 1) → U)) ≃ (U × (Fin (n + 1) → U)) where
  toFun z := (z.2 i, Function.update z.2 i z.1)
  invFun z := (z.2 i, Function.update z.2 i z.1)
  left_inv z := by
    rcases z with ⟨u, c⟩
    simp [Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]
  right_inv z := by
    rcases z with ⟨u, c⟩
    simp [Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self]

private lemma coordinateSwap_weight {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (u : U) (c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    q i (c i) * jointWeight q (Function.update c i u) =
      q i u * jointWeight q c := by
  classical
  unfold jointWeight
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ
    (fun j ↦ q j ((Function.update c i u) j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul Finset.univ (fun j ↦ q j (c j))
    (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp
  have hsame :
      (∏ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q x ((Function.update c i u) x)) =
      ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q x (c x) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
    simp [Function.update, hji]
  rw [hsame]
  ring

theorem productResponse_average {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∑ u, q i u * productResponse q F i u) = productB q F := by
  classical
  unfold productResponse productB productExpectation
  have hswap :
      (∑ z : U × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
        q i z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 * F (Function.update z.2 i z.1)) =
      ∑ z : U × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
        q i z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 * F z.2 := by
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (coordinateSwap i)
    intro z
    rcases z with ⟨u, c⟩
    change q i u * jointWeight q c * F (Function.update c i u) =
      q i (c i) * jointWeight q (Function.update c i u) *
        F (Function.update c i u)
    rw [coordinateSwap_weight]
  rw [show (∑ u, q i u *
      ∑ c, jointWeight q c * F (Function.update c i u)) =
      ∑ z : U × (Fin (n + 1) → U),
        q i z.1 * jointWeight q z.2 * F (Function.update z.2 i z.1) by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro u hu
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c hc
    ring]
  rw [hswap, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [show (∑ x : U, ∑ y, q i x * jointWeight q y * F y) =
      (∑ x : U, q i x) * (∑ y, jointWeight q y * F y) by
    calc
      _ = ∑ x : U, q i x * (∑ y, jointWeight q y * F y) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y hy
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]]
  rw [hRow]
  simp

theorem jointWeight_normalized {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1) :
    ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1 := by
  classical
  unfold jointWeight
  rw [← Fintype.piFinset_univ]
  rw [Finset.sum_prod_piFinset (Finset.univ : Finset U) q]
  simp [hRow]

private lemma weighted_sum_surrogate_expand {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (Q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (b : ℝ) :
    (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
      ((∑ j, Q j (c j)) - ((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b)) =
    (∑ j, ∑ c, jointWeight q c * Q j (c j)) -
      ((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b *
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ c, (jointWeight q c * (∑ j, Q j (c j)) -
        jointWeight q c * (((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      ring
    _ = (∑ c, jointWeight q c * (∑ j, Q j (c j))) -
        ∑ c, jointWeight q c *
          (((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (∑ c, jointWeight q c * (∑ j, Q j (c j))) =
          ∑ j, ∑ c, jointWeight q c * Q j (c j) by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro c hc
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

theorem productA_expectation_eq_productB {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    productExpectation q (productA q F) = productB q F := by
  classical
  have hJoint := jointWeight_normalized q hRow
  have hQmean : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      (∑ c, jointWeight q c * productResponse q F j (c j)) =
        productB q F := by
    intro j
    change productExpectation q (fun c ↦ productResponse q F j (c j)) =
      productB q F
    rw [productExpectation_coordinate q hRow]
    exact productResponse_average q hRow F j
  unfold productExpectation productA surrogate
  rw [weighted_sum_surrogate_expand]
  simp_rw [hQmean]
  rw [hJoint]
  simp
  ring

theorem R0_productResidual_expectation_zero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) :
    productExpectation q (productResidual q F) = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold productExpectation productResidual
  rw [show (∑ c, jointWeight q c * (F c - productA q F c)) =
      (∑ c, jointWeight q c * F c) -
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c * productA q F c) by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c hc
    ring]
  change productB q F - productExpectation q (productA q F) = 0
  rw [productA_expectation_eq_productB q hRow F]
  ring

private lemma weighted_sum_updated_surrogate_expand {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (Q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (b : ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) :
    (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
      ((∑ j, Q j ((Function.update c i u) j)) -
        ((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b)) =
    (∑ j, ∑ c, jointWeight q c * Q j ((Function.update c i u) j)) -
      ((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b *
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ c, (jointWeight q c *
        (∑ j, Q j ((Function.update c i u) j)) -
        jointWeight q c * (((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c hc
      ring
    _ = (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
        (∑ j, Q j ((Function.update c i u) j))) -
        ∑ c, jointWeight q c *
          (((Fintype.card (Fin (n + 1)) : ℝ) - 1) * b) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
          (∑ j, Q j ((Function.update c i u) j))) =
          ∑ j, ∑ c, jointWeight q c *
            Q j ((Function.update c i u) j) by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro c hc
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

theorem productA_response_eq_original {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) :
    productResponse q (productA q F) i u = productResponse q F i u := by
  classical
  have hJoint := jointWeight_normalized q hRow
  have hQmean : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      (∑ c, jointWeight q c * productResponse q F j (c j)) =
        productB q F := by
    intro j
    change productExpectation q (fun c ↦ productResponse q F j (c j)) =
      productB q F
    rw [productExpectation_coordinate q hRow]
    exact productResponse_average q hRow F j
  have hTerm : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
        productResponse q F j ((Function.update c i u) j)) =
      if j = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F := by
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [Function.update]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hJoint, one_mul]
    · simpa [Function.update, hji] using hQmean j
  rw [show productResponse q (productA q F) i u =
      productExpectation q (fun c ↦ productA q F (Function.update c i u)) by
    rfl]
  unfold productExpectation productA surrogate
  rw [weighted_sum_updated_surrogate_expand]
  simp_rw [hTerm]
  rw [hJoint]
  have hite :
      (∑ j : Fin (n + 1),
        if j = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F) =
      productResponse q F i u + (n : ℝ) * productB q F := by
    have hrest :
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if j = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F) =
        (n : ℝ) * productB q F := by
      rw [show (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if j = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, productB q F by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa using hj
        simp [hji]]
      simp
    calc
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if j = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F) +
          (if i = i then productResponse q F i u else productB q F) := by
            symm
            exact Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      _ = _ := by rw [hrest]; simp; ring
  rw [hite]
  simp

theorem R1_productResidual_response_zero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hRow : ∀ i, ∑ u, q i u = 1)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) :
    productResponse q (productResidual q F) i u = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [show productResponse q (productResidual q F) i u =
      productExpectation q (fun c ↦
        F (Function.update c i u) -
          productA q F (Function.update c i u)) by rfl]
  unfold productExpectation
  rw [show (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
      (F (Function.update c i u) - productA q F (Function.update c i u))) =
      (∑ c, jointWeight q c * F (Function.update c i u)) -
        (∑ c, jointWeight q c *
          productA q F (Function.update c i u)) by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c hc
    ring]
  change productResponse q F i u - productResponse q (productA q F) i u = 0
  rw [productA_response_eq_original q hRow F i u]
  ring

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ResidualOrthogonality

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6RevalidationRegretBridgeV1.lean (64 dong)
import «LeanD6RepeatedDiscoveryV1»
import «LeanD6AdaptiveOracleRegretV1»

/-! The erroneous-label contribution to actual D6 oracle regret is bounded
across all allocation epochs. This is a decomposition term, not a matching
regret theorem: the regret inside correctly labelled epochs remains to prove. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6RevalidationRegretBridge
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6GaussianQueryDominance CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AdaptiveOracleRegret
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActualDiscoveryBridge CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {n : ℕ}

def badRegretWork (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : ℕ → Sample (Off j) → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' s : ℕ,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s *
    {y | recommendation (encodedB A j).card (epochSamples r0 s) y ≠ encodedB A j}.indicator
      (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (oracleRegret A j q mu E (w s y))) x

lemma bad_regret_work_le (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : ℕ → Sample (Off j) → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ s x e, e ∈ E → 0 ≤ w s x e) (r0 : ℕ) (x : Sample (Off j)) :
    badRegretWork A j q mu E w r0 x ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*wrongEpochWork (encodedB A j) r0 x := by
  unfold badRegretWork wrongEpochWork
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro s
  by_cases h : x ∈ {y | recommendation (encodedB A j).card (epochSamples r0 s) y ≠ encodedB A j}
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
    have he := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (oracle_regret_bounded A j q mu E (w s x) (hw s x))
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (show (0:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2^s from zero_le)
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem h,mul_zero,le_refl]

/-- Expected total oracle regret incurred during incorrectly labelled epochs
of lengths 2^s is finite and <= 2*eta*oracleValue. Multiplying epoch lengths by a
fixed raw-query block cost multiplies both sides by the same constant. -/
theorem actual_bad_regret_expectation (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (a : Off j) (helper : Off j → Off j)
    (ha : ∀ i,a ≠ helper i) (hi : ∀ i,i ≠ helper i) (q mu : ℝ)
    (E : Finset (Measurement n)) (w : ℕ → Sample (Off j) → Measurement n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ s x e,e ∈ E → 0 ≤ w s x e) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0) :
    (∫⁻ x,badRegretWork A j q mu E w r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*(2*eta (Fintype.card (Off j)) r0) := by
  have hh := expected_wrong_epoch_work (means A j a helper mu) (encodedB A j) a
    (actual_mean_identity A j hj a helper ha hi mu) r0 hr0
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x,ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu))*wrongEpochWork (encodedB A j) r0 x
        ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu) := lintegral_mono (bad_regret_work_le A j q mu E w hw r0)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (oracleValue A j q mu)) *
        ∫⁻ x,wrongEpochWork (encodedB A j) r0 x ∂vectorPath (means A j a helper mu) :=
      lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul le_rfl hh (by positivity) (by positivity)

#print axioms bad_regret_work_le
#print axioms actual_bad_regret_expectation
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6RevalidationRegretBridge

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6SameResponseMarginCertificateV1.lean (133 dong)
import «LeanD6SameResponseMarginGameV1»

/-! Finite actual-world matching certificates. k=q+1. The primal randomizes
between T and T-complement. The dual mixes the full hidden intersection with
q+1 singleton-intersection worlds. Both certificates act on actual loss. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginCertificate
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginLoss
open CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginGame
noncomputable section

def singletonWorld {n : ℕ} (T : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) := insert i (others T j)

lemma singleton_inter {n : ℕ} (T : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hi : i ∈ T) :
    singletonWorld T j i ∩ T={i} := by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [singletonWorld,mem_inter,mem_insert,mem_singleton,others,mem_erase,mem_sdiff,mem_univ,true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h.1 with he | hh
    · exact he
    · exact False.elim (hh.2 h.2)
  · intro he
    subst x
    exact ⟨Or.inl rfl,hi⟩

lemma singleton_valid (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (T : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hT : T ∈ worlds q j) (i : I (2*q+1)) (hi : i ∈ T) :
    singletonWorld T j i ∈ worlds q j := by
  classical
  have hp := world_parameters q j hq hT
  have hj : i ≠ j := by intro he;subst i;exact hp.1 hi
  have hnot : i ∉ others T j := by simp [others,hi]
  have hb : (others T j).card=q := by
    change (Tᶜ.erase j).card=q
    rw [card_erase_of_mem (by simp [hp.1]),hp.2.2.1,hp.2.1]
    omega
  apply mem_powersetCard.mpr
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_insert.mp hx with he | hm
    · subst x;simp [positiveGround,hj]
    · exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨(mem_erase.mp hm).1,mem_univ _⟩
  · change (insert i (others T j)).card=q+1
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hnot,hb]

lemma singleton_average (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (T S : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hT : T ∈ worlds q j) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) :
    (∑ i ∈ T,(loss (singletonWorld T j i) T S j rho-
      loss (singletonWorld T j i) T (singletonWorld T j i)ᶜ j rho))/((q:ℝ)+1)=
      (rho*((T \ S).card:ℝ)-2*((T \ S).card:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)+1)+(2-rho))/2 := by
  classical
  have ht := world_parameters q j hq hT
  let D := T \ S
  have hDdef : D=T \ S := rfl
  have hD : D ⊆ T := sdiff_subset
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ T,((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ))=(D.card:ℝ) := by
    have he (i : I (2*q+1)) (hi : i ∈ T) :
        singletonWorld T j i ∩ D=if i ∈ D then {i} else ∅ := by
      have h := singleton_inter T j i hi
      have hid : singletonWorld T j i ∩ D=(singletonWorld T j i ∩ T) ∩ D := by
        ext x;simp only [mem_inter];exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨⟨hx.1,hD hx.2⟩,hx.2⟩,fun hx => ⟨hx.1.1,hx.2⟩⟩
      rw [hid,h]
      by_cases hh : i ∈ D <;> simp [hh]
    have heq : (∑ i ∈ T,((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ))=
        ∑ i ∈ T,if i ∈ D then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [he i hi]
      split <;> simp
    rw [heq,sum_ite_mem,inter_eq_right.mpr hD]
    simp
  have hpoint (i : I (2*q+1)) (hi : i ∈ T) :
      loss (singletonWorld T j i) T S j rho-loss (singletonWorld T j i) T (singletonWorld T j i)ᶜ j rho=
        (rho*(D.card:ℝ)-2*((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ)+(2-rho))/2 := by
    have hp := world_parameters q j hq (singleton_valid q hq j T hT i hi)
    rw [actual_regret_formula _ T S j hp.1 ht.1 rho hr hp.2.2.2,singleton_inter T j i hi]
    simp only [card_singleton,Nat.cast_one,mul_one,hDdef]
  have heq := sum_congr rfl hpoint
  have hsplit : ∀ i ∈ T,
      (rho*(D.card:ℝ)-2*((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ)+(2-rho))/2=
        (rho*(D.card:ℝ)+(2-rho))/2-((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ) := by
    intro i _;ring
  have hval : (∑ i ∈ T,(rho*(D.card:ℝ)-2*((singletonWorld T j i ∩ D).card:ℝ)+(2-rho))/2)=
      ((q:ℝ)+1)*((rho*(D.card:ℝ)+(2-rho))/2)-(D.card:ℝ) := by
    rw [sum_congr rfl hsplit,sum_sub_distrib,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,hsum,ht.2.1]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [heq,hval]
  change _=(rho*(D.card:ℝ)-2*(D.card:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)+1)+(2-rho))/2
  have hk : (q:ℝ)+1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

/-- A normalized nonnegative prior on k+1 actual same-response worlds makes
every decision have exactly the claimed regret. -/
theorem actual_dual_equalizer (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (T S : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hT : T ∈ worlds q j) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) :
    ((((q:ℝ)+1)*rho-2)/(2*q))*(loss T T S j rho-loss T T Tᶜ j rho)+
      (1-(((q:ℝ)+1)*rho-2)/(2*q))*
        ((∑ i ∈ T,(loss (singletonWorld T j i) T S j rho-
          loss (singletonWorld T j i) T (singletonWorld T j i)ᶜ j rho))/((q:ℝ)+1))=
      ((q:ℝ)+1)*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  have hp := world_parameters q j hq hT
  rw [singleton_average q hq j T S hT rho hr,
    actual_regret_formula T T S j hp.1 hp.1 rho hr hp.2.2.2]
  have he : T ∩ (T \ S)=T \ S := inter_eq_right.mpr sdiff_subset
  rw [inter_self,he,hp.2.1]
  push_cast
  have ha := adversary_equalizer ((q:ℝ)+1) rho ((T \ S).card:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ q+1 by omega))
  convert ha using 1 <;> ring

/-- The same prior lower certificate holds against every finite randomized
rule; sum one is its only assumption. -/
theorem randomized_dual_equalizer (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (T : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hT : T ∈ worlds q j) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho)
    (S : Finset (Finset (I (2*q+1)))) (p : Finset (I (2*q+1)) → ℝ) (hn : ∑ U ∈ S,p U=1) :
    (∑ U ∈ S,p U*(((((q:ℝ)+1)*rho-2)/(2*q))*(loss T T U j rho-loss T T Tᶜ j rho)+
      (1-(((q:ℝ)+1)*rho-2)/(2*q))*
        ((∑ i ∈ T,(loss (singletonWorld T j i) T U j rho-
          loss (singletonWorld T j i) T (singletonWorld T j i)ᶜ j rho))/((q:ℝ)+1))))=
      ((q:ℝ)+1)*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  simp_rw [actual_dual_equalizer q hq j T _ hT rho hr]
  rw [← sum_mul,hn,one_mul]

#print axioms singleton_valid
#print axioms singleton_average
#print axioms actual_dual_equalizer
#print axioms randomized_dual_equalizer
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginCertificate

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6SameResponseMarginGameV1.lean (88 dong)
import «LeanD6SameResponseMarginLossV1»

/-! Actual same-Q regret reduction and the two-action minimax upper strategy.
The adversarial matching certificate is proved algebraically here; its lift to
an arbitrary randomized finite decision rule still needs the singleton-world
averaging bridge. Do not read the upper bound as the full minimax equality. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginGame
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginLoss
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def loss (A T S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (rho : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  productCompressionLoss (fibreWorld A T j rho) (productResponse corner (fibreWorld A T j rho)) S

theorem actual_regret_formula (A T S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjT : j ∉ T)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    loss A T S j rho-loss A T Aᶜ j rho=
      (rho*((T \ S).card:ℝ)-2*((A ∩ (T \ S)).card:ℝ)+(2-rho)*((A ∩ T).card:ℝ))/2 := by
  unfold loss
  rw [actual_loss_formula A T S j hjA hjT rho hr hB,
    actual_loss_formula A T Aᶜ j hjA hjT rho hr hB]
  have he : T \ Aᶜ=A ∩ T := by ext i;simp [and_comm]
  have hi : A ∩ (A ∩ T)=A ∩ T := by ext i;simp
  rw [he,hi]
  ring

/-- The true-world complement is optimal for all decisions of the right size
(and even for unrestricted S). Hence the regret formula uses a true optimum. -/
theorem complement_optimal (A T S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjT : j ∉ T)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hr2 : rho ≤ 2) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    loss A T Aᶜ j rho ≤ loss A T S j rho := by
  have he := actual_regret_formula A T S j hjA hjT rho hr hB
  have hsub : A ∩ (T \ S) ⊆ A ∩ T := by
    intro i hi
    rcases mem_inter.mp hi with ⟨ha,hd⟩
    exact mem_inter.mpr ⟨ha,(mem_sdiff.mp hd).1⟩
  have hu : ((A ∩ (T \ S)).card:ℝ) ≤ (A ∩ T).card := by exact_mod_cast card_le_card hsub
  have hd : ((A ∩ (T \ S)).card:ℝ) ≤ (T \ S).card := by exact_mod_cast card_le_card inter_subset_right
  have h1 := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2-rho by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)
  have h2 := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ rho by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hd)
  nlinarith

/-- A-free strategy: output T with probability rho/2, T-complement otherwise.
Its expected actual regret is exactly k*rho*(2-rho)/4 at every hidden world. -/
theorem actual_two_action_risk (A T : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjT : j ∉ T)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    (rho/2)*(loss A T T j rho-loss A T Aᶜ j rho)+
      (1-rho/2)*(loss A T Tᶜ j rho-loss A T Aᶜ j rho)=
        (T.card:ℝ)*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  rw [actual_regret_formula A T T j hjA hjT rho hr hB,
    actual_regret_formula A T Tᶜ j hjA hjT rho hr hB]
  have hs : T \ T=(∅ : Finset (I n)) := by ext i;simp
  have ht : T \ Tᶜ=T := by ext i;simp
  rw [hs,ht,Finset.inter_empty,Finset.card_empty]
  push_cast
  ring

/-- Algebraic matching adversary: mix the full hidden intersection with a
uniform singleton hidden intersection. d denotes the size of the decision's
omitted subset of T; the expected regret is independent of d. -/
theorem adversary_equalizer (k rho d : ℝ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ((k*rho-2)/(2*(k-1)))*((2-rho)*(k-d)/2)+
      (1-(k*rho-2)/(2*(k-1)))*((rho*d-2*d/k+(2-rho))/2)=
        k*rho*(2-rho)/4 := by
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hk1 : k-1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  <;> ring

theorem mixture_weights_valid (k rho : ℝ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hr2 : rho ≤ 2) :
    0 ≤ (k*rho-2)/(2*(k-1)) ∧ (k*rho-2)/(2*(k-1)) ≤ 1 ∧
      0 ≤ rho/2 ∧ rho/2 ≤ 1 := by
  have hd : 0 < 2*(k-1) := by linarith
  have hn : 0 ≤ k*rho-2 := by nlinarith
  have hupper : k*rho-2 ≤ 2*(k-1) := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨div_nonneg hn hd.le,(div_le_one hd).mpr hupper,by linarith,by linarith⟩

#print axioms actual_regret_formula
#print axioms complement_optimal
#print axioms actual_two_action_risk
#print axioms adversary_equalizer
#print axioms mixture_weights_valid
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginGame

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6SameResponseMarginLossV1.lean (148 dong)
import «LeanD6SharpMarginSteeringV1»

/-! World-dependent modular compensation pins the entire corner response to
rho*1_T, while preserving mixed differences. The compression loss is computed
on actual binary worlds, not postulated as a regret table. rho >= 1. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginLoss
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginSteering
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def compensation (A T : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ :=
  (if i ∈ T then rho else 0)-(if i ∈ A then 1 else 0)
def fibreWorld (A T : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (rho : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  world A j 1 x+linear (compensation A T rho) x

theorem common_response (A T : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (i : I n) (u : Bool) :
    productResponse corner (fibreWorld A T j rho) i u=(if i ∈ T then rho else 0)*bit u := by
  rw [corner_response]
  have hw := world_response A j hj 1 i u
  rw [corner_response] at hw
  have hl := linear_difference (compensation A T rho) zero i u false
  rw [show Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) i false=zero from Function.update_eq_self i zero,
    linear_zero,bit_false] at hl
  simp only [sub_zero] at hl
  dsimp only [fibreWorld]
  rw [hw,hl]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ A <;> by_cases ht : i ∈ T <;> simp [D6Threshold.slope,compensation,hi,ht] <;> ring

theorem mixed_unchanged (A T : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (rho : ℝ) (x c : I n → Bool) :
    mixedDifference (fibreWorld A T j rho) i x c=mixedDifference (world A j 1) i x c := by
  have hx := linear_difference (compensation A T rho) x i (x i) (c i)
  have hc := linear_difference (compensation A T rho) c i (x i) (c i)
  rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hx
  rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hc
  unfold mixedDifference fibreWorld
  linarith

lemma actual_residual (A T S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) :
    fibreWorld A T j rho x-∑ i ∈ S,productResponse corner (fibreWorld A T j rho) i (x i)=
      gate A j x+linear (compensation A (T \ S) rho) x := by
  classical
  simp_rw [common_response A T j hj]
  simp only [fibreWorld,world_one_gate,linear,compensation,sub_mul,ite_mul,zero_mul,one_mul,sum_sub_distrib,sum_ite_mem,univ_inter]
  have hh : (∑ i ∈ T,rho*bit (x i))-(∑ i ∈ S ∩ T,rho*bit (x i))=
      ∑ i ∈ T \ S,rho*bit (x i) := by
    have he : T \ (S ∩ T)=T \ S := by ext i;simp only [mem_sdiff,mem_inter];tauto
    have hsum := sum_sdiff (s₁:=S ∩ T) (s₂:=T) (f:=fun i => rho*bit (x i)) inter_subset_right
    rw [he] at hsum
    linarith
  linarith

def lowerCoeff (A D : Finset (I n)) (i : I n) : ℝ := if i ∈ A \ D then -1 else 0
def upperCoeff (A D : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ :=
  (if i ∈ D then rho else 0)-(if i ∈ A ∩ D then 1 else 0)

lemma coefficient_bounds (A D : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho)
    (i : I n) (b : Bool) :
    lowerCoeff A D i ≤ compensation A D rho i*bit b ∧
      compensation A D rho i*bit b ≤ upperCoeff A D rho i := by
  classical
  by_cases ha : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hd : i ∈ D <;> cases b <;>
    simp [lowerCoeff,upperCoeff,compensation,ha,hd] <;> linarith

lemma linear_bounds (A D : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (x : I n → Bool) :
    -((A \ D).card:ℝ) ≤ linear (compensation A D rho) x ∧
    linear (compensation A D rho) x ≤ rho*(D.card:ℝ)-((A ∩ D).card:ℝ) := by
  have hl := sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ univ) => (coefficient_bounds A D rho hr i (x i)).1)
  have hu := sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ univ) => (coefficient_bounds A D rho hr i (x i)).2)
  simpa only [linear,lowerCoeff,upperCoeff,sum_sub_distrib,sum_ite_mem,univ_inter,
    sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_neg,mul_one,mul_comm,neg_one_mul] using And.intro hl hu

def lo (A D : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : I n → Bool := fun i => decide (i=j ∨ i ∈ A \ D)
def hi (A D : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : I n → Bool := fun i => decide (i≠j ∧ i ∉ A \ D)

lemma lo_linear (A D : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjD : j ∉ D) (rho : ℝ) :
    linear (compensation A D rho) (lo A D j)=-((A \ D).card:ℝ) := by
  classical
  have he (i : I n) : compensation A D rho i*bit (lo A D j i)=lowerCoeff A D i := by
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i;simp [lo,compensation,lowerCoeff,hjA,hjD]
    · by_cases ha : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hd : i ∈ D <;>
        simp [lo,compensation,lowerCoeff,bit,hij,ha,hd]
  simp only [linear,he,lowerCoeff,sum_ite_mem,univ_inter,sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_neg,mul_one]

lemma hi_linear (A D : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjD : j ∉ D) (rho : ℝ) :
    linear (compensation A D rho) (hi A D j)=rho*(D.card:ℝ)-((A ∩ D).card:ℝ) := by
  classical
  have he (i : I n) : compensation A D rho i*bit (hi A D j i)=upperCoeff A D rho i := by
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i;simp [hi,compensation,upperCoeff,hjA,hjD]
    · by_cases ha : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hd : i ∈ D <;>
        simp [hi,compensation,upperCoeff,bit,hij,ha,hd]
  simp only [linear,he,upperCoeff,sum_sub_distrib,sum_ite_mem,univ_inter,
    sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one,mul_comm]

lemma hi_gate (A D : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) : gate A j (hi A D j)=1 := by
  classical
  have hf : (others A j).filter (fun i => hi A D j i=true)=others A j := by
    apply filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro i him
    have h : i ∉ A ∧ i ≠ j := by simpa [others,and_comm] using him
    simp [hi,h.1,h.2]
  have hc : 2 ≤ count (others A j) (hi A D j) := by simpa [count,hf] using hB
  simp [gate,hi,hc]

/-- Exact loss formula for every selected set S. No cardinality premise on S
is needed for this identity; the k-budget is imposed by the game afterwards. -/
theorem actual_loss_formula (A T S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hjA : j ∉ A) (hjT : j ∉ T)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (fibreWorld A T j rho) (productResponse corner (fibreWorld A T j rho)) S=
      (1+(A.card:ℝ)+rho*((T \ S).card:ℝ)-2*((A ∩ (T \ S)).card:ℝ))/2 := by
  classical
  let D := T \ S
  have hjD : j ∉ D := by simp [D,hjT]
  have hl : gate A j (lo A D j)+linear (compensation A D rho) (lo A D j)=-((A \ D).card:ℝ) := by
    rw [lo_linear A D j hjA hjD]
    simp [gate,lo]
  have hu : gate A j (hi A D j)+linear (compensation A D rho) (hi A D j)=
      1+rho*(D.card:ℝ)-((A ∩ D).card:ℝ) := by
    rw [hi_gate A D j hB,hi_linear A D j hjA hjD];ring
  have he := osc_of_extremes (fun x => gate A j x+linear (compensation A D rho) x)
    (lo A D j) (hi A D j) (fun x => by
      rw [hl]
      have h := linear_bounds A D rho hr x
      linarith [(gate_bounds A j x).1]) (fun x => by
      rw [hu]
      have h := linear_bounds A D rho hr x
      linarith [(gate_bounds A j x).2])
  unfold productCompressionLoss
  simp_rw [actual_residual A T S j hjA]
  change osc (fun x => gate A j x+linear (compensation A D rho) x)/2=_
  rw [he,hl,hu]
  have hc : ((A \ D).card:ℝ)+((A ∩ D).card:ℝ)=(A.card:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_sdiff_add_card_inter A D
  change _=(1+(A.card:ℝ)+rho*(D.card:ℝ)-2*((A ∩ D).card:ℝ))/2
  linarith

#print axioms common_response
#print axioms mixed_unchanged
#print axioms actual_loss_formula
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6SameResponseMarginLoss

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ScalarExplorationSeparationV1.lean (68 dong)
import «LeanD6BlindActualMomentsV1»
import «LeanD6AllocationRiskBridgeV1»

/-! Actual information supplied by forced scalar exploration. The inequalities
hold for all wrong labels and nuisance margins. No termination or rate premise
is hidden in this deterministic separation result. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarExplorationSeparation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationSharp CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationRiskBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6BlindActualMoments
noncomputable section

lemma quadratic_separation (q d mu z : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    mu^2/2 ≤ q*z^2/2+d*mu*z+d*mu^2 := by
  have he : q*z^2/2+d*mu*z+d*mu^2-d*mu^2/2=
      (q*z+d*mu)^2/(2*q)+d*(q-d)*mu^2/(2*q) := by field_simp; ring
  have hp : 0 ≤ (q*z+d*mu)^2/(2*q)+d*(q-d)*mu^2/(2*q) := by
    have hdd : 0 ≤ q-d := sub_nonneg.mpr hdq
    positivity
  nlinarith only [he,hp,mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hd) (sq_nonneg mu)]

theorem one_round_information (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (A A' : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hc : A'.card=A.card) (hB : (others A j).card=q) (hne : A' ≠ A) (mu nu : ℝ) :
    mu^2/2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j,scalarKL A A' j i mu nu := by
  have hd := alternative_distance_bounds A A' j q hj' hc hne (by exact_mod_cast hB)
  have he := actual_scalar_average A A' j q mu (nu-mu) hj hj' hc (by exact_mod_cast hB)
  rw [show mu+(nu-mu)=nu by ring] at he
  have hn : ((2*q+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hs := (div_left_inj hn).mp he
  rw [hs]
  exact quadratic_separation q _ mu (nu-mu) (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)) hd.1 hd.2

theorem forced_rounds_information (q : ℕ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) (j : I (2*q+1))
    (A A' : Finset (I (2*q+1))) (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A')
    (hc : A'.card=A.card) (hB : (others A j).card=q) (hne : A' ≠ A) (mu nu r : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (E : Finset (Measurement (2*q+1))) (count : Measurement (2*q+1) → ℝ)
    (hcount : ∀ e ∈ E,0 ≤ count e)
    (hinclude : ∀ i ∈ univ.erase j,(.inl i : Measurement (2*q+1)) ∈ E)
    (hforced : ∀ i ∈ univ.erase j,r ≤ count (.inl i)) :
    r*mu^2/2 ≤ ∑ e ∈ E,count e*information A A' j mu nu e := by
  have hsub : ((univ.erase j).image (Sum.inl : I (2*q+1) → Measurement (2*q+1))) ⊆ E := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
    exact hinclude i hi
  calc
    _ ≤ r*(∑ i ∈ univ.erase j,scalarKL A A' j i mu nu) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_round_information q hq j A A' hj hj' hc hB hne mu nu) hr
      nlinarith only [h]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ univ.erase j,count (.inl i)*information A A' j mu nu (.inl i) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hforced i hi) (information_nonnegative A A' j mu nu (.inl i))
    _ = ∑ e ∈ (univ.erase j).image (Sum.inl : I (2*q+1) → Measurement (2*q+1)),count e*information A A' j mu nu e := by
      rw [sum_image]
      intro i hi k hk he
      exact Sum.inl.inj he
    _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun e he _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hcount e he) (information_nonnegative A A' j mu nu e))

#print axioms quadratic_separation
#print axioms one_round_information
#print axioms forced_rounds_information
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarExplorationSeparation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ScalarMultiaffineMixedDifferenceV1.lean (83 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6ScalarMultiaffineRankOneV1»

/-!
# Mixed differences of a scalar multiaffine world factor exactly

For a world in scalar multiaffine normal form the D6 mixed difference is a
PRODUCT of an action factor and a context factor:

  `mixedDifference F i x c = (phi i (x i) - phi i (c i)) * (H_i x - H_i c)`

This is the reduction that makes the interaction bound cheap.  Bounding
`|mixedDifference|` over all `(i, x, c)` naively is `6 * 729 * 729` instances;
after this lemma it is `|phi i (x i) - phi i (c i)| <= 1` -- immediate when
`phi` is two-valued -- times the oscillation of a single coordinate cofactor.

Nothing here assumes anything about the reference `q`: the mixed difference is
a property of `F` alone.  No decision or half-factor bound is claimed.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarMultiaffineMixedDifference

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarMultiaffineRankOne

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- The exact factorization. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_mixedDifference {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    mixedDifference (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i x c =
      (phi i (x i) - phi i (c i)) *
        (multiaffineContextFactor phi W i x - multiaffineContextFactor phi W i c) := by
  classical
  have hx := scalarMultiaffineWorld_slice_contrast g b phi W i (x i) (c i) x
  have hc := scalarMultiaffineWorld_slice_contrast g b phi W i (x i) (c i) c
  rw [Function.update_eq_self i x] at hx
  rw [Function.update_eq_self i c] at hc
  unfold mixedDifference
  linarith [hx, hc]

/-- With a two-valued `phi` the action factor is bounded by one, so the whole
mixed difference is bounded by the oscillation of the coordinate cofactor. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_mixedDifference_abs_le {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (width : ℝ)
    (hphi : |phi i (x i) - phi i (c i)| ≤ 1)
    (hH : |multiaffineContextFactor phi W i x -
      multiaffineContextFactor phi W i c| ≤ width)
    (hwidth : 0 ≤ width) :
    |mixedDifference (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i x c| ≤ width := by
  rw [scalarMultiaffineWorld_mixedDifference g b phi W i x c, abs_mul]
  calc |phi i (x i) - phi i (c i)| *
        |multiaffineContextFactor phi W i x - multiaffineContextFactor phi W i c|
      ≤ 1 * width := by
        refine mul_le_mul hphi hH (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = width := one_mul width

/-- A two-sided bound on the cofactor gives the oscillation bound the previous
lemma needs.  Stating it this way means the finite work downstream is a bound on
ONE function of the context, not a bound on a difference of two. -/
theorem contextFactor_abs_sub_le {n : ℕ}
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U) (lo hi : ℝ)
    (hlo : ∀ z, lo ≤ multiaffineContextFactor phi W i z)
    (hhi : ∀ z, multiaffineContextFactor phi W i z ≤ hi) :
    |multiaffineContextFactor phi W i x -
      multiaffineContextFactor phi W i c| ≤ hi - lo := by
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor
  · linarith [hhi x, hlo c]
  · linarith [hhi c, hlo x]

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarMultiaffineMixedDifference

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ScalarMultiaffineRankOneV1.lean (234 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6RankOneReferenceInvarianceV1»
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneMinorsV1»

/-!
# Scalar multiaffine worlds are rank one at every coordinate

This is the SUFFICIENCY half of the D6 normal-form question.  A world in
scalar multiaffine normal form

  `F a = (sum_j g j (a j) + b) + sum_{S} W S * prod_{j in S} phi j (a j)`

has, at every coordinate `i`, a centred interaction-contrast profile that
factors as `(phi i u - phi i u0) * (H_i z - E_q H_i)`.  The action factor is
the latent scalar contrast and the context factor is the coordinate-`i`
cofactor of the tensor core, recentred at the reference.

Only normalization of the reference is assumed -- no strict positivity, so
deterministic references are covered.

The CONVERSE (rank one at every coordinate implies this normal form) is NOT
proved here and is not asserted anywhere in this file.  No decision or
half-factor bound is claimed either.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarMultiaffineRankOne

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOneMinors
open CIGAMF.P13.D6RankOneReferenceInvariance

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- A world in scalar multiaffine normal form: a coordinate-additive part plus
a tensor core in the scalar latent maps `phi`. -/
noncomputable def scalarMultiaffineWorld {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  ((∑ j, g j (a j)) + b) +
    ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
      W S * ∏ j ∈ S, phi j (a j)

/-- The coordinate-`i` cofactor of the tensor core. -/
noncomputable def multiaffineContextFactor {n : ℕ}
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) : ℝ :=
  ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
    (if i ∈ S then W S * ∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j (z j) else 0)

private theorem additive_slice_contrast {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u v : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    (∑ j, g j ((Function.update z i u) j)) -
        (∑ j, g j ((Function.update z i v) j)) = g i u - g i v := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [Function.update]
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [Function.update, hji]
  · simp

private theorem core_prod_update {n : ℕ}
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hiS : i ∈ S) :
    (∏ j ∈ S, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) =
      phi i u * ∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j (z j) := by
  classical
  have h1 : (∏ j ∈ S, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) =
      phi i ((Function.update z i u) i) *
        ∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j) :=
    (Finset.mul_prod_erase S (fun j => phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) hiS).symm
  have h2 : (Function.update z i u) i = u := by simp [Function.update]
  have h3 : (∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) =
      ∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j (z j) := by
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj
    simp [Function.update, hji]
  rw [h1, h2, h3]

private theorem core_prod_update_not_mem {n : ℕ}
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hiS : i ∉ S) :
    (∏ j ∈ S, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) = ∏ j ∈ S, phi j (z j) := by
  classical
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
  intro j hj
  have hji : j ≠ i := by
    intro hEq
    exact hiS (hEq ▸ hj)
  simp [Function.update, hji]

/-- The exact slice contrast of a scalar multiaffine world: a constant in the
context plus the latent action contrast times the coordinate cofactor. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_slice_contrast {n : ℕ}
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u v : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W (Function.update z i u) -
        scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W (Function.update z i v) =
      (g i u - g i v) +
        (phi i u - phi i v) * multiaffineContextFactor phi W i z := by
  classical
  unfold scalarMultiaffineWorld multiaffineContextFactor
  have hAdd := additive_slice_contrast g i u v z
  have hCore :
      (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
          W S * ∏ j ∈ S, phi j ((Function.update z i u) j)) -
        (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
          W S * ∏ j ∈ S, phi j ((Function.update z i v) j)) =
      (phi i u - phi i v) *
        ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))).powerset,
          (if i ∈ S then W S * ∏ j ∈ S.erase i, phi j (z j) else 0) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro S _
    by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
    · rw [core_prod_update phi i u z S hiS, core_prod_update phi i v z S hiS,
        if_pos hiS]
      ring
    · rw [core_prod_update_not_mem phi i u z S hiS,
        core_prod_update_not_mem phi i v z S hiS, if_neg hiS]
      ring
  linarith [hAdd, hCore]

/-- The EXPLICIT centred profile of a scalar multiaffine world.  Stating it as an
equation, rather than only as the existential `InteractionContrastRankOne`, is
what lets downstream results talk about the actual action coefficient
`phi i u - phi i u0` instead of an anonymous witness. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_profile_explicit {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u : U) (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    interactionContrastProfile q (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0 u z =
      (phi i u - phi i u0) *
        (multiaffineContextFactor phi W i z -
          productExpectation q (multiaffineContextFactor phi W i)) := by
  classical
  set F := scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W with hF
  set H := multiaffineContextFactor phi W i with hH
  have hslice : ∀ c : Fin (n + 1) → U,
      F (Function.update c i u) - F (Function.update c i u0) =
        (g i u - g i u0) + (phi i u - phi i u0) * H c := by
    intro c
    rw [hF, hH]
    exact scalarMultiaffineWorld_slice_contrast g b phi W i u u0 c
  have hq : productResponse q F i u - productResponse q F i u0 =
      (g i u - g i u0) + (phi i u - phi i u0) * productExpectation q H := by
    rw [productResponse_contrast_eq_productExpectation q F i u0 u,
      productExpectation_congr q
        (fun c => F (Function.update c i u) - F (Function.update c i u0))
        (fun c => (g i u - g i u0) + (phi i u - phi i u0) * H c) hslice,
      productExpectation_const_add_smul q hNorm
        (g i u - g i u0) (phi i u - phi i u0) H]
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  rw [hq, hslice z]
  ring

/-- Two actions with the same latent value have the SAME centred profile, at
every context.  This is the two-profile mechanism: the number of distinct
profiles at a coordinate is at most the number of distinct values of `phi`. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_profile_eq_of_phi_eq {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 u v : U) (hphi : phi i u = phi i v)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → U) :
    interactionContrastProfile q (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0 u z =
      interactionContrastProfile q (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0 v z := by
  rw [scalarMultiaffineWorld_profile_explicit q hNorm g b phi W i u0 u z,
    scalarMultiaffineWorld_profile_explicit q hNorm g b phi W i u0 v z, hphi]

/-- A scalar multiaffine world is rank one at every coordinate, for every
normalized product reference. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_interactionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0 := by
  refine ⟨fun z => multiaffineContextFactor phi W i z -
      productExpectation q (multiaffineContextFactor phi W i),
    fun u => phi i u - phi i u0, by ring, ?_⟩
  intro u z
  exact scalarMultiaffineWorld_profile_explicit q hNorm g b phi W i u0 u z

theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_allCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ) :
    AllCoordinatesInteractionContrastRankOne q
      (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) := by
  intro i
  exact scalarMultiaffineWorld_interactionContrastRankOne q hNorm g b phi W i
    canonicalInteractionContrastAnchor

/-- Every scalar multiaffine world satisfies the exact minor constraints that
the raw-world search writes.  This is what makes the normal-form
parametrization a sound search space: every point it produces is a genuine
rank-one witness. -/
theorem scalarMultiaffineWorld_allMinorsZero {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (g : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (phi : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (W : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U) :
    AllInteractionContrastProfileMinorsZero q
      (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0 :=
  interactionContrastRankOne_implies_all_minors_zero q
    (scalarMultiaffineWorld g b phi W) i u0
    (scalarMultiaffineWorld_interactionContrastRankOne q hNorm g b phi W i u0)

end CIGAMF.P13.D6ScalarMultiaffineRankOne

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6SharpMarginSteeringV1.lean (171 dong)
import «LeanD6ThresholdConstructionV1»

/-! A direct witness throughout the formerly missing margin interval (1,2).
The common statement here compares Top-C with a feasible complement; it does
not assume or assert that complement is globally optimal. This suffices for
strict failure below 2. Reference is explicitly the corner product reference. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginSteering
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

def bump (A : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ := if i ∈ A then rho-1 else 0
def steered (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (rho : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  world A j 1 x+linear (bump A rho) x

lemma bump_sum (A : Finset (I n)) (rho : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) :
    linear (bump A rho) x=(rho-1)*∑ i ∈ A,bit (x i) := by
  classical
  simp [linear,bump,ite_mul,← mul_sum]

lemma world_one_gate (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (x : I n → Bool) :
    world A j 1 x=gate A j x := by simp [world,linear,coeff]

/-- Full responses, not just their oscillations. -/
theorem steered_response (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (i : I n) (u : Bool) :
    productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i u=(if i ∈ A then rho else 0)*bit u := by
  rw [corner_response]
  have hw := world_response A j hj 1 i u
  rw [corner_response] at hw
  have hl := linear_difference (bump A rho) zero i u false
  rw [show Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) i false=zero from Function.update_eq_self i zero,
    linear_zero,bit_false] at hl
  simp only [sub_zero] at hl
  dsimp only [steered]
  rw [hw,hl]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ A <;> simp [D6Threshold.slope,bump,hi] <;> ring

theorem steered_span (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rho) (i : I n) :
    osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i)=if i ∈ A then rho else 0 := by
  have he : productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i=
      fun u => (if i ∈ A then rho else 0)*bit u := by
    funext u; exact steered_response A j hj rho i u
  rw [he]
  apply osc_bit_nonneg
  split <;> linarith

theorem steered_is_top (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rho) :
    IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i)) A A.card := by
  have he : (fun i => osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i))=
      fun i => if i ∈ A then rho else 0 := by funext i; exact steered_span A j hj rho hr i
  rw [he]
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro S hS
  have ha : (∑ i ∈ A,if i ∈ A then rho else 0)=(A.card:ℝ)*rho := by simp
  rw [ha]
  calc _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ S,rho := by
         apply sum_le_sum; intro i _; split <;> linarith
       _ = _ := by simp [hS]

theorem steered_margin (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rho) (a b : I n) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∉ A) :
    osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) a)-
      osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) b)=rho := by
  rw [steered_span A j hj rho hr a,steered_span A j hj rho hr b]
  simp [ha,hb]

/-- Modular steering changes no mixed difference. -/
theorem steered_mixed (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (rho : ℝ) (x c : I n → Bool) :
    mixedDifference (steered A j rho) i x c=mixedDifference (world A j 1) i x c := by
  have hx := linear_difference (bump A rho) x i (x i) (c i)
  have hc := linear_difference (bump A rho) c i (x i) (c i)
  rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hx
  rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hc
  unfold mixedDifference steered
  linarith

theorem steered_mixed_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (rho : ℝ) (x c : I n → Bool) :
    |mixedDifference (steered A j rho) i x c| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [steered_mixed]
  exact mixed_bound A j 1 i x c

theorem steered_mixed_attained (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (a : I n) (ha : a ∈ A) :
    ∃ x c : I n → Bool,mixedDifference (steered A j rho) a x c=1 := by
  obtain ⟨x,c,h⟩ := mixed_bound_attained A j hj 1 a ha
  exact ⟨x,c,by rw [steered_mixed];exact h⟩

/-- The selected residual is unchanged by steering its own components. -/
lemma selected_residual (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (rho : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) :
    steered A j rho x-∑ i ∈ A,productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i (x i)=
      world A j 1 x-∑ i ∈ A,productResponse corner (world A j 1) i (x i) := by
  simp_rw [steered_response A j hj,world_response A j hj]
  simp only [steered,bump_sum]
  have hs : ∑ i ∈ A,(if i ∈ A then rho else 0)*bit (x i)=rho*∑ i ∈ A,bit (x i) := by
    simp [← mul_sum]
  have ht : ∑ i ∈ A,slope A j 1 i*bit (x i)=∑ i ∈ A,bit (x i) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [D6Threshold.slope,hi]
  rw [hs,ht]
  ring

theorem steered_top_loss (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (rho : ℝ)
    (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) A=
      (1+(A.card:ℝ))/2 := by
  have he : productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) A=
      productCompressionLoss (world A j 1) (productResponse corner (world A j 1)) A := by
    unfold productCompressionLoss
    simp_rw [selected_residual A j hj]
  rw [he,actual_loss A A j hj 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) rfl hbal hB]
  norm_num

/-- Every value of the steered function lies in this interval. -/
lemma steered_bounds (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (x : I n → Bool) :
    0 ≤ steered A j rho x ∧ steered A j rho x ≤ 1+(rho-1)*(A.card:ℝ) := by
  have hg := gate_bounds A j x
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ A,bit (x i) := sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (bit_bounds _).1)
  have hs1 : ∑ i ∈ A,bit (x i) ≤ (A.card:ℝ) := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ A,(1:ℝ) := sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (bit_bounds _).2)
         _ = _ := by simp
  rw [steered,world_one_gate,bump_sum]
  constructor
  · exact add_nonneg hg.1 (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr) hs0)
  · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hr)]

theorem complement_loss_upper (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) :
    productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) Aᶜ ≤
      (1+(rho-1)*(A.card:ℝ))/2 := by
  classical
  have hzero (x : I n → Bool) : ∑ i ∈ Aᶜ,productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i (x i)=0 := by
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [steered_response A j hj]
    simp [(mem_compl.mp hi)]
  unfold productCompressionLoss
  simp_rw [hzero,sub_zero]
  have hlo := le_minVal (steered A j rho) (fun x => (steered_bounds A j rho hr x).1)
  have hhi := maxVal_le (steered A j rho) (fun x => (steered_bounds A j rho hr x).2)
  unfold osc
  linarith

/-- A positive actual loss separation for every margin 1 <= rho < 2.
This supplies the lower-bound side of a proposed sharp threshold, without
an LP heuristic or enumeration over dimensions. No universal sufficiency
theorem at margin 2 is asserted by this module. -/
theorem sharp_margin_witness (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    (A.card:ℝ)*(2-rho)/2 ≤
      productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) A-
      productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) Aᶜ := by
  rw [steered_top_loss A j hj rho hbal hB]
  have h := complement_loss_upper A j hj rho hr
  nlinarith

#print axioms steered_is_top

#print axioms steered_mixed_attained
#print axioms steered_response
#print axioms steered_mixed_bound
#print axioms steered_top_loss
#print axioms sharp_margin_witness
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginSteering

/-! Universal sufficiency of margin >= 2 delta for product-response compression,
and a dimension-parametric matching witness at every margin 1 <= rho < 2.
Sufficiency permits degenerate product references. Necessity uses corner.
This is a Top-C optimality threshold, not a theorem about the entire same-Q
fibre's minimax value. These are different quantifiers. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginThreshold
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
open CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginSteering CIGAMF.P13.D6MarginSensitiveExchange
noncomputable section

/-- Every same-cardinality competitor has at least the Top-C loss. -/
theorem margin_two_sufficient {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] {n : ℕ}
    (q : I n → U → ℝ) (F : (I n → U) → ℝ) (delta rho : ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c,0 ≤ jointWeight q c) (hNorm : ∑ c,jointWeight q c=1)
    (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hdelta : ∀ i x c,|mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (T : Finset (I n)) (k : ℕ)
    (htop : IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse q F i)) T k)
    (hmargin : ∀ i ∈ T,∀ j ∉ T,rho+osc (productResponse q F j) ≤ osc (productResponse q F i))
    (hrho : 2*delta ≤ rho) (S : Finset (I n)) (hS : S.card=k) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) T ≤ productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) S := by
  have h := pair_doubled_loss_le_card_mul_two_delta_sub_margin q F delta rho
    hWeight hNorm hd hdelta T S k htop hS hmargin
  have hn : ((T \ S).card:ℝ)*(2*delta-rho) ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
  linarith

/-- The steering construction exactly attains the exchange bound against the
complement. It is not an enumeration or an abstract regret-table witness. -/
theorem steered_exchange_equality {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    2*(productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) A-
      productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) Aᶜ)=
      (A.card:ℝ)*(2-rho) := by
  have htop := steered_is_top A j hj rho (by linarith)
  have hm : ∀ i ∈ A,∀ l ∉ A,rho+osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) l) ≤
      osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i) := by
    intro i hi l hl
    rw [steered_span A j hj rho (by linarith) i,steered_span A j hj rho (by linarith) l]
    simp [hi,hl]
  have hu := pair_doubled_loss_le_card_mul_two_delta_sub_margin corner (steered A j rho) 1 rho
    corner_nonnegative corner_normalized (by norm_num) (steered_mixed_bound A j · rho)
    A Aᶜ A.card htop hbal hm
  have he : A \ Aᶜ=A := by ext i; simp
  rw [he] at hu
  have hl := sharp_margin_witness A j hj rho hr hbal hB
  linarith

/-- A nonzero A supplies strict failure for every rho below two. -/
theorem every_subthreshold_margin_fails {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hne : A.Nonempty) (rho : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ rho) (hr2 : rho < 2)
    (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse corner (steered A j rho) i)) A A.card ∧
    productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) Aᶜ <
      productCompressionLoss (steered A j rho) (productResponse corner (steered A j rho)) A := by
  refine ⟨steered_is_top A j hj rho (by linarith),?_⟩
  have hc : (0:ℝ)<A.card := by exact_mod_cast card_pos.mpr hne
  have hp : 0 < (A.card:ℝ)*(2-rho) := mul_pos hc (by linarith)
  have he := steered_exchange_equality A j hj rho hr hbal hB
  linarith

#print axioms margin_two_sufficient
#print axioms steered_exchange_equality
#print axioms every_subthreshold_margin_fails
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6SharpMarginThreshold

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6SharpnessM6V1.lean (277 dong)
import Mathlib
