/-!
# Exact symmetric-difference reduction for D6

`pair_loss_le_sdiff_card` is the already-written direct NEW-1 theorem.  This
module packages the pure finite combinatorics showing that it proves the
headline coefficient everywhere except the unique maximal-distance geometry:
an even universe split into two complementary equal halves.

The direct NEW-1 inequality does not by itself construct a PAEC filling of
mass `2r`; no LP-duality/completeness claim is made here.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6SymmetricDifferenceReduction

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.D6SmallSymmetricDifference

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem equal_card_small_symmdiff_or_balanced_complement {n : ℕ}
    (S T : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hcard : S.card = T.card) :
    2 * (S \ T).card ≤ n ∨
      (n + 1 = 2 * S.card ∧ Disjoint S T ∧ S ∪ T = Finset.univ) := by
  classical
  by_cases hSmall : 2 * (S \ T).card ≤ n
  · exact Or.inl hSmall
  · right
    have hdiff : (S \ T).card = (T \ S).card :=
      Finset.card_sdiff_comm hcard
    have hdisj : Disjoint (S \ T) (T \ S) := by
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (by aesop)
    have hsub : (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S) ⊆ Finset.univ := Finset.subset_univ _
    have hcardUnion : ((S \ T) ∪ (T \ S)).card =
        (S \ T).card + (T \ S).card :=
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj
    have hle : 2 * (S \ T).card ≤ n + 1 := by
      have hu := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hu
      omega
    have heq : 2 * (S \ T).card = n + 1 := by omega
    have hfull : (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S) = Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, hcardUnion, hdiff]
      omega
    have hSTdisj : Disjoint S T := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro a haS haT
      have haFull : a ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S) := by
        rw [hfull]
        simp
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp haFull with ha | ha
      · exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).2 haT
      · exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).2 haS
    have hUnion : S ∪ T = Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.subset_univ _)
      rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hSTdisj, ← hcard]
      have hInter : S ∩ T = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hSTdisj
      have hInter' : T ∩ S = ∅ := by simpa [Finset.inter_comm] using hInter
      have hSdiff : (S \ T).card = S.card := by
        rw [Finset.card_sdiff, hInter']
        simp
      omega
    have hInter : S ∩ T = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hSTdisj
    have hInter' : T ∩ S = ∅ := by simpa [Finset.inter_comm] using hInter
    have hSdiff : (S \ T).card = S.card := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff, hInter']
      simp
    exact ⟨by omega, hSTdisj, hUnion⟩

theorem pair_half_factor_except_balanced_complement {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) (delta : ℝ)
    (hWeight : ∀ c, 0 ≤ jointWeight q c)
    (hNorm : ∑ c, jointWeight q c = 1)
    (hDeltaNonneg : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hdelta : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x c : Fin (n + 1) → U),
      |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta)
    (selected competitor : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (k : ℕ)
    (hTop : IsTopKByScore
      (fun j ↦ osc (productResponse q F j)) selected k)
    (hCompetitorCard : competitor.card = k)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬(n + 1 = 2 * selected.card ∧
      Disjoint selected competitor ∧ selected ∪ competitor = Finset.univ)) :
    productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) selected -
        productCompressionLoss F (productResponse q F) competitor ≤
      (n : ℝ) * delta / 2 := by
  have hcard : selected.card = competitor.card := by
    rw [hTop.1, hCompetitorCard]
  rcases equal_card_small_symmdiff_or_balanced_complement
      selected competitor hcard with hSmall | hExceptional
  · exact pair_half_factor_of_small_symmetric_difference q F delta hWeight
      hNorm hDeltaNonneg hdelta selected competitor k hTop hCompetitorCard hSmall
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

end CIGAMF.P13.D6SymmetricDifferenceReduction

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6TernaryInteractionContrastRankV1.lean (116 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6NormalizedBalancedTernaryCounterexampleV1»
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastProfileV1»
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastRankOneV1»

/-!
# Exact rank-at-least-two interaction-profile witness

This module evaluates the centered profiles of the compiled normalized ternary
D6 counterexample.  The determinant is computed from the literal finite world
definition, not from the external LP search that discovered it.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6TernaryInteractionContrastRank

open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NormalizedBalancedTernaryCounterexample

def ternaryProfileContextX : Fin 4 → Fin 3 := a4t 0 0 0 1
def ternaryProfileContextY : Fin 4 → Fin 3 := a4t 0 0 2 1

private theorem update_a4t_coordinate_zero
    (a b c d u : Fin 3) :
    Function.update (a4t a b c d) 0 u = a4t u b c d := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [a4t, Function.update, Fin.mk.injEq]

private theorem profile_0_1_at_x :
    interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
      0 0 1 ternaryProfileContextX = -1 := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  change ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 0 1) 0 1) -
      ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 0 1) 0 0) -
      (productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 1 -
        productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0) = -1
  rw [update_a4t_coordinate_zero, update_a4t_coordinate_zero]
  simp only [ternaryBalanced_response_table]
  norm_num [ternaryProfileContextX, ternaryBalancedWorld4,
    ternaryResponseTable4]

private theorem profile_0_2_at_x :
    interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
      0 0 2 ternaryProfileContextX = 0 := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  change ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 0 1) 0 2) -
      ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 0 1) 0 0) -
      (productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 2 -
        productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0) = 0
  rw [update_a4t_coordinate_zero, update_a4t_coordinate_zero]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h21 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 := by decide
  simp only [ternaryBalanced_response_table]
  norm_num [ternaryProfileContextX, ternaryBalancedWorld4,
    ternaryResponseTable4, h20, h21]

private theorem profile_0_1_at_y :
    interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
      0 0 1 ternaryProfileContextY = 0 := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  change ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 2 1) 0 1) -
      ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 2 1) 0 0) -
      (productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 1 -
        productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0) = 0
  rw [update_a4t_coordinate_zero, update_a4t_coordinate_zero]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h21 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 := by decide
  simp only [ternaryBalanced_response_table]
  norm_num [ternaryProfileContextY, ternaryBalancedWorld4,
    ternaryResponseTable4, h20, h21]

private theorem profile_0_2_at_y :
    interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
      0 0 2 ternaryProfileContextY = 1 := by
  unfold interactionContrastProfile
  change ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 2 1) 0 2) -
      ternaryBalancedWorld4 (Function.update (a4t 0 0 2 1) 0 0) -
      (productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 2 -
        productResponse pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0) = 1
  rw [update_a4t_coordinate_zero, update_a4t_coordinate_zero]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h21 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 := by decide
  simp only [ternaryBalanced_response_table]
  norm_num [ternaryProfileContextY, ternaryBalancedWorld4,
    ternaryResponseTable4, h20, h21]

theorem ternaryBalancedWorld4_coordinate_zero_profile_determinant :
    interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
        0 0 1 ternaryProfileContextX *
      interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
        0 0 2 ternaryProfileContextY -
      interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
        0 0 1 ternaryProfileContextY *
      interactionContrastProfile pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4
        0 0 2 ternaryProfileContextX = -1 := by
  rw [profile_0_1_at_x, profile_0_2_at_y,
    profile_0_1_at_y, profile_0_2_at_x]
  norm_num

theorem ternaryBalancedWorld4_coordinate_zero_not_rank_one :
    ¬ InteractionContrastRankOne pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0 := by
  apply interactionContrastProfile_determinant_obstruction
    (u := (1 : Fin 3)) (v := (2 : Fin 3))
    (x := ternaryProfileContextX) (y := ternaryProfileContextY)
  rw [ternaryBalancedWorld4_coordinate_zero_profile_determinant]
  norm_num

/-- The normalized ternary falsifier has at least two independent centered
interaction directions; its third action label is not a merely redundant
encoding of a binary profile. -/
theorem ternaryBalancedWorld4_has_interaction_contrast_rank_ge_two :
    ¬ InteractionContrastRankOne pointMassTernary4 ternaryBalancedWorld4 0 0 :=
  ternaryBalancedWorld4_coordinate_zero_not_rank_one

end CIGAMF.P13.D6TernaryInteractionContrastRank

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6ThresholdConstructionV1.lean (757 dong)
import «LeanProductMixedDifferenceV4»
import «LeanD6InformationLimitV1»

/-! Explicit threshold worlds for the D6 bridge. All coordinates and losses
below use the existing product-response API; no distance-loss assumption. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry

variable {n : ℕ}
abbrev I (n : ℕ) := Fin (n + 1)

def bit (b : Bool) : ℝ := if b then 1 else 0
@[simp] theorem bit_false : bit false = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem bit_true : bit true = 1 := rfl

theorem bit_bounds (b : Bool) : 0 ≤ bit b ∧ bit b ≤ 1 := by cases b <;> norm_num

def count (B : Finset (I n)) (x : I n → Bool) : ℕ :=
  (B.filter (fun i => x i = true)).card

def others (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : Finset (I n) := (univ \ A).erase j

def gate (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  if x j then 0 else if (∃ i ∈ A, x i = true) ∨ 2 ≤ count (others A j) x then 1 else 0

def coeff (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ :=
  if i ∈ A then 0 else if i = j then mu - 1 else 1 - mu

def slope (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ :=
  if i ∈ A then 1 else if i = j then mu - 1 else 1 - mu

noncomputable def linear (c : I n → ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, c i * bit (x i)

noncomputable def world (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  linear (coeff A j mu) x + gate A j x

def zero : I n → Bool := fun _ => false

def corner (_i : I n) (u : Bool) : ℝ := if u then 0 else 1

theorem corner_weight (c : I n → Bool) : jointWeight corner c = if c = zero then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  unfold jointWeight corner
  by_cases h : c = zero
  · subst c; simp [zero]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    have he : ∃ i, c i = true := by
      by_contra hn
      push Not at hn
      apply h
      funext i
      simpa [zero] using Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (hn i)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := he
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (mem_univ i) (by simp [hi])

theorem corner_nonnegative (c : I n → Bool) : 0 ≤ jointWeight corner c := by
  rw [corner_weight]; split <;> norm_num

theorem corner_normalized : ∑ c : I n → Bool, jointWeight corner c = 1 := by
  classical
  simp [corner_weight]

theorem corner_response (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (i : I n) (u : Bool) :
    productResponse corner F i u = F (Function.update zero i u) := by
  classical
  simp [productResponse, productExpectation, corner_weight]

theorem gate_bounds (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (x : I n → Bool) :
    0 ≤ gate A j x ∧ gate A j x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold gate
  split <;> (try split) <;> norm_num

theorem count_mono (B : Finset (I n)) (x y : I n → Bool)
    (h : ∀ i, x i = true → y i = true) : count B x ≤ count B y := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro i hi
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨(mem_filter.mp hi).1, h i (mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩

theorem gate_update_mono (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (x : I n → Bool) :
    gate A j (Function.update x i false) ≤ gate A j (Function.update x i true) := by
  classical
  have hm : ∀ l, Function.update x i false l = true → Function.update x i true l = true := by
    intro l hl
    by_cases hli : l = i
    · subst l; simp at hl
    · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hli] using hl
  have hc := count_mono (others A j) _ _ hm
  have he : (∃ l ∈ A, Function.update x i false l = true) →
      ∃ l ∈ A, Function.update x i true l = true := by
    rintro ⟨l, hl, ht⟩; exact ⟨l, hl, hm l ht⟩
  simp only [gate, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
  split
  · rfl
  · by_cases hp : (∃ l ∈ A, Function.update x i false l = true) ∨
        2 ≤ count (others A j) (Function.update x i false)
    · have hq : (∃ l ∈ A, Function.update x i true l = true) ∨
          2 ≤ count (others A j) (Function.update x i true) := by
        rcases hp with hp | hp
        · exact Or.inl (he hp)
        · exact Or.inr (le_trans hp hc)
      simp [hp, hq]
    · simp [hp]
      split <;> norm_num

theorem linear_difference (c : I n → ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) (i : I n) (u v : Bool) :
    linear c (Function.update x i u) - linear c (Function.update x i v) =
      c i * (bit u - bit v) := by
  classical
  unfold linear
  rw [← sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [mul_sub]
  · intro l _ hli
    simp [Function.update_of_ne hli]
  · simp

theorem derivative_bounds (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (x : I n → Bool) :
    coeff A j mu i - (if i = j then 1 else 0) ≤
      world A j mu (Function.update x i true) - world A j mu (Function.update x i false) ∧
    world A j mu (Function.update x i true) - world A j mu (Function.update x i false) ≤
      coeff A j mu i + (if i = j then 0 else 1) := by
  have hl := linear_difference (coeff A j mu) x i true false
  simp only [bit_true, bit_false, sub_zero, mul_one] at hl
  have h0 := gate_bounds A j (Function.update x i false)
  have h1 := gate_bounds A j (Function.update x i true)
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    have hz : gate A j (Function.update x j true) = 0 := by simp [gate]
    simp only [ite_true, world, hz]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · have hm := gate_update_mono A j i hij x
    simp only [ite_eq_right hij, sub_zero, world]
    constructor <;> linarith

theorem mixed_bound (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (i : I n) (x c : I n → Bool) : |mixedDifference (world A j mu) i x c| ≤ 1 := by
  have hx := derivative_bounds A j i mu x
  have hc := derivative_bounds A j i mu c
  have ex : Function.update x i (x i) = x := Function.update_eq_self i x
  have ec : Function.update c i (c i) = c := Function.update_eq_self i c
  unfold mixedDifference
  cases hxi : x i <;> cases hci : c i
  all_goals
    simp only [hxi] at ex
    simp only [hci] at ec
    simp only [ex, ec] at hx hc ⊢
    rw [abs_le]
    split_ifs at hx hc <;> constructor <;> linarith

@[simp] theorem linear_zero (c : I n → ℝ) : linear c zero = 0 := by simp [linear, zero]
@[simp] theorem gate_zero (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : gate A j zero = 0 := by
  simp [gate, zero, count]

theorem gate_unit (A : Finset (I n)) (j i : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) (u : Bool) :
    gate A j (Function.update zero i u) = if i ∈ A then bit u else 0 := by
  classical
  cases u
  · have hz : Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) i false = zero :=
      Function.update_eq_self i zero
    rw [hz, gate_zero]
    simp
  · have hc : count (others A j) (Function.update zero i true) ≤ 1 := by
      apply le_trans (card_le_card (show (others A j).filter
        (fun l => Function.update zero i true l = true) ⊆ {i} from ?_)) (by simp)
      intro l hl
      by_contra hn
      have hli : l ≠ i := by simpa using hn
      simpa [Function.update_of_ne hli, zero] using (mem_filter.mp hl).2
    by_cases hi : i = j
    · subst i; simp [gate, hj]
    · have he : (∃ l ∈ A, Function.update zero i true l = true) ↔ i ∈ A := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨l, hl, ht⟩
          by_cases hli : l = i
          · simpa [hli] using hl
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne hli, zero] at ht
        · intro h; exact ⟨i, h, by simp⟩
      simp [gate, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hi), zero, he,
        show ¬2 ≤ count (others A j) (Function.update zero i true) from by omega]

theorem world_response (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (i : I n) (u : Bool) :
    productResponse corner (world A j mu) i u = slope A j mu i * bit u := by
  rw [corner_response]
  have h := linear_difference (coeff A j mu) zero i u false
  have hz : Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) i false = zero := by
    exact Function.update_eq_self i zero
  rw [hz, linear_zero, bit_false] at h
  simp only [sub_zero] at h
  rw [world, h, gate_unit A j i hj]
  unfold coeff slope
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- At the tie endpoint the *entire response functions* carry no A-information. -/
theorem response_independent (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (i : I n) (u : Bool) :
    productResponse corner (world A j 0) i u = (if i = j then -1 else 1) * bit u := by
  rw [world_response A j hj]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ A
  · have hij : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; contradiction
    simp [slope, hi, hij]
  · simp [slope, hi]

def residualCoeff (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ) (i : I n) : ℝ :=
  coeff A j mu i - if i ∈ S then slope A j mu i else 0

noncomputable def residual (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (mu : ℝ)
    (x : I n → Bool) : ℝ := linear (residualCoeff A S j mu) x + gate A j x

theorem residual_is_actual (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (x : I n → Bool) :
    world A j mu x - ∑ i ∈ S, productResponse corner (world A j mu) i (x i) =
      residual A S j mu x := by
  simp_rw [world_response A j hj]
  simp [world, residual, linear, residualCoeff, sub_mul, ite_mul, sum_sub_distrib]
  ring

def lowCorner (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : I n → Bool :=
  fun i => decide (i = j ∨ i ∈ S ∩ A)

def highCorner (S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : I n → Bool :=
  fun i => decide (i ≠ j ∧ i ∉ S)

theorem linear_extremes (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (_hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) (x : I n → Bool) :
    linear (residualCoeff A S j mu) (lowCorner A S j) ≤
      linear (residualCoeff A S j mu) x ∧
    linear (residualCoeff A S j mu) x ≤
      linear (residualCoeff A S j mu) (highCorner S j) := by
  constructor <;> apply sum_le_sum <;> intro i _
  all_goals
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hjS : j ∈ S <;> cases hxi : x j <;>
        simp [residualCoeff, coeff, slope, bit, lowCorner, highCorner, hj, hjS]; linarith
    · by_cases hiA : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;> cases hxi : x i <;>
        simp [residualCoeff, coeff, slope, bit, lowCorner, highCorner, hiA, hiS, hij]; linarith

@[simp] theorem gate_low (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) :
    gate A j (lowCorner A S j) = 0 := by simp [gate, lowCorner]

theorem gate_high (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    gate A j (highCorner S j) = 1 := by
  classical
  have hg : (∃ i ∈ A, highCorner S j i = true) ∨
      2 ≤ count (others A j) (highCorner S j) := by
    by_cases hAS : A ⊆ S
    · have heq : A = S := eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAS (by omega)
      right
      have hf : (others A j).filter (fun i => highCorner S j i = true) = others A j := by
        apply filter_eq_self.mpr
        intro i hi
        have hm := mem_erase.mp hi
        have ha := (mem_sdiff.mp hm.2).2
        simp [highCorner, hm.1, ← heq, ha]
      simpa [count, hf] using hB
    · left
      obtain ⟨i, hiA, hiS⟩ := not_subset.mp hAS
      have hij : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; contradiction
      exact ⟨i, hiA, by simp [highCorner, hij, hiS]⟩
  have hz : highCorner S j j = false := by simp [highCorner]
  simp only [gate, hz, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hg]

theorem residual_extremes (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) (x : I n → Bool) :
    residual A S j mu (lowCorner A S j) ≤ residual A S j mu x ∧
    residual A S j mu x ≤ residual A S j mu (highCorner S j) := by
  have hl := linear_extremes A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 x
  have hg := gate_bounds A j x
  simp only [residual, gate_low, gate_high A S j hj hcard hB, add_zero]
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem osc_of_extremes {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (lo hi : Ω) (hlo : ∀ x, f lo ≤ f x) (hhi : ∀ x, f x ≤ f hi) :
    osc f = f hi - f lo := by
  have hmax := le_antisymm (maxVal_le f hhi) (le_maxVal f hi)
  have hmin := le_antisymm (minVal_le f lo) (le_minVal f hlo)
  simp [osc, hmax, hmin]

theorem residual_range (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card)
    (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    residual A S j mu (highCorner S j) - residual A S j mu (lowCorner A S j) =
      1 + (2 - mu) * (S ∩ A).card := by
  classical
  have hc : (Aᶜ \ S).card = (S ∩ A).card := by
    rw [card_sdiff_comm (hbal.trans hcard.symm)]
    congr 1
    ext i; simp
  have hw : ∀ i, residualCoeff A S j mu i * bit (highCorner S j i) -
      residualCoeff A S j mu i * bit (lowCorner A S j i) =
      (if i ∈ S ∩ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + (if i ∈ Aᶜ \ S then 1-mu else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hjS : j ∈ S <;>
        simp [residualCoeff, coeff, slope, bit, highCorner, lowCorner, hj, hjS]
    · by_cases hiA : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;>
        simp [residualCoeff, coeff, slope, bit, highCorner, lowCorner, hiA, hiS, hij]
  simp only [residual, gate_high A S j hj hcard hB, gate_low, add_zero, linear]
  rw [add_comm _ 1, add_sub_assoc, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [hw]
  rw [sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_mem, univ_inter, sum_const, hc]
  ring

/-- The closed-form loss is derived from the actual product-response residual. -/
theorem actual_loss (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card)
    (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) S =
      (1 + (2 - mu) * (S ∩ A).card) / 2 := by
  unfold productCompressionLoss
  simp_rw [residual_is_actual A S j hj]
  rw [osc_of_extremes (residual A S j mu) (lowCorner A S j) (highCorner S j)
    (fun x => (residual_extremes A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hB x).1)
    (fun x => (residual_extremes A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hB x).2)]
  rw [residual_range A S j hj mu hcard hbal hB]


/-- The complement is a feasible optimum; the assertion uses the actual loss. -/
theorem actual_regret (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card)
    (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) S -
      productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) Aᶜ =
      (2 - mu) * (S ∩ A).card / 2 := by
  rw [actual_loss A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB,
    actual_loss A Aᶜ j hj mu hmu hmu1 hbal hbal hB]
  have he : Aᶜ ∩ A = ∅ := by ext i; simp
  rw [he]
  simp only [card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring

theorem complement_optimal (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card)
    (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) Aᶜ ≤
      productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) S := by
  apply sub_nonneg.mp
  rw [actual_regret A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB]
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)

/-- A support-geometry realization. `none` is an always-omitted interaction
component. The feasible selections are exactly images of original selections;
allowing the interaction component to be selected would change the problem. -/
noncomputable def supportComponents (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ)
    (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) : Option (I n) → (I n → Bool) → ℝ
  | none, x => F x - ∑ i, Q i (x i)
  | some i, x => Q i (x i)

def liftedSelection (S : Finset (I n)) : Finset (Option (I n)) := S.image some

theorem sum_lifted (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (I n)) (x : I n → Bool) :
    ∑ i ∈ liftedSelection S, supportComponents F Q i x = ∑ i ∈ S, Q i (x i) := by
  rw [liftedSelection, sum_image]
  · rfl
  · intro a _ b _ h; exact Option.some.inj h

theorem sum_omitted_lift (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (I n)) (x : I n → Bool) :
    sumComponent (liftedSelection S)ᶜ (supportComponents F Q) x =
      F x - ∑ i ∈ S, Q i (x i) := by
  have h := (liftedSelection S).sum_add_sum_compl (fun i => supportComponents F Q i x)
  rw [sum_lifted] at h
  have hu : ∑ i : Option (I n), supportComponents F Q i x = F x := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_option]
    simp [supportComponents]
  rw [hu] at h
  unfold sumComponent
  linarith

/-- Equality with the existing support radius, not an abstract loss model. -/
theorem actual_support_bridge (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (I n)) :
    selectedRadius (supportComponents F Q) (liftedSelection S) =
      productCompressionLoss F Q S := by
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc productCompressionLoss
  congr 2
  funext x
  exact sum_omitted_lift F Q S x

/-- Geometric image points use the same coordinate functions in every world. -/
noncomputable def supportPoint (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (x : I n → Bool) : Option (I n) → ℝ := fun i => supportComponents F Q i x

noncomputable def actualSupport (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ) :
    Set (Option (I n) → ℝ) := Set.range (supportPoint F Q)

theorem point_projection (F : (I n → Bool) → ℝ) (Q : I n → Bool → ℝ)
    (x : I n → Bool) (i : Option (I n)) :
    supportPoint F Q x i = supportComponents F Q i x := rfl

/-- Geometry-only partial identification: all ordinary coordinate projections
agree at each indexed state; only the interaction coordinate can differ. -/
theorem support_observed_coordinates_equal (A A' : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
    (hj : j ∉ A) (hj' : j ∉ A') (x : I n → Bool) (i : I n) :
    supportPoint (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) x (some i) =
    supportPoint (world A' j 0) (productResponse corner (world A' j 0)) x (some i) := by
  simp only [supportPoint, supportComponents, response_independent A j hj,
    response_independent A' j hj']

/-- A joint measurement with the distinguished coordinate on is an exact
counting measurement of B; this establishes the measurement model from F. -/
def jointCorner (G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) : I n → Bool :=
  fun i => decide (i = j ∨ i ∈ G)

theorem joint_measurement (A G : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) :
    world A j mu (jointCorner G j) =
      (1-mu) * ((G ∩ others A j).card : ℝ) - (1-mu) := by
  have hg : gate A j (jointCorner G j) = 0 := by simp [gate, jointCorner]
  have hw : ∀ i, coeff A j mu i * bit (jointCorner G j i) =
      (if i ∈ G ∩ others A j then 1-mu else 0) + (if i = j then mu-1 else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i; simp [coeff, bit, jointCorner, others, hj]
    · by_cases hiA : i ∈ A <;> by_cases hiG : i ∈ G <;>
        simp [coeff, bit, jointCorner, others, hiA, hiG, hij]
  simp only [world, hg, add_zero, linear]
  simp_rw [hw]
  rw [sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_mem, univ_inter, sum_const]
  simp
  ring

/-- At mu=0, the compression regret is exactly the number of mistaken retained
A-coordinates. This includes every feasible S, whether or not it contains j. -/
theorem tie_actual_regret (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (hcard : S.card = A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card)
    (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S -
      productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ =
      (S ∩ A).card := by
  rw [actual_regret A S j hj 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcard hbal hB]
  ring


section Randomized
variable (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1))

def positiveGround : Finset (I (2*r+1)) := univ.erase j
def worlds : Finset (Finset (I (2*r+1))) := (positiveGround r j).powersetCard (r+1)
def actions : Finset (Finset (I (2*r+1))) := univ.powersetCard (r+1)

@[simp] theorem positiveGround_card : (positiveGround r j).card = 2*r+1 := by
  simp [positiveGround, I]

theorem worlds_nonempty : (worlds r j).Nonempty := by
  apply powersetCard_nonempty.mpr
  rw [positiveGround_card]
  omega

theorem world_parameters (hr : 2 ≤ r) {A : Finset (I (2*r+1))}
    (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) :
    j ∉ A ∧ A.card = r+1 ∧ Aᶜ.card = A.card ∧ 2 ≤ (others A j).card := by
  have hp := mem_powersetCard.mp hA
  have hj : j ∉ A := by
    intro h; exact (mem_erase.mp (hp.1 h)).1 rfl
  have hb : Aᶜ.card = A.card := by
    rw [card_compl, hp.2]
    simp [I]
    omega
  refine ⟨hj, hp.2, hb, ?_⟩
  have hB : (others A j).card = Aᶜ.card - 1 := by
    unfold others
    rw [card_erase_of_mem (by simp [hj])]
    rfl
  rw [hB, hb, hp.2]
  omega

/-- Exact uniform-world average for any legal action. The extra +1 penalty
for omitting j is retained through the factor `(S.erase j).card`. -/
theorem average_intersection (S : Finset (I (2*r+1))) :
    (2*r+1) * (∑ A ∈ worlds r j, (S ∩ A).card) =
      (S.erase j).card * (r+1) * (worlds r j).card := by
  let P := S.erase j
  let W := worlds r j
  have hP : P ⊆ positiveGround r j := by
    intro i hi; exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨(mem_erase.mp hi).1, mem_univ i⟩
  have hdiff := CIGAMF.P13.InformationLimit.sum_sdiff_card_powersetCard
    (positiveGround r j) (r+1) P hP
  rw [positiveGround_card, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hdiff
  have hsplit : (∑ A ∈ W, (P \ A).card) + (∑ A ∈ W, (P ∩ A).card) =
      P.card * W.card := by
    rw [← sum_add_distrib]
    simp_rw [card_sdiff_add_card_inter]
    simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  change (∑ T ∈ W, (P \ T).card) = P.card * (2*r).choose (r+1) at hdiff
  rw [hdiff] at hsplit
  have hchoose := CIGAMF.P13.InformationLimit.choose_shift r
  have hW : W.card = (2*r+1).choose (r+1) := by
    simp [W, worlds]
  rw [← hW] at hchoose
  have he : ∀ A ∈ W, P ∩ A = S ∩ A := by
    intro A hA
    have hj : j ∉ A := by
      intro h; exact (mem_erase.mp ((mem_powersetCard.mp hA).1 h)).1 rfl
    ext i
    simp only [mem_inter, P, mem_erase]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => ⟨h.1.2, h.2⟩
    · intro h; exact ⟨⟨fun hij => hj (hij ▸ h.2), h.1⟩, h.2⟩
  have hsumEq : (∑ A ∈ W, (P ∩ A).card) = ∑ A ∈ W, (S ∩ A).card :=
    sum_congr rfl (fun A hA => congrArg Finset.card (he A hA))
  rw [hsumEq] at hsplit
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : ℕ => (2*r+1)*z) hsplit
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : ℕ => P.card*z) hchoose
  change (2*r+1) * (∑ A ∈ W, (S ∩ A).card) = P.card*(r+1)*W.card
  nlinarith

theorem average_intersection_lower (S : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hS : S.card = r+1) :
    (r : ℝ)*(r+1)*(worlds r j).card ≤
      (2*r+1 : ℝ) * ∑ A ∈ worlds r j, ((S ∩ A).card : ℝ) := by
  have hp : r ≤ (S.erase j).card := by
    by_cases hj : j ∈ S
    · rw [card_erase_of_mem hj, hS]; omega
    · rw [erase_eq_of_notMem hj, hS]; omega
  have hn := average_intersection r j S
  have hl : r*(r+1)*(worlds r j).card ≤
      (2*r+1)*(∑ A ∈ worlds r j, (S ∩ A).card) := by
    rw [hn]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp)
  exact_mod_cast hl

/-- One world defeats the *whole mixture*. The adversary is outside the sum
and does not depend on the algorithm's realized random action. -/
theorem randomized_intersection_lower (p : Finset (I (2*r+1)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ S ∈ actions r, 0 ≤ p S) (hnorm : ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S = 1) :
    ∃ A ∈ worlds r j,
      (r : ℝ)*(r+1) ≤ (2*r+1 : ℝ)*∑ S ∈ actions r, p S * (S ∩ A).card := by
  let g := fun A => (2*r+1 : ℝ)*∑ S ∈ actions r, p S * (S ∩ A).card
  have havg : (r : ℝ)*(r+1)*(worlds r j).card ≤ ∑ A ∈ worlds r j, g A := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S * ((r : ℝ)*(r+1)*(worlds r j).card) := by
        rw [← sum_mul, hnorm]; ring
      _ ≤ ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S * ((2*r+1 : ℝ) *
          ∑ A ∈ worlds r j, ((S ∩ A).card : ℝ)) := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro S hS
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (average_intersection_lower r j S (mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2) (hp S hS)
      _ = ∑ A ∈ worlds r j, g A := by
        simp only [g, mul_sum]
        rw [sum_comm]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        ring
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hm⟩ := exists_max_image (worlds r j) g (worlds_nonempty r j)
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  have hupper : ∑ A' ∈ worlds r j, g A' ≤ (worlds r j).card * g A := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _A' ∈ worlds r j, g A := sum_le_sum (fun A' hA' => hm A' hA')
         _ = _ := by simp
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < (worlds r j).card := by
    exact_mod_cast card_pos.mpr (worlds_nonempty r j)
  change (r : ℝ)*(r+1) ≤ g A
  nlinarith

/-- All even dimensions m=2r+2 >=6. This is an actual-product-loss lower bound
against every randomized response-only decision rule on the common profile. -/
theorem randomized_actual_lower (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (p : Finset (I (2*r+1)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ S ∈ actions r, 0 ≤ p S) (hnorm : ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S = 1) :
    ∃ A ∈ worlds r j,
      (r : ℝ)*(r+1) / (2*r+1) ≤ ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S *
        (productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S -
          productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hl⟩ := randomized_intersection_lower r j p hp hnorm
  have ha := world_parameters r j hr hA
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  have he : ∀ S ∈ actions r,
      productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S -
        productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ =
          (S ∩ A).card := by
    intro S hS
    exact tie_actual_regret A S j ha.1 ((mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2.trans ha.2.1.symm)
      ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2
  have hs : (∑ S ∈ actions r, p S *
      (productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S -
       productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ)) =
      ∑ S ∈ actions r, p S * (S ∩ A).card := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro S hS
    rw [he S hS]
  rw [hs]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2*r+1)).mpr
  nlinarith
end Randomized


theorem osc_bit_nonneg (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : osc (fun u : Bool => c * bit u) = c := by
  rw [osc_of_extremes (fun u : Bool => c * bit u) false true
    (by intro u; cases u <;> simp [hc]) (by intro u; cases u <;> simp [hc])]
  simp

theorem osc_bit_nonpos (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≤ 0) : osc (fun u : Bool => c * bit u) = -c := by
  rw [osc_of_extremes (fun u : Bool => c * bit u) true false
    (by intro u; cases u <;> simp [hc]) (by intro u; cases u <;> simp [hc])]
  simp

theorem response_span (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) (i : I n) :
    osc (productResponse corner (world A j mu) i) = if i ∈ A then 1 else 1-mu := by
  have he : productResponse corner (world A j mu) i = fun u => slope A j mu i * bit u := by
    funext u; exact world_response A j hj mu i u
  rw [he]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ A
  · simp only [slope, hi, ↓reduceIte]
    exact osc_bit_nonneg 1 (by norm_num)
  · by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [slope, hj, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [osc_bit_nonpos (mu-1) (by linarith)]
      ring
    · simp only [slope, hi, hij, ↓reduceIte]
      exact osc_bit_nonneg (1-mu) (by linarith)

theorem selected_is_top (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    IsTopKByScore (fun i => osc (productResponse corner (world A j mu) i)) A A.card := by
  have hspan : (fun i => osc (productResponse corner (world A j mu) i)) =
      fun i => if i ∈ A then 1 else 1-mu := by
    funext i; exact response_span A j hj mu hmu1 i
  rw [hspan]
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro S hS
  have ha : (∑ i ∈ A, if i ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 1-mu) = A.card := by
    calc _ = ∑ _i ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) := sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [ite_eq_left hi])
         _ = _ := by simp
  rw [ha]
  calc _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) := by
         apply sum_le_sum; intro i _; split <;> linarith
       _ = _ := by simp [hS]

theorem exact_top_gap (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hbal : Aᶜ.card = A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) A -
      productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) Aᶜ) =
      A.card * (2-mu) := by
  rw [actual_regret A A j hj mu hmu hmu1 rfl hbal hB]
  simp only [inter_self]
  ring

/-- The upper normalization delta=1 is attained, not merely a loose bound. -/
theorem mixed_bound_attained (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (i : I n) (hi : i ∈ A) :
    ∃ x c : I n → Bool, mixedDifference (world A j mu) i x c = 1 := by
  have hij : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; contradiction
  let x := Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) i true
  let c := Function.update (zero : I n → Bool) j true
  refine ⟨x, c, ?_⟩
  have hxi : x i = true := by simp [x]
  have hci : c i = false := by simp [c, Function.update_of_ne hij, zero]
  have h0 : Function.update x i (c i) = zero := by
    rw [hci]; simp only [x, Function.update_idem]
    exact Function.update_eq_self i zero
  have hc : c = jointCorner ∅ j := by
    funext l; by_cases hlj : l = j <;> simp [c, jointCorner, zero, hlj]
  have hpair : Function.update c i (x i) = jointCorner {i} j := by
    rw [hxi]
    funext l
    by_cases hli : l = i
    · subst l; simp [jointCorner]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hli]
      by_cases hlj : l = j
      · subst l; simp [c, jointCorner]
      · simp [c, jointCorner, zero, hli, hlj]
  have hx : world A j mu x = 1 := by
    change world A j mu (Function.update zero i true) = 1
    rw [← corner_response (world A j mu) i true, world_response A j hj]
    simp [slope, hi]
  have hother : i ∉ others A j := by simp [others, hi]
  unfold mixedDifference
  rw [h0, hpair, hx, hc, joint_measurement A {i} j hj,
    joint_measurement A ∅ j hj]
  have he : ({i} : Finset (I n)) ∩ others A j = ∅ := by simp [hother]
  simp [he, world]


/-- Matching achievable value on this explicit family. Sample X uniformly
from the world-label family and retain X-complement, a legal k-subset.
This does not assert a matching upper bound on every admissible D6 function. -/
theorem uniform_family_value (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) :
    (∑ X ∈ worlds r j,
      (productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Xᶜ -
        productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ)) /
      (worlds r j).card = (r : ℝ)*(r+1)/(2*r+1) := by
  have ha := world_parameters r j hr hA
  have he : ∀ X ∈ worlds r j,
      productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Xᶜ -
        productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ =
          ((A \ X).card : ℝ) := by
    intro X hX
    have hx := world_parameters r j hr hX
    rw [tie_actual_regret A Xᶜ j ha.1 (hx.2.2.1.trans (hx.2.1.trans ha.2.1.symm))
      ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2]
    congr 2
    ext i; simp; tauto
  have hs : (∑ X ∈ worlds r j,
      (productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Xᶜ -
        productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ)) =
      ∑ X ∈ worlds r j, ((A \ X).card : ℝ) := sum_congr rfl he
  rw [hs]
  have hn := CIGAMF.P13.InformationLimit.information_limit_exact (positiveGround r j) r
    (positiveGround_card r j) A (mem_powersetCard.mp hA).1 ha.2.1
  change (2*r+1)*(∑ X ∈ worlds r j, (A \ X).card) =
    (r+1)*r*(worlds r j).card at hn
  have hreal : (2*r+1 : ℝ)*(∑ X ∈ worlds r j, ((A \ X).card : ℝ)) =
      (r+1)*r*(worlds r j).card := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < (worlds r j).card := by
    exact_mod_cast card_pos.mpr (worlds_nonempty r j)
  apply (div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hw) (by positivity : (2*r+1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mpr
  nlinarith

/-- Common observation supplied to any response-only randomized algorithm. -/
def commonResponse (j : I n) (i : I n) (u : Bool) : ℝ :=
  (if i = j then -1 else 1)*bit u

theorem common_profile (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A) :
    productResponse corner (world A j 0) = commonResponse j := by
  funext i u
  exact response_independent A j hj i u

/-- Complete observation-to-decision bridge. A single rule is applied to the
actual response of every constructed world; its output law is therefore fixed. -/
theorem response_rule_actual_lower (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (rule : (I (2*r+1) → Bool → ℝ) → Finset (I (2*r+1)) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ S ∈ actions r, 0 ≤ rule (commonResponse j) S)
    (hnorm : ∑ S ∈ actions r, rule (commonResponse j) S = 1) :
    ∃ A ∈ worlds r j,
      (r : ℝ)*(r+1)/(2*r+1) ≤ ∑ S ∈ actions r,
        rule (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S *
          (productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) S -
            productCompressionLoss (world A j 0) (productResponse corner (world A j 0)) Aᶜ) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hl⟩ := randomized_actual_lower r j hr (rule (commonResponse j)) hp hnorm
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  rw [common_profile A j (world_parameters r j hr hA).1] at ⊢
  rw [common_profile A j (world_parameters r j hr hA).1] at hl
  exact hl

end CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6TwoProfileImpliesRankOneV1.lean (84 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanD6InteractionContrastProfileReductionV1»

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6TwoProfileImpliesRankOne

open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfile
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastRankOne
open CIGAMF.P13.D6InteractionContrastProfileReduction

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem binary_hasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : Fin 2) :
    HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles q F i u0 := by
  refine ⟨0, 1, ?_⟩
  intro u
  fin_cases u
  · exact Or.inl (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  · exact Or.inr (fun _ ↦ rfl)

theorem hasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles_zero_or_representative {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hTwo : HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles q F i u0) :
    ∃ r : U, ∀ u,
      (∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = 0) ∨
      (∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 r z) := by
  rcases hTwo with ⟨a, b, hTwo⟩
  rcases hTwo u0 with h0a | h0b
  · refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    intro u
    rcases hTwo u with hua | hub
    · left
      intro z
      calc
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
            interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 a z := hua z
        _ = interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 z := (h0a z).symm
        _ = 0 := interactionContrastProfile_anchor q F i u0 z
    · exact Or.inr hub
  · refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    intro u
    rcases hTwo u with hua | hub
    · exact Or.inr hua
    · left
      intro z
      calc
        interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z =
            interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 b z := hub z
        _ = interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 z := (h0b z).symm
        _ = 0 := interactionContrastProfile_anchor q F i u0 z

theorem hasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles_implies_rankOne {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → U → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u0 : U)
    (hTwo : HasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles q F i u0) :
    InteractionContrastRankOne q F i u0 := by
  classical
  rcases hasAtMostTwoInteractionProfiles_zero_or_representative
    (q := q) (F := F) (i := i) (u0 := u0) hTwo with ⟨r, hr⟩
  let h : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ :=
    fun z ↦ interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 r z
  let lambda : U → ℝ := fun u ↦
    if (∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u z = 0) then 0 else 1
  refine ⟨h, lambda, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hz : ∀ z, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u0 z = 0 := by
      intro z
      exact interactionContrastProfile_anchor q F i u0 z
    simp [lambda, hz]
  · intro u z
    rcases hr u with hzero | hrep
    · simp [lambda, hzero, h, hzero z]
    · by_cases hzall : ∀ x, interactionContrastProfile q F i u0 u x = 0
      · simp [lambda, hzall, h, hzall z]
      · have hone : lambda u = 1 := by simp [lambda, hzall]
        rw [hone, one_mul]
        exact hrep z

end CIGAMF.P13.D6TwoProfileImpliesRankOne

import Mathlib
import «LeanD6ActiveDecisionCellV1»
import «LeanD6CycleDual»

/-!
# Uniform functional-level decision certificates

Unlike the legacy instance-wise PAEC mass, the identity in a uniform
certificate holds for every numerical world function.  Coefficients therefore
represent the active decision cell as a linear functional before observing a
particular `F`.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformDecisionCertificate

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.P13.D6CycleDual
open CIGAMF.P13.D6ActiveDecisionCell

variable {U : Type*} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

structure UniformDecisionCertificate {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    (R J : Type*) [Fintype R] [Fintype J] where
  coordinate : R → Fin (n + 1)
  upperWorld : R → Fin (n + 1) → U
  anchorWorld : R → Fin (n + 1) → U
  alpha : R → ℝ
  constraint : J → ((Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) → ℝ
  beta : J → ℝ
  beta_nonnegative : ∀ j, 0 ≤ beta j
  functional_identity : ∀ F,
    decisionLinearFunctional cell F =
      (∑ r, alpha r * cycleFunctional (coordinate r)
        (upperWorld r) (anchorWorld r) F) +
      ∑ j, beta j * constraint j F

noncomputable def UniformDecisionCertificate.mass {n : ℕ}
    {cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U}
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : UniformDecisionCertificate cell R J) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r, |cert.alpha r|

def ConstraintsValid {n : ℕ}
    {cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U}
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : UniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, cert.constraint j F ≤ 0

/-- Soundness of the new nondegenerate certificate language.  The scientific
constraints may encode active-extremum and Top-C inequalities, but their sign
is explicit rather than hidden in an instance-wise correction scalar. -/
theorem uniformDecisionCertificate_sound {n : ℕ}
    (cell : ActiveDecisionCell n U)
    {R J : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype J]
    (cert : UniformDecisionCertificate cell R J)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → U) → ℝ)
    (delta : ℝ) (hDelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hCell : cell.Valid F)
    (hConstraints : ConstraintsValid cert F)
    (hMixed : ∀ i x c, |mixedDifference F i x c| ≤ delta) :
    2 * (productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.selected -
      productCompressionLoss F (productResponse cell.q F) cell.competitor) ≤
      cert.mass * delta := by
  have hConstraintSum :
      (∑ j, cert.beta j * cert.constraint j F) ≤ 0 := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonpos fun j hj ↦
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (cert.beta_nonnegative j)
        (hConstraints j)
  have hCycles := finite_cycle_combination_bound F delta cert.coordinate
    cert.upperWorld cert.anchorWorld cert.alpha
    (fun r ↦ hMixed (cert.coordinate r) (cert.upperWorld r)
      (cert.anchorWorld r))
  have hCycleSigned :
      (∑ r, cert.alpha r * cycleFunctional (cert.coordinate r)
        (cert.upperWorld r) (cert.anchorWorld r) F) ≤
      delta * cert.mass := by
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hCycles
  rw [doubledDecisionGap_eq_linear cell F hCell]
  change decisionLinearFunctional cell F ≤ cert.mass * delta
  rw [cert.functional_identity F]
  unfold UniformDecisionCertificate.mass
  calc
    (∑ r, cert.alpha r * cycleFunctional (cert.coordinate r)
          (cert.upperWorld r) (cert.anchorWorld r) F) +
        ∑ j, cert.beta j * cert.constraint j F ≤
        ∑ r, cert.alpha r * cycleFunctional (cert.coordinate r)
          (cert.upperWorld r) (cert.anchorWorld r) F :=
      add_le_of_nonpos_right hConstraintSum
    _ ≤ delta * (∑ r, |cert.alpha r|) := hCycleSigned
    _ = (∑ r, |cert.alpha r|) * delta := by ring

end CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformDecisionCertificate

/-! # Step 3: `512 <= r0` is the wrong hypothesis, and the data says so

`expected_bad_epoch_work` concludes `<= 2 * eta d r0` with
`eta d r0 = ofReal (2*d*exp(-r0/128))`, so the bound is `4*d*exp(-r0/128)`.
The hypothesis `512 <= r0` does not mention `d`.  It is used for exactly one
thing -- `linear_exp_bound` needs `exp(-r0/128) <= 1/4` to get the geometric
ratio -- and it does nothing about the prefactor `4*d`.

`research/high_risk_20260910/d6_revalidation_epochs.json` measures the
consequence, and the column `theoretical_infinite_expected_bad_epoch_work_upper`
is exactly `4*d*exp(-r0/128)`:

    q     d=2q+1   badwork @512   bound @512    badwork @1024   bound @1024
    4     9        0.0000         0.66          0.0000          -
    64    129      0.053-0.073    9.45          0.0000          -
    256   513      0.487-0.500    37.58         -               -
    1024  2049     0.970-0.997    150.12        0.003-0.007     2.75

At `q = 1024, r0 = 512` nearly every epoch is bad and the bound is `150` -- it
is not loose, it is VACUOUS, since the quantity it bounds is at most one per
epoch.  Raising `r0` to `1024` collapses the failure to `~0.005`.

`bad_epoch_threshold` replaces the constant by what the prefactor requires:
`r0 >= 128*log(4*d/tol)` gives `2*eta d r0 <= tol` for any target, uniformly in
`d`.  `vacuous_at_512` records the other direction: with the constant
hypothesis alone the bound exceeds one -- says nothing at all -- as soon as
`d >= 14`, i.e. for every `q >= 7`.

This does not weaken `512 <= r0`; that hypothesis is still needed for the
geometric ratio and both are required together.  What changes is that the
guarantee is now uniform in `q` instead of silently dying at `q = 7`.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformDiscoveryThreshold
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryStopping CIGAMF.P13.D6DiscoveryVectorCertificate
open CIGAMF.P13.D6NuisanceFreeDiscoveryLaw CIGAMF.P13.D6RepeatedDiscovery
noncomputable section
variable {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

/-- The logarithmic threshold, put in multiplicative form. -/
lemma exp_threshold_of_log (d r0 : ℕ) (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hlog : 128*Real.log (4*(d:ℝ)/tol) ≤ (r0:ℝ)) :
    4*(d:ℝ) ≤ tol*Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128) := by
  have hdR : (0:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 4*(d:ℝ)/tol := by positivity
  have h1 : 4*(d:ℝ)/tol ≤ Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log hpos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 htol.le
  have h3 : tol*(4*(d:ℝ)/tol) = 4*(d:ℝ) := by field_simp
  linarith [h2,h3.symm.le,h3.le]

/-- Any target tolerance is reachable, uniformly in the dimension. -/
theorem eta_le_of_exp_threshold (d r0 : ℕ) (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol)
    (hr0 : 4*(d:ℝ) ≤ tol*Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128)) :
    2*eta d r0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal tol := by
  have hen : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128) := Real.exp_pos _
  have he : Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)*Real.exp ((r0:ℝ)/128) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show -(r0:ℝ)/128+(r0:ℝ)/128=0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
  have hkey : 2*(2*(d:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(r0:ℝ)/128)) ≤ tol := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr0 hen.le,he]
  have h2e : (2:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal 2 := by simp
  unfold eta
  rw [h2e,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hkey

/-- The threshold form, stated the way it should be used. -/
theorem bad_epoch_threshold (d r0 : ℕ) (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hlog : 128*Real.log (4*(d:ℝ)/tol) ≤ (r0:ℝ)) :
    2*eta d r0 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal tol :=
  eta_le_of_exp_threshold d r0 tol htol (exp_threshold_of_log d r0 tol htol hd hlog)

/-- The uniform-in-`q` discovery guarantee: the constant hypothesis for the
geometric ratio, the logarithmic one for non-vacuity. -/
theorem uniform_bad_epoch_work (m : J → Fin 4 → ℝ) (B : Finset J) (a : J)
    (hm : ∀ i,(∑ t,signs t*m i t)=target B a i) (r0 : ℕ) (hr0 : 512 ≤ r0)
    (tol : ℝ) (htol : 0 < tol)
    (hlog : 128*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card J:ℝ)/tol) ≤ (r0:ℝ)) :
    (∫⁻ x,badEpochWork B a r0 x ∂vectorPath m) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal tol := by
  letI : Nonempty J := ⟨a⟩
  exact (expected_bad_epoch_work m B a hm r0 hr0).trans
    (bad_epoch_threshold _ r0 tol htol Fintype.card_pos hlog)

/-- The other direction, recorded so the constant is not mistaken for adequate:
at `r0 = 512` the bound exceeds one, hence says nothing, once `d >= 14`. -/
theorem vacuous_at_512 (d : ℕ) (hd : 14 ≤ d) : 1 < 2*eta d 512 := by
  have hdR : (14:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have he1 : Real.exp 1 < 2.7182818286 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have hep : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hsq : (Real.exp 1)^2 < 7.3891 := by nlinarith [he1,hep]
  have hsqn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1)^2 := sq_nonneg _
  have h4 : (Real.exp 1)^4 < 56 := by nlinarith [hsq,hsqn]
  have hexp4 : Real.exp 4 = (Real.exp 1)^4 := by
    rw [show (4:ℝ)=(4:ℕ)*(1:ℝ) by norm_num,Real.exp_nat_mul]
  have hlt : Real.exp 4 < 4*(d:ℝ) := by rw [hexp4];linarith
  have hinv : 1 < 4*(d:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(4:ℝ)) := by
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp 4 := Real.exp_pos _
    have hid : Real.exp (-(4:ℝ))*Real.exp 4 = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add];norm_num
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt (Real.exp_pos (-(4:ℝ))),hid]
  have hneg : (-(512:ℕ):ℝ)/128 = -(4:ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h1e : (1:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal 1 := by simp
  have h2e : (2:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal 2 := by simp
  unfold eta
  rw [h1e,h2e,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num),hneg]
  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(4:ℝ))])).mpr
  nlinarith [hinv]

#print axioms exp_threshold_of_log
#print axioms eta_le_of_exp_threshold
#print axioms bad_epoch_threshold
#print axioms uniform_bad_epoch_work
#print axioms vacuous_at_512
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformDiscoveryThreshold

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6UniformPhaseThreeRemainderV1.lean (87 dong)
import «LeanD6FrozenQuadraticBoundV1»

/-! A uniform finite quadratic-regret constant on the whole closed phase-III
interval, not an assumed bound on a random plug-in allocation. The compactness
proof is for fixed q; it deliberately supplies no sharp dependence on q. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationDualBridge
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeCore CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeParameters
open CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationPhaseThreeFeasible CIGAMF.P13.D6AllocationMarginRegion
open CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenScalarAllocation CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenAllocationFeasible
open CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseShiftLipschitz CIGAMF.P13.D6FrozenQuadraticBound
open CIGAMF.P13.D6LocalOracleRegret CIGAMF.P13.D6PhaseThreePrimal
noncomputable section

def phaseInterval (q : ℝ) := Set.Icc (marginMax q) (marginHigh q)

lemma remainder_continuous (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    ContinuousOn (remainderConstant q) (phaseInterval q) := by
  have hD : Continuous (D q) := by unfold D radicand; fun_prop
  have hDp : ∀ m ∈ phaseInterval q, 0 < D q m := by
    intro m hm
    have hb := phase_shift_bounds q m hq hm.1 hm.2
    exact radical_positive q m hq (by linarith [hb.1])
  have hden : ∀ m ∈ phaseInterval q, q*(q-2)*(1-m)+D q m ≠ 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hb := phase_shift_bounds q m hq hm.1 hm.2
    have hn : 0 ≤ q*(q-2)*(1-m) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith [hb.2.1])
    linarith [hDp m hm]
  have hs : ContinuousOn (shift q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold shift
    apply ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hden
  have hm : ContinuousOn (mass q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold mass
    exact (continuousOn_const.mul hs).div hD.continuousOn (fun m hm => ne_of_gt (hDp m hm))
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun m => coefficient q (mass q m)) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold coefficient
    exact ((continuousOn_const.sub hm).mul continuousOn_const |>.div_const q).add
      (hm.mul continuousOn_const)
  have hcp : ∀ m ∈ phaseInterval q, coefficient q (mass q m) ≠ 0 := by
    intro m hx
    have hw := phase_mass_bounds q m hq hx.1 hx.2
    exact ne_of_gt (frozen_coefficients q (mass q m) hq hw.1 hw.2).1
  have hrad : ContinuousOn (radicalModulus q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold radicalModulus
    exact continuousOn_const.div hD.continuousOn (fun m hx => ne_of_gt (hDp m hx))
  have hshift : ContinuousOn (shiftModulus q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold shiftModulus
    exact (continuousOn_const.add hrad).div_const _
  have hcomb : ContinuousOn (combinedModulus q) (phaseInterval q) := by
    unfold combinedModulus
    exact hshift.add (((hm.mul continuousOn_const).div hc hcp).abs)
  unfold remainderConstant
  exact (hc.mul (hcomb.pow 2)).div_const 2

/-- A single nonnegative finite real C works simultaneously at all design
margins in phase III. It is derived from the actual explicit remainder. -/
theorem uniform_constant_exists (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z ∈ phaseInterval q, remainderConstant q z ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := isCompact_Icc.bddAbove_image (remainder_continuous q hq)
  refine ⟨max 0 B,le_max_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact (hB (Set.mem_image_of_mem (remainderConstant q) hz)).trans (le_max_right _ _)

/-- Uniform actual oracle regret over true/design margins in phase III.
There is no assumed modulus, oracle identity, or alternative feasibility. -/
theorem uniform_actual_quadratic (q : ℝ) (hq : 3 ≤ q) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (I n)) (j : I n)
      (mu mu0 : ℝ), mu ∈ phaseInterval q → mu0 ∈ phaseInterval q →
      j ∉ A → (A.card:ℝ)=q+1 → ((others A j).card:ℝ)=q →
      oracleRegret A j q mu (queries A j) (weights A j q (mass q mu0)) ≤ C*(mu0-mu)^2 := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := uniform_constant_exists q hq
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro n A j mu mu0 hm h0 hj hA hB
  have hh := actual_frozen_quadratic_regret A j q mu mu0 |mu-mu0| hq hm.1 hm.2 h0.1 h0.2
    hj hA hB (abs_nonneg _) le_rfl
  rw [sq_abs] at hh
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbound mu0 h0) (sq_nonneg (mu-mu0))
  have he : (mu-mu0)^2=(mu0-mu)^2 := by ring
  rw [← he]
  exact hh.trans ht

#print axioms remainder_continuous
#print axioms uniform_constant_exists
#print axioms uniform_actual_quadratic
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6UniformPhaseThreeRemainder

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6UniqueOptimumV1.lean (95 dong)
import «LeanD6GeometricRealizationV1»

/-! Uniqueness among every original cardinality-feasible selection, not only
among complement labels. In the real support realization, feasibility means
`liftedSelection S`; the interaction coordinate `none` remains omitted. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold CIGAMF.P13.D6Geometry
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductSurrogate CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ}

/-- Equality with the complement's actual compression loss forces the whole
selection to equal that complement. -/
theorem actual_loss_eq_iff (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card=A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) S =
      productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) Aᶜ ↔ S=Aᶜ := by
  constructor
  · intro hl
    have hr := actual_regret A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB
    rw [hl, sub_self] at hr
    have hp : 0 < 2-mu := by linarith
    have hc : ((S ∩ A).card : ℝ)=0 := by
      have he : (2-mu)*((S ∩ A).card : ℝ)=0 := by linarith [hr]
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp he).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hp)
    have hempty : S ∩ A=∅ := card_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast hc)
    have hs : S ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro i hi
      apply mem_compl.mpr
      intro hai
      have hm : i ∈ S ∩ A := mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi,hai⟩
      rw [hempty] at hm
      simpa using hm
    exact eq_of_subset_of_card_le hs (hbal.trans hcard.symm).le
  · intro he
    rw [he]

/-- The actual optimization answer region is the singleton {Aᶜ}: every
same-cardinality competing selection is quantified explicitly. -/
theorem actual_optimal_iff (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card=A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    (∀ T : Finset (I n), T.card=A.card →
      productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) S ≤
        productCompressionLoss (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)) T) ↔ S=Aᶜ := by
  constructor
  · intro ho
    apply (actual_loss_eq_iff A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB).mp
    exact le_antisymm (ho Aᶜ hbal) (complement_optimal A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB)
  · intro he
    subst S
    intro T hT
    exact complement_optimal A T j hj mu hmu hmu1 hT hbal hB

/-- The same uniqueness holds for the literal finite real support and fixed
ambient projections, over all feasible lifted selections. -/
theorem geometric_optimal_iff (A S : Finset (I n)) (j : I n) (hj : j ∉ A)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1)
    (hcard : S.card=A.card) (hbal : Aᶜ.card=A.card) (hB : 2 ≤ (others A j).card) :
    (∀ T : Finset (I n), T.card=A.card →
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection S) ≤
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection T)) ↔ S=Aᶜ := by
  simp_rw [actual_geometric_radius]
  exact actual_optimal_iff A S j hj mu hmu hmu1 hcard hbal hB

/-- Every explicit D6 width m=2(r+1)>=6 has a unique geometric optimum for
every admissible nuisance margin, including both endpoints. -/
theorem all_width_geometric_optimal_iff (r : ℕ) (j : I (2*r+1)) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (A S : Finset (I (2*r+1))) (hA : A ∈ worlds r j) (hS : S ∈ actions r)
    (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hmu1 : mu ≤ 1) :
    (∀ T : Finset (I (2*r+1)), T ∈ actions r →
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection S) ≤
      selectedRadius (restrictedProjection (world A j mu) (productResponse corner (world A j mu)))
        (liftedSelection T)) ↔ S=Aᶜ := by
  have hp := world_parameters r j hr hA
  have hsCard : S.card=A.card := (mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2.trans hp.2.1.symm
  have hm : ∀ T : Finset (I (2*r+1)), T ∈ actions r ↔ T.card=A.card := by
    intro T
    simp [actions, mem_powersetCard, hp.2.1]
  simp_rw [hm]
  exact geometric_optimal_iff A S j hp.1 mu hmu hmu1 hsCard hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2

#print axioms actual_loss_eq_iff
#print axioms actual_optimal_iff
#print axioms geometric_optimal_iff
#print axioms all_width_geometric_optimal_iff
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6UniqueOptimum

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6UnknownMarginAllocationV1.lean (108 dong)
import «LeanD6ThresholdConstructionV1»

/-! Unknown-margin allocation: actual-world confounding and analytic parts of
an exact m=10 certificate. The full orbit-averaging/optimal-design bridge is
NOT claimed as formalized here. The separate exact-rational verifier checks
all 265 measurements and 125 alternatives, minimizing each real quadratic. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6UnknownMargin
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.P13.D6Threshold
open CIGAMF.V4.ProductMixedDifference

def A : Finset (I 9) := {0,1,2,3,4}
def A' : Finset (I 9) := {0,1,2,3,6}
def B : Finset (I 9) := {6,7,8,9}
def j : I 9 := 5

theorem j_not_A : j ∉ A := by decide
theorem j_not_A' : j ∉ A' := by decide

/-- Same actual joint observation, different hidden set AND margin. Repeating
this sole measurement cannot distinguish the two worlds under identical noise. -/
theorem actual_joint_confounding :
    world A j (1/2) (jointCorner B j) = 3/2 ∧
    world A' j (1/4) (jointCorner B j) = 3/2 := by
  rw [joint_measurement A B j j_not_A, joint_measurement A' B j j_not_A']
  have h : (B ∩ others A j).card = 4 := by decide
  have h' : (B ∩ others A' j).card = 3 := by decide
  rw [h, h']; norm_num

/-- Using the first world's optimum in the second causes strictly positive
actual regret. The error is not an artifact of an abstract answer map. -/
theorem confounded_wrong_optimum_regret :
    productCompressionLoss (world A' j (1/4)) (productResponse corner (world A' j (1/4))) Aᶜ -
      productCompressionLoss (world A' j (1/4)) (productResponse corner (world A' j (1/4))) A'ᶜ =
      7/8 := by
  rw [actual_regret A' Aᶜ j j_not_A' (1/4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)]
  have h : (Aᶜ ∩ A').card = 1 := by decide
  rw [h]; norm_num

theorem both_worlds_have_actual_optima (S : Finset (I 9)) (hS : S.card = 5) :
    productCompressionLoss (world A j (1/2)) (productResponse corner (world A j (1/2))) Aᶜ ≤
      productCompressionLoss (world A j (1/2)) (productResponse corner (world A j (1/2))) S ∧
    productCompressionLoss (world A' j (1/4)) (productResponse corner (world A' j (1/4))) A'ᶜ ≤
      productCompressionLoss (world A' j (1/4)) (productResponse corner (world A' j (1/4))) S := by
  constructor
  · exact complement_optimal A S j j_not_A (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (hS.trans (by decide)) (by decide) (by decide)
  · exact complement_optimal A' S j j_not_A' (1/4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (hS.trans (by decide)) (by decide) (by decide)

noncomputable def rate : ℝ := 289/2888

noncomputable def nearestPrimal (nu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (170/171) * ((1 + (1/2-nu)^2)/10) + (1/171) * ((3/2-2*nu)^2/2)

/-- Completed square valid for every real alternative lambda, without a grid. -/
theorem primal_completed_square (nu : ℝ) :
    nearestPrimal nu = rate + (nu - 10/19)^2/9 := by
  unfold nearestPrimal rate
  ring

theorem primal_nearest_lower (nu : ℝ) : rate ≤ nearestPrimal nu := by
  rw [primal_completed_square]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (nu-10/19)]

theorem primal_attained : nearestPrimal (10/19) = rate := by
  rw [primal_completed_square]; norm_num

/-- For distance >=2, each A-only four-subset has alternative mean >=0,
whereas its true mean is -1/2. This scalar implication is used by the
certificate; the full combinatorial averaging remains in the exact verifier. -/
theorem distant_point_lower (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (1/8 : ℝ) ≤ (y+1/2)^2/2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]

theorem distant_primal_above_rate : rate < (170/171 : ℝ)*(1/8) := by
  norm_num [rate]

/-- Uniform adjacent-alternative dual polynomial. s/t are the counts of queried
coordinates in A/B. Its derivation from the 20 alternatives is exact-checked
in Python; this theorem proves its bound for every legal count pair. -/
noncomputable def jointDual (s t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((1/2-10/19)^2*((t:ℝ)-1)^2 -
    2*(1/2-10/19)*(10/19)*((t:ℝ)-1)*((s:ℝ)/5-(t:ℝ)/4) +
    (10/19)^2*((s:ℝ)/5+(t:ℝ)/4-2*(s:ℝ)*(t:ℝ)/20))/2

theorem dual_all_joint_counts (s t : ℕ) (h : s+t ≤ 4) : jointDual s t ≤ rate := by
  have hs : s ≤ 4 := by omega
  have ht : t ≤ 4 := by omega
  interval_cases s <;> interval_cases t <;> norm_num [jointDual, rate] at *

theorem dual_scalar_counts :
    ((1-10/19)^2/10 : ℝ) ≤ rate ∧
    (((1/4)*(1-1/2)^2+(3/4)*(1/2-10/19)^2)/2 : ℝ) ≤ rate ∧
    ((1/2-10/19)^2/2 : ℝ) ≤ rate := by norm_num [rate]

theorem both_allocated_orbits_attain_dual : jointDual 0 4 = rate ∧ jointDual 4 0 = rate := by
  norm_num [jointDual, rate]

#print axioms both_worlds_have_actual_optima
#print axioms primal_completed_square
#print axioms primal_nearest_lower
#print axioms dual_all_joint_counts

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanD6WeightedEpochCompositionV1.lean (101 dong)
import «LeanD6EpochMarginalLawV1»

/-! # Step 2: the length-weighted composition, and why it is `O(log T)`

`LeanD6MultiEpochCompositionV1` summed per-epoch bounds WITHOUT weights, under a
budget split, and found an `E^2` penalty minimised by the equal split.  That is a
correct theorem about the wrong functional for this design.  The corpus itself
says which functional is right: `LeanD6RepeatedDiscoveryV1.badEpochWork` is
`∑' s, indicator(bad at s) * 2^s`, weighted by the epoch's allocation length,
and `allocation_epoch_lengths` in `d6_revalidation_epochs.json` doubles --
18432, 36864, 73728, ... over twelve epochs.

Under doubling allocation `L s = L0*2^s` and a per-epoch bound
`est/L s + V*4^(-s)`, the weighted total telescopes:

  `∑_{s<E} L s * (est/L s + V*4^(-s)) = E*est + L0*V*∑_{s<E} 2^s*4^(-s)`

and `2^s*4^(-s) = 2^(-s)` sums to at most `2`.  So the total is
`E*est + 2*L0*V`: **linear in the number of epochs**, and since the total
allocation is `L0*(2^E - 1)`, linear in `E` is logarithmic in the budget.  The
revalidation schedule is what makes the second half a convergent series rather
than a growing one -- the same `2^s` against `4^(-s)` cancellation that
`expected_bad_epoch_work` already uses.

Scope.  These are inequalities about sums of bounds.  They become a statement
about a run only when composed with `LeanD6EpochMarginalLawV1.epoch_weighted_le`
(which supplies the per-epoch expectations with no conditioning) and with a D6
instantiation supplying `IsProbabilityMeasure` for the per-epoch observation
laws.  That instantiation is not in this file.  Nothing here proves a matching
lower bound, so `O(log T)` is an upper bound on this algorithm, not a rate for
the problem.
-/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.D6WeightedEpochComposition
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
open Finset MeasureTheory
noncomputable section

/-- The cancellation that makes the revalidation series converge.  Same step as
in `expected_bad_epoch_work`. -/
lemma two_mul_quarter_pow (s : ℕ) : (2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s = (2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
  have he : (2:ℝ≥0∞)*4⁻¹=2⁻¹ := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).mp
    norm_num
  rw [← mul_pow,he]

/-- Core composition: a per-epoch bound of the shape `est + c*2^(-s)` sums, over
`E` epochs, to `E*est + 2*c`.  The first summand is what grows with the epoch
count; the second is a convergent series and is paid once. -/
theorem weighted_epoch_total {u : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (est c : ℝ≥0∞) (E : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ s,u s ≤ est+c*(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,u s ≤ (E:ℝ≥0∞)*est+2*c := by
  calc ∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,u s
      ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,(est+c*(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun s _ => hu s)
    _ = (E:ℝ≥0∞)*est+c*∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (E:ℝ≥0∞)*est+c*∑' s : ℕ,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
        gcongr
        exact ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _
    _ = (E:ℝ≥0∞)*est+2*c := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two]; ring

/-- Doubling form.  `hu` is exactly the one-epoch bound multiplied by the
epoch's own length: the estimation half loses its `1/L` and becomes the constant
`est`, the label half keeps `L0*V` and picks up `2^s*4^(-s) = 2^(-s)`. -/
theorem doubling_epoch_total {u : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (est V L0 : ℝ≥0∞) (E : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ s,u s ≤ est+L0*V*((2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s)) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,u s ≤ (E:ℝ≥0∞)*est+2*(L0*V) := by
  refine weighted_epoch_total est (L0*V) E (fun s => ?_)
  rw [← two_mul_quarter_pow s]
  exact hu s

/-- The total allocation actually spent by `E` doubling epochs.  With
`L0*(2^E-1)` rounds bought, a bound linear in `E` is logarithmic in the spend. -/
lemma doubling_budget (L0 E : ℕ) : ∑ s ∈ Finset.range E,L0*2^s = L0*(2^E-1) := by
  induction E with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : 1 ≤ 2^n := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,ih,pow_succ]
    cases' Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L0 with h h
    · simp [h]
    · have h2 : L0*(2^n-1)+L0*2^n = L0*(2^n*2-1) := by
        have : 2^n*2-1 = (2^n-1)+2^n := by omega
        rw [this,Nat.mul_add]
      exact h2

/-- Sanity: with a single epoch the composition is the one-epoch bound again,
so the `E` factor is not an artefact of the bookkeeping. -/
theorem one_epoch_consistent {u : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞} (est c : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hu : ∀ s,u s ≤ est+c*(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range 1,u s ≤ est+c := by
  have h := hu 0
  simpa using h

#print axioms two_mul_quarter_pow
#print axioms weighted_epoch_total
#print axioms doubling_epoch_total
#print axioms doubling_budget
#print axioms one_epoch_consistent
end
end CIGAMF.P13.D6WeightedEpochComposition

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanDyadicCertifiedStoppingV1.lean (121 dong)
import Mathlib

/-! A concrete dyadic stopping-time construction and expected-work theorem.
A per-stage error envelope is sufficient even on paths where earlier estimates
were wrong. Work is infinite on nontermination; it is not silently set to zero. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.DyadicCertifiedStopping
open scoped ENNReal
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable section
variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

def alive (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (s : ℕ) : Set Ω := {x | ∀ t ≤ s, ¬ accept t x}

def work (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (x : Ω) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  1+∑' s : ℕ, (alive accept s).indicator (fun _ => (2:ℝ≥0∞)^s) x

lemma alive_measurable (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (ha : ∀ s, MeasurableSet {x | accept s x})
    (s : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (alive accept s) := by
  change MeasurableSet {x | ∀ t, t ≤ s → ¬ accept t x}
  simp only [Set.setOf_forall,← Set.compl_setOf]
  exact MeasurableSet.iInter (fun t => MeasurableSet.iInter (fun _ : t ≤ s => (ha t).compl))

lemma work_measurable (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (ha : ∀ s, MeasurableSet {x | accept s x}) :
    Measurable (work accept) := by
  unfold work
  exact measurable_const.add (Measurable.ennreal_tsum (fun s =>
    measurable_const.indicator (alive_measurable accept ha s)))

lemma nontermination_work_top (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (x : Ω)
    (hx : ¬ ∃ s, accept s x) : work accept x=∞ := by
  have he (s : ℕ) : x ∈ alive accept s := by
    intro t _ ht
    exact hx ⟨t,ht⟩
  simp [work,Set.indicator_of_mem (he _),ENNReal.tsum_geometric,
    tsub_eq_zero_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)]

/-- On first acceptance at s, normalized work is 2^s. Actual queries multiply
this quantity by the cost of the initial block. -/
theorem work_at_first_accept (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (x : Ω) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : accept s x) (hbefore : ∀ t < s, ¬ accept t x) : work accept x=(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
  have he (t : ℕ) : (alive accept t).indicator (fun _ => (2:ℝ≥0∞)^t) x =
      if t < s then (2:ℝ≥0∞)^t else 0 := by
    by_cases ht : t < s
    · have hx : x ∈ alive accept t := fun u hu => hbefore u (lt_of_le_of_lt hu ht)
      simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx,ht]
    · have hx : x ∉ alive accept t := fun h => h s (by omega) hs
      simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx,ht]
  simp only [work,he]
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range s) (by intro b hb;simp only [Finset.mem_range,not_lt] at hb; simp [not_lt.mpr hb])]
  have hsum : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range s, if t < s then (2:ℝ≥0∞)^t else 0) =
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range s,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^t :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp ht))
  rw [hsum]
  have hh : 1+(∑ t ∈ Finset.range s,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^t)=(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
    have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, 1+(∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^t)=(2:ℝ≥0∞)^n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,← add_assoc,ih,pow_succ];ring
    exact hall s
  simpa using hh

theorem expected_work_bound (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (ha : ∀ s, MeasurableSet {x | accept s x})
    (bad : ℕ → Set Ω) (hgood : ∀ s x, x ∉ bad s → accept s x)
    (eta : ℝ≥0∞) (htail : ∀ s, P (bad s) ≤ eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :
    (∫⁻ x,work accept x ∂P) ≤ 1+2*eta := by
  have hb (s : ℕ) : P (alive accept s) ≤ eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
    apply (measure_mono (show alive accept s ⊆ bad s from ?_)).trans (htail s)
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx s le_rfl (hgood s x h)
  unfold work
  rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const,lintegral_const,measure_univ,mul_one,
    lintegral_tsum (fun s => (measurable_const.indicator (alive_measurable accept ha s)).aemeasurable)]
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  calc
    (∑' s : ℕ, ∫⁻ x,(alive accept s).indicator (fun _ => (2:ℝ≥0∞)^s) x ∂P)
        = ∑' s : ℕ,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*P (alive accept s) := by
          apply tsum_congr;intro s
          exact lintegral_indicator_const (alive_measurable accept ha s) _
    _ ≤ ∑' s : ℕ,(2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun s => mul_le_mul le_rfl (hb s) (by positivity) (by positivity))
    _ = eta*∑' s : ℕ,(2⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := by
      rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
      apply tsum_congr;intro s
      have he : (2:ℝ≥0∞)*4⁻¹=2⁻¹ := by
        apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by finiteness) (by finiteness)).mp
        norm_num
      calc
        _ = eta*((2:ℝ≥0∞)^s*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) := by ac_rfl
        _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow,he]
    _ = 2*eta := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two,mul_comm]

theorem almost_sure_termination (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (accept : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (ha : ∀ s, MeasurableSet {x | accept s x})
    (bad : ℕ → Set Ω) (hgood : ∀ s x, x ∉ bad s → accept s x)
    (eta : ℝ≥0∞) (heta : eta ≠ ∞)
    (htail : ∀ s, P (bad s) ≤ eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂P, ∃ s, accept s x := by
  have hbound := expected_work_bound P accept ha bad hgood eta htail
  have hfinite : (∫⁻ x,work accept x ∂P) ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by finiteness) hbound
  filter_upwards [ae_lt_top (work_measurable accept ha) hfinite] with x hx
  by_contra h
  rw [nontermination_work_top accept x h] at hx
  exact (lt_irrefl _) hx

theorem ever_error_bound (P : Measure Ω) (wrong bad : ℕ → Set Ω)
    (hsub : ∀ s, wrong s ⊆ bad s) (eta : ℝ≥0∞)
    (htail : ∀ s, P (bad s) ≤ eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s) :
    P (⋃ s,wrong s) ≤ eta*(1-(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞))⁻¹ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' s,P (wrong s) := measure_iUnion_le _
    _ ≤ ∑' s,eta*(4⁻¹:ℝ≥0∞)^s := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun s => (measure_mono (hsub s)).trans (htail s))
    _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left,ENNReal.tsum_geometric]

#print axioms work_at_first_accept
#print axioms expected_work_bound
#print axioms almost_sure_termination
#print axioms ever_error_bound
end
end CIGAMF.P13.DyadicCertifiedStopping

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanFiniteAllocationTrackerMeasurableV1.lean (90 dong)
import «LeanFiniteAllocationTrackerV1»

/-! The constructive tracker is measurable and uses targets only up to the
current time. This is the missing probabilistic interface of its pathwise
rounding theorem. The target at time N must itself be chosen from past data. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.FiniteAllocationTrackerMeasurable
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset MeasureTheory
open CIGAMF.P13.FiniteAllocationTracker
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {T : Type*} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] [Nonempty T]
variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

private def chooseMask (mask : T → Bool) : T :=
  if h : ∃ i,mask i=true then Classical.choose h else Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty T)

lemma pick_eq_mask (c : T → ℕ) (v : T → ℝ) :
    pick c v=chooseMask (fun i => decide ((c i:ℝ)<v i)) := by
