/-! Generic nested-chain scaffolding for scalar-prefix rankability.

The definition records the common ranking that realizes the chain.  This makes
the equivalence below an exact interface theorem between the existing
`ScalarPrefixRankable` predicate and cardinality-optimal nested prefixes.  It is
not presented as a new characterization of the CIG-AMF support-radius class.

Finite discovery accompanying this module rejected the tested specialized
submodular, supermodular, exchange, accessibility, and extrema-compatibility
candidate characterizations; consequently no `SR1` iff is asserted here. -/

namespace CIGAMF.V7.StructuralRankabilityCharacterization

open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

def CardinalityOptimal
    (objective : Finset ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  S.card = k ∧ ∀ T : Finset ι, T.card = k → objective S ≤ objective T

def NestedOptimalChain (objective : Finset ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ranking : List ι,
    IsFullRanking ranking ∧
    (∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card ι →
      CardinalityOptimal objective (prefixSet ranking k) k) ∧
    (∀ k, k < Fintype.card ι →
      prefixSet ranking k ⊂ prefixSet ranking (k + 1))

private theorem ranking_prefix_strict
    (ranking : List ι) (hfull : IsFullRanking ranking)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < Fintype.card ι) :
    prefixSet ranking k ⊂ prefixSet ranking (k + 1) := by
  have hsubset := prefixSet_nested ranking k
  have hk0 : k ≤ Fintype.card ι := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hk
  have hcard0 := prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull k hk0
  have hcard1 := prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull (k + 1) hk1
  exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsubset, by
    intro heq
    have := congrArg Finset.card heq
    rw [hcard0, hcard1] at this
    omega⟩

theorem SR0_scalarPrefix_iff_nestedOptimalChain
    (objective : Finset ι → ℝ) :
    ScalarPrefixRankable objective ↔ NestedOptimalChain objective := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ranking, hfull, hoptimal⟩
    refine ⟨ranking, hfull, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      exact ⟨prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull k hk, hoptimal k hk⟩
    · intro k hk
      exact ranking_prefix_strict ranking hfull k hk
  · rintro ⟨ranking, hfull, hoptimal, _hnested⟩
    refine ⟨ranking, hfull, ?_⟩
    intro k hk S hcard
    exact (hoptimal k hk).2 S hcard

theorem SR0_selectedRadius_scalarPrefix_iff_nestedOptimalChain
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    ScalarPrefixRankable (selectedRadius f) ↔
      NestedOptimalChain (selectedRadius f) :=
  SR0_scalarPrefix_iff_nestedOptimalChain (selectedRadius f)

end CIGAMF.V7.StructuralRankabilityCharacterization

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralRankabilityV4.lean (65 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanSupportGeometryV4»

/-! The proved structural implication; characterization work remains separate. -/

namespace CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability

open SupportGeometry

variable {Ω ι : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

def GloballyCoextremizable (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ amax amin : Ω,
    (∀ j, f j amax = componentMax f j) ∧
    (∀ j, f j amin = componentMin f j)

def AllSubsetsModular (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : Finset ι, supportOsc T f = modularSpan T f

theorem S1_global_coextremizable_implies_all_subsets_modular
    (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    GloballyCoextremizable f → AllSubsetsModular f := by
  rintro ⟨amax, amin, hmax, hmin⟩ T
  exact BH4_coextremizable_exactness T f amax amin
    (fun j _ => hmax j) (fun j _ => hmin j)

/- A scalar-prefix ranking is one fixed duplicate-free list containing every
index.  Budget-k candidates are prefixes of that same list. -/
def IsFullRanking (ranking : List ι) : Prop :=
  ranking.Nodup ∧ ranking.toFinset = Finset.univ

def prefixSet (ranking : List ι) (k : Nat) : Finset ι :=
  (ranking.take k).toFinset

theorem prefixSet_nested (ranking : List ι) (k : Nat) :
    prefixSet ranking k ⊆ prefixSet ranking (k + 1) := by
  intro x hx
  have hp : ranking.take k <+: ranking.take (k + 1) :=
    List.take_prefix_take_left (Nat.le_succ k)
  have hxList : x ∈ ranking.take k := by simpa [prefixSet] using hx
  have : x ∈ ranking.take (k + 1) := hp.subset hxList
  simpa [prefixSet] using this

def TopCExactAllBudgets (objective : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (topC : Nat → Finset ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card ι → ∀ S, S.card = k → objective (topC k) ≤ objective S

def ScalarPrefixRankable (objective : Finset ι → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ranking : List ι, IsFullRanking ranking ∧
    ∀ k, k ≤ Fintype.card ι → ∀ S, S.card = k →
      objective (prefixSet ranking k) ≤ objective S

theorem S1_topC_exact_implies_scalar_prefix
    (objective : Finset ι → ℝ) (topC : Nat → Finset ι)
    (ranking : List ι) (hfull : IsFullRanking ranking)
    (hprefix : ∀ k, topC k = prefixSet ranking k)
    (hExact : TopCExactAllBudgets objective topC) :
    ScalarPrefixRankable objective := by
  refine ⟨ranking, hfull, ?_⟩
  intro k hk S hcard
  rw [← hprefix k]
  exact hExact k hk S hcard

end CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability

    (hnot : ¬ A ⊆ B) : r ≠ s := by
  intro hrs
  subst s
  exact hnot (by simpa [hr, hs] using prefixSet_mono r hkl)

  rcases hCover.2.2 4 (by norm_num) with ⟨r4, hr4, ho4⟩
  rcases hCover.2.2 5 (by norm_num) with ⟨r5, hr5, ho5⟩

  have hp5 := unique_optimal_five _ ho5
  have h12 : r1 ≠ r2 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r1 r2 (by omega)
    opt1 opt2 hp1 hp2 (by decide)
  have h13 : r1 ≠ r3 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r1 r3 (by omega)
    opt1 opt3 hp1 hp3 (by decide)
  have h14 : r1 ≠ r4 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r1 r4 (by omega)

  have h35 : r3 ≠ r5 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r3 r5 (by omega)

  have h45 : r4 ≠ r5 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r4 r5 (by omega)
    opt4 opt5 hp4 hp5 (by decide)
  have hfive :
      ({r1, r2, r3, r4, r5} : Finset (List (Fin 7))).card = 5 := by

    · exact hr2
    · exact hr3
    · exact hr4
    · exact hr5
  have hcardLower := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  rw [hfive] at hcardLower
  omega

/-!
# Kernel-checked replacement for the ten `native_decide` steps of the χ≥5 witness

`LeanStructuralScalarChi5WitnessV1` proves ten arithmetic facts by
`native_decide`, a tactic this project rejects as a trust hole: it compiles the
proposition to machine code, runs it, and records the answer through the axiom
`Lean.ofReduceBool`.  Consequently the χ_prefix ≥ 5 claim is a COMPILED
ARTIFACT, not PROVED, and the module is absent from the audited set.

Nothing is deleted here.  This module re-proves the same ten statements about
the same definitions using kernel `decide`, so the corresponding axiom set is
`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` with no `Lean.ofReduceBool`.

Scale of the kernel work: five closed evaluations, plus five quantifications
over `Finset (Fin 7)` -- 128 subsets, each a signed 7-term integer sum and one
`natAbs`.  That is 896 kernel integer additions in total, not a case explosion.
Each statement is a separate theorem so that a failure localises.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralScalarChi5Kernel

open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralScalarChi5Witness

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-! ## The five closed evaluations -/

theorem opt1_abs_kernel : complementAbs7 opt1 = 1 := by decide
theorem opt2_abs_kernel : complementAbs7 opt2 = 0 := by decide
theorem opt3_abs_kernel : complementAbs7 opt3 = 1 := by decide
theorem opt4_abs_kernel : complementAbs7 opt4 = 2 := by decide
theorem opt5_abs_kernel : complementAbs7 opt5 = 0 := by decide

/-! ## The five uniqueness statements -/

theorem unique_abs1_kernel :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 7), S.card = 1 → complementAbs7 S ≤ 1 → S = opt1 := by
  decide

theorem unique_abs2_kernel :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 7), S.card = 2 → complementAbs7 S ≤ 0 → S = opt2 := by
  decide

theorem unique_abs3_kernel :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 7), S.card = 3 → complementAbs7 S ≤ 1 → S = opt3 := by
  decide

theorem unique_abs4_kernel :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 7), S.card = 4 → complementAbs7 S ≤ 2 → S = opt4 := by
  decide

theorem unique_abs5_kernel :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 7), S.card = 5 → complementAbs7 S ≤ 0 → S = opt5 := by
  decide

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralScalarChi5Kernel

def scalarWeight7 : Fin 7 → ℤ := ![-32, 7, 29, -7, -8, -13, 18]

/-- At support point zero the component exposes its signed weight; at support
point one it is zero. -/
def scalarF7 (j : Fin 7) (a : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  if a = 0 then scalarWeight7 j else 0

def complementWeight7 (S : Finset (Fin 7)) : ℤ :=
  Sᶜ.sum scalarWeight7

def complementAbs7 (S : Finset (Fin 7)) : ℕ :=
  (complementWeight7 S).natAbs

private theorem scalar_sum_zero (S : Finset (Fin 7)) :
    sumComponent Sᶜ scalarF7 0 = (complementWeight7 S : ℝ) := by
  unfold sumComponent complementWeight7 scalarF7
  norm_cast

private theorem scalar_sum_one (S : Finset (Fin 7)) :
    sumComponent Sᶜ scalarF7 1 = 0 := by
  simp [sumComponent, scalarF7]

weight. -/

    selectedRadius scalarF7 S = (complementAbs7 S : ℝ) / 2 := by
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc osc
  rw [maxVal_fin2, minVal_fin2, scalar_sum_zero, scalar_sum_one,
    max_sub_min_eq_abs]

  have h35 : r3 ≠ r5 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r3 r5 (by omega)
    opt3 opt5 hp3 hp5 (by decide)
  have h45 : r4 ≠ r5 := rankings_distinct_of_incomparable r4 r5 (by omega)
    opt4 opt5 hp4 hp5 (by decide)
  have hfive :
      ({r1, r2, r3, r4, r5} : Finset (List (Fin 7))).card = 5 := by
    simp [h12, h13, h14, h15, h23, h24, h25, h34, h35, h45]
  have hsubset :
      ({r1, r2, r3, r4, r5} : Finset (List (Fin 7))) ⊆ menu := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hr
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hr1
    · exact hr2
    · exact hr3
    · exact hr4
    · exact hr5
  have hcardLower := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  rw [hfive] at hcardLower
  omega

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralScalarChi5Witness

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseApproximationV1.lean (112 dong)
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCoverV1»

/-! A single ranking is within 1/2 of optimum at every budget in the entire
staircase family. After total-component-radius normalization the error is
1/(2r). Thus exact unbounded prefix complexity need not remain robust. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseApproximation
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseUnbounded
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCover
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralOrdinaryChainCharacterization
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralMinimumTransversalWidth
noncomputable section

lemma low_subset_negative {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    lowSelected k ⊆ negativeUniverse := by
  intro j hj
  simp only [negativeUniverse,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
  exact lowSelected_all_negative k j hj

theorem negative_first_ranking_exists (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ ranking : List (StairRel r), IsFullRanking ranking ∧
      prefixSet ranking r = negativeUniverse ∧
      ∀ k : Fin r, prefixSet ranking k.val = lowSelected k := by
  let chain : Finset (Finset (StairRel r)) := insert negativeUniverse (lowChain r)
  have hchain : InclusionChain chain := by
    intro A hA B hB
    rcases mem_insert.mp hA with rfl | hA
    · rcases mem_insert.mp hB with rfl | hB
      · exact Or.inl Subset.rfl
      · obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hB
        exact Or.inr (low_subset_negative k)
    · rcases mem_insert.mp hB with rfl | hB
      · obtain ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hA
        exact Or.inl (low_subset_negative k)
      · exact lowChain_inclusionChain A hA B hB
  obtain ⟨ranking,hfull,hprefix⟩ := finite_inclusion_chain_extends_to_full_ranking chain hchain
  refine ⟨ranking,hfull,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [negativeUniverse_card] using hprefix negativeUniverse (mem_insert_self _ _)
  · intro k
    have hk : lowSelected k ∈ chain := mem_insert_of_mem (mem_image.mpr ⟨k,mem_univ _,rfl⟩)
    simpa only [lowSelected_card] using hprefix (lowSelected k) hk

theorem radius_le_half_after_negatives {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hS : negativeUniverse ⊆ S) : selectedRadius staircaseF S ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hneg (i : Fin r) : negativeAt Sᶜ i = ∅ := by
    apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro j hj
    have h := mem_filter.mp hj
    have hjS : j ∈ S := hS (by simp [negativeUniverse,h.2.1])
    exact (mem_compl.mp h.1) hjS
  have hbounds (a : StairAction r) :
      0 ≤ sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF a ∧ sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF a ≤ 1 := by
    cases a with
    | none => simp [sumComponent,staircaseF]
    | some i => rw [staircase_sum_formula,hneg]; simp; split <;> norm_num
  have hmax := maxVal_le (sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF) (fun a => (hbounds a).2)
  have hmin := le_minVal (sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF) (fun a => (hbounds a).1)
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc osc
  linarith

lemma prefix_mono {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I] (ranking : List I) {k l : ℕ}
    (hkl : k ≤ l) : prefixSet ranking k ⊆ prefixSet ranking l := by
  intro x hx
  have hp : ranking.take k <+: ranking.take l := List.take_prefix_take_left hkl
  have hx' : x ∈ ranking.take k := by simpa [prefixSet] using hx
  simpa [prefixSet] using hp.subset hx'

/-- Uniform in r, with an actual support-radius objective and a full ranking. -/
theorem one_ranking_half (r : ℕ) :
    OnePrefixChain (selectedRadius (@staircaseF r)) (1/2) := by
  obtain ⟨ranking,hfull,hneg,hlow⟩ := negative_first_ranking_exists r
  refine ⟨ranking,hfull,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  refine ⟨CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural.prefixSet_card_of_full ranking hfull k hk,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  by_cases hkr : k < r
  · let k' : Fin r := ⟨k,hkr⟩
    have hp := hlow k'
    have ho := (lowSelected_exact_optimal k').2 T hT
    rw [hp]
    linarith
  · have hcontains : negativeUniverse ⊆ prefixSet ranking k := by
      rw [← hneg]; exact prefix_mono ranking (by omega)
    have hradius := radius_le_half_after_negatives _ hcontains
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ selectedRadius staircaseF T := by
      unfold selectedRadius supportOsc
      exact div_nonneg (osc_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    linarith

theorem one_ranking_normalized (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    OnePrefixChain (fun S => selectedRadius (@staircaseF r) S / r) (1/(2*(r:ℝ))) := by
  obtain ⟨ranking,hfull,hcover⟩ := one_ranking_half r
  have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  refine ⟨ranking,hfull,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  refine ⟨(hcover k hk).1,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ((hcover k hk).2 T hT) hr'.le
  calc
    _ ≤ (selectedRadius staircaseF T + 1/2) / (r:ℝ) := hh
    _ = selectedRadius staircaseF T / (r:ℝ) + 1/(2*(r:ℝ)) := by ring

#print axioms negative_first_ranking_exists
#print axioms radius_le_half_after_negatives
#print axioms one_ranking_half
#print axioms one_ranking_normalized
end
end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseApproximation

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCoverV1.lean (708 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseUnboundedV1»
import «LeanStructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamilyV1»
import «LeanStructuralOrdinaryChainCharacterizationV1»
import «LeanStructuralGeometryWitnessesV4»

/-!
# Exact prefix-menu law for the staircase supportOsc family

This is the constructive upper branch complementary to the compiled
incomparable-zero-optima lower bound. It uses no DP result: the low-budget
chain is certified by one anchor contrast, while the middle-budget optima are
the already-characterized zero-radius staircase sets.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCover

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseUnbounded
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralOrdinaryChainCharacterization
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralMinimumTransversalWidth
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralGeometryWitnesses

/-! ## Elementary negative-coordinate counting -/

def negativeUniverse {r : ℕ} : Finset (StairRel r) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun j => j.2 = true

theorem negativeUniverse_eq_image {r : ℕ} :
    negativeUniverse (r := r) = Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin r => (i, true)) := by
  classical
  ext j
  rcases j with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b <;> simp [negativeUniverse]

theorem negativeUniverse_card {r : ℕ} :
    (negativeUniverse (r := r)).card = r := by
  classical
  rw [negativeUniverse_eq_image, Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
  · simp
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hij

theorem negativePart_subset {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    negativePart S ⊆ S := by
  intro j hj
  have h : j ∈ S ∧ j.2 = true := by
    simpa [negativePart] using hj
  exact h.1

theorem negativeUniverse_partition {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    negativeUniverse (r := r) = negativePart S ∪ negativePart Sᶜ := by
  classical
  ext j
  by_cases hS : j ∈ S <;> simp [negativeUniverse, negativePart, hS]

theorem negativeParts_disjoint {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    Disjoint (negativePart S) (negativePart Sᶜ) := by
  classical
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro j hjS hjCompl
  have hS : j ∈ S := (negativePart_subset S) hjS
  have hCompl : j ∈ Sᶜ := (negativePart_subset Sᶜ) hjCompl
  have hNotS : j ∉ S := by simpa using hCompl
  exact hNotS hS

/-- If a retained set has cardinality at most `k`, at least `r-k` negative
relations remain omitted. -/
theorem omitted_negative_card_lower {r k : ℕ}
    (S : Finset (StairRel r)) (hCard : S.card ≤ k) :
    r - k ≤ (negativePart Sᶜ).card := by
  classical
  have hPartition := negativeUniverse_partition S
  have hDisjoint := negativeParts_disjoint S
  have hNegS : (negativePart S).card ≤ S.card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (negativePart_subset S)
  have hSum : r = (negativePart S).card + (negativePart Sᶜ).card := by
    calc
      r = (negativeUniverse (r := r)).card := (negativeUniverse_card (r := r)).symm
      _ = (negativePart S ∪ negativePart Sᶜ).card := by rw [← hPartition]
      _ = (negativePart S).card + (negativePart Sᶜ).card :=
        Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDisjoint
  omega

/-! ## Low-budget optimality from the `some 0` contrast -/

/-- Every retained `k`-set in the low regime leaves enough negative staircase
relations omitted to force the displayed radius lower bound. -/
theorem low_budget_radius_lower {r k : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hk : k ≤ r - 1) (S : Finset (StairRel r)) (hCard : S.card = k) :
    ((r - k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 ≤ selectedRadius staircaseF S := by
  classical
  let i0 : Fin r := ⟨0, hr⟩
  let g : StairAction r → ℝ := sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF
  have hOmitted : r - k ≤ (negativePart Sᶜ).card := by
    apply omitted_negative_card_lower S
    omega
  have hOmittedR : ((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (negativePart Sᶜ).card := by
    exact_mod_cast hOmitted
  have hStep : r - k = (r - k - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hStepR : ((r - k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hStep.symm
  have hRecombine : r - k + k = r := by omega
  have hRecombineR : ((r - k : ℕ) : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) = r := by
    exact_mod_cast hRecombine
  have hAtZero : g (some i0) ≤ -((r - k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hFormula : g (some i0) =
        (if (i0, false) ∈ Sᶜ then 1 else 0) - (negativePart Sᶜ).card := by
      rw [show g (some i0) = sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF (some i0) by rfl,
        staircase_sum_formula, negativeAt_zero_eq_negativePart hr]
    rw [hFormula]
    by_cases hp : (i0, false) ∈ Sᶜ
    · rw [if_pos hp]
      norm_num
      linarith
    · rw [if_neg hp]
      norm_num
      linarith
  have hAnchor : g none = 0 := by
    simp [g, sumComponent, staircaseF]
  have hMax : 0 ≤ maxVal g := by
    rw [← hAnchor]
    exact le_maxVal g none
  have hMin : minVal g ≤ g (some i0) := minVal_le g (some i0)
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc osc
  change ((r - k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (maxVal g - minVal g) / 2
  linarith

/-! ## The main low-budget chain -/

/-- The first `k` indices of `Fin r`, with `k < r` carried by the type. -/
def lowIndices {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) : Finset (Fin r) :=
  ((Finset.range k.val).attach).image
    (fun j : {x // x ∈ Finset.range k.val} =>
      (⟨j.val, lt_trans (Finset.mem_range.mp j.property) k.isLt⟩ : Fin r))

/-- `L_k`: retain precisely the negative relations indexed strictly below `k`.
For `k = 0` this is empty. -/
def lowSelected {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) : Finset (StairRel r) :=
  (lowIndices k).image (fun i => (i, true))

theorem lowIndices_card {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    (lowIndices k).card = k.val := by
  classical
  unfold lowIndices
  rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
  · simp
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val hab

theorem lowSelected_card {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    (lowSelected k).card = k.val := by
  classical
  unfold lowSelected
  rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
  · exact lowIndices_card k
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hij

theorem mem_lowIndices_iff {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) (i : Fin r) :
    i ∈ lowIndices k ↔ i.val < k.val := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hi
    unfold lowIndices at hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨a, ha, hai⟩
    have hlt : a.val < k.val := Finset.mem_range.mp a.property
    have hval : i.val = a.val := by
      exact (congrArg Fin.val hai).symm
    omega
  · intro hi
    unfold lowIndices
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    let a : {x // x ∈ Finset.range k.val} := ⟨i.val, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi⟩
    refine ⟨a, by simp [a], ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl

theorem mem_lowSelected_iff {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) (j : StairRel r) :
    j ∈ lowSelected k ↔ j.2 = true ∧ j.1.val < k.val := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hj
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hj with ⟨i, hi, hij⟩
    have hi' := (mem_lowIndices_iff k i).1 hi
    rcases j with ⟨j, b⟩
    have hfirst : j = i := (congrArg Prod.fst hij).symm
    have hsecond : b = true := (congrArg Prod.snd hij).symm
    subst b
    subst j
    exact ⟨rfl, hi'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hSecond, hlt⟩
    have hi : j.1 ∈ lowIndices k := (mem_lowIndices_iff k j.1).2 hlt
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨j.1, hi, ?_⟩
    cases j with
    | mk i b => simpa using hSecond

theorem lowSelected_all_negative {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    ∀ j ∈ lowSelected k, j.2 = true := by
  intro j hj
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hj with ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
  rfl

theorem negativePart_lowSelected {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    negativePart (lowSelected k) = lowSelected k := by
  classical
  ext j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    exact (negativePart_subset (lowSelected k)) hj
  · intro hj
    simp [negativePart, hj, lowSelected_all_negative k j hj]

theorem lowSelected_chain {r : ℕ} {k l : Fin r} (hkl : k ≤ l) :
    lowSelected k ⊆ lowSelected l := by
  intro j hj
  rcases (mem_lowSelected_iff k j).1 hj with ⟨hSecond, hlt⟩
  apply (mem_lowSelected_iff l j).2
  exact ⟨hSecond, lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hkl⟩

theorem omitted_negative_lowSelected_card {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    (negativePart (lowSelected k)ᶜ).card = r - k.val := by
  classical
  have hPartition := negativeUniverse_partition (lowSelected k)
  have hDisjoint := negativeParts_disjoint (lowSelected k)
  have hSum : r = (negativePart (lowSelected k)).card +
      (negativePart (lowSelected k)ᶜ).card := by
    calc
      r = (negativeUniverse (r := r)).card := (negativeUniverse_card (r := r)).symm
      _ = (negativePart (lowSelected k) ∪ negativePart (lowSelected k)ᶜ).card := by
        rw [← hPartition]
      _ = (negativePart (lowSelected k)).card +
          (negativePart (lowSelected k)ᶜ).card :=
        Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hDisjoint
  rw [negativePart_lowSelected, lowSelected_card] at hSum
  omega

theorem positive_not_mem_lowSelected {r : ℕ} (k i : Fin r) :
    (i, false) ∉ lowSelected k := by
  intro h
  have := (mem_lowSelected_iff k (i, false)).1 h
  simp at this

private theorem negativeAt_subset_negativePart_local {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (i : Fin r) :
    negativeAt T i ⊆ negativePart T := by
  intro j hj
  simp [negativeAt, negativePart] at hj ⊢
  exact ⟨hj.1, hj.2.1⟩

private def maxIndex {r : ℕ} (i k : Fin r) : Fin r :=
  ⟨max i.val k.val, max_lt i.isLt k.isLt⟩

private theorem negativeAt_lowSelected_nonempty {r : ℕ} (k i : Fin r) :
    (negativeAt (lowSelected k)ᶜ i).Nonempty := by
  classical
  let t : Fin r := maxIndex i k
  have hNotLow : (t, true) ∉ lowSelected k := by
    intro h
    rcases (mem_lowSelected_iff k (t, true)).1 h with ⟨-, hlt⟩
    dsimp [t, maxIndex] at hlt
    omega
  have hComp : (t, true) ∈ (lowSelected k)ᶜ := by simpa using hNotLow
  have hle : i ≤ t := by
    change i.val ≤ t.val
    dsimp [t, maxIndex]
    exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
  refine ⟨(t, true), ?_⟩
  simp [negativeAt, hComp, hle]

private theorem lowSelected_sum_some {r : ℕ} (k i : Fin r) :
    sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF (some i) =
      1 - (negativeAt (lowSelected k)ᶜ i).card := by
  classical
  rw [staircase_sum_formula]
  have hPos : (i, false) ∈ (lowSelected k)ᶜ := by
    simpa using positive_not_mem_lowSelected k i
  rw [if_pos hPos]

theorem lowSelected_sum_lower {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) (a : StairAction r) :
    -((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF a := by
  classical
  cases a with
  | none =>
      rw [show sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF none = 0 by
        simp [sumComponent, staircaseF]]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity)
  | some i =>
      rw [lowSelected_sum_some]
      have hSubset : negativeAt (lowSelected k)ᶜ i ⊆
          negativePart (lowSelected k)ᶜ :=
        negativeAt_subset_negativePart_local _ _
      have hCard := Finset.card_le_card hSubset
      rw [omitted_negative_lowSelected_card] at hCard
      have hCardR : ((negativeAt (lowSelected k)ᶜ i).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((r - k.val : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hCard
      have hStep : r - k.val = (r - k.val - 1) + 1 := by
        have := k.isLt
        omega
      have hStepR : ((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((r - k.val : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hStep.symm
      linarith

theorem lowSelected_sum_upper {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) (a : StairAction r) :
    sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF a ≤ 0 := by
  classical
  cases a with
  | none => simp [sumComponent, staircaseF]
  | some i =>
      rw [lowSelected_sum_some]
      have hNonempty := negativeAt_lowSelected_nonempty k i
      have hCardR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (negativeAt (lowSelected k)ᶜ i).card := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr hNonempty)
      linarith

theorem lowSelected_sum_zero_anchor {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF none = 0 := by
  simp [sumComponent, staircaseF]

theorem lowSelected_sum_at_zero {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF
      (some ⟨0, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) k.isLt⟩) =
      -((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) k.isLt
  rw [lowSelected_sum_some, negativeAt_zero_eq_negativePart hr,
    omitted_negative_lowSelected_card]
  have hStep : r - k.val = (r - k.val - 1) + 1 := by
    have := k.isLt
    omega
  have hStepR : ((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((r - k.val : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hStep.symm
  linarith

theorem lowSelected_radius_exact {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    selectedRadius staircaseF (lowSelected k) =
      ((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by
  classical
  let g : StairAction r → ℝ := sumComponent (lowSelected k)ᶜ staircaseF
  have hLower : ∀ a, -((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ g a := by
    intro a
    exact lowSelected_sum_lower k a
  have hUpper : ∀ a, g a ≤ 0 := by
    intro a
    exact lowSelected_sum_upper k a
  have hAnchor : g none = 0 := lowSelected_sum_zero_anchor k
  have hAtZero : g (some ⟨0, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) k.isLt⟩) =
      -((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    lowSelected_sum_at_zero k
  have hMax : maxVal g = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact maxVal_le _ hUpper
    · rw [← hAnchor]
      exact le_maxVal g none
  have hMin : minVal g = -((r - k.val - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← hAtZero]
      exact minVal_le g _
    · exact le_minVal _ hLower
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc osc
  change (maxVal g - minVal g) / 2 = _
  rw [hMax, hMin]
  ring

theorem lowSelected_exact_optimal {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius staircaseF) 0 k.val (lowSelected k) := by
  refine ⟨lowSelected_card k, ?_⟩
  intro S hCard
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) k.isLt
  have hk : k.val ≤ r - 1 := by omega
  have hLower := low_budget_radius_lower hr hk S hCard
  rw [lowSelected_radius_exact]
  linarith

/-! ## The `2r-1` boundary layer -/

theorem staircase_component_osc_one {r : ℕ} (j : StairRel r) :
    osc (staircaseF j) = 1 := by
  rcases j with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b
  · have hMax : maxVal (staircaseF (i, false)) = 1 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply maxVal_le
        intro a
        cases a with
        | none => simp [staircaseF]
        | some x => by_cases h : i = x <;> simp [staircaseF, h]
      · rw [show (1 : ℝ) = staircaseF (i, false) (some i) by simp [staircaseF]]
        exact le_maxVal _ _
    have hMin : minVal (staircaseF (i, false)) = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · calc
          minVal (staircaseF (i, false)) ≤ staircaseF (i, false) none :=
            minVal_le _ _
          _ = 0 := by simp [staircaseF]
      · apply le_minVal
        intro a
        cases a with
        | none => simp [staircaseF]
        | some x => by_cases h : i = x <;> simp [staircaseF, h]
    simp [osc, hMax, hMin]
  · have hMax : maxVal (staircaseF (i, true)) = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply maxVal_le
        intro a
        cases a with
        | none => simp [staircaseF]
        | some x => by_cases h : x ≤ i <;> simp [staircaseF, h]
      · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = staircaseF (i, true) none by simp [staircaseF]]
        exact le_maxVal _ _
    have hMin : minVal (staircaseF (i, true)) = -1 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · calc
          minVal (staircaseF (i, true)) ≤ staircaseF (i, true) (some i) :=
            minVal_le _ _
          _ = -1 := by simp [staircaseF]
      · apply le_minVal
        intro a
        cases a with
        | none => simp [staircaseF]
        | some x => by_cases h : x ≤ i <;> simp [staircaseF, h]
    simp [osc, hMax, hMin]

theorem selectedRadius_compl_singleton {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r))
    (j : StairRel r) (hCompl : Sᶜ = {j}) :
    selectedRadius staircaseF S = 1 / 2 := by
  have hSum : sumComponent ({j} : Finset (StairRel r)) staircaseF = staircaseF j := by
    funext a
    simp [sumComponent]
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc
  rw [hCompl]
  simp [hSum, staircase_component_osc_one]

theorem card_two_mul_stairRel (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (StairRel r) = 2 * r := by
  simp [StairRel, Nat.mul_comm]

/-- The hypothesis `0 < r` is not decoration: at `r = 0` the statement is FALSE.
`StairRel 0` is empty, `2 * 0 - 1 = 0` by truncated subtraction, so `S.card = 0`
holds for `S = univ = empty` and the complement has card `0`, not `1`. -/
theorem card_eq_two_mul_sub_one_radius {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (S : Finset (StairRel r)) (hCard : S.card = 2 * r - 1) :
    selectedRadius staircaseF S = 1 / 2 := by
  classical
  have hComplCard : Sᶜ.card = 1 := by
    have hTotal : Fintype.card (StairRel r) = 2 * r := card_two_mul_stairRel r
    have hEq : Sᶜ.card = Fintype.card (StairRel r) - S.card := by
      simpa using (Finset.card_compl S)
    rw [hEq, hTotal, hCard]
    omega
  rcases Finset.card_eq_one.mp hComplCard with ⟨j, hCompl⟩
  exact selectedRadius_compl_singleton S j hCompl

theorem high_boundary_exact_optimal {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (S : Finset (StairRel r)) (hCard : S.card = 2 * r - 1) :
    EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius staircaseF) 0 (2 * r - 1) S := by
  refine ⟨hCard, ?_⟩
  intro T hT
  rw [card_eq_two_mul_sub_one_radius hr S hCard,
    card_eq_two_mul_sub_one_radius hr T hT]
  norm_num


/-! ## Cardinality and optimality of the zero-radius layer optima

The block `B_t` has `t+2` elements, so the retained set `staircaseSelected t`
sits at budget `2r - (t+2)`.  As `t` runs over `Fin r` those budgets are
`2r-2, 2r-3, ..., r-1`: exactly `r` layers, each with a forced unique optimum.
-/

theorem staircaseSelected_card {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    (staircaseSelected t).card = 2 * r - (t.val + 2) := by
  classical
  have h : (staircaseSelected t).card
      = Fintype.card (StairRel r) - (staircaseBlock t).card := by
    simpa [staircaseSelected] using (Finset.card_compl (staircaseBlock t))
  rw [h, card_two_mul_stairRel, staircaseBlock_card]

/-- Radius zero is the global floor, so a zero-radius set is optimal at its own
budget without any comparison argument. -/
theorem staircaseSelected_exact_optimal {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0
      (staircaseSelected t).card (staircaseSelected t) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro T _
  rw [staircaseSelected_radius_zero]
  have hT := selectedRadius_nonneg (staircaseF (r := r)) T
  linarith

/-! ## The low-budget family is one inclusion chain -/

def lowChain (r : ℕ) : Finset (Finset (StairRel r)) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun k : Fin r => lowSelected k)

theorem lowChain_inclusionChain {r : ℕ} : InclusionChain (lowChain r) := by
  classical
  intro A hA B hB
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hA with ⟨k, -, rfl⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hB with ⟨l, -, rfl⟩
  rcases le_total k l with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (lowSelected_chain h)
  · exact Or.inr (lowSelected_chain h)

/-! ## The two explicit ranking families

`lowRanking` realizes the whole low chain at once -- that is the entire point
of using a chain rather than `r` separate rankings for the low budgets.  Each
`blockRanking t` realizes one zero-radius optimum.
-/

private theorem lowRanking_exists {r : ℕ} :
    ∃ ranking : List (StairRel r), IsFullRanking ranking ∧
      ∀ k : Fin r, prefixSet ranking k.val = lowSelected k := by
  classical
  rcases finite_inclusion_chain_extends_to_full_ranking (lowChain r)
      lowChain_inclusionChain with ⟨ranking, hFull, hPrefix⟩
  refine ⟨ranking, hFull, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hmem : lowSelected k ∈ lowChain r :=
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ k, rfl⟩
  have h := hPrefix (lowSelected k) hmem
  rwa [lowSelected_card k] at h

private theorem blockRanking_exists {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    ∃ ranking : List (StairRel r), IsFullRanking ranking ∧
      prefixSet ranking (staircaseSelected t).card = staircaseSelected t := by
  classical
  have hChain : InclusionChain
      ({staircaseSelected t} : Finset (Finset (StairRel r))) := by
    intro A hA B hB
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hA hB
    subst A
    subst B
    exact Or.inl Finset.Subset.rfl
  rcases finite_inclusion_chain_extends_to_full_ranking _ hChain with
    ⟨ranking, hFull, hPrefix⟩
  exact ⟨ranking, hFull, hPrefix _ (by simp)⟩

noncomputable def lowRanking (r : ℕ) : List (StairRel r) :=
  Classical.choose (lowRanking_exists (r := r))

noncomputable def blockRanking {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) : List (StairRel r) :=
  Classical.choose (blockRanking_exists t)

private theorem lowRanking_full {r : ℕ} : IsFullRanking (lowRanking r) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (lowRanking_exists (r := r))).1

private theorem lowRanking_prefix {r : ℕ} (k : Fin r) :
    prefixSet (lowRanking r) k.val = lowSelected k :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (lowRanking_exists (r := r))).2 k

private theorem blockRanking_full {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    IsFullRanking (blockRanking t) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (blockRanking_exists t)).1

private theorem blockRanking_prefix {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    prefixSet (blockRanking t) (staircaseSelected t).card = staircaseSelected t :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (blockRanking_exists t)).2

/-- The menu is indexed by `Fin r`.  The last index carries the low chain; the
other `r-1` indices carry one zero-radius optimum each.  That is why the menu
has `r` entries and not `r+1`: the low chain already covers layer `r-1`, which
is the layer `blockRanking ⟨r-1⟩` would otherwise have supplied. -/
noncomputable def stairMenuFun {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) : List (StairRel r) :=
  if t.val + 1 = r then lowRanking r else blockRanking t

noncomputable def stairMenu (r : ℕ) : Finset (List (StairRel r)) :=
  Finset.univ.image (stairMenuFun (r := r))

theorem stairMenu_card_le {r : ℕ} : (stairMenu r).card ≤ r := by
  classical
  calc
    (stairMenu r).card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)).card :=
      Finset.card_image_le
    _ = r := by simp

private theorem stairMenuFun_mem {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    stairMenuFun t ∈ stairMenu r :=
  Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_univ t, rfl⟩

/-! ## The covering theorem -/

theorem stairMenu_prefixCover {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    PrefixCover (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0 (stairMenu r) := by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, hr⟩⟩
  have hLowFull : IsFullRanking (lowRanking r) := lowRanking_full
  -- the index whose menu entry is the low chain
  let top : Fin r := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  have hTopIsLow : stairMenuFun top = lowRanking r := by
    unfold stairMenuFun
    have : top.val + 1 = r := by
      show (r - 1) + 1 = r
      omega
    rw [if_pos this]
  refine ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mpr Finset.univ_nonempty, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ranking hRanking
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hRanking with ⟨t, -, rfl⟩
    unfold stairMenuFun
    by_cases h : t.val + 1 = r
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact hLowFull
    · rw [if_neg h]
      exact blockRanking_full t
  · intro k hk
    rw [card_two_mul_stairRel] at hk
    by_cases hLow : k < r
    · -- low chain layer
      refine ⟨stairMenuFun top, stairMenuFun_mem top, ?_⟩
      rw [hTopIsLow]
      let kk : Fin r := ⟨k, hLow⟩
      have hPrefix : prefixSet (lowRanking r) k = lowSelected kk := by
        simpa [kk] using lowRanking_prefix kk
      have hOpt := lowSelected_exact_optimal kk
      rw [hPrefix]
      simpa [kk] using hOpt
    · by_cases hMid : k ≤ 2 * r - 2
      · -- zero-radius layer, supplied by exactly one block ranking
        have hrTwo : 2 ≤ r := by omega
        let t : Fin r := ⟨2 * r - 2 - k, by omega⟩
        have hNotLow : ¬ (t.val + 1 = r) := by
          show ¬ ((2 * r - 2 - k) + 1 = r)
          omega
        have hEntry : stairMenuFun t = blockRanking t := by
          unfold stairMenuFun
          rw [if_neg hNotLow]
        have hCard : (staircaseSelected t).card = k := by
          rw [staircaseSelected_card]
          show 2 * r - ((2 * r - 2 - k) + 2) = k
          omega
        refine ⟨stairMenuFun t, stairMenuFun_mem t, ?_⟩
        rw [hEntry, ← hCard, blockRanking_prefix]
        exact staircaseSelected_exact_optimal t
      · by_cases hHigh : k = 2 * r - 1
        · -- every (2r-1)-set is optimal, so any ranking in the menu will do
          refine ⟨stairMenuFun top, stairMenuFun_mem top, ?_⟩
          rw [hTopIsLow]
          have hCard : (prefixSet (lowRanking r) k).card = k :=
            CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural.prefixSet_card_of_full
              (lowRanking r) hLowFull k (by rw [card_two_mul_stairRel]; omega)
          subst k
          exact high_boundary_exact_optimal hr _ hCard
        · -- the only remaining budget is the full ground set
          have hFullBudget : k = 2 * r := by omega
          refine ⟨stairMenuFun top, stairMenuFun_mem top, ?_⟩
          rw [hTopIsLow]
          have hCard : (prefixSet (lowRanking r) k).card = k :=
            CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural.prefixSet_card_of_full
              (lowRanking r) hLowFull k (by rw [card_two_mul_stairRel]; omega)
          have hUniv : prefixSet (lowRanking r) k = Finset.univ := by
            apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
            rw [hCard, hFullBudget, card_two_mul_stairRel]
          refine ⟨hCard, ?_⟩
          intro T hT
          have hTUniv : T = Finset.univ := by
            apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
            rw [hT, hFullBudget, card_two_mul_stairRel]
          rw [hUniv, hTUniv]
          linarith

/-! ## The exact law -/

theorem STRUCT_staircase_prefix_cover_at_most_r {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0 r :=
  ⟨stairMenu r, stairMenu_card_le, stairMenu_prefixCover hr⟩

/-- `chi_prefix(F_r, 0) = r` exactly.  The upper bound is the explicit `r`-entry
menu above; the lower bound is the compiled incomparable-optima argument. -/
theorem STRUCT_staircase_prefix_dimension_eq {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    prefixDimensionValue (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0 = r := by
  classical
  let objective : Finset (StairRel r) → ℝ := selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))
  have hUpperPredicate : PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost objective 0 r :=
    STRUCT_staircase_prefix_cover_at_most_r hr
  have hFeasible :
      {K : ℕ | PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost objective 0 K}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨r, hUpperPredicate⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.sInf_le hUpperPredicate
  · by_contra hLower
    have hLt : prefixDimensionValue objective 0 < r := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hLower
    have hSmall : prefixDimensionValue objective 0 ≤ r - 1 :=
      Nat.le_pred_of_lt hLt
    have hMinFeasible :
        PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost objective 0
          (prefixDimensionValue objective 0) := Nat.sInf_mem hFeasible
    rcases hMinFeasible with ⟨menu, hMenuCard, hCover⟩
    exact STRUCT_UNBOUNDED_staircase_prefix_dimension_ge hr
      ⟨menu, hMenuCard.trans hSmall, hCover⟩

/-- The extremal law in ground-set terms: on this family the prefix-menu
complexity is exactly half the number of relations. -/
theorem STRUCT_staircase_chi_eq_half_ground_set {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    2 * prefixDimensionValue (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0
      = Fintype.card (StairRel r) := by
  rw [STRUCT_staircase_prefix_dimension_eq hr, card_two_mul_stairRel]


end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCover

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseFamilyV1.lean (132 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanStructuralPrefixCoverDimensionV1»
import «LeanStructuralGeometryWitnessesV4»

/-!
# Staircase supportOsc family (parametric branch)

This file starts the actual all-dimension construction suggested by the exact
`chi >= 5` search.  Relations come in positive/negative pairs.  A negative
relation `t` is cancelled, at every support coordinate, by precisely the
positive prefix `0,...,t`.  The resulting zero-radius omitted blocks have
different cardinalities and are pairwise incomparable.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralGeometryWitnesses
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension

abbrev StairRel (r : ℕ) := Fin r × Bool
abbrev StairAction (r : ℕ) := Option (Fin r)

/-- Positive relation `i` is the `i`-th basis vector.  Negative relation `t`
is minus the indicator of the coordinate prefix through `t`.  `none` is a
zero anchor support point. -/
def staircaseF {r : ℕ} (j : StairRel r) (a : StairAction r) : ℝ :=
  match a with
  | none => 0
  | some i =>
      if j.2 then
        if i ≤ j.1 then -1 else 0
      else
        if j.1 = i then 1 else 0

/-- The omitted block whose negative staircase vector is exactly cancelled by
its positive prefix. -/
def staircaseBlock {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) : Finset (StairRel r) :=
  insert (t, true) ((Finset.Iic t).image (fun i => (i, false)))

def staircaseSelected {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) : Finset (StairRel r) :=
  (staircaseBlock t)ᶜ

private theorem negative_not_in_positive_prefix {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    (t, true) ∉ (Finset.Iic t).image (fun i => (i, false)) := by
  simp

theorem staircaseBlock_card {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    (staircaseBlock t).card = t.val + 2 := by
  classical
  rw [staircaseBlock, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (negative_not_in_positive_prefix t),
    Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
  · simp
  · intro i hi j hj h
    simpa using congrArg Prod.fst h

private theorem positive_prefix_sum {r : ℕ} (t i : Fin r) :
    ((Finset.Iic t).image (fun a => (a, false))).sum
        (fun j => staircaseF j (some i)) = if i ≤ t then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hit : i ≤ t
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (i, false)]
    · simp [staircaseF, hit]
    · intro b hb hne
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hb with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      have hai : a ≠ i := by
        intro h
        subst a
        exact hne rfl
      simp [staircaseF, hai]
    · simp [hit]
  · have hzero : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.Iic t).image (fun a => (a, false)),
        staircaseF j (some i) = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hj with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      have hat : a ≤ t := by simpa using ha
      have hai : a ≠ i := by
        intro h
        subst a
        exact hit hat
      simp [staircaseF, hai]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero]
    simp [hit]

/-- Every designated omitted block has identically zero aggregate response. -/
theorem staircaseBlock_sum_zero {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r)
    (a : StairAction r) :
    sumComponent (staircaseBlock t) staircaseF a = 0 := by
  classical
  cases a with
  | none => simp [sumComponent, staircaseBlock, staircaseF]
  | some i =>
      rw [sumComponent, staircaseBlock,
        Finset.sum_insert (negative_not_in_positive_prefix t),
        positive_prefix_sum]
      by_cases hit : i ≤ t <;> simp [staircaseF, hit]

/-- Hence each designated retained set has exact support-compression radius
zero. -/
theorem staircaseSelected_radius_zero {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r) :
    selectedRadius staircaseF (staircaseSelected t) = 0 := by
  classical
  have hcompl : (staircaseSelected t)ᶜ = staircaseBlock t := by
    simp [staircaseSelected]
  calc
    selectedRadius staircaseF (staircaseSelected t) = (0 - 0 : ℝ) / 2 :=
      selectedRadius_from_extrema staircaseF (staircaseSelected t) 0 0
        (by intro a; rw [hcompl, staircaseBlock_sum_zero])
        (by intro a; rw [hcompl, staircaseBlock_sum_zero])
        none none
        (by rw [hcompl, staircaseBlock_sum_zero])
        (by rw [hcompl, staircaseBlock_sum_zero])
    _ = 0 := by norm_num

theorem staircaseBlocks_incomparable {r : ℕ} {s t : Fin r} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    ¬ staircaseBlock s ⊆ staircaseBlock t := by
  intro hsub
  have hneg : (s, true) ∈ staircaseBlock t :=
    hsub (by simp [staircaseBlock])
  simp [staircaseBlock] at hneg
  exact hst hneg

theorem staircaseSelected_incomparable {r : ℕ} {s t : Fin r} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    ¬ staircaseSelected s ⊆ staircaseSelected t := by
  intro hsub
  have hcomp : staircaseBlock t ⊆ staircaseBlock s := by
    simpa [staircaseSelected] using Finset.compl_subset_compl.mpr hsub
  exact staircaseBlocks_incomparable (Ne.symm hst) hcomp

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseToleranceCurveV1.lean (79 dong)
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseToleranceLowerV1»
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseApproximationV1»

/-! The complete normalized tolerance curve of every staircase instance.
Both branches follow from actual support-radius constructions. This closes
the finite-family curve observed numerically without extrapolating from small r. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseToleranceCurve
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralMinimumTransversalWidth
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCover
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseToleranceLower
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseApproximation
noncomputable section

lemma normalized_cover_r {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost
      (fun S => selectedRadius (@staircaseF r) S/(r:ℝ)) eps r := by
  obtain ⟨menu,hcard,hne,hfull,hcover⟩ := STRUCT_staircase_prefix_cover_at_most_r hr
  refine ⟨menu,hcard,hne,hfull,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨ranking,hm,ho⟩ := hcover k hk
  refine ⟨ranking,hm,ho.1,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (ho.2 T hT) (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ r)
  simp only [add_zero] at hh
  linarith

/-- Every positive-r staircase has exactly r required rankings below the
threshold, including arbitrarily close to it. -/
theorem dimension_below {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hlt : eps < 1/(2*(r:ℝ))) :
    prefixDimensionValue (fun S => selectedRadius (@staircaseF r) S/(r:ℝ)) eps=r := by
  let R : Finset (StairRel r) → ℝ := fun S => selectedRadius staircaseF S/(r:ℝ)
  have hu : PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps r := normalized_cover_r hr eps heps
  have hf : {K : ℕ | PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps K}.Nonempty := ⟨r,hu⟩
  have ht : 2*(r:ℝ)*eps < 1 := by
    have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2*r)).mp hlt
    nlinarith
  apply le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hu)
  by_contra h
  have hs : prefixDimensionValue R eps ≤ r-1 := by
    change ¬ r ≤ prefixDimensionValue R eps at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨menu,hcard,hcover⟩ := (Nat.sInf_mem hf : PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps (prefixDimensionValue R eps))
  exact normalized_tolerance_lower hr eps ht ⟨menu,hcard.trans hs,hcover⟩

/-- At the threshold itself the negative-first ranking already suffices. -/
theorem dimension_above {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ)
    (hle : 1/(2*(r:ℝ)) ≤ eps) :
    prefixDimensionValue (fun S => selectedRadius (@staircaseF r) S/(r:ℝ)) eps=1 := by
  let R : Finset (StairRel r) → ℝ := fun S => selectedRadius staircaseF S/(r:ℝ)
  obtain ⟨ranking,hcover⟩ :=
    (singleton_prefix_cover_iff_one_prefix_chain R (1/(2*(r:ℝ)))).mpr (one_ranking_normalized r hr)
  have hu : PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps 1 :=
    STRUCT_B3_tolerance_monotonicity R _ eps hle 1 ⟨{ranking},by simp,hcover⟩
  have hf : {K : ℕ | PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps K}.Nonempty := ⟨1,hu⟩
  apply le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hu)
  obtain ⟨menu,hcard,hcover⟩ := (Nat.sInf_mem hf : PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost R eps (prefixDimensionValue R eps))
  exact (card_pos.mpr hcover.1).trans_le hcard

/-- Complete curve, for all r>0 and all nonnegative normalized tolerances.
For r=1 both values coincide, so there is no strict jump in that edge case. -/
theorem exact_curve {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    prefixDimensionValue (fun S => selectedRadius (@staircaseF r) S/(r:ℝ)) eps =
      if eps < 1/(2*(r:ℝ)) then r else 1 := by
  split
  · exact dimension_below hr eps heps ‹_›
  · exact dimension_above hr eps (le_of_not_gt ‹_›)

#print axioms normalized_cover_r
#print axioms dimension_below
#print axioms dimension_above
#print axioms exact_curve
end
end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseToleranceCurve

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseToleranceLowerV1.lean (91 dong)
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCoverV1»

/-! Matching-order tolerance obstruction: normalized staircase still needs r
rankings when epsilon<1/(2r). This is a family bound, not a fixed small witness. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseToleranceLower
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseExactPrefixCover
noncomputable section

lemma osc_integer {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, g x=z) : ∃ z : ℤ, osc g=z := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := exists_eq_maxVal g
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_eq_minVal g
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hg a
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hg b
  refine ⟨u-v,?_⟩
  simp only [osc,← ha,← hb,hu,hv,Int.cast_sub]

lemma component_integer {r : ℕ} (j : StairRel r) (a : StairAction r) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, staircaseF j a=z := by
  rcases j with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases a with
  | none => exact ⟨0,by simp [staircaseF]⟩
  | some a =>
    cases b
    · by_cases h : i=a
      · exact ⟨1,by simp [staircaseF,h]⟩
      · exact ⟨0,by simp [staircaseF,h]⟩
    · by_cases h : a ≤ i
      · exact ⟨-1,by simp [staircaseF,h]⟩
      · exact ⟨0,by simp [staircaseF,h]⟩

lemma twice_radius_integer {r : ℕ} (S : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, 2*selectedRadius staircaseF S=z := by
  have hg : ∀ a, ∃ z : ℤ, sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF a=z := by
    intro a
    choose z hz using (fun j : StairRel r => component_integer j a)
    refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Sᶜ,z j,?_⟩
    simp [sumComponent,hz]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := osc_integer _ hg
  refine ⟨z,?_⟩
  unfold selectedRadius supportOsc
  linarith

lemma normalized_epsilon_exact {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ)
    (heps : 2*(r:ℝ)*eps < 1) (k : ℕ) (S : Finset (StairRel r))
    (ho : EpsilonOptimalAt (fun T => selectedRadius staircaseF T/(r:ℝ)) eps k S) :
    EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius staircaseF) 0 k S := by
  refine ⟨ho.1,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  have h := ho.2 T hT
  have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have h' := (div_le_iff₀ hr').mp h
  have he : (selectedRadius staircaseF T/(r:ℝ)+eps)*(r:ℝ)=
      selectedRadius staircaseF T+eps*r := by field_simp
  rw [he] at h'
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := twice_radius_integer S
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := twice_radius_integer T
  have hzlt : (z:ℝ) < (w:ℝ)+1 := by nlinarith
  have hzint : z < w+1 := by exact_mod_cast hzlt
  have hzle : (z:ℝ) ≤ w := by exact_mod_cast (show z ≤ w by omega)
  linarith

/-- Since each component has oscillation one and there are 2r components,
dividing radius by r is exactly normalization by total component radius. -/
theorem normalized_tolerance_lower {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (eps : ℝ)
    (heps : 2*(r:ℝ)*eps < 1) :
    ¬ PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost
      (fun S => selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r)) S/(r:ℝ)) eps (r-1) := by
  rintro ⟨menu,hcard,hcover⟩
  apply STRUCT_UNBOUNDED_staircase_prefix_dimension_ge hr
  refine ⟨menu,hcard,hcover.1,hcover.2.1,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨rnk,hm,ho⟩ := hcover.2.2 k hk
  exact ⟨rnk,hm,normalized_epsilon_exact hr eps heps k _ ho⟩

theorem normalization (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ j : StairRel r,osc (staircaseF j)/2)=(r:ℝ) := by
  simp_rw [staircase_component_osc_one]
  simp [StairRel]

#print axioms twice_radius_integer
#print axioms normalized_tolerance_lower
#print axioms normalization
end
end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseToleranceLower

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralStaircaseUnboundedV1.lean (183 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseFamilyV1»

/-!
# Zero-radius characterization for the staircase supportOsc family

This module proves the non-numerical core needed for an unbounded
prefix-cover lower bound: the only nonempty omitted sets with radius zero are
the designated positive-prefix/negative-staircase blocks.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseUnbounded

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily

def negativeAt {r : ℕ} (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (i : Fin r) :
    Finset (StairRel r) :=
  T.filter (fun j => j.2 = true ∧ i ≤ j.1)

def negativePart {r : ℕ} (T : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    Finset (StairRel r) :=
  T.filter (fun j => j.2 = true)

theorem staircase_sum_formula {r : ℕ} (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (i : Fin r) :
    sumComponent T staircaseF (some i) =
      (if (i, false) ∈ T then 1 else 0) - (negativeAt T i).card := by
  classical
  unfold sumComponent
  have hpoint : ∀ j : StairRel r,
      staircaseF j (some i) =
        (if j = (i, false) then 1 else 0) -
          (if j.2 = true ∧ i ≤ j.1 then 1 else 0) := by
    rintro ⟨j, b⟩
    cases b
    · simp [staircaseF]
    · by_cases h : i ≤ j <;> simp [staircaseF, h]
  simp_rw [hpoint, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp [negativeAt]

theorem negativeAt_zero_eq_negativePart {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) :
    negativeAt T ⟨0, hr⟩ = negativePart T := by
  classical
  ext j
  simp only [negativeAt, negativePart, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hjT, hjNeg, -⟩
    exact ⟨hjT, hjNeg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hjT, hjNeg⟩
    refine ⟨hjT, hjNeg, ?_⟩
    change 0 ≤ j.1.val
    omega

theorem negativePart_card_le_one_of_sum_zero {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (T : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hzero : ∀ a : StairAction r, sumComponent T staircaseF a = 0) :
    (negativePart T).card ≤ 1 := by
  let i0 : Fin r := ⟨0, hr⟩
  have h := hzero (some i0)
  rw [staircase_sum_formula, negativeAt_zero_eq_negativePart hr] at h
  by_cases hp : (i0, false) ∈ T
  · simp [hp] at h
    have hcR : ((negativePart T).card : ℝ) = 1 := by linarith
    have hc : (negativePart T).card = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hcR
    omega
  · simp [hp] at h
    simp [h]

private theorem negativeAt_subset_negativePart {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (i : Fin r) :
    negativeAt T i ⊆ negativePart T := by
  intro j hj
  simp [negativeAt, negativePart] at hj ⊢
  exact ⟨hj.1, hj.2.1⟩

private theorem no_negative_of_negativePart_empty {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (hneg : negativePart T = ∅)
    (j : StairRel r) (hj : j ∈ T) : j.2 = false := by
  cases hb : j.2 with
  | false => simpa using hb
  | true =>
      have : j ∈ negativePart T := by simp [negativePart, hj, hb]
      simpa [hneg] using this

theorem sum_zero_and_no_negative_implies_empty {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hzero : ∀ a : StairAction r, sumComponent T staircaseF a = 0)
    (hneg : negativePart T = ∅) : T = ∅ := by
  classical
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
  intro hj
  have hb := no_negative_of_negativePart_empty T hneg j hj
  rcases j with ⟨i, b⟩
  simp only at hb
  subst b
  have h := hzero (some i)
  rw [staircase_sum_formula] at h
  have hAt : negativeAt T i = ∅ := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
    intro hx
    have hx' := negativeAt_subset_negativePart T i hx
    simpa [hneg] using hx'
  simp [hj, hAt] at h

private theorem negativePart_singleton_has_negative_second {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (j : StairRel r)
    (hneg : negativePart T = {j}) : j.2 = true := by
  have hj : j ∈ negativePart T := by simp [hneg]
  have hj' : j ∈ T ∧ j.2 = true := by
    simpa [negativePart] using hj
  exact hj'.2

private theorem negative_membership_of_singleton {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (t : Fin r)
    (hneg : negativePart T = {(t, true)}) (j : Fin r) :
    (j, true) ∈ T ↔ j = t := by
  constructor
  · intro hj
    have : (j, true) ∈ negativePart T := by simp [negativePart, hj]
    simpa [hneg] using this
  · intro hj
    subst j
    have : (t, true) ∈ negativePart T := by simp [hneg]
    have ht : (t, true) ∈ T ∧ (true = true) := by
      simpa [negativePart] using this
    exact ht.1

private theorem negativeAt_of_singleton {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (t i : Fin r)
    (hneg : negativePart T = {(t, true)}) :
    negativeAt T i = if i ≤ t then {(t, true)} else ∅ := by
  classical
  ext j
  rcases j with ⟨j, b⟩
  cases b
  · by_cases hit : i ≤ t <;> simp [negativeAt, hit]
  · by_cases hjt : j = t
    · subst j
      by_cases hit : i ≤ t <;>
        simp [negativeAt, negative_membership_of_singleton T t hneg, hit]
    · by_cases hit : i ≤ t <;>
        simp [negativeAt, negative_membership_of_singleton T t hneg, hit, hjt]

private theorem positive_membership_of_singleton {r : ℕ}
    (T : Finset (StairRel r)) (t i : Fin r)
    (hzero : ∀ a : StairAction r, sumComponent T staircaseF a = 0)
    (hneg : negativePart T = {(t, true)}) :
    (i, false) ∈ T ↔ i ≤ t := by
  have h := hzero (some i)
  rw [staircase_sum_formula, negativeAt_of_singleton T t i hneg] at h
  by_cases hit : i ≤ t <;> by_cases hp : (i, false) ∈ T <;>
    simp [hit, hp] at h ⊢

theorem sum_zero_set_eq_empty_or_staircaseBlock {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (T : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hzero : ∀ a : StairAction r, sumComponent T staircaseF a = 0) :
    T = ∅ ∨ ∃ t : Fin r, T = staircaseBlock t := by
  classical
  have hcard := negativePart_card_le_one_of_sum_zero hr T hzero
  interval_cases hc : (negativePart T).card
  · left
    apply sum_zero_and_no_negative_implies_empty T hzero
    exact Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc
  · right
    rcases Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc with ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hb := negativePart_singleton_has_negative_second T j hj
    rcases j with ⟨t, b⟩
    simp only at hb
    subst b
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    ext j
    rcases j with ⟨i, b⟩
    cases b
    · simp [staircaseBlock,
        positive_membership_of_singleton T t i hzero hj]
    · simp [staircaseBlock,
        negative_membership_of_singleton T t hj]

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseUnbounded

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralSupportOscMaxModularV1.lean (88 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanSupportGeometryV4»

/-!
# Support oscillation as a finite maximum of modular scenarios

This is an algorithmic bridge, not a novelty claim: an actual support-aware
compression radius is the maximum, over two feasible support worlds, of a
modular set function.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralSupportOscMaxModular

open scoped BigOperators
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry

variable {Ω I : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def directedSupportContrast (T : Finset I) (f : I → Ω → ℝ)
    (ab : Ω × Ω) : ℝ :=
  T.sum fun j ↦ f j ab.1 - f j ab.2

theorem directedSupportContrast_eq_sumComponent_sub
    (T : Finset I) (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (a b : Ω) :
    directedSupportContrast T f (a, b) =
      sumComponent T f a - sumComponent T f b := by
  simp [directedSupportContrast, sumComponent, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

/-- Exact finite identity: oscillation equals the largest directed pairwise
contrast on the feasible support. -/
theorem supportOsc_eq_max_directed_contrast
    (T : Finset I) (f : I → Ω → ℝ) :
    supportOsc T f = maxVal (directedSupportContrast T f) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rcases exists_eq_maxVal (sumComponent T f) with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases exists_eq_minVal (sumComponent T f) with ⟨b, hb⟩
    rw [supportOsc, osc, ← ha, ← hb,
      ← directedSupportContrast_eq_sumComponent_sub T f a b]
    exact le_maxVal (directedSupportContrast T f) (a, b)
  · apply maxVal_le
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    rw [directedSupportContrast_eq_sumComponent_sub]
    unfold supportOsc osc
    linarith [le_maxVal (sumComponent T f) a,
      minVal_le (sumComponent T f) b]

/-- Literal form requested for the CIG-AMF selected radius. -/
theorem two_selectedRadius_eq_max_pair_contrast
    (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (selected : Finset I) :
    2 * selectedRadius f selected =
      maxVal (directedSupportContrast selectedᶜ f) := by
  rw [selectedRadius, supportOsc_eq_max_directed_contrast]
  ring

/-- Scenario constant for the maximum-of-modular representation. -/
def scenarioConstant (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (ab : Ω × Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, (f j ab.1 - f j ab.2)

/-- Scenario coefficient removed when relation `j` is selected. -/
def scenarioCoefficient (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (ab : Ω × Ω) (j : I) : ℝ :=
  f j ab.1 - f j ab.2

theorem complement_contrast_eq_scenario_modular
    (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (selected : Finset I) (ab : Ω × Ω) :
    directedSupportContrast selectedᶜ f ab =
      scenarioConstant f ab - selected.sum (scenarioCoefficient f ab) := by
  classical
  let g : I → ℝ := fun j ↦ f j ab.1 - f j ab.2
  have hsum := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl selected g
  change selectedᶜ.sum g = (∑ j, g j) - selected.sum g
  linarith

/-- Actual `supportOsc` is a finite maximum of modular scenario objectives. -/
theorem two_selectedRadius_eq_max_modular_scenarios
    (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (selected : Finset I) :
    2 * selectedRadius f selected =
      maxVal (fun ab : Ω × Ω ↦
        scenarioConstant f ab - selected.sum (scenarioCoefficient f ab)) := by
  rw [two_selectedRadius_eq_max_pair_contrast]
  apply le_antisymm <;> apply maxVal_le <;> rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  · rw [complement_contrast_eq_scenario_modular]
    exact le_maxVal (fun ab : Ω × Ω ↦
      scenarioConstant f ab - selected.sum (scenarioCoefficient f ab)) (a, b)
  · rw [← complement_contrast_eq_scenario_modular]
    exact le_maxVal (directedSupportContrast selectedᶜ f) (a, b)

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralSupportOscMaxModular

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralToleranceBudgetNetV1.lean (128 dong)
import «LeanStructuralPrefixCoverUniversalUpperV1»

/-! A quantitative budget net for actual support radius. Uniformly small
component radii make one exact ranking cover a whole interval of budgets.
This upper bound does not assume monotonicity or submodularity of the objective. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralToleranceBudgetNet
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralOrdinaryChainCharacterization
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralMinimumTransversalWidth
noncomputable section
variable {I Ω : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]

lemma radius_nested_change (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (S T : Finset I) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    |selectedRadius f S-selectedRadius f T| ≤ ∑ i ∈ T\S,osc (f i)/2 := by
  have hd : Disjoint (Tᶜ) (T\S) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    exact (mem_compl.mp hi) (mem_sdiff.mp hj).1
  have hu : Tᶜ ∪ (T\S)=Sᶜ := by
    ext i
    by_cases hs : i ∈ S
    · simp [hs,hST hs]
    · by_cases ht : i ∈ T <;> simp [hs,ht]
  have he : sumComponent Sᶜ f = fun x => sumComponent Tᶜ f x+sumComponent (T\S) f x := by
    funext x
    simp only [sumComponent,← hu,sum_union hd]
  have hb := osc_add_deviation (sumComponent Tᶜ f) (sumComponent (T\S) f)
  rw [← he] at hb
  have hm := BH2_supportOsc_le_modularSpan (T\S) f
  change osc (sumComponent (T\S) f) ≤ ∑ i ∈ T\S,osc (f i) at hm
  simp only [selectedRadius,supportOsc,← sub_div,abs_div,show |(2:ℝ)|=2 by norm_num,← sum_div]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hb.trans hm) (by norm_num)

lemma radius_nested_uniform (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, osc (f i)/2 ≤ c) (S T : Finset I) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    |selectedRadius f S-selectedRadius f T| ≤ ((T.card-S.card : ℕ):ℝ)*c := by
  apply (radius_nested_change f S T hST).trans
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ T\S,osc (f i)/2) ≤ ∑ _i ∈ T\S,c := sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hc i)
    _ = ((T.card-S.card : ℕ):ℝ)*c := by simp [card_sdiff_of_subset hST]

/-- Every extension of a k-optimum is 2*c*(l-k)-optimal at budget l. -/
theorem optimal_extension (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, osc (f i)/2 ≤ c) (S P : Finset I) (hSP : S ⊆ P)
    (hopt : EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) 0 S.card S) :
    EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) (2*c*((P.card-S.card : ℕ):ℝ)) P.card P := by
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  obtain ⟨R,hRT,hR⟩ := T.exists_subset_card_eq (show S.card ≤ T.card by rw [hT];exact card_le_card hSP)
  have hmin := hopt.2 R hR
  have h1 := (abs_le.mp (radius_nested_uniform f c hc S P hSP)).1
  have h2 := (abs_le.mp (radius_nested_uniform f c hc R T hRT)).2
  rw [hT,hR] at h2
  nlinarith

lemma prefix_subset (r : List I) {k l : ℕ} (h : k ≤ l) : prefixSet r k ⊆ prefixSet r l := by
  intro i hi
  have hh : r.take k <+: r.take l := List.take_prefix_take_left h
  exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (hh.subset (List.mem_toFinset.mp hi))

lemma exact_ranking (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card I) :
    ∃ r : List I, IsFullRanking r ∧ EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) 0 k (prefixSet r k) := by
  let candidates : Finset (Finset I) := univ.filter (fun S => S.card=k)
  have hne : candidates.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨S,_,hs⟩ := (univ : Finset I).exists_subset_card_eq (by simpa using hk)
    exact ⟨S,by simp [candidates,hs]⟩
  obtain ⟨S,hs,hmin⟩ := exists_min_image candidates (selectedRadius f) hne
  have hcard : S.card=k := (mem_filter.mp hs).2
  have hchain : InclusionChain ({S} : Finset (Finset I)) := by
    intro A hA B hB
    simp only [mem_singleton] at hA hB
    subst A; subst B; exact Or.inl (Subset.rfl)
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hprefix⟩ := finite_inclusion_chain_extends_to_full_ranking {S} hchain
  have he : prefixSet r k=S := by rw [← hcard];exact hprefix S (by simp)
  refine ⟨r,hr,?_⟩
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨hcard,fun T hT => by simpa using hmin T (by simp [candidates,hT])⟩

/-- Spacing h yields at most floor(m/h)+1 rankings and tolerance 2*c*h.
For normalized balanced components c=O(1/m), taking h proportional to m
makes this bound independent of m at each fixed positive tolerance. -/
theorem budget_net_cover (f : I → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : ∀ i, osc (f i)/2 ≤ c) (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost (selectedRadius f) (2*c*h) (Fintype.card I/h+1) := by
  let B := Fin (Fintype.card I/h+1)
  have hex (b : B) : ∃ r : List I, IsFullRanking r ∧
      EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) 0 (b.val*h) (prefixSet r (b.val*h)) := by
    apply exact_ranking
    have hb : b.val ≤ Fintype.card I/h := by omega
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right h hb).trans (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _)
  choose r hr using hex
  let menu : Finset (List I) := univ.image r
  refine ⟨menu,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact card_image_le.trans (by simp [B])
  · exact image_nonempty.mpr univ_nonempty
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b,_,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp ha
    exact (hr b).1
  · intro k hk
    let b : B := ⟨k/h,by have hd : k/h ≤ Fintype.card I/h := Nat.div_le_div_right hk;omega⟩
    have hanchor : b.val*h ≤ k := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    have ha : b.val*h ≤ Fintype.card I := hanchor.trans hk
    have hkcard := CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural.prefixSet_card_of_full (r b) (hr b).1 k hk
    have hacard := CIGAMF.V4.AuxiliaryBH6Structural.prefixSet_card_of_full (r b) (hr b).1 (b.val*h) ha
    have ho : EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) 0
        (prefixSet (r b) (b.val*h)).card (prefixSet (r b) (b.val*h)) := by
      rw [hacard];exact (hr b).2
    have ht := optimal_extension f c hc _ _ (prefix_subset (r b) hanchor) ho
    rw [hkcard,hacard] at ht
    have hrem : k-b.val*h ≤ h := by
      dsimp [b]
      rw [← Nat.mod_eq_sub_div_mul]
      exact (Nat.mod_lt k hh).le
    have heps : 2*c*((k-b.val*h : ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 2*c*h :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hrem) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨r b,mem_image.mpr ⟨b,mem_univ _,rfl⟩,ht.1,?_⟩
    intro T hT
    have hb := ht.2 T hT
    linarith

#print axioms radius_nested_change
#print axioms optimal_extension
#print axioms budget_net_cover
end
end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralToleranceBudgetNet

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralUnbalancedToleranceUpperV1.lean (66 dong)
import «LeanStructuralOrderedRadiusChainV1»
import «LeanPrefixBudgetMetricCoverV1»

/-! Dimension-free tolerance upper bound without component balance. Sorted
radii are a coordinate order, not an equal-weight assumption. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnbalancedToleranceUpper
open scoped BigOperators
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension CIGAMF.P13.StructuralToleranceBudgetNet
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralOrderedRadiusStep CIGAMF.P13.StructuralOrderedRadiusChain
open CIGAMF.P13.PrefixBudgetMetricCover
noncomputable section
variable {m : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]

def potential (c : Fin m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) := ∑ z ∈ range k,charge c z

lemma charge_nonneg (c : Fin m → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ charge c k := by
  have hw (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ weight c j := by
    unfold weight
    split_ifs
    · exact hc _
    · exact le_rfl
  exact add_nonneg (hw _) (hw _)

lemma potential_mono (c : Fin m → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) : Monotone (potential c) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro k
  simp only [potential,sum_range_succ]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (charge_nonneg c hc k)

lemma accumulated_eq (c : Fin m → ℝ) (a t : ℕ) :
    accumulated c a t=potential c (a+t)-potential c a := by
  unfold accumulated potential
  rw [sum_range_add]
  ring

theorem sorted_unbalanced_upper (f : Fin m → Ω → ℝ) (c : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hc : Monotone c) (hc0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hf : ∀ i, osc (f i)/2 ≤ c i) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost (selectedRadius f) eps (⌊(2*∑ i,c i)/eps⌋₊+1) := by
  have hpot : potential c m=2*∑ i,c i := total_charge c
  rw [← hpot]
  have hanch : ∀ a, a ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m) → ∃ r : List (Fin m), IsFullRanking r ∧
      ∀ k, a ≤ k → k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin m) →
        EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) (potential c k-potential c a) k (prefixSet r k) := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨r,hr,ho⟩ := exact_ranking f a ha
    let S := prefixSet r a
    have hcard : S.card=a := ho.1
    have hS : EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius f) 0 S.card S := by rw [hcard];exact ho
    obtain ⟨r',hr',hall⟩ := anchored_ranking f c hc hf S hS
    refine ⟨r',hr',?_⟩
    intro k hak hk
    have hsum : S.card+(k-a)=k := by omega
    have h := hall (k-a) (by simpa [hsum] using hk)
    rw [accumulated_eq,hsum,hcard] at h
    exact h
  have hh := metric_cover (selectedRadius f) (potential c) (potential_mono c hc0)
    (fun k => sum_nonneg (fun z _ => charge_nonneg c hc0 z)) hanch eps heps
  simpa using hh

#print axioms accumulated_eq
#print axioms sorted_unbalanced_upper
end
end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnbalancedToleranceUpper

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanStructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamilyV1.lean (143 dong)
import Mathlib
import «LeanStructuralStaircaseUnboundedV1»
import «LeanStructuralPrefixCoverDimensionV1»

/-!
# An actual supportOsc family with unbounded prefix-cover dimension

For every positive `r`, the staircase construction has `r` distinct budget
layers with forced unique zero-radius optima.  Those optima are pairwise
incomparable, so fewer than `r` full rankings cannot hit every layer.
-/

namespace CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamily

open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralGeometryWitnesses
open CIGAMF.V4.StructuralRankability
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralPrefixCoverDimension
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseFamily
open CIGAMF.P13.StructuralStaircaseUnbounded

private theorem osc_zero_eq_anchor
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (anchor : Ω) (h : osc g = 0) :
    ∀ a, g a = g anchor := by
  have hEq : maxVal g = minVal g := by
    simpa [osc] using sub_eq_zero.mp h
  intro a
  linarith [minVal_le g a, le_maxVal g a,
    minVal_le g anchor, le_maxVal g anchor]

theorem omitted_sum_zero_of_radius_zero {r : ℕ}
    (S : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hzero : selectedRadius staircaseF S = 0) :
    ∀ a : StairAction r, sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF a = 0 := by
  have hosc : osc (sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF) = 0 := by
    unfold selectedRadius supportOsc at hzero
    linarith
  have hconst := osc_zero_eq_anchor (sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF) none hosc
  intro a
  calc
    sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF a =
        sumComponent Sᶜ staircaseF none := hconst a
    _ = 0 := by simp [sumComponent, staircaseF]

theorem staircaseSelected_unique_optimal {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (t : Fin r) (S : Finset (StairRel r))
    (hOptimal : EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius staircaseF) 0
      (staircaseSelected t).card S) :
    S = staircaseSelected t := by
  have hle := hOptimal.2 (staircaseSelected t) rfl
  rw [staircaseSelected_radius_zero] at hle
  have hnonneg := selectedRadius_nonneg staircaseF S
  have hzero : selectedRadius staircaseF S = 0 := by linarith
  have hsum := omitted_sum_zero_of_radius_zero S hzero
  have hcardCompl : Sᶜ.card = (staircaseSelected t)ᶜ.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_compl, Finset.card_compl, hOptimal.1]
  rcases sum_zero_set_eq_empty_or_staircaseBlock hr Sᶜ hsum with hempty | ⟨s, hs⟩
  · have hright : (staircaseSelected t)ᶜ.card = t.val + 2 := by
      simp [staircaseSelected, staircaseBlock_card]
    rw [hempty] at hcardCompl
    simp [hright] at hcardCompl
  · have hst : s = t := by
      have hc : s.val + 2 = t.val + 2 := by
        calc
          s.val + 2 = (staircaseBlock s).card := (staircaseBlock_card s).symm
          _ = Sᶜ.card := by rw [hs]
          _ = (staircaseSelected t)ᶜ.card := hcardCompl
          _ = (staircaseBlock t).card := by simp [staircaseSelected]
          _ = t.val + 2 := staircaseBlock_card t
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    subst s
    apply compl_injective
    simpa [staircaseSelected] using hs

private theorem prefixSet_mono_staircase {r : ℕ}
    (ranking : List (StairRel r)) {k l : ℕ} (hkl : k ≤ l) :
    prefixSet ranking k ⊆ prefixSet ranking l := by
  intro x hx
  have hp : ranking.take k <+: ranking.take l :=
    List.take_prefix_take_left hkl
  have hxList : x ∈ ranking.take k := by simpa [prefixSet] using hx
  have : x ∈ ranking.take l := hp.subset hxList
  simpa [prefixSet] using this

/-- The explicit family is unbounded: at parameter `r`, its zero-tolerance
prefix-cover dimension is at least `r`. -/
theorem STRUCT_UNBOUNDED_staircase_prefix_dimension_ge {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ¬ PrefixCoverDimensionAtMost (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0
      (r - 1) := by
  classical
  intro hDim
  rcases hDim with ⟨menu, hMenuCard, hCover⟩
  have hLayer : ∀ t : Fin r,
      ∃ ranking ∈ menu,
        EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0
          (staircaseSelected t).card
          (prefixSet ranking (staircaseSelected t).card) := by
    intro t
    exact hCover.2.2 (staircaseSelected t).card
      (Finset.card_le_univ (staircaseSelected t))
  let rankFor : Fin r → List (StairRel r) := fun t => Classical.choose (hLayer t)
  have rankFor_mem (t : Fin r) : rankFor t ∈ menu :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hLayer t)).1
  have rankFor_opt (t : Fin r) :
      EpsilonOptimalAt (selectedRadius (staircaseF (r := r))) 0
        (staircaseSelected t).card
        (prefixSet (rankFor t) (staircaseSelected t).card) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hLayer t)).2
  have rankFor_prefix (t : Fin r) :
      prefixSet (rankFor t) (staircaseSelected t).card =
        staircaseSelected t :=
    staircaseSelected_unique_optimal hr t _ (rankFor_opt t)
  have rankFor_injective : Function.Injective rankFor := by
    intro s t heq
    by_contra hst
    by_cases hcard : (staircaseSelected s).card ≤ (staircaseSelected t).card
    · have hsub : staircaseSelected s ⊆ staircaseSelected t := by
        rw [← rankFor_prefix s, ← rankFor_prefix t, heq]
        exact prefixSet_mono_staircase (rankFor t) hcard
      exact staircaseSelected_incomparable hst hsub
    · have hcard' : (staircaseSelected t).card ≤ (staircaseSelected s).card := by omega
      have hsub : staircaseSelected t ⊆ staircaseSelected s := by
        rw [← rankFor_prefix t, ← rankFor_prefix s, ← heq]
        exact prefixSet_mono_staircase (rankFor s) hcard'
      exact staircaseSelected_incomparable (Ne.symm hst) hsub
  let used : Finset (List (StairRel r)) := Finset.univ.image rankFor
  have hUsedCard : used.card = r := by
    unfold used
    rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
    · simp
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact rankFor_injective hab
  have hUsedSubset : used ⊆ menu := by
    intro ranking hranking
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hranking with ⟨t, -, rfl⟩
    exact rankFor_mem t
  have hLower := Finset.card_le_card hUsedSubset
  rw [hUsedCard] at hLower
  omega

end CIGAMF.P13.StructuralUnboundedPrefixCoverFamily

########## FILE: work/p13_conjectures/LeanSupportAdaptiveQuerySeparationV1.lean (119 dong)
import «LeanSupportMultiTipGeometryV1»

/-! Sharp deterministic membership decision-tree cost in actual support geometry.
Dense supports (all tips but one) have pairwise incompatible safe decisions,
yet require m-1 queries. This contrasts with the one-query sparse family whose
minimal bad fibre has size m. Queries here are individual tip memberships. -/
namespace CIGAMF.P13.SupportAdaptiveQuerySeparation
open Finset
open CIGAMF.V4.SupportGeometry
open CIGAMF.P13.SupportUnboundedObstruction (tip)
open CIGAMF.P13.SupportMultiTipGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {m : ℕ}

inductive Tree (m : ℕ) where
  | leaf : Fin m → Tree m
  | ask : Fin m → Tree m → Tree m → Tree m

def depth : Tree m → ℕ
  | .leaf _ => 0
  | .ask _ no yes => max (depth no) (depth yes)+1

def run (oracle : Fin m → Bool) : Tree m → Fin m
  | .leaf j => j
  | .ask a no yes => if oracle a then run oracle yes else run oracle no

def positiveQueries : Tree m → Finset (Fin m)
  | .leaf _ => ∅
  | .ask a _ yes => insert a (positiveQueries yes)

def positiveOutput : Tree m → Fin m
  | .leaf j => j
  | .ask _ _ yes => positiveOutput yes
